title: Improving the Diversity of LLM Outputs without a Trade-off
summary: We propose DAST (Diversifying Arithmetic Sampling with TokenTour), a method that increases the diversity of LLM outputs without any change to the marginal distribution and with negligible generation-time overhead (a few microseconds). We observe that token IDs are often arranged in a meaningless order and reassign them so that tokens with similar meanings appear consecutively. This can be done in advance in a few hundred seconds per model, and the resulting order can be reused for all subsequent generations. By combining this order with arithmetic sampling (or quasi-Monte Carlo methods), we make similar tokens less likely to be generated across runs while preserving the distribution. Our method not only produces qualitatively good ideas but also significantly improves performance on the downstream task of ProtoQA.

AI.tldr: 提出DAST方法，通过重排token ID顺序并结合算术采样，在不改变边缘分布、几乎无额外开销的前提下提升LLM输出多样性。
AI.motivation: LLM生成时输出多样性不足，而现有提升多样性的方法往往会改变输出分布或带来较高的生成开销。
AI.method: 观察到token ID排列顺序往往无意义，将语义相似的token重新排列为连续顺序，该重排可预先按模型完成（每个模型数百秒）并复用于所有后续生成；再将该顺序与算术采样（或拟蒙特卡洛方法）结合，在保持分布不变的情况下降低不同运行间相似token被生成的概率。
AI.result: 生成多样性提升且不改变边缘分布，生成开销仅增加几微秒；生成的想法在质量上表现良好，并在ProtoQA下游任务上显著提升性能。
AI.conclusion: DAST是一种低开销、分布保真的LLM输出多样化方法，在创意生成与ProtoQA任务上均有效。

title: Pinned and Still Unstable: Within-Judge Verdict Variance and the Noise Floor of LLM-as-Judge Leaderboards
comment: v2: corrects reporting details (claim provenance, candidate generation cap, top-K ties, data completeness, abort threshold, model aliases) and clarifies wording; no new experiments, within-judge variance results unchanged. Changes are listed in Appendix D. 32 pages, 3 figures
summary: Modern LLM evaluation assumes that pinning a judge to a fixed model version and decoding at temperature zero yields reproducible verdicts. We show this assumption fails as a property of how LLM-as-Judge is operationalized on cloud serving infrastructure, not of any particular model family. Across four frontier judges served via a single major enterprise cloud platform and three standard benchmarks (Arena-Hard, AlpacaEval 2, MT-Bench), identical inputs to the same temperature-zero judge, at a constant serving-reported model version, produce different verdicts across re-runs: per-item flip rates of roughly 5% on average and about 40% on the close-call items that decide leaderboard margins, with a per-judge magnitude spanning a 40x range (0.13% to nearly 10%). We introduce metrics tailored to this instability: per-item flip rate, a two-part stability profile (waver fraction and conditional intensity), and adjacency separability. For the principal judge the aggregate ranking is stable (0% top-K instability, 0% pooled winner flip); what degrades is precision: under a paired hierarchical bootstrap, roughly one-fifth to three-quarters of adjacent leaderboard positions are statistically indistinguishable, a noise floor driven mainly by finite prompt sampling rather than the judge. Across judges, leaderboards agree on the coarse ordering but diverge in the middle (Kendall's tau of 0.42-0.64 between Gemini and Sonnet judges on Arena-Hard, values sensitive to answers truncated at the generation cap). Of 15 expected head-to-head orderings we re-judge, 12 survive every re-run of the principal judge but only 8 survive every judge. Leaderboards thus report unhedged point estimates that overstate their precision. We propose a minimal, low-cost reporting protocol: several judge re-runs, published stability profiles and adjacency intervals, and results under at least two judges from different families.

AI.tldr: 固定模型版本+温度0的LLM-as-Judge评测并不能保证可复现：同一云端平台上四个前沿评判模型在三个基准上对相同输入重跑会产生不同判定，平均逐项翻转率约5%，接近判定项约40%，且评判模型间波动幅度相差40倍；排行榜聚合排序稳定但相邻名次常不可区分，故应公开多次重跑、稳定性画像与邻接区间，并至少用两个不同家族的评判模型。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM评测普遍假设"固定评判模型版本+温度0解码"即可获得可复现的判定结果，并据此发布排行榜点估计。作者要检验这一假设是否成立，并论证其失效并非某个模型家族的特性，而是LLM-as-Judge在云端推理基础设施上被操作化的方式所致。
AI.method: 在单一主流企业云平台上调用四个前沿评判模型，对Arena-Hard、AlpacaEval 2、MT-Bench三个标准基准，在服务上报的模型版本恒定、温度设为0的条件下，对完全相同的输入重复判定。提出面向该不稳定性的三项指标：逐项翻转率(per-item flip rate)、两部分稳定性画像(摇摆比例waver fraction与条件强度conditional intensity)、邻接可分性(adjacency separability)。采用配对层次自助法(paired hierarchical bootstrap)评估相邻名次差异的显著性，并跨评判模型比较排行榜(Kendall's tau)。
AI.result: 相同输入、相同零温度、相同上报版本下重跑产生不同判定：平均逐项翻转率约5%，决定排行榜差距的接近判定项约40%，各评判模型幅度跨越40倍区间(0.13%至近10%)。主评判模型的聚合排序保持稳定(前K不稳定率0%，汇总胜者翻转率0%)，退化的是精度：配对层次自助法下约五分之一至四分之三的相邻名次在统计上不可区分，噪声底主要来自有限的提示采样而非评判模型本身。跨评判模型层面，排行榜在粗粒度顺序上一致但中段分歧(Kendall's tau为0.42–0.64)，且取值受生成上限截断答案影响。15组预期的两两排序中，12组在主评判模型每次重跑下均存活，但仅8组在全部评判模型下存活。
AI.conclusion: LLM-as-Judge的可复现性不是模型属性而是服务化操作方式的属性；排行榜目前发布的是未经对冲的点估计，夸大了自身精度。作者建议采用低成本的最小报告协议：多次评判重跑、公开稳定性画像与邻接区间、并至少报告来自两个不同模型家族的评判结果。

title: SharedSAE: a unified sparse dictionary across u-net blocks and denoising time for diffusion models
summary: Concept representations in diffusion models drift across network depth and denoising time, yet existing sparse autoencoders offer only per-block or per-timestep dictionaries, leaving no single feature dictionary for localization and intervention in the network. We present Shared Sparse Autoencoder (SharedSAE), which learns one sparse dictionary shared across four U-Net attention blocks and all 50 denoising steps of SDXL 1.0. A block-specific low-rank input adapter aligns the residual distribution of each block before the shared encoder, and a temporal conditioning module with a shared timestep branch and a block-timestep correction branch absorbs temporal non-stationarity. Despite spanning both axes, Shared SAE preserves a coherent dictionary structure. Built on the shared dictionary, localized feature suppression reduces the number of NudeNet-positive generations in the I2P detector-positive subset from 139 to 1. Tracing sparse features across the trajectory further reveals that concept representations are redistributed across U-Net blocks during generation, shifting from the earliest downsampling block toward intermediate and later blocks as denoising proceeds. SharedSAE thus provides a unified, interpretable, and intervention-ready representation space for diffusion models, enabling concept analysis and erasure at any covered block and denoising step.

AI.tldr: 提出 SharedSAE，用跨四个 U-Net 注意力块与全部 50 个去噪步共享的稀疏字典，实现扩散模型概念表征的统一定位与干预。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的概念表征随网络深度和去噪时间漂移，而现有稀疏自编码器只提供逐块或逐时间步的字典，缺乏可用于网络定位和干预的单一特征字典。
AI.method: 学习一个跨 SDXL 1.0 四个 U-Net 注意力块及 50 个去噪步共享的稀疏字典；用块特定低秩输入适配器对齐各块残差分布，并用含共享时间步分支与块-时间步校正分支的时间条件模块吸收时间非平稳性。
AI.result: 跨两轴仍保持连贯字典结构；基于共享字典的局部特征抑制将 I2P 检测器阳性子集中 NudeNet 阳性生成数从 139 降至 1；追踪稀疏特征发现概念表征在生成过程中从最早下采样块向中间及较晚块重新分配。
AI.conclusion: SharedSAE 为扩散模型提供了统一、可解释且可干预的表征空间，支持在任意覆盖的块和去噪步进行概念分析与擦除。

title: Reading Too Much into Context: Passive Exposure Can Steer LLM Decisions
summary: Large language model (LLM) assistants can now search the web and consult external sources while completing user requests. These sources can provide useful evidence, but they can also introduce additional content into the model's context. Can such passive exposure steer a decision even when the added content provides no reason to change it? We examine the stability of model decisions on the same tasks with and without such external content. Across all open-weight and closed-weight models we test, exposure systematically shifts decisions, with effects reaching nearly 50 percentage points in closed-weight models. The same pattern appears with real-world online opinions. The influence also extends beyond subjective preferences. Such exposure can steer models toward choices that violate explicit user requirements and increase their acceptance of false claims. In short, what enters an LLM's context can influence its decision even when it should not determine it.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM助手在联网检索外部信息时，无关内容是否会影响其决策，发现被动接触会系统性改变模型判断，效应最高近50个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM助手在完成任务时可检索并引用外部来源，这些来源虽可提供证据，但也向模型上下文引入额外内容。作者关注的问题是：当新增内容并未提供任何改变决策的理由时，这种被动接触是否仍会左右模型的判断。
AI.method: 在相同任务上对比模型在有、无此类外部内容条件下的决策稳定性，覆盖多个开放权重与闭源模型，并进一步使用真实世界网络观点进行验证，同时考察其对主观偏好之外决策的影响。
AI.result: 所有被测试的开放权重和闭源模型均出现决策系统性偏移，闭源模型的效应最高接近50个百分点；使用真实网络观点时呈现相同模式；该影响还使模型倾向于违背用户明确要求，并提高对虚假陈述的接受度。
AI.conclusion: 进入LLM上下文的内容会影响其决策，即便这些内容本不应成为决策依据。

title: Algorithmic Harms Associated with Generative Model-Augmented Recommendation Systems
comment: Presented at the KDD 2025 Workshop on Online and Adaptive Recommender Systems (OARS), August 3, 2025, Toronto, Ontario, Canada
summary: In this work, we consider algorithmic harms that may arise as generative models are incorporated into machine learning platforms. We argue that existing harm taxonomies and threat models require extension to (1) address novel causal drivers of well-studied representational and quality-of-service harms; and (2) anticipate and mitigate endogenous harms, such as sanitization, which may arise when system inputs are misaligned with the system designer's objectives, or the generative model's inductive priors. To this end, we introduce an expanded taxonomy of algorithmic harms associated with the use of generative models in non-conversational recommendation systems. In addition, we offer a causal analysis of how problematic subsets of the (input, output) joint distribution can arise, in an effort to inform harms detection and mitigation efforts.

AI.tldr: 本文针对生成模型进入机器学习平台后的算法危害问题，指出既有危害分类与威胁模型需扩展，提出面向非对话式推荐系统的扩展危害分类体系，并对（输入，输出）联合分布中问题子集的成因进行因果分析。
AI.motivation: 生成模型被整合进机器学习平台后，产生了既有危害分类学与威胁模型未能覆盖的新问题，需要扩展以应对新型因果驱动的危害及内生危害。
AI.method: 其一，构建扩展的算法危害分类学，涵盖生成模型在非对话式推荐系统中的使用；其二，对（输入，输出）联合分布中问题子集的出现方式进行因果分析。
AI.result: 提出扩展的危害分类体系，识别出既有表征危害与服务质量危害的新型因果驱动因素，并刻画了如"净化"（sanitization）等内生危害，即当系统输入与设计者目标或生成模型归纳先验不一致时产生的危害。
AI.conclusion: 既有危害与威胁模型需扩展以覆盖生成模型带来的新型与内生危害；扩展分类学与因果分析可为危害的检测与缓解提供依据。

title: NutriVision: Ingredient-Conditioned Fusion and Prediction for Single-Image Food Nutrition Estimation
summary: Nutrition estimation is a fundamental task in consumer diet tracking, clinical dietetics, chronic disease management, sports and hospital nutrition, and broader food computing systems. The existing approaches have progressed along two largely separate axes, vision models that rely on calibrated RGB-depth captures and ingredient-aware methods that use textual cues but use limited multimodal fusion. We introduce NutriVision, an end-to-end framework that leverages visual geometry and ingredient semantics to estimate calories, mass, fat content, carbohydrates, and protein from a single RGB image and an optional ingredient list. It obtains the unavailable depth modality using DepthAnything-V3 and encodes ingredient descriptions using CLIP. It integrates three complementary mechanisms: (1) an \emph{Ingredient-Conditioned Frequency-Aligned Fusion Module (IC-FAFM)}, which uses textual guidance to reweight and align RGB-depth frequency components; (2) an \emph{Ingredient-Aware Mask-based Prediction Head (IA-MPH)}, whose gating and channel masks are conditioned on food identity; and (3) modality-specific \emph{Internal Semantic Modeling (ISM)} blocks. On the Nutrition5k dataset, NutriVision achieves a mean PMAE of $\mathbf{13.60\pm0.10\%}$, outperforming our IGSMNet implementation by $0.89$ percentage points and OmniFood8k by $2.90$ percentage points (both $p<0.001$). The module-level ablations identify the ingredient-aware prediction head as the primary architectural contributor, improving mean PMAE by $1.50\pm0.17$ percentage points ($p<0.001$). These results demonstrate that ingredient-conditioned prediction and frequency-aware RGB-depth fusion provide measurable gains for single-image nutrient estimation. More broadly, NutriVision offers a practical route toward nutrition-assessment systems that exploit geometric and semantic cues without requiring specialized depth-sensing hardware

AI.tldr: NutriVision：单张RGB图像+可选配料表，用DepthAnything-V3生成深度、CLIP编码配料，通过IC-FAFM、IA-MPH、ISM三模块融合，Nutrition5k上PMAE 13.60±0.10%。
AI.motivation: 营养估计是饮食追踪、临床营养、慢病管理、运动与医院营养等场景的基础任务。现有方法沿两条相对独立的路线发展：依赖标定RGB-D采集的视觉模型，以及使用文本线索但多模态融合有限的配料感知方法，二者未有效结合，且通常需要专用深度传感硬件。
AI.method: 端到端框架NutriVision，仅用单张RGB图像和可选配料表估计热量、质量、脂肪、碳水与蛋白质。用DepthAnything-V3获取缺失的深度模态，用CLIP编码配料描述。集成三个机制：(1) Ingredient-Conditioned Frequency-Aligned Fusion Module (IC-FAFM)，以文本引导对RGB-深度频率分量重加权与对齐；(2) Ingredient-Aware Mask-based Prediction Head (IA-MPH)，其门控与通道掩码由食物身份条件化；(3) 模态特定的Internal Semantic Modeling (ISM)块。
AI.result: Nutrition5k上平均PMAE为13.60±0.10%，比其IGSMNet实现优0.89个百分点，比OmniFood8k优2.90个百分点（均p<0.001）。模块级消融显示配料感知预测头是主要架构贡献，使平均PMAE改善1.50±0.17个百分点（p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 配料条件化预测与频率感知的RGB-深度融合能为单图营养估计带来可量化增益。NutriVision为在无需专用深度传感硬件的前提下利用几何与语义线索的营养评估系统提供了可行路径。

title: Parameter-Efficient 3D Segmentation of Liver and Liver tumors: Depthwise factorization Scales Better Than Dense Convolution with Spatial Dimensionality
summary: Three-dimensional dense convolutional networks are the strongest performers on volumetric medical image segmentation, but their parameter counts scale poorly: moving a dense k x k convolution to k x k x k multiplies its weights by k. We observe that depthwise separable factorization does not share this penalty. Because the cubic kernel term applies only to the depthwise stage while the pointwise projection, which dominates the parameter count, is unchanged, the same architecture grows by 5 % from 2D to 3D where a dense convolutional U-Net grows by 200 %. We exploit this asymmetry to build a 3D U-Net with 536,990 parameters, 24x fewer than an identical dense 3D U-Net. On MSD Task03 Liver (the Medical Segmentation Decathlon liver task, derived from LiTS), evaluated per case under five-fold cross-validation over all 131 public volumes, the model reaches a tumor Dice of 0.577 (95% CI [0.518, 0.633]) and a liver Dice of 0.947 (95% CI [0.941, 0.952]). Its liver Dice exceeds previously reported performance. Its tumor Dice exceeds their low-resolution configuration (0.4701) by 0.107 and their 2D configuration (0.5394), at approximately one twenty-fourth of the parameters and roughly half the in-plane resolution. Trained under identical conditions on a common held-out split, it exceeds a dense 3D U-Net on liver by +0.031 Dice (paired p = 0.006) and on tumor by +0.041 (95 % CI [+0.005, +0.081], paired p = 0.056), suggesting the factorization also acts as a regularizer in the small-data regime characteristic of medical imaging. We further show, on both LiTS and a 2D endoscopy benchmark, that a large fraction of the network's learnable spatial filters can be replaced by fixed shifts at no cost in accuracy, but that replacing all of them is measurably worse, the placement of spatial capacity matters more than its total amount.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用深度可分离卷积的非对称参数增长特性，构建仅536,990参数的3D U-Net，在肝脏肿瘤分割任务上以约1/24参数量超越密集卷积基线。
AI.motivation: 3D密集卷积网络在体积医学图像分割中性能最优，但参数随卷积核维数激增：从k×k扩展到k×k×k会使权重成倍增长，导致模型庞大、难以在小样本医学数据上训练。作者希望找到一种从2D到3D参数增长代价极小的架构方案。
AI.method: 作者观察到深度可分离因式分解不承担这一参数惩罚：三次方核项仅作用于深度卷积阶段，而占主导参数量的逐点投影保持不变，故同架构从2D到3D仅增长5%，而密集卷积U-Net增长200%。基于该非对称性，构建参数量为536,990的3D U-Net。在MSD Task03 Liver（源自LiTS）上采用五折交叉验证逐例评估全部131例公开体积。此外在LiTS与一个2D内窥镜基准上，测试用固定位移替换部分可学习空间滤波器的影响。
AI.result: 模型达到肿瘤Dice 0.577（95% CI [0.518, 0.633]），肝脏Dice 0.947（95% CI [0.941, 0.952]）。肝脏Dice超过此前报告性能；肿瘤Dice比其低分辨率配置（0.4701）高0.107，优于其2D配置（0.5394），且参数量约为其1/24、面内分辨率约为其一半。在共同留出划分下相同条件训练，较密集3D U-Net肝脏+0.031 Dice（配对p=0.006）、肿瘤+0.041（95% CI [+0.005, +0.081]，配对p=0.056）。在LiTS与2D内窥镜基准上，大部分可学习空间滤波器可替换为固定位移而精度不降，但全部替换则明显变差。
AI.conclusion: 深度可分离因式分解在3D医学图像分割中可显著压缩参数量并保持甚至提升精度，在小样本医学数据场景下还可能起到正则化作用。此外，空间容量的"放置位置"比其总量更重要——部分滤波器可被固定位移替代而无损精度，但不可全部替代。该结论在肝脏分割与2D内窥镜基准上均得到验证。

title: Emo-Jev: Probabilistic Reasoning for Emotion Classification with Jev
summary: Jev offers an alternative interface for language understanding: given an input and predefined questions, it returns probabilistic decisions rather than free-form responses. Whether this interface can support effective reasoning for text classification against leading LLMs remains an open questions. We introduce Emo-Jev, a training-free framework with two complementary implementations. Emo-Jev-D decomposes classification into task-specific atomic judgments and composes their probabilities into a final prediction. Emo-Jev-SC constructs multiple judgment paths from complementary perspectives and aggregates their predictions into a consensus decision. We evaluate Emo-Jev on eight datasets spanning sentiment analysis, emotion recognition, sarcasm detection and humor detection, comparing against direct Jev classification and five SoTA LLMs under input/output and chain-of-thought reasoning. Standard Jev achieves 62.93\% average macro-F1 versus 67.28\% for the strongest LLM baseline, with lower observed latency and generally lower cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练框架 Emo-Jev（含分解式 D 与多路径共识 SC 两种实现），将 Jev 概率判定接口用于文本分类，在 8 个情感相关数据集上系统评估其相对直接 Jev 分类与五种 SoTA LLM 的表现。
AI.motivation: Jev 以"给定输入与预设问题返回概率化判定"替代自由生成，这一接口能否支撑有效的文本分类推理、并与领先 LLM 竞争，尚属开放问题，需要实证检验。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架 Emo-Jev，包含两种互补实现：Emo-Jev-D 将分类任务分解为任务特定的原子判定，并把各判定概率组合为最终预测；Emo-Jev-SC 从互补视角构造多条判定路径，聚合其预测形成共识决策。在 8 个数据集（情感分析、情绪识别、讽刺检测、幽默检测）上，与直接 Jev 分类及五种 SoTA LLM（输入/输出式与思维链推理两种设定）对比。
AI.result: 标准 Jev 平均宏 F1 为 62.93%，最强 LLM 基线为 67.28%；Jev 侧观察到的时延更低，成本总体也更低。
AI.conclusion: Jev 式概率判定接口在文本分类上尚不及最强 LLM 基线（宏 F1 低约 4.35 个百分点），但在时延与成本上具优势；Emo-Jev 的分解与多路径共识设计为提升该接口的推理能力提供了可行方向。

title: SemReward-VL: Semantic Reward-Guided Video-Language Adaptation for Developmental Behavior Assessment
summary: Developmental screening videos show how children perform specific behaviors, but clinical records usually contain outcomes rather than descriptions of what happened. We present SemReward-VL, which learns to describe item-specific behavior from these outcomes. A vision-language model generates a description, and a frozen language model scores its agreement with the clinical outcome, relevance to the item, abstention on unrelated video-item pairs, and clarity. Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) updates LoRA adapters using this semantic reward. On 13,379 videos covering 41 items, the method improves aggregate accuracy and the number of items with recall above 0.5. Errors remain in temporal direction, duration, and age-specific interpretations of behavior.

AI.tldr: SemReward-VL通过语义奖励驱动的GRPO微调视觉语言模型，从临床筛查结果中学习描述儿童行为，在13,379段视频上提升了准确率。
AI.motivation: 临床记录通常只包含筛查结果，而缺少对儿童具体行为表现的描述，导致行为细节信息缺失。需要一种能从结果反推行为描述的方法。
AI.method: 使用视觉语言模型生成行为描述，由冻结的语言模型从四方面打分构成语义奖励：与临床结果的一致性、与筛查条目的相关性、对无关视频-条目对的弃答、描述的清晰度；再用组相对策略优化（GRPO）基于该奖励更新LoRA适配器。
AI.result: 在涵盖41个条目、13,379段视频的数据集上，方法提升了总体准确率以及召回率超过0.5的条目数量；错误仍存在于时间方向、持续时长和年龄特异性行为解读方面。
AI.conclusion: 基于语义奖励的强化学习可有效利用临床结果监督提升行为描述质量，但时间与年龄相关语义仍是未来改进方向。

title: dKFD: Phase-Structured Evidence Allocation for Fixed-Budget Localized Event Understanding
summary: Sparse video understanding often requires selecting a small set of visual evidence under a fixed frame budget. Most sparse selectors allocate this budget globally, allowing all frames to compete with one another. For temporally localized events, this can be a poor inductive bias: useful evidence is often distributed across pre-event context, the event itself, and post-event consequences. We study fixed-budget evidence allocation for localized event videos and show that globally competitive Top-$K$ selectors can preserve recognition and grounding while producing unstable event evidence. On DoTA Video Anomaly Recognition, Global Top-$K$ obtains competitive recognition and temporal grounding, but low selector-event alignment at $K=12$ (Frame AUC $51.5 \pm 10.8$). We propose dKFD, a phase-structured differentiable selector that reserves evidence capacity across pre-event, event, and post-event phases after full-sequence temporal encoding. Under matched-budget multi-seed evaluation, dKFD improves Frame AUC by $+30.97$ over a matched Global Top-$K$ selector at $K=12$ ($p<0.01$), while yielding modest but statistically significant recognition gains and comparable temporal grounding. Mechanism ablations show that phase supervision is load-bearing: removing it reduces Frame AUC to $41.1 \pm 12.0$ even when phase-partitioned budgets are retained. Downstream diagnostics on VRU-Accident show consistent gains over learned Global Top-$K$ across VLM families, while dense captioning reveals a boundary condition where uniform sampling remains competitive. These results support phase-structured allocation as a controlled fixed-budget approach for event-centric sparse evidence selection, not as a universal video summarization strategy.

AI.tldr: 针对局部化事件视频的固定预算证据选择，论文指出全局竞争的Top-K选择器虽能保持识别与定位性能，却产生不稳定的事件证据；提出相位结构化的可微分选择器dKFD，将证据容量分配至事件前、事件中、事件后三个阶段，在DoTA上大幅提升选择器-事件对齐度。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视频理解需在固定帧预算下选择少量视觉证据。主流稀疏选择器采用全局竞争分配预算，但这对时间局部化事件是较差的归纳偏置：有用证据常分布在事件前上下文、事件本身与事件后结果中。作者因此研究面向局部化事件视频的固定预算证据分配问题。
AI.method: 提出dKFD（phase-structured differentiable selector），一种相位结构化的可微分选择器：在完成全序列时间编码后，将证据容量预留并分配给事件前、事件中、事件后三个阶段。方法配合相位监督，并以匹配预算的多随机种子评测进行验证，同时开展机制消融与下游诊断。
AI.result: 在DoTA视频异常识别上，全局Top-K在K=12时获得有竞争力的识别与时序定位，但选择器-事件对齐度低（Frame AUC 51.5±10.8）。dKFD在匹配预算下将Frame AUC提升+30.97（K=12，p<0.01），识别有适度但统计显著的增益，时序定位相当。消融显示相位监督是关键：去除后Frame AUC降至41.1±12.0（即使保留相位分区预算）。VRU-Accident下游诊断在多个VLM家族上一致优于可学习全局Top-K；密集描述任务揭示边界条件——均匀采样仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 相位结构化分配是一种可控的固定预算方法，适用于以事件为中心的稀疏证据选择，但并非通用的视频摘要策略。

title: QSCP: Beyond Class-Name Prompts for Query-Guided Semantic Change Parsing
summary: Traditional change detection (CD) identifies changes between bi-temporal remote sensing images, while semantic change detection (SCD) assigns predefined land-cover classes. However, mapping all changes may not meet a user's specific needs. Referring change detection (RCD) enables selective retrieval through category prompts. However, existing category-prompted RCD uses the queried category to specify the destination of a change and returns only a binary mask of the corresponding regions. Users may instead request a particular transition and paired semantic maps to understand what changed into what. Such requests require explicit source and target reasoning beyond target-class localization. To address these needs, we propose query-guided semantic change parsing (QSCP), which supports category names, synonyms, and intent-bearing sentences and returns a query-specific mask with paired temporal semantic maps. QSCP parses requests into intents and semantic slots, composes bidirectional visual evidence, and predicts both temporal states with a query-conditioned decoder. On SECOND, QSCP outperforms RCDNet on synonym, sentence, and transition queries and improves end-to-end semantic prediction over evaluated semantic baselines. WHU-CDC experiments further assess cross-dataset transfer and consistency across equivalent expressions without target-domain training. Code is available at https://github.com/qianyuancs/QSCP

AI.tldr: 提出查询引导的语义变化解析（QSCP）任务与方法：支持类别名、同义词和意图句查询，输出查询专属掩膜及成对时序语义图，并可解析"从什么变为什么"的转换型请求。
AI.motivation: 传统变化检测（CD）只标识双时相影像间的变化，语义变化检测（SCD）虽赋予预定义地物类别，但全量变化制图未必符合用户特定需求。现有类别提示式指代变化检测（RCD）仅用查询类别指定变化的目的类别，且只返回对应区域的二值掩膜，无法满足用户对特定转换关系及成对语义图（理解"什么变成了什么"）的需求，这需要显式的源—目标推理而非仅目标类别定位。
AI.method: 提出查询引导语义变化解析（QSCP）：将请求解析为意图与语义槽，构建双向视觉证据，并用查询条件化解码器预测两个时相的状态；支持类别名称、同义词及含意图的句子作为查询。
AI.result: 在SECOND数据集上，QSCP在同义词查询、句子查询和转换型查询上均优于RCDNet，且端到端语义预测优于所评估的语义基线；在WHU-CDC上的实验进一步验证了跨数据集迁移能力及在无目标域训练条件下对等价表达的预测一致性。
AI.conclusion: QSCP统一了选择性检索与成对语义推理，支持更灵活、更贴近用户意图的变化查询；代码已开源。

title: OneSign: Unifying Sign Language Understanding Tasks with One Model
summary: SLU encompasses a diverse set of tasks, including ISLR, CSLR, and SLT. Although these tasks share basic semantic and linguistic foundations, they are typically addressed with task-specific architectures and training pipelines, which hinders knowledge sharing and requires costly pretraining and finetuning for each task. In this paper, we focus on two aspects of SLU tasks: (1) training and inference pipelines are highly fragmented: most methods rely on pretraining on large-scale SL datasets followed by task- or dataset-specific finetuning, which leads to multiple specialized models rather than a single checkpoint. (2) current LLM-based methods may overlook the inherent modality discrepancy between sign and text tokens, simply concatenating them and processing both modalities with the same decoder layers. In this paper, we present OneSign, a unified framework that addresses multiple SLU tasks within a single model and a single checkpoint. OneSign reformulates ISLR, CSLR, and SLT under a single training paradigm. To accommodate the heterogeneous characteristics of sign and text representations, we introduce a Modality-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts (MA-MoE) architecture, consisting of a shared expert and modality-specific experts for sign and text tokens. A modality router dynamically activates the corresponding experts, and their outputs are aggregated to form the final token representations. By enabling modality-dependent expert specialization while preserving a shared expert path, MA-MoE can effectively model the modality differences between continuous sign representations and discrete text tokens. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that OneSign achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance on several benchmarks, highlighting its effectiveness as a unified SLU model. Datasets are available at : https://github.com/gswycf/OneSign.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OneSign，一个统一的 SLU 框架，将 ISLR、CSLR 和 SLT 三类任务纳入单一模型和单一检查点，并通过模态自适应混合专家（MA-MoE）架构缓解手语与文本之间的模态差异。
AI.motivation: 现有 SLU 任务（ISLR、CSLR、SLT）虽共享语义与语言学基础，却通常采用任务专用架构和训练流程，导致知识难以共享，且每个任务都需昂贵的预训练与微调。此外，现有方法训练与推理流程高度碎片化，倾向于产生多个专用模型而非单一检查点；基于 LLM 的方法还常忽视手语与文本 token 之间的固有模态差异，简单拼接后用同一解码器处理。
AI.method: OneSign 将 ISLR、CSLR 与 SLT 重新表述为统一的训练范式。为适应手语与文本表征的异质性，引入模态自适应混合专家（MA-MoE）架构，包含一个共享专家以及分别面向手语 token 和文本 token 的模态专用专家。模态路由器动态激活相应专家，并将其输出聚合为最终 token 表示。该设计在保留共享专家路径的同时实现模态相关的专家特化，从而有效建模连续手语表示与离散文本 token 之间的模态差异。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，OneSign 在若干基准上取得有竞争力或最先进的性能，验证了其作为统一 SLU 模型的有效性。
AI.conclusion: OneSign 以单模型、单检查点统一处理多种 SLU 任务，并通过 MA-MoE 有效弥合手语与文本的模态差异，展现出作为统一 SLU 框架的有效性。

title: Query, Align, and Distill: Navigation-Aware Cross-Modal Interaction for Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Recent large-scale Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) models deliver strong accuracy but remain costly to deploy due to their large parameter counts and computational requirements. We tackle efficient VLN in two steps. First, we build a high-performing teacher that makes navigation evidence selection explicit and compressible. The teacher introduces a small set of learnable query slots to extract global and local action-sufficient navigable evidence from panoramic observations via a Navigable Query Generator, then progressively grounds these evidence tokens to the instruction with an Instruction-Query Aligner for policy prediction. Second, using this explicit query bottleneck as a distillation interface, we train a compact student by transferring both where to attend and what to do. We distill the teacher's global and local navigable queries with a navigation-aware token-adaptive objective, then further match action distributions during fine-tuning. Experiments on standard VLN benchmarks demonstrate that our student nearly matches the teacher's navigation performance while reducing the number of parameters by 93.65% compared to the teacher.

AI.tldr: 提出一种高效VLN的两阶段方案：先构建具备可学习查询瓶颈的强教师模型，再通过查询与动作蒸馏训练紧凑学生模型，学生性能接近教师且参数量减少93.65%。
AI.motivation: 大规模视觉-语言导航（VLN）模型精度高，但参数量大、计算需求高，部署成本昂贵，因此需要研究高效的VLN方案。
AI.method: 分两步：1）构建强教师模型，使导航证据选择显式且可压缩——引入少量可学习查询槽，通过Navigable Query Generator从全景观测中提取全局与局部、动作充分的通航证据，再用Instruction-Query Aligner将证据token与指令逐步对齐以预测策略；2）以该显式查询瓶颈作为蒸馏接口，训练紧凑学生模型，迁移"关注何处"与"做什么"，采用导航感知的token自适应目标蒸馏教师的全局与局部通航查询，并在微调阶段进一步匹配动作分布。
AI.result: 在标准VLN基准上，学生模型导航性能几乎与教师持平，同时参数量相比教师减少93.65%。
AI.conclusion: 显式、可压缩的查询瓶颈可作为有效的蒸馏接口，实现VLN模型的高效压缩，在几乎不损失导航性能的前提下大幅降低参数量。

title: Octree-based Video Representation
summary: Video models commonly use uniform grids even though visual complexity varies substantially across space and time. We introduce OctVideo, which approximates a video clip with an octree. This hierarchy recursively partitions a spatio-temporal volume into eight subvolumes, so that smooth regions remain coarse while detailed regions receive finer cells. Each leaf stores local RGB values and spatio-temporal gradients, supplemented by a lightweight learned residual. For reconstruction, a Conv1D VAE maps the serialized cells to a regular latent grid and selectively refines details during decoding. Our VAE achieves 36.12 dB PSNR with 38.2M parameters and 189.4 GFLOPs per clip on Kinetics-400 (K400). It also generalizes zero-shot to the high-resolution Densely Annotated VIdeo Segmentation (DAVIS) 2016 dataset with reconstruction quality comparable to the best evaluated models. On both datasets, it requires the fewest model FLOPs and achieves the fastest encoding and decoding among the evaluated models. OctVideo also supports video understanding, achieving competitive recognition performance with few input tokens when trained from scratch. By exploiting the redundancy already present in video signals and efficiently processing sparse structures, OctVideo provides an efficient representation for video.

AI.tldr: OctVideo 用八叉树对视频时空体进行递归划分，平滑区域粗、细节区域细，叶子存储局部RGB与时空梯度加轻量残差，经Conv1D VAE序列化为规则潜网格并选择性精化解码，实现高效视频表示。
AI.motivation: 视频模型普遍采用均匀网格，但视觉复杂度在空间和时间上变化显著，均匀采样会造成冗余与算力浪费；因此需要一种能自适应匹配内容复杂度、利用视频信号固有冗余的高效视频表示方法。
AI.method: 将视频片段近似为八叉树：递归地把时空体划分为八个子体，使平滑区域保持粗粒度、细节区域获得更细单元。每个叶节点存储局部RGB值与时空梯度，并辅以轻量学习的残差。重建时用Conv1D VAE把序列化的叶单元映射到规则潜网格，并在解码中按需细化细节。
AI.result: 该VAE在Kinetics-400上以38.2M参数、每clip 189.4 GFLOPs达到36.12 dB PSNR；零样本泛化到高分辨率DAVIS 2016，重建质量与最佳评测模型相当。在两个数据集上所需模型FLOPs最少，编码与解码速度在评测模型中最快。同时支持视频理解，从头训练时用少量输入token达到有竞争力的识别性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用视频信号中已存在的冗余并高效处理稀疏结构，OctVideo 为视频提供了一种高效表示。

title: Toward Comprehensive 3D Grounding: Orientation Grounding through Vision-Language Models
summary: Grounding is a core capability of spatial vision-language models, yet most existing work focuses only on where a referred object is. Many 3D tasks also require knowing how it is oriented. Although existing 3D VLMs may predict oriented boxes, box pose does not explicitly capture object-centric orientation or symmetry-induced ambiguities. We introduce orientation grounding, a referring grounding task that predicts an object's 6D orientation and axial symmetry from a language or box query in single-view or multi-view scenes. To support this task, we construct ReferOri, with 331K multi-view and 387K single-view orientation-grounding queries obtained through scalable reconstruction, consistency checking, and human verification. We further present OG-VLM, which adapts a 3D VLM with structured box/orientation outputs, sign and symmetry tokens, and geometry-aware auxiliary losses. Across single-view and multi-view benchmarks, OG-VLM substantially outperforms orientation-aware VLM baselines and surpasses object-level orientation foundation models on scene-level referring benchmarks, showing that explicit orientation grounding is a distinct and learnable capability beyond localization. Downstream results validate its benefit for orientation-related spatial reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"朝向定位"(orientation grounding)任务，预测被指代物体的6D朝向与轴对称性，并构建ReferOri数据集与OG-VLM模型，在单/多视图基准上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有空间视觉语言模型多只关注"物体在哪里"(location)，而许多3D任务还需知道物体"如何朝向"。现有3D VLM即使能预测有向包围盒，盒的姿态也无法显式表达以物体为中心的朝向及对称性带来的歧义。
AI.method: 提出朝向定位任务：从语言或包围盒查询出发，在单视图或多视图中预测物体的6D朝向与轴对称性。构建ReferOri数据集(33.1万多视图、38.7万单视图查询)，通过可扩展重建、一致性检查与人工验证获得。提出OG-VLM，在3D VLM上引入结构化包围盒/朝向输出、符号与对称性token及几何感知辅助损失。
AI.result: 在单视图与多视图基准上，OG-VLM显著优于具有朝向感知能力的VLM基线，并在场景级指代基准上超过物体级朝向基础模型；下游实验验证其有利于朝向相关的空间推理。
AI.conclusion: 显式朝向定位是区别于"定位"的、可学习的独立能力，所提任务、数据集与模型为此提供了有效支撑。

title: ECG-Scroll: A Long-Horizon, Streaming Benchmark and Agent Environment for Interpretation of Ambulatory Electrocardiograms
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can now interpret a standard ten-second, twelve-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) with clinically grounded, reward-verified reasoning. Real cardiac monitoring is different. Ambulatory (Holter) and telemetry recordings span hours to days and are read as they stream in, and their clinically decisive findings are paroxysmal, brief episodes buried in an otherwise unremarkable trace. Such a recording cannot be held in one context at diagnostic resolution, and its future has not yet happened, so a reader must work online, deciding what to measure now, committing evidence to memory as it passes, and reporting events as they occur. We recast long-duration ECG interpretation as a long-horizon, online (streaming, causal) sequential decision process and introduce ECG-Scroll. As a benchmark, long ambulatory recordings are streamed to an agent chunk by chunk, and it must localize, quantify, and promptly flag paroxysmal events without access to future signal; because the underlying signal is retained, every answer is checkable against objective ground truth, giving rule-based rather than judge-based rewards, and the streaming formulation adds a metric batch evaluation cannot express, the detection latency between an event's onset and the moment the agent records it. As an agent environment, it is a fixed, gym-style interaction layer that exercises three competencies single-glance ECG models never touch: Memory, Tool use through signal-grounded measurement rather than reading pixels, and Planning of what to measure now and when to commit. We release 390 whole-recording instances spanning 2,536 hours of two-lead ambulatory ECG and evaluate a signal-threshold rule agent alongside off-the-shelf LLM agents online, characterizing how they use memory, tools, and planning and where the benchmark's head-room lies.

AI.tldr: 本文将长时程（动态/遥测）心电图的解读重新定义为长时程在线（流式、因果）序列决策过程，提出基准与交互环境 ECG-Scroll：将长程记录逐块流式喂给智能体，要求其在不接触未来信号的前提下实时定位、量化并尽早标记阵发性事件，并额外提出"检测延迟"这一批处理评测无法表达的指标，同时开源 390 个完整记录实例、共 2,536 小时的双导联动态 ECG 数据。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型虽能解读标准的十秒十二导联心电图并给出有临床依据、带奖励校验的推理，但真实心脏监测情境完全不同：动态（Holter）与遥测记录跨越数小时至数天，需边流式到达边阅读；其临床决定性发现往往是阵发性、短暂、埋藏于其余看似正常波形中的事件。此类记录无法在诊断分辨率下整体放入单一上下文，且其"未来"尚未发生，因此阅读者必须在线工作——此刻决定测什么、随信号流逝把证据写入记忆、并在事件发生时即刻报告。现有十秒单次快照式模型既无法承载这种长上下文，也无法评估因果性与及时性，故需要全新的评测范式。
AI.method: 作者将长时程 ECG 解读重构为长时程、在线（流式、因果）的序列决策过程并命名为 ECG-Scroll。（1）作为基准：长程动态记录按块（chunk）逐步流式输入智能体，智能体不访问未来信号，需定位、量化并及时标记阵发性事件；由于底层信号被保留，每个回答都可与客观真值核对，从而获得基于规则而非基于评审（judge）的奖励；流式设定还引入批处理评测无法表达的指标——事件起始到智能体记录该事件之间的检测延迟。（2）作为智能体环境：提供固定的 gym 风格交互层，考察单次判读 ECG 模型从未涉及的三项能力——记忆（Memory）、通过信号接地测量而非读取像素的工具使用（Tool use）、以及对"现在测什么、何时提交"的规划（Planning）。
AI.result: 发布 390 个完整记录实例，覆盖 2,536 小时的双导联动态 ECG；在在线设定下评估了信号阈值规则智能体与若干现成大模型智能体，刻画了它们在记忆、工具与规划上的使用方式，并指出该基准的剩余提升空间（head-room）所在。
AI.conclusion: ECG-Scroll 将长时程 ECG 解读从离线单次快照推进为在线、因果、长时程的序列决策任务，兼具可核查的规则化奖励与检测延迟等新指标，并作为固定 gym 式交互环境显式考察记忆、工具使用与规划三项能力，为长程心脏监测中的流式智能体评测提供了统一基准与数据基础。

title: MedRouter: Demystifying Knowledge Differences Across Medical LLMs for Routing-Based Reasoning
summary: Medical question answering spans diverse specialties and modalities, and individual medical large language models (LLMs) exhibit distinct strengths across tasks and domains. This heterogeneity suggests that combining specialists may enable broader coverage of medical questions than relying on any single model. However, existing LLM routing methods primarily seek to balance answer quality and inference cost, leaving open how to exploit differences in specialist competence to improve medical reasoning. In this paper, we introduce MedRouter, an agentic system that uses an embedding-based multi-label router to select and query specialist LLMs, then passes their responses to a generator to produce the final answer. We further propose SCALE (Specialist Competence-Aware Learning), a two-stage training framework that first trains the Router with specialist correctness supervision and then optimizes its selections through reinforcement learning. The second stage uses a Performance Gain Reward (PGR) that measures how specialist information affects the generator's answer correctness relative to answering without that information. Experiments on eight text-based and multimodal medical QA benchmarks show that MedRouter outperforms the strongest routing baseline by 8% in average accuracy. Our analysis of specialist outputs further reveals distinct strengths and complementary question-level coverage, motivating learned routing to combine these capabilities for more comprehensive medical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出MedRouter智能体系统，用嵌入多标签路由器选择并查询专家LLM，再由生成器产出答案；配套SCALE两阶段训练（专家正确性监督+强化学习，PGR奖励）。在8个医学QA基准上平均准确率比最强路由基线高8%。
AI.motivation: 医学问答跨越多个专科与模态，单个医学大模型在不同任务/领域各有所长，这种异构性意味着组合专家模型可能覆盖更广的医学问题。但现有LLM路由方法主要权衡答案质量与推理成本，未探索如何利用专家能力差异提升医学推理。
AI.method: MedRouter：基于嵌入的多标签路由器选择并查询专家LLM，其回答交给生成器生成最终答案。SCALE两阶段训练：第一阶段用专家正确性监督训练路由器；第二阶段用强化学习优化其选择，采用Performance Gain Reward（PGR），衡量专家信息相对于无该信息时对生成器答案正确性的增益。
AI.result: 在8个文本与多模态医学QA基准上，MedRouter平均准确率比最强路由基线高8%。对专家输出的分析显示各专家具有明显优势与互补的题目级覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 专家能力差异与互补覆盖支持学习式路由，将多专家能力组合以实现更全面的医学推理。

title: Classifying Dominant Temporal Orientation without Pretrained Text Embeddings: A Novel Morphosyntactic Inventory Vector Approach
summary: Computational methods have consistently struggled to determine the dominant temporal orientation of a sentence. This difficulty is especially pronounced when a sentence contains multiple embedded clauses with competing tense and aspectual information. To address this difficulty, we propose an alternative approach for identifying a sentence's past, present, or future global reference interval. Our method does not use any form of pretrained embeddings. We rather encode sentences using fixed-length inventory vectors that are comprised of part-of-speech counts, dependency relation counts, and explicit futurate pattern counts. We term this inventory vector of a sentence a "Morphosyntacton". The method does not use any padding, sequence models, or large language models. Evaluation on 1,799 syntactically complex English sentences, annotated as past, present or future, shows balanced and high accuracy multiclass classification, achieving an overall multi-class accuracy of 92%.

AI.tldr: 提出用词性、依存关系及未来时显式模式计数构成的定长"形态句法向量"（Morphosyntacton）表征句子，不使用预训练嵌入、序列模型或大语言模型，在1,799个句法复杂英语句子的过去/现在/未来三分类任务上达到92%的整体准确率。
AI.motivation: 计算方法在判定句子的主导时间取向（过去、现在或未来）方面长期存在困难，尤其当句子包含多个嵌套从句且时态与体信息相互竞争时，这一困难更为突出。
AI.method: 不使用任何形式的预训练嵌入，也无需填充、序列模型或大语言模型；而是用固定长度的"存量向量"（inventory vector）编码句子，该向量由词性计数、依存关系计数以及显式的未来时（futurate）模式计数组成，称为句子的"Morphosyntacton"。
AI.result: 在1,799个句法复杂的英语句子上进行评估，这些句子被标注为过去、现在或未来，方法实现了平衡且高精度的多类分类，整体多类准确率约92%。
AI.conclusion: 基于形态句法特征的简单定长向量表示可在不使用预训练嵌入与大型神经模型的前提下，有效且高精度地判定复杂句子的全局时间参考区间。

title: Train Together or Merge Later? Unifying VLA Experts via a Shared Action Interface
summary: Co-training offers a straightforward way to build a multi-task vision-language-action (VLA) policy, but can fall short of the performance achieved by training each task independently. The challenge is to retain these task-specific gains in a multi-task policy without joint post-training. Combining independently trained experts through model merging is a natural approach, yet strong individual experts do not necessarily yield a strong merged policy. We identify one source of this incompatibility: task-specific changes to the action interface, comprising action normalization and the action encoder and decoder. We propose PolicyWeave, combining merge-compatible post-training with context-guided sparse merging. During post-training, all experts retain the common base policy's action interface, while task adaptation is restricted to LoRA updates in the hidden layers of the action model. This makes the experts more compatible with existing model merging methods. However, merging all experts can still introduce interference from unrelated tasks at deployment. PolicyWeave scores each expert's LoRA updates using the initial visual-language context, determines the expert set through leave-one-layer-out ranking stability, and forms a sparse weighted merge of the selected updates that remains fixed for current task. We evaluate PolicyWeave with GR00T N1.5 on 18 RoboCasa365 tasks, using only 10% of the target-task demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Preserving the shared action interface raises the average success rate across four static merging methods from 17.0% to 52.8%. PolicyWeave achieves 64.7% success with these SFT experts and 74.1% after task-specific reinforcement learning (RL), compared with 60.7% for joint RL. Further evaluations on LIBERO-10 and an AgileX Piper arm support the deployment of independently learned skills in long-horizon and real-world manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PolicyWeave，通过保证动作接口一致的后训练与上下文引导的稀疏合并，将多个独立训练的VLA专家有效整合为单一多任务策略，在RoboCasa365等基准上显著优于静态合并与联合训练。
AI.motivation: 多任务VLA策略的协同训练（co-training）往往达不到单任务独立训练的性能，而若不做联合后训练，又难以在多任务策略中保留各任务的专属收益。用模型合并整合独立专家是自然思路，但强专家未必能合并出强策略。作者指出其中一个不兼容来源：任务特定的动作接口改动（动作归一化以及动作编码器与解码器）。
AI.method: 提出PolicyWeave，包含两部分：(1) 合并兼容的后训练：所有专家保留共享基座策略的动作接口，任务适配仅限动作模型隐层的LoRA更新，从而提升与现有模型合并方法的兼容性；(2) 上下文引导的稀疏合并：用初始视觉-语言上下文对每个专家的LoRA更新打分，通过留一层的排序稳定性确定专家集合，并对所选更新做稀疏加权合并，该合并对当前任务保持固定，以减少无关任务的干扰。
AI.result: 在GR00T N1.5上、18个RoboCasa365任务、仅用10%目标任务示范做SFT：保留共享动作接口使四种静态合并方法的平均成功率从17.0%提升至52.8%。PolicyWeave在使用这些SFT专家时达到64.7%成功率，经任务特定强化学习（RL）后达到74.1%，而联合RL为60.7%。在LIBERO-10和AgileX Piper机械臂上的进一步评估支持独立学习技能在长时序与真实世界操作中的部署。
AI.conclusion: 任务特定的动作接口改动是独立VLA专家难以合并的重要不兼容来源；统一动作接口并仅以隐层LoRA做任务适配，可大幅提升现有合并方法的效力。在此基础上，基于视觉-语言上下文打分的稀疏加权合并（PolicyWeave）进一步缓解任务间干扰，使独立学习的技能可在多任务、长时序及真实机器人场景中有效部署，且优于联合RL。

title: Save Your Saturated Data: Learning Beyond Reward Saturation in Group-Based RL
summary: Group-relative reinforcement learning (RL) relies on reward variation among sampled responses to estimate informative relative advantages. As language models become increasingly capable, existing training data can become reward-saturated: all sampled responses to the same problem might receive equally high rewards, where the group-relative learning signals vanish and leave previously useful data obsolete. In this work, we investigate whether useful learning signals can be recovered from such saturated data. We study interventions at four levels of group-policy RL pipelines---data, rollout, reward, and advantage---and conduct extensive RL training on saturated reasoning data only. While standard GRPO on saturated data would almost always yield near-0 advantages and near-noise signals, diverse interventions successfully recycle and repurpose such data: among the proposed strategies, interventions at rollout generation are consistently most effective: nudging the policy to generate ``high-quality'', incorrect solutions introduces rollouts with poor rewards into saturated groups as negative samples, which turns out to improve GRPO by 6.4% to 9.0% across Qwen3-1.7B and 4B. Other interventions such as increasing rollout temperature or adding auxiliary rewards can also restore non-zero advantages, but yield less consistent gains. Further analyses show that effective negative rollouts require informative negative trajectories, that the method remains effective alongside unsaturated data, and that it supports iterative recycling of newly saturated examples. While increasingly stronger LLMs would render more data as saturated, our results demonstrate that don't waste your saturated data: with the right strategies they can be recycled into useful RL training signals in an increasingly data-scarce world.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究当语言模型能力增强导致训练数据"奖励饱和"（同组样本奖励几乎相同、GRPO优势消失）时，能否通过干预从饱和数据中恢复有效学习信号。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型能力提升，现有训练数据趋于奖励饱和：同一问题采样的多个回答获得同等高奖励，组内相对优势趋近于零，学习信号消失，导致原本有用的数据失效。论文希望探究能否从这类饱和数据中"回收"有用的强化学习信号，以应对数据日益稀缺的局面。
AI.method: 论文在组相对策略强化学习（group-policy RL）流程的四个层级——数据、rollout生成、奖励、优势——设计干预策略，并仅在饱和推理数据上进行大规模RL训练。具体比较了多种干预手段，包括在rollout生成阶段"诱导"策略产生"高质量但错误"的解答，从而向原本全为高奖励的饱和组中注入低奖励的负样本；此外还测试了提高rollout温度、添加辅助奖励等方式。
AI.result: 标准GRPO在饱和数据上几乎总是产生接近0的优势与近噪声信号。多种干预能成功回收利用饱和数据，其中rollout生成阶段的干预最稳定有效：注入错误解法产生的负样本使GRPO在Qwen3-1.7B和4B上提升6.4%~9.0%。提高rollout温度或添加辅助奖励虽也能恢复非零优势，但增益一致性较差。
AI.conclusion: 有效负样本需具备信息量的负轨迹；该方法与未饱和数据共存时仍有效，并支持对新近饱和样本的迭代回收。结论是"不要浪费饱和数据"：在数据日益稀缺的背景下，采用恰当策略可将饱和数据回收为有用的RL训练信号。

title: Knowing Is Not Choosing: What Explicit Verification Adds Beyond Generative Preference
summary: Generating a correct answer does not mean that a language model will select it. We separate factual recall into three steps: generating a correct candidate, ranking the available candidates, and selecting the final answer. Pre-generation readouts predict factual recall and which questions sampling will cover across three model families, but say little about whether an available correct answer will ultimately be selected. Explicit verification with $P(\mathrm{True})$ improves within-question ranking over mean log-likelihood in Gemma, Qwen3, and Llama, with AUROC gains of $0.08$--$0.12$. In a prospectively defined Gemma cohort, verification raises plurality accuracy by about $5$ points, and still gains about $2$ points over chat-template likelihood, a stronger generative baseline. The advantage is strongest for relations with common-answer priors and depends on access to the entity; masking the entity removes the ranking advantage in larger Qwen models. Finally, the measured benefit depends on how correctness is defined: recall-oriented reference matching can credit option lists favored by likelihood and substantially understate the improvement seen under human semantic judgments. Prior work shows that models can carry latent factual knowledge and judge candidate answers; we show that these capabilities do not collapse into a single notion of ``knowing,'' and trace where information is gained, lost, or mismeasured between availability, ranking, and final choice.

AI.tldr: 该论文将事实回忆拆解为"生成正确候选、对候选排序、最终选择"三步，发现预生成读出（pre-generation readouts）能预测事实回忆与采样覆盖，却无法判断已有正确答案是否会被选中；显式验证（$P(\mathrm{True})$）在多个模型家族中提升候选排序与最终准确率，但该收益依赖实体可访问性、关系类型及正确性的定义方式。
AI.motivation: "生成正确"不等于"选择正确"。既有研究显示模型具备潜在事实知识与候选判断能力，但将二者等同为单一"知道"概念存在缺陷：预生成信号只能说明候选是否可用，无法解释可用候选最终是否被选中。作者希望厘清"可用性—排序—选择"之间信息如何获得、丢失或被误测。
AI.method: 将事实回忆解耦为三步（生成正确候选、排序可得候选、选择最终答案）；在 Gemma、Qwen3、Llama 三个模型家族中比较预生成读出与显式验证 $P(\mathrm{True})$ 对排序的预测能力（AUROC）；在预设的 Gemma 队列中与均值对数似然及 chat-template 似然基线对比准确率；并做实体掩码消融，以及对比参照匹配与人工语义判断两种正确性定义。
AI.result: 显式验证在三个模型家族中相较均值对数似然提升问题内排序，AUROC 增益约 $0.08$–$0.12$；在预设 Gemma 队列中，验证使多数投票准确率提升约 $5$ 个百分点，相较更强的生成式基线（chat-template 似然）仍提升约 $2$ 个百分点。优势在具有常见答案先验的关系上最强，且依赖实体可访问性——掩码实体后，较大 Qwen 模型的排序优势消失。此外，收益大小取决于正确性定义：参照匹配倾向于给似然偏好的选项列表"加分"，会显著低估人工语义判断下的改进幅度。
AI.conclusion: 潜在事实知识与候选判断能力并不构成统一的"知道"概念；显式验证是提升答案选择的有效手段，但其效果受实体信息、关系类型及评估口径制约。评估事实回忆时应区分"生成可用性"与"最终选择"，并谨慎对待不同正确性定义带来的度量偏差。

title: CAME: Company-Aware Evidence-Memory Experts for Interpretable Quarter-Ahead Revenue Forecasting
summary: Quarter-ahead revenue forecasting requires company-scale numerical accuracy, strict temporal validity, and company-specific interpretation of narrative disclosures. LLMs can distill textual evidence but can produce scale-misaligned forecasts, whereas history-based anchors are stable but miss forecast-time signals such as product transitions, supply constraints, and management guidance. We introduce CAME (Company-Aware Evidence-Memory Experts), a residual-forecasting framework that refines a no-leakage statistical anchor when current semantic evidence and prior error patterns justify an adjustment. On a development-inclusive rolling backtest of 336 company-quarters from 12 large public technology and platform firms, CAME achieves the lowest aggregate point-estimate error among the reported methods, with statistically supported macro-sMAPE gains over the matched Statistical Anchor, and outperforms History + Guidance on all six aggregate metrics. CAME also links adjustments to source-linked evidence cards and guarded memory traces, supporting forecast inspection, provenance, and failure localization.

AI.tldr: CAME 提出一种面向公司级季度营收预测的残差预测框架：以无泄漏统计锚点为基线，仅在当前语义证据与历史误差模式支持时才进行调整，从而兼顾数值尺度一致性、时序合法性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 季度营收预测要求公司级数值精度、严格时序有效性和公司特定文本解读。LLM 虽能提炼文本证据，但易产生尺度错配预测；纯历史锚点虽稳定，却会遗漏预测时点的关键信号，如产品切换、供应约束和管理层指引。
AI.method: CAME（Company-Aware Evidence-Memory Experts）采用残差预测思路：以无泄漏统计锚点为基础预测，引入当前语义证据与历史误差模式（记忆）作为专家信号，仅当二者能证明调整合理时才修正锚点。
AI.result: 在覆盖 12 家大型上市科技与平台公司、共 336 个公司-季度的开发集滚动回测中，CAME 在所报告方法中取得最低的总体点估计误差，相较匹配的 Statistical Anchor 有统计显著支持的 macro-sMAPE 提升，并在全部六项聚合指标上优于 History + Guidance。
AI.conclusion: CAME 通过残差式证据-记忆调整实现更准确且尺度对齐的营收预测，同时将调整关联到可溯源的证据卡与受约束的记忆轨迹，支持预测审查、来源追溯与失败定位。

title: DroneWAM: Efficient World Action Model for Drone Visual Navigation
summary: World-action models give visual navigation agents a way to anticipate how candidate actions will change future observations and to act from the predicted consequences. For drones, this capability must operate under tight accuracy and efficiency constraints. We present DroneWAM, an efficient world-action model for drone visual navigation. DroneWAM adopts a JEPA-based architecture to model future states directly in representation space, avoiding the cost of explicit future image generation. A pretrained Resampler further compresses dense encoder features into fewer latent tokens, reducing the computation repeated at each imagined step. We also introduce adaptive rollout, where a preference-trained Gate adaptively allocates prediction depth according to the current scene. To support learning under richer aerial motion, we construct DroneNav-6D, a simulated visual navigation dataset with synchronized RGB observations, 6-DoF flight trajectories, control commands, and randomized wind disturbances. On DroneNav-6D, DroneWAM achieves the best trajectory accuracy among the compared methods. Adaptive rollout further reduces the average prediction depth from 8 to 4.58 while improving trajectory accuracy, demonstrating that predictive computation can be allocated more effectively across scenes. \href{https://github.com/1e12Leon/DroneWAM}{Codes and data} will be released.

AI.tldr: DroneWAM 是一种面向无人机视觉导航的高效世界-动作模型，基于 JEPA 架构在表征空间预测未来状态，结合 Resampler 特征压缩与自适应 rollout，在 DroneNav-6D 数据集上取得最佳轨迹精度，并将平均预测深度从 8 降至 4.58。
AI.motivation: 无人机视觉导航需在严格的精度与效率约束下预判候选动作对未来观测的影响；显式生成未来图像代价高，且固定预测深度在不同场景中计算分配不够高效。
AI.method: 采用 JEPA 架构直接在表征空间建模未来状态，避免显式图像生成；用预训练 Resampler 将稠密编码器特征压缩为少量潜变量 token，降低每步想象的计算量；引入自适应 rollout，由偏好训练的 Gate 按场景动态分配预测深度；构建 DroneNav-6D 仿真数据集，包含同步 RGB 观测、6-DoF 飞行轨迹、控制指令及随机风扰。
AI.result: 在 DroneNav-6D 上，DroneWAM 在对比方法中取得最佳轨迹精度；自适应 rollout 将平均预测深度从 8 降至 4.58，同时提升轨迹精度。
AI.conclusion: DroneWAM 表明预测计算可按场景更有效分配，在满足效率约束的同时提升无人机视觉导航精度；代码与数据将开源。

title: Generalization Dynamics of LM Pre-training
summary: People typically assume that LMs stably mature from pattern-matching parrots to generalizable intelligence during pre-training. We build a toy eval suite and show this mental model is wrong: throughout pre-training, LMs frequently and suddenly hop between parrot-like and intelligence-like computations. We call this mode-hopping. Across our suite, LMs suddenly latch onto memorized or in-context patterns instead of in-context learning, use System 1 instead of System 2 thinking, pick up what sounds true instead of what is true, fail at multi-hop persona QA, out-of-context reasoning, and emergent misalignment -- then just as suddenly revert and generalize. Mode-hopping is not explained by standard optimization dynamics: it is locally stable and cannot be fixed by checkpoint averaging. We instead think of it as a capacity allocation problem: in a capacity-bounded model, generalizable circuits must compete with the shallow ones learned early in training, and the data in each pre-training window may decide which circuits win. Our suite provides a new efficient lens on generalization. We demonstrate two concrete applications: (i) select intermediate pre-training checkpoints that strongly generalize reasoning and alignment, better than the final pre- or mid-training checkpoints, and (ii) select pre-training data that controls and stabilizes generalization dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"模式跳跃"(mode-hopping)现象：语言模型在预训练全过程中并非稳定地从"鹦鹉式"模式匹配进化为可泛化的智能，而是在类鹦鹉与类智能计算间频繁且突然地切换；作者用玩具评测套件验证该现象，将其归因于容量受限下的容量分配竞争问题，并提供选择泛化性更强的中间检查点与稳定泛化的预训练数据两项应用。
AI.motivation: 惯常假设认为语言模型在预训练期间从模式匹配的"鹦鹉"稳定地成熟为可泛化的智能，但该心智模型可能错误。作者旨在检验并纠正这一认知，揭示预训练泛化过程的非单调、突变特性。
AI.method: 构建一个玩具评测套件(toy eval suite)，在预训练全程密集监测语言模型的行为表现，观察其是否在类鹦鹉计算(in-context pattern matching)与类智能计算(in-context learning、System 2推理等)之间切换；同时检验该现象是否可用标准优化动力学解释（考察局部稳定性和检查点平均的效果）；并提出容量分配(capacity allocation)假说。
AI.result: 模型频繁且突然地在两类计算间跃迁：突然依赖记忆化或上下文模式而非上下文学习、使用System 1而非System 2、偏好"听起来为真"而非真正为真，并在多跳人物问答(multi-hop persona QA)、上下文外推理(out-of-context reasoning)和涌现性失准(emergent misalignment)上失败——随后又同样突然地回归并泛化。该现象具有局部稳定性，无法通过检查点平均(checkpoint averaging)消除，标准优化动力学无法解释。
AI.conclusion: 模式跳跃的根源在于容量受限模型中可泛化回路与训练早期习得的浅层回路之间的竞争，每个预训练窗口的数据决定哪类回路胜出。该套件为泛化研究提供高效新视角，并有两项应用：(i)挑选在推理与对齐上泛化更强的中间预训练检查点，优于最终或中期检查点；(ii)选择能控制并稳定泛化动态的预训练数据。

title: Where Do Test-Time Scaling and Training Fall Short in Individual Stance Prediction?
summary: Test-time scaling and post-training have improved LLM performance in coding and mathematical reasoning, but their effectiveness for individual stance prediction remains unclear. We study this question by predicting a person's stance in a new discussion from their history. We evaluate widely used test-time scaling strategies and post-training methods, such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and identify four failure modes across generation, selection, and learning: (1) incorrect consensus, where repeated samples agree on the wrong stance; (2) selection failure, where generation covers the observed stance but selection misses it; (3) response overfitting, where supervised fine-tuning improves imitation but harms prediction; and (4) early plateau, where reinforcement learning shows modest initial gains followed by limited further improvement. We expose these failures using STANCE-BENCH, which contains 2499 prediction tasks from 500 Hacker News users. Guided by this analysis, we explore a simple approach that combines direct scores for all candidate stances with explicit assessments of support from the individual's history. On the 781-task test set, this approach achieves 21.83 discussion-specific Macro F1 with Qwen3-8B, compared with 19.27 for direct scoring. Our results motivate evaluating candidate generation, final selection, and person-specific evidence use separately. Our data is available at https://github.com/stance-bench/Stance-Bench.

AI.tldr: 研究测试时扩展与后训练在个体立场预测上的效果，通过 STANCE-BENCH 识别四类失败模式，并提出结合直接打分与历史证据评估的简单方法。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展与后训练已在代码和数学推理上提升 LLM 表现，但其对个体立场预测是否有效尚不清楚，需要系统性检验并理解其失效机制。
AI.method: 构建 STANCE-BENCH（500 名 Hacker News 用户、2499 个预测任务），评估常用测试时扩展策略与后训练方法（监督微调、强化学习），归纳生成、选择与学习三个环节的失败模式；据此提出将各候选立场的直接得分与对个体历史支持证据的显式评估相结合的方法。
AI.result: 识别出四类失败模式：错误共识、选择失败、回复过拟合、过早饱和。在 781 任务测试集上，Qwen3-8B 下所提方法达到 21.83 的讨论级 Macro F1，而直接打分为 19.27。
AI.conclusion: 个体立场预测中应分别评估候选生成、最终选择与个体证据利用，测试时扩展与后训练并非普遍有效。

title: FOCUS: Benchmarking Retinal Model Generalization from Foundation Vision Encoders to Multimodal LLMs
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track. Interactive benchmark dashboard: https://huggingface.co/spaces/focus-retina-benchmark/focus-retinal-benchmark-arena
summary: Progress in AI-based retinal image analysis has advanced with foundation models, yet evaluating their reliability remains challenging. Performance reported on a single dataset does not capture how models behave under dataset shift, across clinical definitions, or for different patient subgroups. This limitation is particularly critical in medical imaging analysis, where robustness, calibration, and fairness are essential for safe deployment. We introduce FOCUS (Foundation Ophthalmic Cross-Dataset Understanding under Shift), a cross-dataset benchmark for evaluating retinal fundus models that considers vision-only encoder models (VM), vision-language dual-encoder models (VLM), and multimodal large language models (MLLM). FOCUS harmonizes binary diabetic retinopathy, referable diabetic retinopathy, and glaucomatous optic neuropathy tasks across ten public datasets spanning diverse geographies, acquisition conditions, and label protocols. The benchmark evaluates models through a unified analysis layer that measures ranking performance, calibration, subgroup disparities, and image-quality robustness. We present a large-scale evaluation covering 532 base configurations and 228 MLLM configurations adapted through supervised fine-tuning with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). Results show that no model family consistently dominates across tasks and datasets: general VM encoders achieve the strongest average ranking performance, medical MLLMs are competitive but variable, and dual encoder VLMs benefit substantially from lightweight adaptation. Fine-tuning improves in-domain performance but exhibits heterogeneous transfer to external datasets, particularly in calibration. These findings demonstrate that retinal model evaluation is inherently multidimensional. FOCUS provides a practical framework and public benchmark to assess generalization, reliability, and robustness beyond single-dataset leaderboards

AI.tldr: 提出FOCUS跨数据集基准，统一评估视网膜眼底模型（VM/VLM/MLLM）在多数据集、多临床定义与亚组下的排序、校准、公平性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有视网膜图像分析基础模型多以单一数据集性能为评价标准，无法反映数据偏移、临床定义差异及患者亚组表现，而医疗影像对鲁棒性、校准与公平性要求极高，缺乏可靠评估手段。
AI.method: 构建FOCUS基准，涵盖视觉编码器模型（VM）、视觉-语言双编码器模型（VLM）与多模态大语言模型（MLLM）；统一二分类糖尿病视网膜病变、需转诊糖网及青光眼性视神经病变三类任务，整合十个地理、采集条件与标注协议各异的公开数据集；通过统一分析层评估排序性能、校准、亚组差异与图像质量鲁棒性；开展大规模评测，包括532个基础配置与经LoRA监督微调的228个MLLM配置。
AI.result: 无任何模型族在所有任务与数据集上持续占优：通用VM编码器平均排序性能最强；医学MLLM具竞争力但波动较大；双编码器VLM经轻量适配提升显著；微调改善域内性能，但向外部数据集的迁移异质，校准方面尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 视网膜模型评估本质上是多维的；FOCUS提供实用框架与公开基准，支持超越单数据集榜单的泛化性、可靠性与鲁棒性评估。

title: FloodDiffusion 2: Efficient and Path Controllable Streaming Motion Generation
comment: 27 pages. Updated author affiliations and corresponding-author information. Code: https://github.com/AlayaLab/FloodDiffusion2
summary: We present FloodDiffusion 2 (FD2), an efficient and controllable framework that builds upon FloodDiffusion (FD1), a state-of-the-art streaming motion generation model. While FD1 produces plausible motion, it suffers from low efficiency and limited controllability, as its attention design requires repeated computation over the entire history, and it lacks precise trajectory control for real-world applications. To address these limitations and improve generation quality, FD2 introduces three advances. First, Partial Attention makes finalized history representations independent of the active window, enabling KV-cached inference and shared-history packing for efficient training. Second, we establish a necessary-and-sufficient Bregman criterion for regression losses to preserve diffusion's conditional-mean velocity field. This criterion guides an FK-induced quadratic loss that incorporates motion geometry without online FK evaluation. Third, FD2 introduces precise path conditioning to control the character's root trajectory while preserving natural body motion. Experiments show that FD2 reduces training computation by 4.6$\times$ and accelerates denoising by 11.29$\times$, reaching 2.303 ms per update on long sequences. Alongside these efficiency gains, FD2 improves motion quality over FD1 and achieves state-of-the-art FID scores among streaming methods, with 0.048 on SEED and 0.053 on HumanML3D.

AI.tldr: FD2 是一个高效可控的流式运动生成框架，通过 Partial Attention、Bregman 回归损失准则和路径条件控制三项改进，在训练计算量降低 4.6×、去噪加速 11.29× 的同时提升了运动质量并取得流式方法中最优 FID。
AI.motivation: FD1 虽能生成合理运动，但效率低且可控性受限：其注意力设计需对完整历史重复计算，且缺乏面向真实应用的精确轨迹控制。
AI.method: 三项改进：(1) Partial Attention 使已定稿的历史表示独立于活动窗口，支持 KV 缓存推理与共享历史打包的高效训练；(2) 建立回归损失的充要 Bregman 准则以保持扩散的条件均值速度场，并据此设计 FK 诱导的二次损失，在无需在线 FK 评估下引入运动几何；(3) 精确路径条件控制角色根轨迹，同时保持自然身体运动。
AI.result: 训练计算量减少 4.6×，去噪加速 11.29×，长序列每步更新达 2.303 ms；运动质量优于 FD1，FID 在流式方法中达到 SOTA，SEED 上 0.048，HumanML3D 上 0.053。
AI.conclusion: FD2 在效率与可控性上显著改进 FD1，同时提升生成质量，实现了流式运动生成的最优性能。

title: Perturb-and-Solve: Efficient Learned-Operator Conditioning for Latent Diffusion Inverse Problems
summary: Latent diffusion models serve as powerful priors for solving inverse problems in image restoration, such as deblurring, inpainting, and super-resolution. Current methods have a trade-off between generality and efficiency. Solvers that are restricted to a fixed set of degradation operators are fast and efficient. Methods that support arbitrary degradation operators are slow and require gradients through the diffusion network. To break this bottleneck, we introduce PASEO (Perturb-And-Solve for Efficient Operator conditioning), a method that uses a small (1M parameters) learned network to degrade diffusion model predictions in latent space. PASEO supports learned degradation operators without back-propagating through the diffusion network. We efficiently sample reconstructions from an approximate posterior by combining the diffusion model's prediction with the observed image. We do this by adding noise and solving linear equations based on a local linear approximation of the learned network, without building or inverting large covariance matrices. Across super-resolution, deblurring, and inpainting on FFHQ and COCO, PASEO achieves strong perceptual quality while running up to 9x faster and using up to 34% less peak memory than the tested baselines, with the same or fewer model evaluations.

AI.tldr: PASEO提出一种高效且通用的潜在扩散模型逆问题求解器，用小网络在潜空间对预测加扰动并解线性方程，避免穿越扩散网络反传，在超分、去模糊、修复任务上兼顾质量、速度与内存。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散先验逆问题求解器存在通用性与效率的权衡：固定退化算子方法快但通用性差，任意算子方法慢且需经扩散网络求梯度（反传），形成瓶颈。
AI.method: PASEO用一个约1M参数的学习网络在潜空间对扩散模型预测施加退化（Perturb），无需反传扩散网络即可支持学习到的退化算子；通过加噪并基于该网络的局部线性近似求解线性方程组，从近似后验中采样重建，避免构建或求逆大型协方差矩阵。
AI.result: 在FFHQ和COCO上的超分辨率、去模糊、修复任务中，PASEO在相同或更少模型评估次数下，取得较强的感知质量，相比基线最高快9倍，峰值内存最多减少34%。
AI.conclusion: PASEO通过潜空间扰动与线性求解，打破了扩散先验逆问题中通用性与效率的权衡，在保持感知质量的同时显著提升速度并降低内存。

title: Dynamic Manipulation with World-Action Models via Counterfactual Planning
comment: 48 pages, including appendices. Project page: https://methoder00.github.io/DPP/
summary: World-Action models (WAMs) trained on static demonstrations often fail to manipulate moving targets even when they possess the required manipulation skills. We attribute this failure to target-response collapse: as execution advances, the policy becomes increasingly biased toward the learned continuation of its ongoing behavior and less responsive to target relocation. To bridge the gap between what the model has learned and what it can generate from the current context, we formulate dynamic manipulation as counterfactual planning by decoupling the context used for plan generation from the physical state used for execution. Our framework, Dynamic Predictive Planning (DPP), first uses the WAM's predictive rollout to estimate when an interaction is expected to occur, and combines this timing estimate with observed target motion to predict the target's future interaction position. DPP then constructs a counterfactual observation that places this predicted target position in a familiar robot context, allowing the model to invoke an existing manipulation skill rather than generate a recovery behavior from an unfamiliar robot-target configuration. The resulting plan is connected to the robot's actual state during execution. DPP enables real-time dynamic manipulation on a single consumer GPU without additional training on dynamic data. Experiments in simulation and on a real robot demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse target motions, with simulation performance surpassing all evaluated baselines, including methods additionally trained on dynamic data. Project page: https://methoder00.github.io/DPP/

AI.tldr: 提出动态预测规划（DPP）框架，将动态操作建模为反事实规划，通过解耦规划上下文与执行状态，使仅用静态数据训练的WAM能在单张消费级GPU上实时操作移动目标。
AI.motivation: 基于静态演示训练的World-Action模型（WAMs）虽具备操作技能，却难以操作移动目标。作者将失败归因于"目标响应坍塌"（target-response collapse）：执行过程中策略日益偏向延续自身既有行为，对目标位置变化响应减弱。核心动机是弥合模型已学知识与当前上下文可生成行为之间的差距。
AI.method: 将动态操作形式化为反事实规划，把用于生成规划的上下文与用于执行的物理状态解耦。DPP分两步：（1）利用WAM的预测展开估计交互发生时刻，结合观测到的目标运动预测目标未来交互位置；（2）构造反事实观测，将预测的目标位置置于熟悉的机器人上下文中，从而调用已有操作技能而非从陌生机器人-目标构型生成恢复行为；执行时将所得规划与机器人实际状态对接。
AI.result: 无需动态数据额外训练即可在单张消费级GPU上实现实时动态操作。仿真与真机实验在多种目标运动下均取得一致提升；仿真性能超越所有评估基线，包括额外使用动态数据训练的方法。
AI.conclusion: DPP通过反事实规划与上下文-状态解耦，有效缓解目标响应坍塌，为静态数据训练的WAM赋予实时动态操作能力，且成本低、泛化性好。

title: ABO-Med: Accelerated Bilevel Optimization for Few-Shot Medical Image Classification
summary: In recent years, bilevel optimization has been widely used in a variety of machine learning tasks. However, prior bilevel optimization algorithms generally require the computation of second-order information, which limits their practical scalability. Only recently has a first-order paradigm for bilevel optimization been established, attaining near-optimal theoretical guarantees for solving bilevel optimization problems. In this paper, we propose ABO-Med, a scalable instantiation of this paradigm for few-shot learning, by incorporating it into the model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML) framework and tailoring it to medical image classification. We also introduce Medical Adaptive RandomAugment (MedRAug), a modality-aware augmentation strategy designed for medical images. Theoretically, ABO-Med establishes the optimality of MAML-type meta-learning approaches. Empirically, ABO-Med outperforms prior baselines on several public medical datasets, with gains of 1.99% to 18.76%, while MedRAug further improves the average accuracy by 2.20% to 6.34%. Additional cross-domain experiments, augmentation ablation studies, backbone ablation studies, and training efficiency analysis further validate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ABO-Med——首个将一阶双层优化范式与MAML结合的可扩展小样本医学图像分类方法，并设计模态感知的MedRAug增强策略，理论与实验均验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统双层优化算法依赖二阶信息（如Hessian向量积），计算与显存开销大，可扩展性差；一阶双层优化范式虽已有近最优理论保证，但缺乏面向具体任务的可用实例。医学图像领域更存在标注稀缺、模态差异大等挑战，亟需兼顾理论保证与实用效率的小样本学习方法。
AI.method: 1）将一阶双层优化范式嵌入MAML框架，提出可扩展的小样本学习实例ABO-Med，避免二阶信息计算；2）提出Medical Adaptive RandomAugment（MedRAug），一种面向医学图像的模态感知自适应增强策略；3）从理论上建立MAML型元学习方法的（近）最优性保证。
AI.result: 在多个公开医学数据集上，ABO-Med相对已有基线提升1.99%–18.76%；叠加MedRAug后平均精度进一步提高2.20%–6.34%。跨域实验、增强消融、骨干网络消融及训练效率分析均支持方法的有效性与高效性。
AI.conclusion: ABO-Med为双层优化在医学小样本分类中提供了兼具理论最优性与计算可扩展性的实现，MedRAug作为模态感知增强进一步稳定增益，验证了一阶双层范式的实用价值。

title: DeltaWAM: Change-Centric Visual Foresight via Delta Tokens for an Efficient World-Action Model
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) offer visual foresight for robotic manipulation, but pixel-space models repeatedly reconstruct entire future scenes, incurring high computational cost and spatio-temporal redundancy. In physical manipulation, consecutive frames often share most of their visual context; the changes between them are what an action policy needs to anticipate. We introduce DeltaWAM, a change-centric WAM that makes a compact delta token the unit of future prediction. Each token is a single vector encoding changes between consecutive dense DINO feature maps. DeltaWAM builds on DeltaWorld, a latent world model pretrained on large-scale videos, to autoregressively predict one delta token per future frame. A flow-matching action expert then conditions on the predicted transitions and current DINO features, which serve as spatial anchors, to generate action chunks. Trained for 256 GPU hours on two H100 GPUs, DeltaWAM has 0.725B parameters and achieves 92.8% average success on LIBERO. It also shows robust generalization under procedural perturbations on LIBERO-Pro. Inference takes 142.1 ms per action chunk with 3.86 GB peak memory.

AI.tldr: DeltaWAM 是一种以“变化”为中心的潜在世界-动作模型，用单个 delta 向量 token 表示相邻 DINO 特征图之间的变化，并以此自回归预测未来帧变化，再驱动流匹配动作专家生成动作块，在 LIBERO 上取得 92.8% 平均成功率，推理每动作块 142.1 ms、峰值显存 3.86 GB。
AI.motivation: 现有基于像素空间的世界-动作模型（WAMs）需要反复重建完整的未来场景，计算成本高且存在时空冗余。在物理操作任务中，相邻帧的大部分视觉上下文是共享的，动作策略真正需要预测的是帧间的“变化”，而非整幅图像。
AI.method: 1) 提出变化为中心的 DeltaWAM，以紧凑的 delta token 作为未来预测单元：每个 token 是一个向量，编码相邻稠密 DINO 特征图之间的变化；2) 基于大规模视频预训练的潜在世界模型 DeltaWorld，自回归地逐帧预测一个 delta token；3) 使用流匹配（flow-matching）动作专家，以预测的转移和当前 DINO 特征（作为空间锚点）为条件，生成动作块（action chunks）。
AI.result: 模型规模 0.725B 参数，在两块 H100 GPU 上训练 256 GPU 小时；在 LIBERO 上平均成功率达 92.8%；在 LIBERO-Pro 的过程性扰动下具备稳健的泛化能力；推理每个动作块耗时 142.1 ms，峰值内存 3.86 GB。
AI.conclusion: 将未来预测从像素重建转向潜在空间中的帧间变化建模，可在显著降低计算与内存开销的同时保持甚至提升操作任务的成功率与泛化性，为高效的世界-动作模型提供了一条可行路径。

title: Can Protein-Derived Knowledge Improve Pathology Foundation Models?
summary: Molecularly guided pathology foundation models (PFMs) exploit transcriptomic or proteomic information to enrich whole-slide image (WSI) representations, yet effectively leveraging large standalone molecular corpora remains challenging. First, existing molecular foundation models encode protein sequences or single-cell states, not the patient-level bulk expression profiles paired with WSIs. Second, because cross-modal supervision is restricted to paired WSI-omics samples, knowledge from standalone molecular corpora reaches the pathology encoder only indirectly, creating a paired-support bottleneck. To address these challenges, we propose a three-stage framework that decouples proteomic knowledge acquisition from cross-modal transfer, yielding ProSlide, a slide-level hierarchical pathology foundation model. First, to close the modality gap, we pretrain a Proteomic Foundation Encoder (PFE) on 12,695 sample-level bulk protein profiles using virtual profile generation and expression-space multi-view pretraining. Second, we pretrain ProSlide, a patch-region-slide encoder, to predict protein expression from paired WSI-protein samples. Third, to relax the paired-support bottleneck, we introduce Prot2Path, a cross-modal relational distillation objective. For each paired sample, it aligns the similarity distributions of the WSI and its protein profile over a shared, frozen bank of PFE-encoded paired and standalone profiles. We evaluate ProSlide on 12 downstream tasks across breast, lung, and renal cancers. Despite being pretrained with only 2,229 WSIs and 12,695 sample-level protein profiles, ProSlide achieves the highest mean accuracy and AUC within each cancer group.

AI.tldr: 提出三阶段框架ProSlide，通过解耦蛋白组知识获取与跨模态迁移，缓解配对支持瓶颈，在乳腺、肺、肾癌12项下游任务中取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 分子引导的病理基础模型（PFM）虽可利用转录组或蛋白组信息增强WSI表征，但存在两大挑战：一是现有分子基础模型编码的是蛋白序列或单细胞状态，而非与WSI配对的患者级bulk表达谱；二是跨模态监督仅限于配对WSI-组学样本，独立分子语料知识只能间接到达病理编码器，形成配对支持瓶颈。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：（1）在12,695个样本级bulk蛋白谱上，采用虚拟谱生成与表达空间多视图预训练，构建蛋白组基础编码器（PFE）以弥合模态鸿沟；（2）预训练ProSlide（patch-region-slide多层级编码器），从配对WSI-蛋白样本预测蛋白表达；（3）提出Prot2Path跨模态关系蒸馏目标：对每个配对样本，在共享的冻结PFE编码配对与独立蛋白谱库上，对齐WSI与蛋白谱的相似度分布，以缓解配对支持瓶颈。
AI.result: 在乳腺、肺、肾癌的12项下游任务上评估，仅用2,229张WSI与12,695个样本级蛋白谱预训练，ProSlide在各类癌症组内均取得最高平均准确率与AUC。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦蛋白组知识获取与跨模态迁移，Prot2Path关系蒸馏使独立分子语料的知识更充分传递至病理编码器，验证了分层病理基础模型在有限配对数据下的有效性。

title: Scoring the Wrong Question: Readout Failures in Constrained-Option Evaluation
summary: Constrained-option scoring reads a model's probabilities for a fixed set of permitted answers, so it returns a score even when the model is about to write something else. We study a prompt that quotes a multiple-choice item, ending in the item's own answer instruction, and asks for a forecast of whether a reader model given only a short note will answer it correctly. The model can begin answering the quoted item: on three Qwen3 checkpoints an answer letter is the most probable token on nearly every passage, and the forecast ranks the reader's correctness indistinguishably from chance. Beyond prior work's argmax check and prefill repair, we contribute a label-free diagnostic of the declared options' support, their first-token mass in context; a deletion test tracing the Qwen3 answer-letter start to the quoted instruction; and rendering and tokenisation checks for dropped separators and coinciding first tokens. Prefilling an answer stem lifts the median option mass from below to above one half on all nine checkpoints scored with this prompt and, with options and renormalisation unchanged, raises the Qwen3-averaged AUC from 0.4929 to 0.6152. lm-polygraph's default P(True) estimator shows a related failure: it reads True where Qwen3 without thinking favours an answer letter (MMLU) or the prompt's (A)/(B) label (TriviaQA), and its Qwen3-averaged AUROC is indistinguishable from chance on MMLU and below chance on TriviaQA. Scoring and renormalising the (A)/(B) labels after an answer stem raises it to 0.632 and 0.868, renormalising True against False in place reaches 0.660 and 0.860, and on TriviaQA both exceed all fourteen default single-answer library estimators. The original forecast is renormalised too, yet stays indistinguishable from chance: option mass flags low support in both settings without labels, and only checking the intended target shows which score still ranks.

AI.tldr: 受限选项打分在模型即将输出其他内容时仍能给出分数，但存在失效模式；作者提出无标签诊断并证明答案词干预填充可显著提升排序性能。
AI.motivation: 受限选项打分对固定许可答案集合读取模型概率，即使模型将要写别的内容也会返回分数，因此需要诊断这种"表面有分数、实际无区分力"的失效情形，并检验模型是否真的支持所声明的选项。
AI.method: 研究一个引用多选题、并以该题自身作答指令结尾、要求预测"仅看简短提示的读者模型是否会答对"的提示。除已有的argmax检查和prefill修复外，贡献三项无标签诊断：声明选项支持度（其上下文首token质量）、追踪Qwen3答案字母起始来源的删除测试、以及针对分隔符丢失与首token重合的渲染和分词检查；并采用答案词干预填充。
AI.result: 三个Qwen3检查点上答案字母几乎每个段落都是最高概率token，预测forecast排序与随机无异。预填充答案词干在九个检查点上将中位选项质量从低于一半提升到高于一半，选项与重归一化不变时Qwen3平均AUC由0.4929升至0.6152。lm-polygraph默认P(True)估计器同样失效：在Qwen3无思考模式下对MMLU读取到True而模型偏好答案字母，在TriviaQA读取到True而偏好(A)/(B)标签，Qwen3平均AUROC在MMLU与随机无异、TriviaQA低于随机。对(A)/(B)标签在答案词干后打分并重归一化达到0.632和0.868，将True对False原地重归一化达到0.660和0.860，TriviaQA上两者均超过全部十四个默认单答案库估计器。原始forecast即使重归一化仍与随机无异。
AI.conclusion: 选项质量可在无标签情况下同时标记两种设置中的低支持度，但只有检查预期目标才能判断哪个分数仍具排序能力；诊断揭示了受限选项打分的隐藏失效，并提供有效修复路径。

title: SeOPD: Self-Evolving LLMs via Online Policy Distillation from Self-Generated Chain-of-Thought
summary: Recent advances in online policy self-distillation (OPSD) have demonstrated that large language models (LLMs) can improve their capabilities by leveraging external privileged information (PI), such as manual annotations or feedback from external environments. However, obtaining accurate annotations and constructing sophisticated environments often require substantial human effort and computation, limiting the scalability of OPSD. While a few recent studies have explored self-improvement without external PI, the resulting gains remain limited. In this work, we explore whether LLMs can achieve comparable self-improvement without external PI. Our key observation is that a single LLM can support multiple reasoning modes, such as deep-thinking and non-thinking modes, with deep thinking generating additional information during reasoning. Based on this observation, we propose Self-Evolving Online Policy Distillation (SeOPD), which enables LLMs to distill and internalize information generated by their own chain of thought (CoT). Specifically, it (1) generates CoT with the deep-thinking mode, (2) produces responses with the non-thinking mode, and (3) uses the generated CoT as PI to provide token-level supervision for the non-thinking response, allowing new information inferred during reasoning to guide the non-thinking mode and be internalized into the shared model parameters, thereby improving both non-thinking and deep-thinking capabilities. Extensive experiments across LLMs and tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of SeOPD.

AI.tldr: 提出SeOPD，让单个LLM用自身深度思考模式生成的CoT作为特权信息，对非思考模式响应进行token级监督，实现无需外部特权信息的在线策略自蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）依赖外部特权信息（人工标注或环境反馈），获取成本高、可扩展性受限；而无需外部PI的自改进方法收益有限。因此探索能否在不依赖外部PI的情况下实现相当的自改进。
AI.method: 基于单个LLM可支持多种推理模式（如深度思考与非思考模式）的观察，提出SeOPD：(1)用深度思考模式生成CoT；(2)用非思考模式生成响应；(3)将生成的CoT作为特权信息，对非思考响应提供token级监督，使推理中推断出的新信息引导非思考模式并内化到共享模型参数中。
AI.result: 在多种LLM和任务上的大量实验表明SeOPD有效。
AI.conclusion: SeOPD证明LLM可利用自身内部推理模式差异作为特权信息实现自进化，在无需外部PI的情况下同时提升非思考与深度思考能力，为可扩展的在线策略自蒸馏提供新路径。

title: Identifying Temporal Features within Transcoders for Time Sensitive Factual Recall
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) suffer from temporal misalignment, often due to the contradictory nature of their training corpora. While current mitigation strategies rely on computationally expensive fine-tuning or context-heavy retrieval augmented generation (RAG), the internal mechanisms governing time-sensitive recall remain under-explored. Unlike prior studies that identify temporal components such as attention heads and MLP layers, we provide the first feature-level map of temporal recall by isolating individual MLP features via transcoder circuit tracing. We identify three node categories (common temporal, common to the year, and chrono-semantic) which interact to generate a temporal filter during factual recall. By analysing Gemma 2 2B, LLaMA 3.2 1B, and Qwen3-4B, we show that these features do not follow a simple linear pipeline but represent time through a parallel and mixed syntactic-semantic interplay across layers. We additionally discover a class of higher-layer temporal components invisible to existing EAP-IG methods, establishing transcoders as a more complete lens for temporal interpretability in time-sensitive factual recall. These findings present MLP components for potential targeted interventions in time-sensitive factual recall

AI.tldr: 本文首次在特征层面绘制大模型时序召回图谱，通过transcoder电路追踪分离单个MLP特征，识别出三类时序节点及其并行、句法-语义混合交互机制，并发现现有EAP-IG方法遗漏的高层时序组件。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型存在时序错位问题（部分源于训练语料的矛盾性）。现有缓解策略依赖计算昂贵的微调或上下文繁重的RAG，而对时序敏感召回的内部机制研究不足。已有工作仅识别注意力头和MLP层等时序组件，缺乏特征级别的机制刻画，因此需要更细粒度的时序可解释性视角。
AI.method: 提出基于transcoder电路追踪的特征级时序召回映射方法，将单个MLP特征进行隔离分析。在Gemma 2 2B、LLaMA 3.2 1B和Qwen3-4B三个模型上进行验证，追踪特征间的连接与交互路径，并与现有EAP-IG方法进行对比，检验其可识别组件的完整程度。
AI.result: 识别出三类时序节点：common temporal（通用时序）、common to the year（年份通用）和chrono-semantic（时序-语义混合）。这些节点相互作用，在事实召回过程中生成一个"时序过滤器"。时序特征并非遵循简单线性流水线，而是跨层呈现并行且句法-语义混合的交互模式。此外发现一类更高层的时序组件，是EAP-IG方法无法识别的。
AI.conclusion: transcoder为时序敏感事实召回提供了比EAP-IG更完整的时序可解释性视角。所识别的MLP组件可作为未来面向时序敏感事实召回进行定向干预的候选目标。

title: When an Evaluation Rule Writes Training Labels: Measuring Human-Reference Forgiveness in NAVSIM
summary: When the human reference scores zero on a metric, the released GTRS-Dense label generator for NAVSIM marks every candidate trajectory in the scene as passing it. NAVSIM's authors introduced this human-reference forgiveness to avoid penalizing contextually justified maneuvers when scoring one trajectory, and warned that it could overlook important failures. In label generation it sets a whole column of 16,384 candidate targets to passing. To measure the consequences for supervision, we re-run the generator with the overwrite disabled and compare the pre-overwrite targets with the released labels on all 103,288 navtrain scenes. The rule erases a candidate distinction that the training loss reads on 11,237 of them (10.8793%). Firing usually changes most of a column: lane keeping carries 9,982 of the 13,042 forgiven loss columns, and its median forgiven column had 14,391 of 16,384 candidates failing before the overwrite. On held-out navtest scenes forgiven on lane keeping, the released lane-keeping head's median AUC against the pre-overwrite outcome is 0.7095; on unforgiven scenes matched on failing-candidate count it is 0.9807. For the Hydra-MDP checkpoint released with GTRS, whose configuration takes the same label file, the two values are 0.6627 and 0.9761. Continuing the released GTRS-Dense checkpoint for 300 optimizer steps with three paired seeds, we observe the forgiven-scene AUC 0.1086-0.1251 higher with pre-overwrite than with published targets, and a narrower gap between matched groups, still above zero. Scoring with forgiveness disabled, we observe lane keeping higher by 2.478-3.524 points on navtest scenes forgiven on any of five loss metrics, with lower adjacent-frame plan consistency. Both changes are larger there than on the rest. EPDMS, scored the same way, does not separate the two target sets.

AI.tldr: 该论文量化了 NAVSIM 中“人类参考得分为零即原谅全部候选轨迹”规则对监督信号的影响：该规则在 10.88% 的 navtrain 场景中抹去了训练损失所依赖的候选区分度，并通过禁用覆盖、重跑生成器与继续训练实验证明，被原谅场景的监督质量显著下降。
AI.motivation: NAVSIM 的 GTRS-Dense 标签生成器在被参考人类轨迹得分为零的度量上，会将整列 16,384 个候选目标全部标为通过。作者引入这一“人类参考原谅”机制是为了在单轨迹评分时避免惩罚上下文合理的操作，但也警告它可能掩盖重要失败。本文旨在测量该规则在标签生成中对监督信号的实际后果。
AI.method: 作者在全部 103,288 个 navtrain 场景上禁用覆盖并重跑生成器，将覆盖前的目标与已发布标签逐列对比，统计被抹去的候选区分度；随后在 navtest 上按失败候选数匹配被原谅与未被原谅场景，评估已发布的 lane-keeping 头与 Hydra-MDP 检查点的中位 AUC；再用三个配对种子继续训练已发布的 GTRS-Dense 检查点 300 个优化步，并比较禁用原谅评分下 lane keeping、相邻帧规划一致性与 EPDMS 的表现。
