AI.result: 规则在 11,237 个场景（10.8793%）中抹去了训练损失读取的候选区分度，其中车道保持占 13,042 个被原谅损失列中的 9,982 个，其被原谅列中位有 14,391/16,384 个候选在覆盖前为失败。在 navtest 被原谅场景上，已发布 lane-keeping 头对覆盖前结果的中位 AUC 为 0.7095，匹配的未被原谅场景为 0.9807；Hydra-MDP 分别为 0.6627 与 0.9761。继续训练后，被原谅场景 AUC 在使用覆盖前目标时高出 0.1086–0.1251，且匹配组间差距收窄但仍大于零。禁用原谅评分时，车道保持在五类损失度量上任一被原谅的 navtest 场景上高出 2.478–3.524 分，同时相邻帧规划一致性更低，且这些变化在该场景上大于其余场景；EPDMS 无法区分两组目标。
AI.conclusion: 人类参考原谅规则在训练标签中系统性抹除了大量候选区分度，主要集中于车道保持，并导致模型在被原谅场景上的排序能力显著劣化、规划一致性下降。该机制对监督质量的负面影响大于评分阶段的设计初衷，需要重新审视其使用。

title: SemTree: Judge-Aware Semantic Decision Trees for Inspectable and Repairable Rule Decisions
summary: Rule decisions such as content moderation, advertising compliance, and eligibility checks combine several conditions, exemptions, and missing-information cases, and an error can be fixed only once the failing condition is known. We introduce SemTree, a framework that represents a rule decision as a semantic decision tree: each node is a natural-language question with explicit Yes/No/Unknown criteria, a pluggable semantic judge answers it, and the branching structure is compiled on the answers that this judge actually gives. The executed path is the reasoning behind every decision, so errors are repaired where they occur: a reviewer corrects a single node and replays the rule, corrected nodes become training labels for the judge, and a tool-using LLM editor revises questions and subtrees while observing execution results. On all 8,276 ShARC test cases, a tree executed by a hosted judge reaches 67.70% accuracy with 2.99 questions per case, on par with asking the same judge for the final label (68.23%); an earlier tree compiled for a different judge scores 47.87% when executed by this judge, while a new tree compiled on this judge's answers to a 12-question initial pool already scores 64.39%. Node-level repair raises BANKING77 accuracy from 82.04% to 86.16%, an explicit exemption node cuts the false positives of a Chinese e-commerce moderation clause from 24 to 5, and a trained editor raises the development accuracy of edited trees from 64.47% to 73.35%.

AI.tldr: 提出SemTree框架，将规则决策表示为语义决策树：节点为带Yes/No/Unknown标准的自然语言问题，由可插拔语义判定器回答，分支结构依据判定器实际答案编译；执行路径即决策推理依据，可实现节点级纠错与再训练。
AI.motivation: 内容审核、广告合规、资格核查等规则决策融合了多重条件、豁免条款与信息缺失情形，而错误只有在定位到失效条件时才能被修复；传统单一标签预测缺乏可解释的推理路径，难以精准定位与局部修复。
AI.method: 将规则决策构建为语义决策树：每个节点是含显式Yes/No/Unknown判据的自然语言问题，由可插拔语义判定器作答；树的实际分支基于该判定器的真实答案动态编译；执行路径作为决策推理轨迹。支持三类机制：审阅者修正单个节点并重放规则、修正节点转为判定器的训练标签、以及使用工具的大模型编辑器在观察执行结果的同时改写问题与子树。
AI.result: 在全部8276个ShARC测试用例上，由托管判定器执行的树达到67.70%准确率，平均每例2.99个问题，与直接向同一判定器询问最终标签（68.23%）相当；为其他判定器编译的旧树在该判定器下仅47.87%，而基于该判定器对12题初始池的答案新编译的树已达64.39%。节点级修复将BANKING77准确率从82.04%提升至86.16%；引入显式豁免节点将某中文电商审核条款的假阳性从24降至5；训练后的编辑器将编辑树的开发集准确率从64.47%提升至73.35%。
AI.conclusion: 将规则决策表示为语义决策树，能够在保持与直接标签预测相当精度的同时，提供可定位、可局部修复的推理路径；节点级纠错、豁免显式化与LLM编辑器可有效提升准确率并降低假阳性，且树需针对所用判定器重新编译以保证性能。

title: FocusDrive: Reasoning with Visual Focus for Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving decisions depend on both where to focus and how to act on what is seen. Effective driving reasoning must establish which objects matter, where they are, and how they inform the intended action. Text-based rationales can describe a driving response while leaving its correspondence to specific visual evidence implicit. Visual focus provides a concrete starting point for this connection by identifying what matters in the scene and where it is. We propose FocusDrive, a structured multimodal reasoning framework that organizes end-to-end planning around explicit visual focus. It pairs descriptions of decision-relevant objects with image-patch references, bringing explicit visual focus into the reasoning that generates driving plans and trajectories. We first assess this focus representation through driver gaze prediction, then investigate its role in planning reasoning using driving-focus annotations within existing NAVSIM training scenes. Experiments on W3DA and NAVSIM demonstrate competitive gaze prediction and end-to-end planning performance, with FocusDrive improving over text-based chain-of-thought. These results support visual focus as an effective link between scene understanding and driving action.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FocusDrive——一种以显式视觉焦点为核心的结构化多模态推理框架，将决策相关物体描述与图像块引用配对，用于端到端驾驶规划，并在 W3DA 与 NAVSIM 上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 驾驶决策同时依赖"关注何处"与"如何据此行动"，有效推理需明确哪类物体重要、位于何处、如何影响预期动作。纯文本 rationale 虽能描述驾驶反应，却难以显式对应到具体的视觉证据，缺乏可溯源的视觉锚点。
AI.method: 提出 FocusDrive 结构化多模态推理框架，围绕显式视觉焦点组织端到端规划：将决策相关物体描述与图像 patch 引用配对，使显式视觉焦点进入生成驾驶规划与轨迹的推理过程。先在驾驶员注视预测任务上评估该焦点表示，再利用现有 NAVSIM 训练场景中的驾驶焦点标注，考察其在规划推理中的作用。
AI.result: 在 W3DA 与 NAVSIM 上，FocusDrive 在注视预测和端到端规划任务上均取得具竞争力的性能，且优于基于文本的思维链方法。
AI.conclusion: 视觉焦点可作为连接场景理解与驾驶动作的有效桥梁，为多模态驾驶推理提供显式、可溯源的中间表示。

title: AG-CoT: Verified Algorithmic Traces for LLM Program Synthesis on Clifford Circuits
summary: Scientific code generation can produce executable programs that fail to compute the intended scientific object. We study this problem in language-model synthesis of Clifford circuits, which prepare the stabilizer states used in quantum error correction and admit exact classical verification. In our target-conditioned framework, each target is given as compact signed stabilizer generators, and an exact verifier checks the generated OpenQASM circuits. We supervise models with Aaronson-Gottesman chain-of-thought (AG-CoT) traces checked by the verifier, and continue training on model generations that the verifier accepts. Across two independently trained model families (3B and 7B), AG-CoT supervision multiplies greedy-decode state-equivalence accuracy by four to six times over circuit-only baselines, and verifier-filtered continuation training adds a further consistent gain atop both. A complementary 32B study shows that supervised models achieve near-perfect syntax and Clifford validity while the strongest direct model reaches 6.14% state equivalence per target, rising to over 10% under verifier-guided selection with multiple candidates. These results show that algorithmic trace supervision gives a large, statistically significant gain in both model families and that verifier-filtered continuation adds a further repeated gain. The persistent gap between Clifford validity and state equivalence confirms that exact verification is necessary: a circuit can be syntactically and physically valid yet prepare the wrong quantum state.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究科学代码生成中"程序可运行但未计算出目标科学对象"的问题，以Clifford电路的量子电路合成为场景，提出AG-CoT算法轨迹监督与验证器过滤的持续训练方法，显著提升状态等价准确率，并证明精确验证的必要性。
AI.motivation: 科学代码生成可产出可执行程序，却可能无法计算出预期的科学对象。作者希望在这一"正确性"缺口上做研究，选择Clifford电路合成作为载体，因为它能制备量子纠错所需的稳定子态，且允许精确的经典验证，从而可以严格判定生成电路是否真正实现目标，而非仅停留在语法或物理合法性层面。
AI.method: 提出目标条件（target-conditioned）框架：每个目标以紧凑的有符号稳定子生成元给出，用精确验证器检查生成的OpenQASM电路。用Aaronson-Gottesman思维链（AG-CoT）轨迹对模型进行监督，该轨迹经验证器校验；随后在验证器接受的模型生成结果上继续训练（验证器过滤的持续训练）。在3B和7B两个独立训练的模型家族上评估，并补充32B研究，对比电路-only基线、直接模型以及多候选验证器引导选择。
AI.result: AG-CoT监督使贪心解码的状态等价准确率相对电路-only基线提升4至6倍；验证器过滤的持续训练在两个模型家族上均带来进一步的一致增益。32B补充研究中，监督模型达到近乎完美的语法与Clifford合法性，最强直接模型每目标状态等价率仅6.14%，在验证器引导的多候选选择下提升至超过10%。
AI.conclusion: 算法轨迹监督在两个模型家族中均带来大幅且统计显著的提升，验证器过滤的持续训练还能进一步重复增益。Clifford合法性与状态等价之间持续存在的差距证实精确验证不可或缺：电路可以在语法和物理上都合法，却制备出错误的量子态。

title: Teach Yourself Where to Look: On-Policy Attention Self-Distillation for Reasoning
summary: On-policy self-distillation trains reasoning models on their own trajectories using dense token distribution guidance from a privileged teacher with access to a verified solution. This supervision transfers what the teacher predicts without directly transferring where it attends within the preceding context. We introduce On-Policy Attention Self-Distillation (OPASD), which complements token-level supervision with solution-conditioned attention distillation. Because the privileged teacher can attend to verified solution tokens unavailable to the student, OPASD projects teacher attention onto student-visible positions and renormalizes the resulting distribution before alignment. Across three model sizes and four competition-level mathematics benchmarks, OPASD consistently outperforms token-only OPSD, improving average accuracy by 4.98 to 8.40 percentage points. OPASD also avoids the response-length inflation and performance degradation observed with token-only distillation, reducing generated rollout tokens by 73.9% and estimated model compute by 72.6% while training 1.53x faster. These results show that solution-conditioned attention provides a complementary supervision signal that makes on-policy self-distillation more accurate, stable, and compute-efficient.

AI.tldr: 提出OPASD方法，在on-policy自蒸馏中引入解条件注意力蒸馏，将教师注意力投影到学生可见位置并重归一化，从而在多个模型规模和数学基准上显著提升准确率并降低生成长度与计算量。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy自蒸馏仅通过密集token分布监督传递教师预测，而未直接传递教师在上下文中的注意力位置信息，监督信号不够充分。
AI.method: 提出On-Policy Attention Self-Distillation（OPASD），在token级监督基础上加入解条件注意力蒸馏；由于特权教师可访问学生不可见的已验证解token，方法将教师注意力投影到学生可见位置并重归一化后再对齐。
AI.result: 在3种模型规模和4个竞赛级数学基准上，OPASD持续优于仅token的OPSD，平均准确率提升4.98至8.40个百分点；同时避免响应长度膨胀和性能退化，rollout token减少73.9%，估计模型计算减少72.6%，训练速度提升1.53倍。
AI.conclusion: 解条件注意力提供了互补的监督信号，使on-policy自蒸馏更准确、更稳定且更高效。

title: ReAL: Accelerating Flow Matching through Segment Advancement with Shared Lookahead
summary: Flow-matching models generate high-quality images and videos, but repeated neural network evaluations make sampling expensive. Skipping evaluations reduces this cost by extending an available velocity estimate over a longer span. However, local velocity agreement alone does not determine a suitable span, and checking each candidate endpoint adds costly model calls. We introduce ReAL, a training-free sampler that selects how far to advance using one shared lookahead. Our key insight is that the discrepancy between uncorrected and lookahead-corrected endpoint proposals can be computed directly from the observed velocity mismatch and the candidate span beyond the lookahead. This relation provides a span-dependent selection criterion without additional endpoint evaluations. The same lookahead selects the longest passing candidate span, corrects the accepted update, and supplies its velocity as the next starting estimate. After initialization, each regular iteration requires only one fresh evaluation. ReAL uses the pretrained velocity output and original noise schedule, with no additional training or access to internal features. Experiments cover four image-generation backbones, video generation, and image editing. ReAL achieves 4.91x measured speedup on FLUX.1-dev while retaining 97.0% of dense mean ImageReward. On HunyuanVideo, it achieves a 5.49x speedup while maintaining a VBench score close to that of dense sampling.

AI.tldr: ReAL是一种无需训练的采样器，通过一次共享前瞻，利用观测到的速度失配与候选跨度之间的关系来选择推进距离，从而在保持生成质量的同时大幅降低流匹配模型的采样成本。
AI.motivation: 流匹配模型能生成高质量图像和视频，但反复的神经网络评估使采样代价高昂。跳过部分评估虽可降低成本，但仅靠局部速度一致性无法确定合适的跨度，且逐一检查候选端点会带来额外模型调用开销。
AI.method: ReAL使用一次共享前瞻：根据观测到的速度失配与前瞻之外候选跨度，直接计算未校正端点提议与前瞻校正端点提议之间的差异，从而得到跨度相关的选择准则而无需额外端点评估。同一前瞻选择最长的通过候选跨度、校正被接受的更新，并将其速度作为下一步起始估计。
AI.result: 在FLUX.1-dev上实现4.91倍实测加速，同时保留97.0%的稠密平均ImageReward；在HunyuanVideo上实现5.49倍加速，VBench得分接近稠密采样。
AI.conclusion: ReAL是一种免训练采样方法，仅使用预训练速度输出和原始噪声调度，无需额外训练或访问内部特征。除初始化外，每次常规迭代仅需一次全新评估，在四类图像生成骨干、视频生成和图像编辑任务中均有效。

title: Structured Residual Connectivity Matters for Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have established themselves as a scalable backbone for high-fidelity image synthesis. However, unlike U-Net based diffusion models that rely on rigid, hand-crafted skip connections, DiTs predominantly use a uniform residual stream that integrates all preceding layers as a monolithic state. In this work, we rethink residual connections in diffusion transformers and propose to transform them from passive summation into an active retrieval mechanism optimized for image denoising. First, we conduct a systematic analysis of DiT's internal representation, revealing a latent preference for early-layer feature reuse and symmetric layer guidance. Motivated by this, we introduce a structured connectivity design that explicitly integrates local residual connections with long-range pathways. Instead of static skip connections or dense all-layer routing, our method enables each transformer block to selectively ``attend'' to critical earlier representations, dynamically retrieving spatial and semantic cues through direct, differentiable cross-depth paths. Experiments show that our adaptive connectivity leads to faster convergence, with up to $1.73\times$ fewer training iterations, and significant gains in FID and visual quality with less than $0.1\%$ additional parameters, further improving a strong REPA-XL/2 model from $5.9$ to $4.34$ FID without guidance and reaching $1.39$ FID with classifier-free guidance. Our findings suggest that adaptive cross-layer connectivity is a critical yet underexplored factor in diffusion transformers, and that incorporating structured information pathways provides a simple and effective direction for improving scalable generative models.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视DiT中的残差连接，将其从被动求和的均匀残差流改造为面向去噪的主动检索机制，通过结构化跨深度连接实现自适应层间信息复用，以极少参数代价显著提升收敛速度与生成质量。
AI.motivation: DiT已成为高保真图像生成的可扩展骨干，但其依赖统一的残差流，将所有前序层整合为单一整体状态，缺乏U-Net式的手工跳跃连接带来的结构化信息通路。作者认为跨层连接这一关键因素在DiT中被严重低估，因此希望用自适应、面向去噪的检索式连接替代静态求和。
AI.method: 首先对DiT内部表示进行系统分析，发现其存在对浅层特征复用与对称层引导的潜在偏好。基于此设计结构化连接：将局部残差连接与长程通路结合，使每个Transformer块能够选择性"关注"关键的早期表示，通过直接且可微的跨深度路径动态检索空间与语义线索，从而以主动检索替代静态跳跃或全层稠密路由。
AI.result: 该方法带来更快收敛，训练迭代次数最多减少1.73倍；在参数量增加不足0.1%的情况下，FID与视觉质量显著提升。在强基线REPA-XL/2上，无引导条件下FID由5.9降至4.34，配合无分类器引导达到1.39 FID。
AI.conclusion: 自适应跨层连接是扩散Transformer中被忽视的关键因素；引入结构化信息通路为提升可扩展生成模型提供了一条简单有效的方向。

title: Turning Speech Language Models into Multilingual Listeners
summary: Speech Language Models (SLMs) that understand spoken language questions support only a few high-resource languages, limiting access to millions of people worldwide. This gap stems from the scarcity of multilingual speech instruction-tuning datasets. We present MULTISPEECHQA, a large-scale, synthetically generated and human-verified dataset comprising 9200 hours of 10.8 million spoken question-answer pairs in 23 typologically diverse languages. Using MULTISPEECHQA, we also introduce MULTISPEECH-BENCH, a multi-task benchmark for evaluating SLM performance on 23 languages. We compare the performance of a cascading system to open-weight and closed SLMs on MULTISPEECH-BENCH and find that the cascading system outperforms open-weight SLMs but not all closed SLMs. We use MULTISPEECHQA to finetune Qwen 2.5-Omni, which improves its performance on our benchmark. Our findings show that high-quality synthetic datasets offer a cheap solution to improving the multilingual capabilities of SLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出多语言语音问答数据集MULTISPEECHQA及评测基准MULTISPEECH-BENCH，证明合成数据可低成本提升语音语言模型的多语言能力。
AI.motivation: 现有语音语言模型（SLMs）仅支持少数高资源语言，导致全球数百万用户无法使用；其根本原因是缺乏多语言语音指令微调数据集。
AI.method: 构建大规模合成并经人工校验的数据集MULTISPEECHQA（9200小时、1080万条语音问答对、覆盖23种类型学多样的语言）；基于该数据集提出多任务评测基准MULTISPEECH-BENCH；在基准上对比级联系统、开源权重SLMs与闭源SLMs；并用MULTISPEECHQA微调Qwen 2.5-Omni。
AI.result: 级联系统性能优于开源权重SLMs，但不及部分闭源SLMs；用MULTISPEECHQA微调后Qwen 2.5-Omni在基准上的表现得到提升。
AI.conclusion: 高质量合成数据集为提升语音语言模型的多语言能力提供了一种低成本解决方案。

title: WorldAgent: Verification-Guided Agentic Physical World Construction
summary: Constructing complex physical worlds from language requires coordinating extensive 3D environments, detailed structures and objects at different spatial scales, and interacting physical processes under both stated goals and implicit physical constraints. We present WorldAgent, an agentic framework for verification-guided physical world construction from a single natural-language prompt, without iterative user debugging. A world construction layer expands the prompt into a structured world specification and uses physical knowledge to build scenes and run numerical simulations. After every step, a verification layer inspects scene geometry and simulation states alongside rendered views. Failed checks guide automatic revisions to the specification and re-execution of the affected steps. Accepted worlds pass the required checks and remain editable for further inspection and resimulation. We introduce AgenticSimBench, on which WorldAgent achieves the best scores among the evaluated agent-based methods on five of seven metrics. In a 26-participant user study, it receives the highest mean ratings across all four criteria.

AI.tldr: 提出 WorldAgent 智能体框架，可从单条自然语言提示出发，通过"构建层+验证层"闭环自动生成并校验复杂物理世界，无需用户迭代调试；同时发布 AgenticSimBench 基准。
AI.motivation: 从语言构建复杂物理世界需协调大规模 3D 环境、多空间尺度的结构与物体，以及既定目标与隐含物理约束下的交互过程，现有方法通常依赖用户反复调试，缺乏自动化验证机制。
AI.method: 框架分两层：世界构建层将提示扩展为结构化世界规范，利用物理知识构建场景并运行数值仿真；验证层在每步之后检查场景几何、仿真状态及渲染视图，未通过的检查驱动规范自动修订与受影响步骤重执行，通过的世界保持可编辑、可重仿真。并提出基准 AgenticSimBench 进行评估。
AI.result: 在 AgenticSimBench 上，WorldAgent 在 7 项指标中的 5 项取得所评估智能体方法中的最佳成绩；在 26 人用户研究中，于全部 4 项标准上获得最高平均评分。
AI.conclusion: 验证引导的智能体框架能有效支撑从自然语言到复杂物理世界的自动构建，并在自动指标与人类主观评价上均优于对比方法。

title: Beyond Calibration: Do a Typed-Decision Model's Probabilities Obey the Probability Axioms?
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Code and data at https://github.com/bro789/typed-decision-coherence
summary: Typed-decision models such as TypeSafe's Jev answer a declared yes/no or multiple-choice question about a state with a probability instead of text, and their evaluations report accuracy and calibration. Neither requires that the probabilities a model gives to logically related questions fit together item by item, which is what a system that acts on those probabilities needs. We test this property, coherence, with a battery of logically linked questions that needs no labels. For 160 items from ChaosNLI and PubMedQA, each with three mutually exclusive labels, we ask whether the label is X, whether it is not X, whether it is one of the other two labels, and which label applies. On 480 negation pairs, Jev's probabilities for "the label is X" and "the label is not X" miss summing to one by 0.064 on average (95% CI 0.055 to 0.072). Qwen3.8-27B, run from its official BF16 weights, misses by 0.293 with first-token probabilities and by 0.122 with verbalized probabilities. The gap to the first-token readout persists on pairs where both systems give similar probabilities, without double-negation labels, and after averaging Jev's repeated calls. Jev is not coherent either: its violations are about five times its repeat noise, and it over-endorses statements about single labels, so that its three single-label probabilities sum to 1.14 on average. The two systems also fail differently. Qwen3.8-27B's first-token readout under-endorses the complement of a label whether or not the question contains "not", rejecting both a statement and its negation in 196 of 480 pairs, and it does not become more coherent where it is more confident, whereas Jev's violations concentrate where its answer is uncertain. Because the checks need no labels, they expose biases that appear only when question forms are compared, and inconsistencies within items.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用“逻辑一致性（coherence）”评估类型化决策模型（如Jev、Qwen3.8-27B），通过无需标签的逻辑关联问题组检验概率是否逐项自洽。
AI.motivation: 传统评估只报告准确率与校准度，但二者都不要求模型对逻辑相关问题给出的概率在逐项层面自洽，而实际基于这些概率行动的系统正需要这种一致性。
AI.method: 从ChaosNLI和PubMedQA选取160个各含三个互斥标签的样本，针对每个样本询问“标签是否为X”“是否不为X”“是否为其余两个标签之一”以及“哪个标签适用”，构造480个否定对，比较概率之和偏离1的程度。
AI.result: Jev在480个否定对上平均偏离1达0.064（95% CI 0.055–0.072）；Qwen3.8-27B官方BF16权重下首token概率偏离0.293，verbalized概率偏离0.122。Jev三类单标签概率平均求和为1.14，其违例约为重复噪声的5倍；Qwen3.8-27B在196/480对中同时拒绝陈述及其否定，且置信度更高时并不更一致，而Jev的违例集中在不确定处。
AI.conclusion: 无需标签的逻辑检验能揭示仅在比较问题形式时才出现的偏差及项目内部的不一致，两系统均不满足逐项相干性，且失效模式不同。

title: Background Gradients Shape Memorization in Flow Matching
summary: Repetition is closely associated with memorization in generative models, but how other training images affect the retention and copying of targets remains unclear. We study this question in class-conditioned flow matching, where images outside the target set form the background. At fixed target repetition and same-class background row count, replacing repeated same-class images with distinct images reduces the target extraction rate from 80.7% to 18.0%. To explain this effect, we develop a paired-trajectory framework that isolates target-induced parameter displacement and the background gradient response to it. This response has an exact path-integrated curvature representation, connecting background loss geometry to target learning. Reciprocal response transfer between repeated and distinct backgrounds changes target retention and copying in both directions, establishing the response's causal role. After target removal, the response correction parallel to the target-induced displacement preserves approximately 90% of the copying effects of full response transfer. Directly scaling the displacement also changes copying without further training. The post-removal copying effects of reciprocal transfer are reproduced across datasets and architectures. Together, these results identify the background gradient response as a mechanism through which same-class training data shape the retention of target learning and the reproduction of target images.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示同类背景图像的梯度响应是决定生成模型目标记忆与复制的关键机制，通过配对轨迹框架建立了背景损失几何与目标学习之间的因果联系。
AI.motivation: 重复训练与生成模型记忆密切相关，但目标集合之外的训练图像如何影响目标图像的保留与复制尚不明确，作者希望厘清背景数据在目标学习中的作用机制。
AI.method: 在类别条件流匹配中控制变量：固定目标重复次数与同类背景行数，将重复同类图像替换为不同图像；提出配对轨迹框架，分离目标诱导的参数位移与背景梯度对该位移的响应，并以精确的路径积分曲率表示刻画背景损失几何；通过重复与不同背景间的互惠响应迁移验证因果性。
AI.result: 相同目标重复与背景行数下，用不同图像替换重复同类图像使目标提取率从80.7%降至18.0%；互惠响应迁移可双向改变目标保留与复制；移除目标后，沿目标诱导位移方向的响应校正保留了约90%的完全响应迁移复制效应；直接缩放位移也能在无需再训练的情况下改变复制行为。
AI.conclusion: 背景梯度响应是同类训练数据塑造目标学习保留与目标图像复制的因果机制，该效应在移除目标后仍可复现，并跨数据集与架构成立。

title: CoLMbo-SV: A Grounded Language Model for Explainable Speaker Verification
summary: Speaker verification systems achieve high accuracy but provide little account of the acoustic evidence behind their judgments. Making these systems inspectable requires exposing interpretable evidence while retaining the richer information on which their decisions depend. We present \textbf{CoLMbo-SV}, a speaker language model that combines strong speaker discrimination with structured, acoustically grounded comparison reports. By connecting a pretrained speaker encoder to a language model and supplying explicit acoustic measurements, CoLMbo-SV makes voice comparisons inspectable without restricting verification to the evidence verbalized in its reports. We additionally introduce \textbf{VoxReason}, paired recordings with measured acoustic properties and comparison reports filtered through numerical and qualitative checks, providing supervision for this combined capability. We also develop an evaluation framework that separates what acoustic information a speaker representation encodes, what influences the verification score, and what the generated report discusses. On VoxCeleb1-O, CoLMbo-SV achieves 0.99\% EER, reducing verification error by approximately 80\% relative to the strongest audio-language baseline fine-tuned on VoxReason, while attaining a numerical-grounding score of 0.82. Our analysis further demonstrates that acoustic correctness and decision relevance are distinct properties of an explanation, exposing a gap that numerical-grounding metrics miss. Together, these contributions substantially advance audio-language speaker verification, bring its accuracy toward that of dedicated speaker encoders while adding checkable acoustic reporting, and establish an empirical framework for connecting natural-language explanations to the decisions they explain.

AI.tldr: 提出CoLMbo-SV说话人语言模型，将预训练说话人编码器与大语言模型连接并输入显式声学测量，实现可核查的声音对比报告，同时保持高判别性能；配套发布VoxReason数据集和三层评估框架。在VoxCeleb1-O上EER达0.99%。
AI.motivation: 现有说话人验证系统精度高，但无法说明判断背后的声学证据，缺乏可解释性；而要让系统可审查，既需要暴露可解释证据，又不能把验证决策限制在报告所口述的证据范围内。
AI.method: 1) 构建CoLMbo-SV：将预训练说话人编码器接入语言模型，并供给显式声学测量，生成结构化、声学有据的比较报告；2) 构建VoxReason数据集：成对录音+实测声学属性+经数值与定性校验过滤的比较报告，为上述联合能力提供监督；3) 设计评估框架，分离表征编码的声学信息、影响验证分数的影响因素、生成报告所讨论的内容三个层面。
AI.result: 在VoxCeleb1-O上EER为0.99%，相比在VoxReason上微调的最强音频-语言基线，验证错误降低约80%；数值接地分数达0.82。分析表明声学正确性与决策相关性是解释的两个不同属性，存在数值接地指标未捕捉的差距。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推进了音频-语言说话人验证，使其精度接近专用说话人编码器，同时增加可核查的声学报告，并建立了将自然语言解释与其所解释决策相联系的实证框架。

title: RepFlow: Reciprocal Supervision Improves Generation and Representation in Flow Models
summary: Generative models learn visual structure through denoising, yet their internal states are entangled with both noise level and network depth, making it difficult to obtain a stable visual representation from the generator itself. We introduce RepFlow, which learns such a representation from the generator's evolving computation and uses it to guide generation. Specifically, a separate timestep-free encoder is trained, through a timestep-conditioned predictor, to recover generator states across depths and noise levels from masked clean images. By excluding the reference noise and masked-out content from the encoder's input, we encourage the encoder to distill visual information that is recoverable from the visible image context and predictive of generator states. The representation learned from the generator's evolving states is then fed back to guide and improve the generator, whose updated states provide supervision for further representation learning, forming a reciprocal learning process. This reciprocal process improves multi-step generation and representation quality, as measured by frozen linear probing on ImageNet with latent-space SiT and pixel-space JiT, without an externally pretrained representation teacher. Across the two unconditional settings, FID decreases by $19.2$--$40.8\%$ relative to native training, while linear-probe accuracy improves by 6.80--10.04 percentage points over the best searched raw generator features. The learned representation also serves as a distributional metric for one-step JiT post-training, extending its role from instance-level alignment to distribution-level supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出 RepFlow，从生成器演化计算中学习稳定视觉表征并反馈引导生成，形成互惠学习，显著提升多步生成与表征质量（FID 降 19.2–40.8%，线性探测涨 6.80–10.04 个百分点），且无需外部预训练表征教师。
AI.motivation: 生成模型虽通过去噪学习视觉结构，但其内部状态同时纠缠于噪声水平和网络深度，难以从生成器自身获得稳定的视觉表征。
AI.method: 训练一个独立的无时间步编码器，通过时间步条件预测器，从被掩码的干净图像中恢复不同深度与噪声水平下的生成器状态。编码器输入排除参考噪声与被掩码内容，从而蒸馏出可从可见图像上下文恢复、且能预测生成器状态的视觉信息。所学表征再反馈以引导和改进生成器，更新后的生成器状态又为下一步表征学习提供监督，构成互惠学习闭环。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 上对潜空间 SiT 与像素空间 JiT 进行冻结线性探测：两个无条件设定下，FID 相对原生训练下降 19.2–40.8%，线性探测精度较最佳搜索的原始生成器特征提升 6.80–10.04 个百分点；无需外部预训练表征教师。所学表征还可作为一步 JiT 后训练中的分布级度量，将作用从实例级对齐扩展到分布级监督。
AI.conclusion: 从生成器演化计算中学习的表征可有效指导生成，且生成器改进又反哺表征学习，实现生成质量与表征质量的双重提升，拓展了表征在分布级监督中的应用。

title: Scope-WM: Scoped Computation for Efficient Visual World Models
summary: Visual world models enable robotic planning by predicting future observations, but dense latent-state propagation and sample-intensive trajectory optimization incur high inference latency and peak memory usage, limiting real-time deployment on resource-constrained platforms. Existing sparse world-model acceleration methods either rely on unguided token sparsification, which may discard planning-relevant information and restrict achievable sparsity, or introduce heavy auxiliary modules and cumbersome multi-stage training pipelines. In this work, we present Scope-WM, an efficient visual world model that scopes computation to prediction-relevant latent regions and promising action sequences. Scope-WM distills prediction relevance into a lightweight action-conditioned selector and applies full dynamics prediction only to a compact subset of selected tokens. It updates the remaining tokens using a compact summary of foreground states and their changes, allowing the background to perceive foreground dynamics without costly token-to-token interactions. During planning, Scope-WM preserves and reuses high-quality action sequences discovered during the initial MPC search, focusing subsequent search under reduced rollout budgets. The resulting pipeline requires only a one-off selector distillation followed by a single joint training stage for the sparse world model. On the challenging Push-T task, Scope-WM reduces peak GPU memory usage and planning time to $18.1\%$ and $14.3\%$ of those of dense DINO-WM, respectively, corresponding to a $6.97\times$ planning speedup, while maintaining competitive task performance. Further evaluations across five diverse visual planning tasks demonstrate the general applicability of Scope-WM. Code is available at https://github.com/ChunZheng2022/Scope-WM.

AI.tldr: Scope-WM通过将计算范围限定在预测相关的潜在区域和有潜力的动作序列，实现了视觉世界模型的高效规划加速。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界模型可用于机器人规划，但稠密潜在状态传播与样本密集的轨迹优化导致高推理延迟和峰值内存占用，限制了在资源受限平台上的实时部署。现有稀疏加速方法要么使用无引导的 token 稀疏化，可能丢弃规划相关信息并限制可达稀疏度，要么引入笨重的辅助模块和多阶段训练流程。
AI.method: 提出 Scope-WM：将预测相关性蒸馏到一个轻量级、动作条件化的选择器中，仅对选定 token 的紧凑子集执行完整动力学预测；其余 token 通过前景状态及其变化的紧凑摘要进行更新，使背景无需昂贵的 token 间交互即可感知前景动态。规划阶段保留并复用初始 MPC 搜索中发现的高质量动作序列，在缩减的 rollout 预算下聚焦后续搜索。整个流程仅需一次性选择器蒸馏加单个联合训练阶段。
AI.result: 在 Push-T 任务上，Scope-WM 将峰值 GPU 内存和规划时间分别降至稠密 DINO-WM 的 18.1% 和 14.3%，实现 6.97 倍规划加速，同时保持有竞争力的任务性能。在五个多样化视觉规划任务上的评估验证了其通用性。
AI.conclusion: Scope-WM 通过预测相关性引导的稀疏计算与动作序列复用，有效降低视觉世界模型规划的延迟与内存开销，具备良好的通用性，适用于资源受限平台上的实时机器人规划。

title: When Do Models Admit They Are Wrong? Failure Disclosure Is Unstable Under Reinforcement Learning
summary: Outcome-based reinforcement learning can produce models with similar task performance but very different ways of communicating about their mistakes. We study failure disclosure: whether a model admits that an attempted solution failed rather than staying silent or presenting it as successful. Across repeated outcome-only GRPO training runs, failure disclosure varies far more than task accuracy. The pattern extends to a second reasoning task and stabilized PPO, persists at 7B, and also appears in an instruction-conditioned 32B setting. We also find that small floating-point and sampling differences during training can redirect reporting behavior even when the task objective and earlier training history are held fixed. Additional tests show that failure disclosure is not a single decision: Checking the answer, entering a report, and completing the admission can separate, and the weak point depends on the task and response format. Further, experiments with neutral controls show more broadly that behaviors left weakly constrained by training are especially likely to vary across runs, of which failure disclosure is an example. We can reduce variability in failure disclosure by discouraging the model from drifting from its starting policy on failed, well-formed responses. This makes reporting substantially more consistent, though its effect on task performance depends on the setting. Stable task accuracy therefore does not guarantee stable safety-relevant behavior: Researchers should measure these behaviors directly across runs and design training methods that keep them reliable.

AI.tldr: 仅基于结果反馈的强化学习可训练出任务表现相近但"失败披露"行为差异极大的模型；这种差异源于训练欠约束，需跨运行直接测量并显式约束。
AI.motivation: 已有实践常以任务准确率作为模型可靠性的主要指标，但任务表现稳定并不代表安全相关行为稳定。作者关注"失败披露"这一具体行为——模型是否承认尝试失败，而非沉默或谎报成功——并希望检验其在重复训练中的可变性及成因。
AI.method: 在仅使用结果信号的GRPO上做多次重复训练并比较任务准确率与失败披露率；将验证扩展到第二个推理任务、稳定化PPO、7B模型以及指令条件下的32B设置。同时进行扰动实验（浮点与采样微差，固定目标与历史）、行为分解测试（检查答案、进入报告、完成承认三阶段）、中性对照实验，以及通过惩罚模型在失败但格式良好的回答上偏离初始策略来降低可变性的干预实验。
AI.result: 失败披露在重复运行间的波动显著大于任务准确率，该模式可跨任务、算法、规模复现；训练中微小的浮点或采样差异即可改变报告行为。失败披露并非单一决策，可分解为若干环节，且脆弱环节随任务与回答格式变化。中性对照表明训练约束较弱的行为普遍易在多轮运行间波动。对失败且格式良好的回答施加"不偏离初始策略"的约束可显著提高报告一致性，但对任务性能的影响依设置而异。
AI.conclusion: 稳定的任务准确率不能保证稳定的安全相关行为。研究者应在多次运行中直接测量此类行为，并设计能保持其可靠性的训练方法。

title: Beyond Memory Construction: Rethinking Memory Access for LLM-based Conversational Agents
summary: Memory is a core component of conversational agents, enabling coherent and context-aware behavior over long interactions. Recent approaches commonly rely on LLM-based memory construction, where raw interactions are rewritten into structured memory units and later retrieved via a RAG pipeline. While effective in controlled settings, we show that this paradigm breaks down in long-horizon, high-entropy conversations: memory construction becomes increasingly lossy and unstable as context length and information complexity grow, and incurs prohibitive cost due to repeated LLM invocation. To address these limitations, we propose Threader, a memory system that shifts the focus from memory construction to efficient, structure-aware access over raw interactions. Instead of rewriting interactions, Threader preserves them as first-class memory, organizes them into topic-coherent segments via lightweight incremental segmentation, and enables accurate retrieval through multi-view representation. At query time, it performs multi-signal retrieval that combines segment-level access with localized evidence matching, ensuring both completeness and coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Threader consistently improves answer accuracy and evidence recall, while significantly reducing the memory construction overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Threader 记忆系统，放弃 LLM 重写式记忆构建，改为对原始交互进行结构化访问，在长程高熵对话中提升答案准确率与证据召回并显著降低构建开销。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的对话记忆构建范式在长程、高熵对话中失效：随着上下文长度与信息复杂度增长，记忆构建愈发有损且不稳定，且重复调用 LLM 带来高昂成本。
AI.method: Threader 将原始交互保留为一等记忆而非重写；通过轻量级增量分割将其组织为主题一致的片段；借助多视图表示实现精准检索；查询时执行多信号检索，结合片段级访问与局部证据匹配。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Threader 在答案准确率和证据召回上持续提升，同时显著降低记忆构建开销。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆系统重心从记忆构建转向高效、结构感知的原始交互访问，是应对长程高熵对话记忆问题的有效路径。

title: AevaScenes: An FMCW LiDAR Dataset and Benchmark for Long-Range Perception
summary: FMCW LiDAR measures per-point radial Doppler velocity alongside range, providing a motion cue unavailable in conventional time-of-flight sensors. Exploiting this signal at long range remains understudied. We present an FMCW LiDAR dataset of 575 sequences (57.5K frames) with over 8 million annotated 3D boxes across 16 detection classes and per-point labels across 24 semantic classes, captured by six commercial FMCW LiDAR sensors and six paired 4K cameras across eight Bay Area cities, including 237 nighttime sequences, with annotations extending to 400m. We define a benchmark with three tasks: 3D object detection, scene flow estimation, and semantic segmentation. Detection and scene flow are evaluated across three range bins to 400m, with a public evaluation server. We explore the impact of Doppler measurements on flagship recognition tasks, and find significant improvements up to 2X in detection AP of far-away vehicles and pedestrians, particularly in low-latency single-frame settings. We similarly find scene flow accuracy is significantly improved with Doppler measurements across all ranges. Our dataset and benchmark have been publicly released at https://scenes.aeva.com.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布了大规模FMCW LiDAR数据集（575序列/57.5K帧，800万+3D框，16类检测、24类语义，探测距离达400m），并建立含3D检测、场景流与语义分割的基准，证明多普勒速度可显著提升远距离目标检测与场景流精度。
AI.motivation: FMCW LiDAR可提供逐点径向多普勒速度作为运动线索，但如何在远距离场景中利用该信号仍缺乏研究，也缺少相应的公开数据集与基准。
AI.method: 采集6种商用FMCW LiDAR与6台4K相机在8个Bay Area城市的数据，含237个夜间序列，标注延伸至400m；构建三大任务基准，检测与场景流按三个距离区间（至400m）评估，并提供公开评测服务器；对比分析多普勒测量对检测和场景流的影响。
AI.result: 引入多普勒测量后，远距离车辆与行人的检测AP最高提升2倍，在低延迟单帧设置下尤为明显；场景流精度在所有距离区间均显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 多普勒速度对远距离感知任务具有显著增益，数据集与基准已公开（https://scenes.aeva.com），为FMCW LiDAR远距离感知研究提供支撑。

title: PARSEE-VAD: Efficient Training-Free Online Video Anomaly Detection via Proposition-Aware Reasoning and Streaming Evidence Escalation
summary: Training-free online video anomaly detection (VAD) with frozen multimodal language models faces two coupled challenges: extracting reliable current-window semantics under causal and computational constraints, and maintaining temporal continuity without repeatedly transmitting high-dimensional history. Encoding history through text can compress visual evidence and introduce semantic bias, whereas retaining visual history expands multimodal context. We introduce PARSEE-VAD, a two-module framework that separates semantic evidence acquisition from score-state evolution. Proposition-Aware Reasoning (PAR) extracts structured propositional evidence from the current causal window and conditionally activates more specific queries when coarse evidence warrants further refinement. By sharing a reusable causal visual prefix across queries, PAR reduces redundant computation through selective execution. Streaming Evidence Escalation (SEE) maps the acquired proposition evidence into a compact score-domain event state through current evidence escalation, then propagates only the resulting bounded state across decisions to support temporal continuity. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate strong training-free online performance while selective routing reduces specialist computation and score-state propagation remains sparse. These results support a current-first principle for streaming multimodal inference: resolve present semantics first, then use compact historical state only to repair residual continuity gaps.

AI.tldr: 提出 PARSEE-VAD 双模块无训练在线视频异常检测框架，将语义证据获取与分数状态演化解耦，在四个基准上实现较强在线性能并降低计算与状态传播开销。
AI.motivation: 无训练在线视频异常检测使用冻结多模态语言模型时面临两个耦合难题：一是在因果与算力约束下提取可靠的当前窗口语义；二是在不反复传输高维历史的前提下保持时间连续性。文本编码历史可压缩视觉证据但引入语义偏差，保留视觉历史则扩张多模态上下文。
AI.method: PARSEE-VAD 包含两个模块。Proposition-Aware Reasoning（PAR）从当前因果窗口提取结构化命题证据，并在粗粒度证据需要时条件激活更具体的查询；通过跨查询共享可复用因果视觉前缀与选择性执行降低冗余计算。Streaming Evidence Escalation（SEE）将命题证据经当前证据升级映射为紧凑的分数域事件状态，仅传播有界状态以维持时间连续性。
AI.result: 在四个基准上取得较强的无训练在线性能；选择性路由降低了专家模块计算量，分数状态传播保持稀疏。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持流式多模态推理的“当前优先”原则：先解析当前语义，再仅用紧凑历史状态修复残余的连续性缺口。

title: Acoustic Progress Propagation for Long-Horizon Speculative Decoding in ASR
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive automatic speech recognition (ASR), but the acceptance length of alignment-aware drafters can saturate as the draft horizon increases. We propose a progress-aware speculative drafter that recurrently propagates an acoustic progress state across draft steps and feeds it back into audio cross-attention to guide token generation. We jointly train the drafter and progress predictor over variable draft horizons. On five ASR test sets, our method achieves lossless, macro-averaged end-to-end speedups of 1.657x and 1.227x over target-only autoregressive decoding with Qwen3-ASR-0.6B and Qwen3-ASR-1.7B, respectively. Relative to AnchorDraft, our method improves the macro-averaged speedup by 34.3% and 9.0%, respectively. Horizon sweeps show continued growth in acceptance length beyond the baselines' saturation. Code is available at https://github.com/yuanyuanjia71-spec/ProgDraft.

AI.tldr: 提出进度感知投机解码器（ProgDraft），通过递归传播声学进度状态并回馈至音频交叉注意力以引导草稿生成，缓解对齐感知草稿器接受长度随草稿视野饱和的问题。
AI.motivation: 投机解码可加速自回归ASR，但对齐感知草稿器的接受长度随草稿视野增大而饱和，限制进一步加速。
AI.method: 提出进度感知投机草稿器：在草稿步骤间递归传播声学进度状态，并将其回馈到音频交叉注意力中引导token生成；对草稿器与进度预测器在可变草稿视野下联合训练。
AI.result: 在五个ASR测试集上，基于Qwen3-ASR-0.6B与Qwen3-ASR-1.7B实现无损宏平均端到端加速1.657倍与1.227倍；相对AnchorDraft，宏平均加速分别提升34.3%与9.0%；视野扫描显示接受长度超越基线饱和点后仍持续增长。
AI.conclusion: 进度感知机制有效打破对齐感知草稿器的接受长度饱和，在无损前提下获得更高ASR投机解码加速。

title: VGGT-Diff: Visual Geometry Meets Diffusion for Sparse-View Novel View Synthesis
summary: We present VGGT-Diff, a geometry-routed multi-view diffusion model for sparse-view novel view synthesis. Existing novel view synthesis (NVS) methods face a fundamental trade-off: reconstruction-based approaches preserve observed geometry but struggle to synthesize unseen regions, while diffusion-based methods provide strong generative priors yet rely on implicit source-to-query correspondence. VGGT-Diff bridges these regimes by routing visual geometry latents from VGGT-Ω into a pretrained video diffusion model. Each visual token is associated with a 3D point and confidence, then transformed into query-aligned latent conditions through a confidence-aware Visual Geometry Router (VGR) that preserves front and back surface evidence. These conditions guide joint target-view denoising, while Point-Track Residual Consistency (PTRC) regularizes predicted-clean residuals along reliable 3D tracks, improving multi-view stability. We further introduce robust geometry conditioning, combining training-time regularization with inference-time guidance for improved robustness. Experiments show competitive or state-of-the-art performance across interpolation and extrapolation under different viewpoint difficulties. Our code is available at https://github.com/chenkangjie1123/VGGT-Diff.

AI.tldr: VGGT-Diff 通过将 VGGT-Ω 的视觉几何潜变量路由进预训练视频扩散模型，弥合重建法与扩散法在稀疏视角新视角合成中的取舍，在插值与外推上取得竞争性或SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有新视角合成方法存在根本性权衡：基于重建的方法能保持可观测几何，但难以合成未观测区域；基于扩散的方法具备强生成先验，却依赖隐式的源到查询对应关系。作者希望结合两者的优势，兼顾几何保真与生成能力。
AI.method: 提出 VGGT-Diff，一种几何路由的多视角扩散模型。将 VGGT-Ω 的视觉几何潜变量作为条件路由进预训练视频扩散模型；每个视觉 token 关联一个3D点及置信度，经置信度感知的 Visual Geometry Router (VGR) 转换为查询对齐的潜变量条件，保留前/后表面证据以引导联合目标视角去噪；引入 Point-Track Residual Consistency (PTRC)，沿可靠3D轨迹对预测的干净残差进行正则化以提升多视角稳定性；并采用鲁棒几何条件化，结合训练时正则化与推理时引导。
AI.result: 实验表明，在不同视角难度下的插值（interpolation）与外推（extrapolation）任务中，方法取得竞争性或最先进（state-of-the-art）的性能。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: VGGT-Diff 通过几何路由机制有效统一了重建式与扩散式范式，为稀疏视角新视角合成提供了兼顾几何一致性与生成质量的可行方案。

title: BERT4DTI : BERT-based Model for Predicting Drug-Protein Interactions
summary: Understanding how drugs interact with protein targets is fundamental to drug discovery, drug repurposing and the early identification of promising therapeutic candidates before costly experimental testing. Sequence-based DTI models face three practical limitations: labelled interactions are scarce and unevenly distributed, large pretrained chemical and protein encoders are expensive to fine-tune end-to-end, and independently encoded sequences do not capture pair-specific dependencies. We present BERT4DTI, which encodes SMILES strings with ChemBERTa and amino-acid sequences with ProtBERT, applies bidirectional mutual attention between token-level representations, and classifies the resulting interaction features using convolutional layers and a multilayer perceptron. To reduce trainable size, ProtBERT is truncated to 18 retained layers and only the last two layers of each encoder are fine-tuned. On BIOSNAP, DAVIS and BindingDB, BERT4DTI is competitive, achieving the best ROC-AUC and PR-AUC on BIOSNAP and the highest sensitivity on all three benchmarks. An ablation on DAVIS shows that mutual attention improves PR-AUC and specificity. With 125M trainable parameters compared with 353M for full BERT fine-tuning, BERT4DTI provides a favourable performance-parameter trade-off for sequence-based DTI screening, while leaving runtime profiling, calibration and leakage-audited validation for future work.

AI.tldr: BERT4DTI 用 ChemBERTa 与 ProtBERT 分别编码 SMILES 和氨基酸序列，通过双向互注意力融合 token 级表示，再用卷积层与 MLP 分类，在有限参数下实现具竞争力的 DTI 预测性能。
AI.motivation: 药物-靶标相互作用（DTI）预测是药物发现、药物重定位和候选治疗药物早期筛选的基础。现有基于序列的 DTI 模型存在三个实际限制：标注交互数据稀少且分布不均；大型预训练化学与蛋白质编码器端到端微调成本高；独立编码的序列无法捕捉配对特异性依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出 BERT4DTI：使用 ChemBERTa 编码 SMILES 字符串、ProtBERT 编码氨基酸序列；在 token 级表示之间施加双向互注意力（bidirectional mutual attention）；将得到的交互特征经卷积层与多层感知机（MLP）分类。为降低可训练参数量，将 ProtBERT 截断至保留 18 层，且每个编码器仅微调最后两层。
AI.result: 在 BIOSNAP、DAVIS 和 BindingDB 三个基准上，BERT4DTI 表现具竞争力：在 BIOSNAP 上取得最佳 ROC-AUC 与 PR-AUC，并在三个基准上均获得最高灵敏度（sensitivity）。DAVIS 上的消融实验表明互注意力可提升 PR-AUC 与特异性（specificity）。可训练参数为 125M，相较全量 BERT 微调的 353M 显著更少。
AI.conclusion: BERT4DTI 在基于序列的 DTI 筛选中提供了性能与参数量之间良好的权衡，适合作为低成本、具竞争力的方案；运行时性能分析、概率校准及防泄漏审计的验证留待未来工作。

title: PORTER: Edge-Cloud Residency for Persistent 3D Scene Graph Memory
summary: Recent task-driven and just-in-time 3D Scene Graph (3DSG) methods reduce per-task representations by constructing or activating only task-relevant information. Yet sparse per-task working sets do not bound onboard memory usage over a robot's lifetime: as tasks change, payloads accumulated for earlier tasks may become irrelevant to the current task but can be useful again in future tasks. Over repeated task switches and expanding environments, retaining such reusable payloads causes local memory to grow, whereas discarding them entirely can lead to costly repeated construction of the same payloads later. We introduce PORTER, which decouples persistence from residency: lightweight anchors remain in the limited memory of the edge robot while heavy object payloads migrate between the edge and the cloud. Relevance alone is insufficient for deciding residency because multiple relevant payloads may provide redundant information. We therefore decompose each task into functional requirements and introduce Irreplaceable Support Erasure (ISE), which measures the loss in requirement coverage caused by offloading. ISE discounts replaceable support and penalizes losses more strongly when the remaining coverage of a requirement is weak. PORTER constructs a budget-aware local working set by repeatedly offloading the payload with the smallest marginal ISE per byte. Experiments on JITOMA-Bench evaluate PORTER across four 3DSG builders. Under progressive compression, pooled relative mR@3 remains at 100% through 91% payload-byte offloading.

AI.tldr: PORTER 将持久性与驻留解耦：轻量锚点常驻机器人内存，重型对象载荷在边缘与云间迁移，并用不可替代支持擦除（ISE）指标做预算感知的卸载决策。
AI.motivation: 任务驱动与即时（just-in-time）3DSG 方法只构建或激活与当前任务相关的信息，但稀疏的按任务工作集无法在机器人整个生命周期内约束机载内存：任务切换后，早期任务积累的载荷对当前任务可能无关，却可能在将来复用。全部保留会随任务切换与环境扩展导致本地内存持续增长，全部丢弃又会在将来重复构建，代价高昂。
AI.method: 1) 解耦持久性与驻留：轻量锚点保留在边缘机器人有限内存中，重型对象载荷在边缘与云之间迁移。2) 指出仅用相关性不足以决定驻留，因为多个相关载荷可能提供冗余信息；将任务分解为功能需求。3) 提出不可替代支持擦除（ISE），度量卸载导致的需求覆盖损失：对可替代支持进行折扣，且当某需求剩余覆盖较弱时对损失的惩罚更强。4) 通过反复卸载“每字节边际 ISE 最小”的载荷，构建预算感知的本地工作集。
AI.result: 在 JITOMA-Bench 上对四种 3DSG 构建器进行评估。在渐进压缩下，载荷字节卸载比例达到 91% 时，池化相对 mR@3 仍保持 100%。
AI.conclusion: 以 ISE 为核心的预算感知卸载策略可在大幅削减本地载荷字节的同时保持任务性能，为长期运行机器人提供可扩展的内存管理方案。

title: EngIntervene: Benchmarking Multimodal Engineering State Understanding and Design Intervention Reasoning
summary: Multimodal engineering benchmarks largely evaluate static understanding, such as recognizing components, interpreting diagrams, or answering technical questions. This leaves a missing middle between engineering perception and full design generation: whether a model can use an understood system state to reason about relations, constraints, and the consequences of design changes. We introduce \textsc{EngIntervene}, a benchmark for this capability. It contains 3,229 questions across seven engineering domains and organizes evaluation into four levels: state grounding (T1), relational and mechanistic reasoning (T2), constraint-aware diagnosis (T3), and intervention reasoning (T4), which asks whether a proposed modification achieves its target while preserving required constraints. The tasks instantiate a unified engineering state representation spanning objects, relations, constraints, and design objectives, and T2--T4 are scored against structured reference answers with atomic criteria. Across open- and closed-weight multimodal models, stronger grounding does not reliably translate into better diagnosis or intervention, and the best open-weight model trails the best closed model by 14.7 percentage points on the T2--T4 average. Removing or shuffling visual evidence consistently degrades performance, while benchmark-specific supervised fine-tuning improves T1 but not T2--T4. T4 further exposes a large gap between satisfying individual revision criteria and producing a fully valid intervention. Engineering reasoning thus requires not only recovering the current state, but also reliably using it to reason about constraints and post-intervention consequences. Code and benchmark artifacts are available at https://github.com/changcv2021/EngIntervene

AI.tldr: 提出 EngIntervene 基准，覆盖 7 个工程领域、3,229 题，按 T1 状态锚定、T2 关系/机理推理、T3 约束感知诊断、T4 干预推理四级评估多模态模型，揭示"看得懂≠会推理"的能力断层。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态工程基准多评估静态理解（识别部件、读图、答技术题），在"工程感知"与"完整设计生成"之间存在空白：模型能否利用已理解的系统状态去推理关系、约束及设计变更的后果，尚缺评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 EngIntervene，含 3,229 题、7 个工程领域，分四级：T1 状态锚定、T2 关系与机理推理、T3 约束感知诊断、T4 干预推理（判断修改是否达成目标并保持约束）。任务基于统一工程状态表示（对象、关系、约束、设计目标），T2–T4 采用结构化参考答案与原子化评分标准打分。对开源与闭源多模态模型进行评测，并做视觉证据移除/打乱、基准监督微调等消融。
AI.result: 更强的状态锚定能力并不能可靠转化为更好的诊断或干预能力；T2–T4 平均分上最佳开源模型落后最佳闭源模型 14.7 个百分点。移除或打乱视觉证据一致导致性能下降；基准专用监督微调提升 T1 但不提升 T2–T4。T4 暴露出满足单条修改标准与产出完整有效干预之间的巨大差距。
AI.conclusion: 工程推理不仅要求恢复当前状态，更要求可靠地利用该状态推理约束与干预后后果；现有模型在这一"中间能力"上存在系统性缺陷，EngIntervene 为该能力提供了可诊断的评测框架。

title: VehDyn: A Driving World Model Benchmark for Vehicle Dynamics
summary: Video world models are emerging as data engines, action planners, and generative simulators for autonomous driving, but existing benchmarks primarily assess visual fidelity and coarse physical plausibility, providing limited evidence on whether generated driving futures obey realistic vehicle kinematics and dynamics. This limitation is further compounded by the lack of datasets in which vehicle, road, maneuver, and speed conditions are independently controlled, and ground-truth vehicle states are recorded in synchrony with videos. We introduce VehDyn, a driving world model benchmark for vehicle dynamics. VehDyn is built on a CARLA-CarSim co-simulation platform where photorealistic rendering is coupled with a validated multi-body dynamics model, and it contains 10,080 configurations from a full factorial design over five vehicle types, four tire-road friction coefficients, three maneuvers, four target speeds, 14 scenes, and three illuminations, each paired with synchronized position, velocity, and attitude sequences. Built on this dataset, VehDyn introduces a hierarchical evaluation framework that measures trajectory alignment, kinematic consistency, and dynamic consistency, and benchmarks 12 state-of-the-art video world models. We further assess the video quality using two established protocols and correlate it with the VehDyn score. Trajectory-level metrics are nearly saturated, with ten of twelve models within 20\% of ground truth, while no model reaches 92\% of ground truth on dynamic consistency, and visual-quality metrics are only weakly correlated with vehicle-dynamics fidelity. DrivingWorld achieves the highest VehDyn score, followed by Cosmos 3 Nano and LTX-Video 2.5, and the VehDyn score agrees closely with human judgment. VehDyn provides a systematic foundation for developing driving world models that are physically consistent and visually realistic.

AI.tldr: VehDyn是面向驾驶世界模型的车辆动力学基准，基于CARLA-CarSim联合仿真构建10,080组配置数据集，提出分层评估框架并评测12个先进视频世界模型，发现轨迹级指标接近饱和但动力学一致性普遍不足，且视觉质量与动力学保真度仅弱相关。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型基准主要评估视觉保真度和粗略物理合理性，无法证明生成的驾驶未来是否遵循真实车辆运动学与动力学；同时缺乏对车辆、道路、机动与速度条件独立控制且与视频同步记录真值车辆状态的数据集。
AI.method: 构建CARLA-CarSim联合仿真平台，将照片级渲染与经校验的多体动力学模型耦合；采用全因子设计生成10,080组配置，覆盖5种车型、4种轮胎-路面摩擦系数、3种机动、4种目标速度、14个场景和3种光照，每组配合同步的位置、速度与姿态序列；提出分层评估框架，度量轨迹对齐、运动学一致性与动力学一致性，并对12个先进视频世界模型进行基准评测，同时用两种成熟协议评估视频质量并与VehDyn分数做相关性分析。
AI.result: 轨迹级指标接近饱和，12个模型中有10个在真值20%以内；然而没有任何模型在动力学一致性上达到真值的92%；视觉质量指标与车辆动力学保真度仅弱相关。DrivingWorld取得最高VehDyn分数，其后为Cosmos 3 Nano和LTX-Video 2.5，且VehDyn分数与人类判断高度一致。
AI.conclusion: VehDyn为开发兼具物理一致性与视觉真实感的驾驶世界模型提供了系统化基础，揭示了当前模型在动力学一致性方面的显著缺口以及视觉质量指标在评估物理真实性上的局限。

title: Q-WAM: 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models with Action-Subspace Protection
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate video and robot actions through iterative diffusion and perform strongly in robotic manipulation. However, their prohibitive compute and memory costs pose substantial deployment challenges. Post-training quantization (PTQ) can reduce these costs, but existing PTQ methods such as smoothing and rotation are insufficient to maintain the precision of action generation. To overcome this limitation, we propose Q-WAM, a new 4-bit weight-activation quantization for WAMs that preserves the actions the model generates. Specifically, we introduce the \textit{Action Observability Gramian (AOG)}, which measures how much rounding errors in each weighted combination of a layer's input channels change the final action through all denoising steps. We also develop Action-Subspace Protection (ASP), which keeps the few most action-sensitive channel combinations in a tiny 16-bit low-rank branch and quantizes the complementary weights and activations to 4 bits, both as dense matrix multiplications that run efficiently on GPUs. Finally, to preserve action quality with minimal overhead, we identify the experts that matter most for the generated action by aggregating the AOG-derived action mass across the layers of each expert and apply ASP only to those experts. We evaluate Q-WAM on three WAMs, both in simulation and in real-world deployment. On the RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark, it reaches 89.6--93.0\% average success rate, within 1.1 percentage points of the 16-bit models, while reducing the memory of the quantized blocks by 3.1--3.4$\times$. Our method outperforms the strongest baseline, SVDQuant, by 2.5--8.7 percentage points. On a Unitree G1 humanoid and a bimanual UR3 robot, it improves success over SVDQuant by 12.8-17.6 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出Q-WAM，面向世界动作模型（WAMs）的4比特权重-激活后训练量化方法，通过动作可观测格拉姆矩阵（AOG）与动作子空间保护（ASP）保持动作生成精度，显著降低显存并保持成功率。
AI.motivation: WAMs通过迭代扩散联合生成视频与机器人动作，在机器人操作中表现优异，但其计算与显存开销极大，部署困难。现有PTQ方法（如平滑、旋转）难以维持动作生成精度。
AI.method: 提出Q-WAM：1) 定义动作可观测格拉姆矩阵（AOG），度量每层输入通道各加权组合的舍入误差经全部去噪步骤对最终动作的影响；2) 设计动作子空间保护（ASP），将少数最动作敏感的通道组合保留在16比特低秩分支，其余权重与激活量化为4比特，均以GPU高效稠密矩阵乘法实现；3) 通过在各专家层聚合AOG导出的动作质量，识别对生成动作最重要的专家，仅对这些专家应用ASP以最小开销保持动作质量。
AI.result: 在三个WAMs上于仿真与真实部署中评估。RoboTwin 2.0上平均成功率89.6–93.0%，距16比特模型1.1个百分点以内，量化块显存降低3.1–3.4倍；优于最强基线SVDQuant 2.5–8.7个百分点。在Unitree G1人形与双臂UR3机器人上，较SVDQuant成功率提升12.8–17.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Q-WAM是一种面向WAMs的4比特权重-激活量化方案，在保持动作生成精度的同时大幅降低显存并提升部署可行性，仿真与真实机器人实验均优于现有PTQ基线。

title: The Text Beside the Image: Detection, Utility and Leakage for Trustworthy Multimodal Medical Data and Beyond
summary: Medical images are released with the reports that describe them, and protecting the image does not protect the report. This paper measures the text component of such releases. We measure identifier detection, downstream utility and residual identity leakage on the same documents, with the pseudonymisation policy as the variable under test: 15 detectors, three release conditions and four corpora of medical reports, legal judgments, news and other genres, and e-mail, in German, English, Chinese and Arabic. A fixed 13-detector union reaches a person sensitivity of 0.9998 at specificity 0.8686 on the medical reports, 0.9958 at 0.8504 on the legal judgments, 0.9352 at 0.9318 on news and other genres, and 0.9906 at 0.6235 on e-mail. With this ensemble, frequency matching with a public name list recovers zero identities by alignment across the four corpora; the names it got right were ones the detector missed, left in clear text. Cross-document linkage ranks the correct person first for 0.93% of e-mail queries without training and 3.94% with it, against 1/3697 chance and 71.98% on unmodified text. On the medical reports it recovers nothing without training and 0.71% of 138 queries with it, against 1/207 chance and a 2.73% ceiling on unmodified text.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评测了医学文本发布中的去标识化效果，在四种语料、四种语言上测量标识符检测、下游效用与残余身份泄漏，发现固定13检测器联合体在医学报告上人物灵敏度0.9998（特异度0.8686），但跨文档链接仍存在残余泄漏风险。
AI.motivation: 医学图像发布时通常附带描述性报告，而仅对图像进行保护并不能保护报告文本内容，因此需要量化文本发布环节的标识符泄漏风险，并评估不同假名化策略的实际保护效果。
AI.method: 以假名化策略为受试变量，在德语、英语、中文、阿拉伯语四种语言上，使用医学报告、法律判决、新闻及其他体裁、电子邮件四类语料，比较15种检测器、三种发布条件下的标识符检测率、下游效用与残余身份泄漏；并评估固定13检测器联合体、公开姓名列表频率匹配以及跨文档链接攻击的效果。
AI.result: 固定13检测器联合体在医学报告上人物灵敏度0.9998、特异度0.8686，法律判决0.9958/0.8504，新闻及其他体裁0.9352/0.9318，电子邮件0.9906/0.6235。频率匹配在四类语料上通过对齐恢复的身份数为零，检出的姓名均为检测器漏检而留在明文中的部分。跨文档链接在电子邮件查询中无训练时正确人物排名第一的比例为0.93%，有训练时为3.94%，对照随机概率1/3697、未修改文本为71.98%；医学报告上无训练时无恢复，有训练时138个查询中恢复0.71%，对照随机概率1/207、未修改文本上限为2.73%。
AI.conclusion: 文本去标识化检测性能较高，但残余身份泄漏仍然存在，尤其是跨文档链接攻击在特定条件下可恢复部分身份，说明单一假名化策略不足以保证发布文本的隐私安全。

title: InfoEdit: Probing Global Layout Reasoning in Infographic Editing
summary: Multimodal foundation models edit natural photographs at production quality, yet the same models struggle with structured visual content such as infographics. Unlike photographs, infographics encode information through logical relations; editing one element often requires surrounding elements to be adapted. We refer to this global layout reasoning capability as reflow. Existing image-editing benchmarks neither provide a dedicated setting for structured visual content nor evaluate the reflow capability. We introduce InfoEdit, a novel benchmark of 1,000 infographics across eight logical-relation families, paired with 4,000 editing instructions across four editing tasks, and a reflow-aware evaluation protocol. Across eight frontier editors, only GPT-Image-2 clears 60% average success rate; most models fall below 7%, and no editor exceeds 36% on the Swap-Block task even with perfect target localization. We further show that code-level editing can match the strongest pixel-level editor, revealing complementary strengths across tasks. InfoEdit identifies reflow as a central challenge in structured visual content editing and provides a diagnostic benchmark to facilitate future progress.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InfoEdit基准，包含1,000张信息图、8类逻辑关系、4,000条编辑指令及4类任务，并设计reflow感知评测协议；结果显示多模态基础模型在结构化视觉内容编辑上远逊于自然照片，reflow是核心挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态基础模型虽能在生产级质量上编辑自然照片，但面对信息图等结构化视觉内容时表现不佳。信息图通过逻辑关系编码信息，编辑单个元素往往需要联动调整周边元素（即全局布局推理能力，作者称之为reflow）。而现有图像编辑基准既未提供面向结构化视觉内容的专门设定，也未评估reflow能力。
AI.method: 构建InfoEdit基准：覆盖8类逻辑关系家族的1,000张信息图，配以跨4类编辑任务的4,000条编辑指令，并设计reflow感知的评测协议。在8个前沿编辑器上进行评测，同时对比代码级编辑与像素级编辑的表现。
AI.result: 仅GPT-Image-2平均成功率超过60%，多数模型低于7%；在Swap-Block任务上，即便目标定位完美，也无编辑器超过36%。此外，代码级编辑可达与最强像素级编辑器相当的水平，揭示不同任务间的互补优势。
AI.conclusion: InfoEdit将reflow确认为结构化视觉内容编辑的核心挑战，并提供了一个可诊断的基准以推动未来进展。

title: Informative Viewpoint Selection for Episodic-Memory Embodied Question Answering using Omnidirectional Images
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. Supplementary video is provided as an ancillary file
summary: Embodied Question Answering (EQA) requires agents to answer natural language questions about surrounding environments from visual observations. In this work, we focus on open-vocabulary episodic-memory EQA (EM-EQA), where an agent answers free-form questions using recorded observation histories. Omnidirectional images are promising for this task, as they provide wide field-of-view observations that can capture surrounding context without requiring explicit camera rotations. However, omnidirectional images introduce two challenges for EQA: (i) equirectangular projection causes severe geometric distortion that degrades vision-language model (VLM) recognition accuracy, and (ii) feeding equirectangular images directly into VLMs introduces excessive irrelevant background information, reducing answer accuracy and increasing the visual-token burden. To address these challenges, we propose a viewpoint selection method for EM-EQA using omnidirectional images. Our method converts equirectangular observations into perspective views via cubemap projection, estimates question-conditioned relevance with fine-tuned BLIP-2, and selects informative and diverse viewpoints through diversity-aware greedy selection. Experiments on the Habitat-Matterport 3D (HM3D) subset of OpenEQA show that our method achieves state-of-the-art model performance among the reported model results with equirectangular observations. Moreover, after removing rotation views, which reduces observation frames by 65.5%, our method largely maintains its answer accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文针对开放式词汇情景记忆EQA（EM-EQA），提出一种基于全向图像的视角选择方法：将等距柱状投影观测转为立方体贴图透视图，用微调的BLIP-2估计问题相关度，并通过多样性感知贪婪选择挑出信息量高且多样的视角。在OpenEQA的HM3D子集上取得报告模型中基于等距柱状观测的最优性能，且删去旋转视角后观测帧减少65.5%仍基本保持精度。
AI.motivation: EM-EQA需要智能体基于记录的历史观测回答自由形式问题。全向图像可提供无需显式旋转相机的大视场上下文，但等距柱状投影带来两个问题：一是严重几何畸变降低VLM识别精度；二是直接输入整张图像引入大量无关背景，降低答案准确率并增加视觉token负担。因此需要一种视角选择机制来缓解畸变并去除冗余。
AI.method: 方法包含三步：(1) 将等距柱状观测通过立方体贴图投影转换为透视图；(2) 用微调的BLIP-2估计问题条件下的视角相关度；(3) 通过多样性感知的贪婪选择，选出信息量高且多样化的视角集，供VLM作答。
AI.result: 在OpenEQA的HM3D子集上，该方法在报告的基于等距柱状观测的模型结果中达到SOTA。去除旋转视角后，观测帧数减少65.5%，答案准确率仍基本保持。
AI.conclusion: 以立方体贴图透视图替代等距柱状图并结合问题条件相关度与多样性感知选择，能有效缓解几何畸变和冗余背景问题，在提升EM-EQA精度的同时大幅降低观测帧数与视觉token开销。

title: Calibration, Not Answer Selection: Distilling Internal Confidence in Reasoning Models
summary: Reinforcement learning with binary correctness rewards trains correctness, not calibrated confidence. The confidence that reasoning models verbalize is systematically overconfident, and the problem is not merely one of scale: verbalized confidence tracks how willing a model is to commit to an answer, not how likely the answer is to be right. Post-hoc rescaling therefore fits one distribution but rarely transfers. We look inside the model instead. On factual question answering, a linear probe on the hidden state between the chain of thought and the answer is substantially better calibrated: its expected calibration error is 5 to 38 times lower than that of the verbalized score across four benchmarks and two model families. However, when used to pick among N sampled answers, that same probe nearly ties majority voting yet falls far short of the oracle. Internal states answer "how certain am I" well and "which answer is right" poorly, so the signal should be reported as a confidence rather than used to select answers. As a result, we introduce probe-guided self-distillation (Probe-SD): score a model's own sampled traces with the probe, overwrite the confidence each trace states, and finetune the base checkpoint of the same family, so nothing but the model itself remains at test time. On Qwen3-14B, Probe-SD cuts ECE from 0.178 to 0.024 in-domain and from 0.542 to 0.113 out-of-domain, where it also beats post-hoc recalibration and self-consistency distillation. The resulting confidence is well-calibrated and useful for weighted voting, behaviors previously attributed to online RL, here obtained with supervised finetuning alone.

AI.tldr: 用隐藏状态探针提取置信度并自我蒸馏，可得到校准良好、可用于加权投票的置信度。
AI.motivation: 二值正确性奖励的强化学习只训练正确性、不训练校准置信度；模型"说出的"置信度系统性过度自信，且不是规模问题——它反映的是模型"是否愿意给出答案"而非"答案是否正确"。事后重缩放只能拟合单一分布、难以迁移。
AI.method: 转向模型内部：在事实问答中，取思维链与答案之间隐藏状态上的线性探针。发现该探针校准显著更优，但在 N 选一中接近多数投票、远逊于 oracle，说明内部状态擅长回答"我有多确信"而非"哪个答案对"。据此提出探针引导自我蒸馏（Probe-SD）：用探针给模型自己采样的轨迹打分，覆盖每条轨迹陈述的置信度，微调同家族基础检查点，测试时仅保留模型本身。
AI.result: 在四个基准、两个模型家族上，探针 ECE 比"说出的"置信度低 5–38 倍。Qwen3-14B 上，Probe-SD 将 ECE 从域内 0.178 降至 0.024，域外从 0.542 降至 0.113，并优于事后重校准与自洽蒸馏。
AI.conclusion: 内部状态置信度应作为"置信度"报告而非用于选答案；Probe-SD 用纯监督微调即可获得校准良好且利于加权投票的置信度，此前被认为需在线 RL 才能实现。

title: TraceDance: An Automated System for Building Agent Behavior Benchmarks from Real-World Agent Deployment Traces
summary: An agent can complete a task while exhibiting undesirable behavior during execution. Developers need tests for the specific behaviors encountered in deployment, beyond fixed benchmark suites. We present TraceDance, an agent system that constructs targeted benchmarks from deployment traces for user-specified undesirable behaviors. For efficient construction, Anchor-and-Confirm combines programmable retrieval with candidate-level confirmation by a Flash large language model (LLM), while the Anchor Synthesis Loop generates and revises specifications for custom behaviors. The benchmarks use decision-point continuation to evaluate an LLM's next turn at a recorded decision point with a behavior-specific rubric, without a reference answer or environment replay. Experiments in coding and general tool use draw on 252,557 sessions and produce 107 benchmarks with 4,125 instances, fulfilling 95.3% of build-target requests. Both human annotators confirm the requested behavior in 84% of sampled instances, and the automated grader's agreement with human pass/fail judgments is comparable to that between the annotators. Nine frontier LLMs achieve a mean pass rate of only 26.7%, showing that they still struggle to respond appropriately at the evaluated decision points. Analysis across behavior-specific benchmarks further reveals weaknesses in how current LLMs behave as agents. By turning deployment problems into targeted benchmarks, TraceDance could serve as a key component of the recursive self-improvement (RSI) loop.

AI.tldr: TraceDance 是一种从部署轨迹中自动构建针对性 agent 行为基准的系统，结合可编程检索与 LLM 确认，在编码与通用工具使用场景中生成 107 个基准、4125 个实例，九个前沿 LLM 平均通过率仅 26.7%。
AI.motivation: 固定基准套件无法覆盖部署中实际出现的不良行为，开发者需要针对特定行为的测试；因此需要将部署轨迹转化为定制化基准，以支撑 agent 的持续改进。
AI.method: 提出 TraceDance：Anchor-and-Confirm 将可编程检索与 Flash LLM 候选级确认结合以高效构建基准；Anchor Synthesis Loop 生成并修订自定义行为的规格；基准采用决策点续写（decision-point continuation）方式，在记录的决策点用行为特定评分标准评估 LLM 的下一轮输出，无需参考答案或环境回放。
AI.result: 在编码与通用工具使用场景中，基于 252,557 个会话构建 107 个基准、4,125 个实例，满足 95.3% 的构建目标请求；两位人工标注者在 84% 的抽样实例中确认了目标行为，自动评分器与人工通过/失败判断的一致性接近标注者之间的一致性；九个前沿 LLM 平均通过率仅 26.7%。
AI.conclusion: TraceDance 可将部署问题转化为针对性基准，揭示当前 LLM 作为 agent 的行为弱点，有望成为递归自我改进（RSI）闭环的关键组件。

title: BaatCheet: A Multilingual Corpus for Dialogue Translation in Indian Languages
summary: Existing translation models are typically trained on sentence-level and formal text, limiting their ability to capture everyday conversational dialogue phenomena such as informality, speaker interaction, and discourse coherence. Most existing Indic translation resources and evaluation benchmarks focus on sentence-level or formal text, making it difficult to assess translation quality of the dialogue phenomena. In this work, we introduce BaatCheet, a multilingual dialogue corpus named after the Hindi term for conversation or chitchat, containing approximately 49,000 dialogues for dialogue translation across five translation directions. We fine-tune five open-source LLMs across seven training data configurations and find that fine-tuning yields substantial gains over zero- and few-shot baselines. To comprehensively evaluate dialogue translation quality, we employ multiple evaluation strategies, including automatic metrics, LLM-as-judge, and human assessments using an SQM-guided Direct Assessment (DA) Protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BaatCheet——一个多语言对话翻译语料库，包含约49,000个对话，覆盖五个翻译方向，并基于七种训练数据配置对五个开源大语言模型进行微调，发现微调显著优于零样本和少样本基线；同时采用自动指标、LLM-as-judge和人工评估综合衡量对话翻译质量。
AI.motivation: 现有翻译模型大多基于句子级和正式文本训练，难以捕捉日常会话中的非正式性、说话人互动和语篇连贯等现象；同时现有印度语言翻译资源和评测基准也多集中于句子级或正式文本，无法有效评估对话翻译质量。
AI.method: 构建BaatCheet多语言对话语料库，覆盖五个翻译方向、约49,000个对话；在七种训练数据配置下微调五个开源大语言模型；并采用自动指标、LLM-as-judge以及基于SQM引导的直接评估（DA）协议的人工评估进行多维评测。
AI.result: 微调在对话翻译任务上相较零样本和少样本基线取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: BaatCheet为印度语言对话翻译提供了新的数据资源与评测基准，表明针对对话场景的微调对提升翻译质量具有重要作用，并通过多策略评估为对话翻译质量提供了更全面的衡量方式。

title: Hesitation-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by iterative unmasking. At each denoising step, a dLLM proposes a token at every masked position, but the decoder commits only a confident subset of these proposals. Trace-based on-policy distillation (TOPD) builds on this process by matching the student to a stronger teacher, yet only at the committed positions. We argue that this discards much of the useful signal, which resides in the uncommitted proposals, where the student has made a prediction but is not yet confident enough to commit it. We call these proposals hesitations. In our pilot study on an SDAR-4B student, hesitations make up only 24% of supervisable state-position pairs but carry 66% of the teacher-student divergence. To exploit this signal, we propose Hesitation-Aware On-Policy Distillation (HOPD), which extends teacher distribution matching to every masked position of each denoising step. Because hesitations are not equally informative, we further allocate supervision using hindsight from the completed trajectory, placing more weight on positions whose proposal was later disagreed with the final token and on blocks where first-step proposals rarely survive. Since both models already produce distributions at all masked positions, HOPD requires no additional forward passes over TOPD. The only extra cost is evaluating the loss at more positions. With SDAR-1.7B and SDAR-4B students distilled from TraDo-8B-Instruct, HOPD achieves the best average score among the evaluated methods on five math and coding benchmarks, under both static and dynamic decoding and at both scales. It also speeds up decoding. On SDAR-4B, the HOPD student hesitates less and commits 11% more tokens per denoising step than TOPD, while reaching higher accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出HOPD，将扩散语言模型的在线策略蒸馏从已提交位置扩展到所有掩码位置（含"犹豫"），无需额外前向，在数学与代码基准上取得更优成绩并加速解码。
AI.motivation: 现有基于轨迹的在线策略蒸馏（TOPD）仅在解码器已提交的置信位置上匹配教师分布，丢弃了未提交的proposals中所含的大量有用信号。作者将这类"学生已预测但置信度不足以提交"的proposals称为"犹豫"（hesitations），并指出其在监督信号中的占比虽小，却承载了大部分师生分布差异。
AI.method: 先做试点研究：在SDAR-4B学生上统计犹豫占可监督状态-位置对的比例及其对师生散度的贡献。基于此提出HOPD，将教师分布匹配扩展到每个去噪步骤的所有掩码位置；并利用完整轨迹的事后信息（hindsight）进行监督加权——对最终token与提案不一致的位置、以及首步提案很少存活的位置给予更高权重。由于两模型本就在所有掩码位置输出分布，HOPD相比TOPD无需额外前向，仅增加loss评估位置。
AI.result: 以TraDo-8B-Instruct蒸馏SDAR-1.7B与SDAR-4B学生，在五个数学与代码基准上，HOPD在静态与动态解码、两种规模下均取得所评估方法中最佳平均分，并加快解码。在SDAR-4B上，HOPD学生犹豫更少，每步提交token数比TOPD多11%，同时准确率更高。
AI.conclusion: 未提交的"犹豫"位置是扩散语言模型在线策略蒸馏中被忽视的高价值监督信号；将其纳入全位置分布匹配并配合事后加权，可在几乎不增加计算成本的前提下提升精度与解码效率。

title: Relevance Does Not Imply Applicability: Experience Activation for Personal GUI Agents
summary: Personal Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents rely on interaction history to infer what a user wants from ambiguous instructions and to anticipate recurring routines. Existing approaches retrieve task-relevant history and append it to the policy's context, implicitly assuming that experience relevant to a task remains useful for each decision within it. We find that this help is largely spent at the first decision: retrieved history strongly improves the opening step of an episode, yet provides little sustained benefit over the remaining 90\% of steps, and offers weak guidance on whether a proactive suggestion is warranted. A relevant record may tell the agent where to begin, but not which past action applies to the current screen or whether a routine is due now. The underlying issue is that relevance does not imply applicability}: relevance is determined at the task level, whereas applicability depends on the situation at decision time. We therefore recast personalization as experience activation and introduce ExpActivator, a training-free framework that activates only the experience applicable to the current situation. During execution, ExpActivator matches each new screen to historical states in the frozen GUI backbone's latent space and supplies the corresponding action as a reference. Before execution, it activates a recurring intent only when the current time and scenario provide sufficient support, and otherwise abstains. Across four GUI backbones, ExpActivator improves within-trajectory step success by 28\% on average, achieves the best personalized execution on every backbone while using about one-fifth as many history tokens, and reaches approximately 2.3$\times$ the Matthews correlation coefficient of the strongest proactive baseline. Experience pays where it is activated, not where it is appended.

AI.tldr: 现有个人化GUI智能体将检索到的历史直接拼接进策略上下文，隐含假设"任务相关即每步有用"；作者发现检索历史收益几乎集中在首个决策，对后续90%步骤帮助有限。为此提出免训练框架ExpActivator，把个人化重构为"经验激活"：在执行时于冻结GUI骨干的隐空间中，将当前屏幕与历史状态匹配并给出对应动作参考；执行前仅在时间与场景提供充分支持时激活复现意图，否则弃权。在四个GUI骨干上，平均提升轨迹内步骤成功率28%，个性化执行最优且历史token用量约降至五分之一，主动建议的MCC约为最强基线的2.3倍。
AI.motivation: 个人化GUI智能体依赖交互历史来消解模糊指令并预判复现性例程。既有方法检索任务相关历史并拼接进策略上下文，隐含假设"与任务相关的经验对任务内每一步决策都有用"。作者实证发现该收益几乎全部消耗在首个决策：检索历史显著改善回合开端，但在剩余约90%的步骤中几乎没有持续收益，且对"是否应作出主动建议"的指引很弱。一条相关记录能告诉智能体从何处开始，却无法说明哪一历史动作适用于当前屏幕、或某例程此刻是否到期。根本问题是"相关性不等于适用性"：相关性在任务层面确定，而适用性取决于决策时刻的具体情境。
AI.method: 将个人化重新表述为"经验激活"，提出免训练框架ExpActivator，只激活适用于当前情境的经验。执行阶段：在冻结的GUI骨干潜空间中，将每个新屏幕与历史状态进行匹配，并供给对应动作作为参考。执行前阶段：仅当当前时间与场景提供充分支持时才激活某复现性意图，支持不足则弃权（abstain）。
AI.result: 在四个GUI骨干上：轨迹内步骤成功率平均提升28%；在每个骨干上均取得最佳个人化执行效果，同时历史token用量约为原来的五分之一；主动建议的Matthews相关系数约为最强基线的2.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 经验的价值在于"被激活的位置"，而非"被拼接的位置"（Experience pays where it is activated, not where it is appended）。个人化不应以任务级相关性为准则检索并追加历史，而应在决策时刻按情境适用性激活经验。

title: LoopTrack: A Simple Baseline for Parameter-Efficient Transformer Tracking
comment: Code and models will be released
summary: Current Transformer-based tracking methods typically stack multiple Transformer blocks with separate parameters to model interactions between the target template and the search region for target localization. These trackers often incur substantial parameter overhead from stacked blocks, making their deployment on resource-limited devices difficult. To address this, we propose a parameter-efficient Transformer tracking framework, dubbed LoopTrack, which repeatedly applies a set of Transformer blocks with shared parameters to interact features in a looped architecture for tracking, significantly reducing the number of parameters. To further exploit target cues, we present two lightweight designs, including target-aware looping (TAL) and gated target memory (GTM). The former applies intermediate target information generated by one loop to guide feature interaction in the subsequent loop, enabling progressive feature refinement, while the latter maintains a compact memory across frames, which is incorporated into the loop process to provide long-term information to the tracker, mitigating temporal drift in tracking. Compared to existing Transformer trackers, LoopTrack enables multiple rounds of feature interaction with fewer model parameters, making it resource-friendly for deployment. In extensive experiments on multiple datasets, LoopTrack shows a favorable accuracy-parameter trade-off. In particular, our LoopTrack$_{\rm One}$, with a single shared Transformer block, achieves 66.2\% SUC score on LaSOT with only 3.4M parameters, while LoopTrack$_{\rm Three}$, using three shared blocks, achieves 69.3\% SUC score with 6.4M parameters, surpassing existing parameter-efficient tracking methods with comparable or larger model size. With LoopTrack, we aim to establish a simple yet strong baseline for parameter-efficient Transformer tracking. Our code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出参数高效的Transformer跟踪框架LoopTrack，通过循环共享参数块并引入目标感知循环与门控目标记忆，显著减少参数量并保持竞争力精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的跟踪方法通常堆叠多个参数独立的Transformer块来建模模板与搜索区域交互，导致参数量开销巨大，难以部署在资源受限设备上。
AI.method: LoopTrack在循环架构中反复应用一组共享参数的Transformer块进行特征交互，从而大幅减少参数量；并设计两种轻量模块：目标感知循环（TAL）利用上一轮循环产生的中间目标信息引导下一轮特征交互，实现渐进式特征细化；门控目标记忆（GTM）跨帧维护紧凑记忆并融入循环过程，提供长期信息以缓解时序漂移。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上展现出良好的精度-参数权衡：LoopTrack_One（单个共享块）在LaSOT上以3.4M参数达到66.2% SUC；LoopTrack_Three（三个共享块）以6.4M参数达到69.3% SUC，超越参数量相当或更大的现有参数高效跟踪方法。
AI.conclusion: LoopTrack以更少参数实现多轮特征交互，对部署友好，可作为参数高效Transformer跟踪的简单而强力的基线。

title: SocialHumanoid: Towards Expressive Humanoid Behavior via One-Step Co-Speech Motion Generation
summary: Humanoid robots are increasingly expected to serve as embodied social agents that communicate naturally with humans through face-to-face interaction. During such communication, humanoid robots require body behaviors that are synchronized with speech, affectively expressive, and suitable for real-time execution. However, existing co-speech methods are primarily developed for digital humans and lack joint support for affective control and low-latency continuous generation on physical embodiments. To bridge this gap, we present SocialHumanoid, a system for expressive humanoid behavior via one-step co-speech motion generation. Given response speech and a specified affective condition, SocialHumanoid generates each full-body motion window in a single forward pass and connects successive windows through motion-history conditioning. The generated human motion is further converted online into embodiment-compatible robot references and tracked by a whole-body controller for physical execution. To provide explicit supervision for affective body expression, we further introduce AffectMoCap, a 4-hour dataset captured from two professional actors, containing synchronized speech, body motion, fine-grained hand motion, and emotion annotations. On BEAT2, SocialHumanoid achieves the best FGD among the compared generation methods, competitive speech-motion synchrony, and approximately $6\times$ faster inference than GestureLSM under the same protocol. Perceptual evaluations further show that training with AffectMoCap improves affect recognition from generated body motion, while real-robot experiments demonstrate continuous affect-conditioned behavior and stable long-horizon execution. Our project page is https://rex0191.github.io/SocialHumanoid/.

AI.tldr: 提出SocialHumanoid系统，通过一步式共语动作生成，为类人机器人提供情感可控、低延迟的全身行为，并配套发布AffectMoCap情感动作数据集，实现物理实体的实时连续执行。
AI.motivation: 类人机器人需要与语音同步、具情感表现力且能实时执行的身体行为，但现有共语方法主要面向数字人，缺乏情感控制与低延迟连续生成的联合支持，难以迁移到物理实体。
AI.method: 给定响应语音与指定情感条件，单次前向生成每个全身运动窗口，并通过运动历史条件连接相邻窗口；将生成的人体运动在线转换为机器人可用的参考，并由全身控制器跟踪执行。同时构建AffectMoCap数据集（两名专业演员、4小时，含同步语音、身体运动、精细手部运动与情感标注）以提供显式情感监督。
AI.result: 在BEAT2上取得对比方法中最优FGD，语音-运动同步性具竞争力，同协议下推理速度约为GestureLSM的6倍；感知评估显示AffectMoCap训练提升了生成动作的情感识别率；真机实验验证了连续情感条件行为与稳定的长时程执行。
AI.conclusion: SocialHumanoid弥合了数字人共语生成与类人机器人物理执行之间的差距，兼具情感可控、低延迟与实时连续生成能力，并通过新数据集与真机实验验证了其有效性。

title: PIC-UIE: Predicting Image-Adaptive Corrections for Lightweight Underwater Image Enhancement
summary: Underwater image enhancement (UIE) aims to restore visibility, color fidelity, and structural detail from images degraded by wavelength-dependent attenuation and backscatter. State-of-the-art UIE methods often rely on large backbones and dense image-to-image prediction, limiting their practicality for edge deployment. Moreover, operating entirely in a single color space couples degradation estimation with luminance and chroma correction. To address these challenges, we propose PIC-UIE, a lightweight predictor--executor framework that predicts image-adaptive corrections from a fixed $256\times256$ RGB thumbnail and applies them to the native-resolution input in the YCbCr color space. The predictor produces seven outputs, organized into spatial correction, nonlinear luminance and coupled chroma mapping, and image-level color calibration. A depth map regularizes the transmission proxy during training, whereas inference uses only the RGB input. With 9,486 parameters and 0.094 GFLOPs at $256\times256$, PIC-UIE achieves 24.137 dB PSNR and 0.9216 SSIM on UIEB-90 and 21.320 dB PSNR on zero-shot LSUI. It further processes native 4K images at 55.0 FPS under the comparison protocol. These results show that structured correction prediction provides an effective and practical alternative to dense RGB reconstruction for underwater image enhancement.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级"预测器-执行器"框架PIC-UIE，从固定256×256缩略图预测图像自适应校正，在YCbCr空间作用于原分辨率图像，参数量仅9486、0.094 GFLOPs，在UIEB-90与LSUI上取得竞争力性能，并以55.0 FPS处理4K图像。
AI.motivation: 水下图像因波长相关衰减与后向散射导致可见度、色彩保真度与结构细节退化。现有SOTA UIE方法依赖大骨干网络和稠密的图像到图像预测，难以边缘部署；且完全在单一色彩空间操作，使退化估计与亮度、色度校正相互耦合。
AI.method: 提出PIC-UIE，一种轻量级预测器-执行器框架：预测器从固定256×256 RGB缩略图生成图像自适应校正量，执行器在原生分辨率输入的YCbCr空间施加校正。预测器输出七类结果，组织为空间校正、非线性亮度与耦合色度映射、以及图像级色彩标定。训练阶段用深度图作为透射率代理的正则化，推理阶段仅需RGB输入。
AI.result: 在256×256下参数量9486、0.094 GFLOPs；UIEB-90上PSNR 24.137 dB、SSIM 0.9216；零样本LSUI上PSNR 21.320 dB；按对比协议处理原生4K图像达55.0 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 结构化校正预测为水下图像增强提供了相对稠密RGB重建更有效且实用的替代方案。

title: Robust Hierarchical Structures for Agentic Document Analysis
comment: To appear in Proceedings of the ACM on Management of Data (SIGMOD 2027). 25 pages
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) enable us to better understand text documents, including PDFs and Word documents. However, LLMs, as well as more modern LLM agents, i.e., those with tool-calling abilities, typically treat such documents as plain text, ignoring the fact that they are often organized hierarchically into sections and subsections. Extracting this structure, while difficult, can improve efficiency and effectiveness for agents (and humans)---since only sections relevant to a given task need to be processed. Unfortunately, prior work on structure extraction provides no formal guarantees on how well the inferred structure matches the true one. Instead, we target a robust and compact variant that is feasible to infer and useful in practice. Robustness ensures that the text under each subsection header is a superset of the text under the same header in the true structure. Compactness seeks to minimize this superset, reducing agentic cost (or human cognitive load). We propose SHED, a two-stage workflow for inferring a robust and compact structure. The first stage is pluggable with an infinite family of approaches, each guaranteeing robustness for a specific document class. We theoretically characterize the document space using these classes and their hierarchical relationships. Empirically, SHED improves F-1 scores (measuring the robustness--compactness trade-off) by 13%--68% over non-LLM baselines and 9%--15% over expensive LLM-based approaches. Finally, we show how SHED-inferred structures are valuable for agentic document analysis: agents using SHED outperform baselines, achieving 3%--23% higher accuracy while being up to 10x cheaper.
