AI.tldr: 本文提出SHED——一种两阶段工作流，用于从文本/PDF/Word等文档中推断"鲁棒且紧凑"的层次结构，兼顾正确性与成本，并在文档分析任务上显著提升LLM Agent的准确率与效率。
AI.motivation: LLM及具备工具调用能力的Agent通常将文档视为纯文本，忽视了其按章节/子章节的层次组织，导致处理效率与效果受限。虽然抽取结构可缓解该问题，但现有结构抽取工作缺乏对"推断结构与真实结构匹配程度"的形式化保证。
AI.method: 绕过难以保证的精确结构抽取，转而定义"鲁棒且紧凑"的可行变体：鲁棒性要求每个子章节标题下的文本是真实结构下同一标题文本的超集；紧凑性要求最小化该超集以降低Agent成本或人类认知负荷。据此提出SHED两阶段工作流，第一阶段可插入无限族方法，每种方法针对特定文档类保证鲁棒性，并理论上用这些类别及其层级关系刻画文档空间。
AI.result: F-1分数（衡量鲁棒性—紧凑性权衡）相比非LLM基线提升13%–68%，相比昂贵的LLM方法提升9%–15%；使用SHED结构的Agent在文档分析中准确率高3%–23%，且成本最多降低10倍。
AI.conclusion: SHED能在缺乏精确结构保证的前提下，提供鲁棒且紧凑的层次结构推断，既优于现有基线，又能显著提升Agentic文档分析的准确率与成本效益。

title: VisionHOPE: Visual Backbones as Self-Modifying Learning Systems
summary: Visual backbones have evolved from Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with local aggregation to Vision Transformers (ViTs) with global interactions, State-Space Models (SSMs) with input-dependent state transitions, and Test-Time Training (TTT) layers that adapt an inner learner while processing an image. Across this progression, visual computation has become increasingly adaptive to each input, yet the rules governing that adaptation remain largely prescribed by the trained backbone. We introduce VisionHOPE, the first generic visual backbone formulated as a self-modifying learning system, in which what the model remembers and how it learns co-evolve within an image. Building on the self-referential construction of Nested Learning (NL), VisionHOPE realizes this co-evolution through five coupled memories that store content, generate key and value representations, and govern learning rate and retention. These memories evolve jointly as visual context accumulates along each scan. However, directly applying the unconstrained self-referential update to a visual backbone leads to instability. We therefore derive a stability-matched step-size control scheme that combines a soft cap on self-referential injection with a spectral clamp on the retained memory transition, and prove that the resulting memory dynamics are non-expansive along each scan. For two-dimensional feature maps, we adapt NL's chunk formulation by aligning chunks with image rows and columns across four directional scans. The proposed VisionHOPE achieves competitive results on ImageNet-1K, COCO, and ADE20K, establishing self-modifying learning systems as a practical foundation for general-purpose visual backbones. The code is available at https://github.com/PSRben/VisionHOPE.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VisionHOPE，首个将通用视觉骨干网络形式化为自修改学习系统的方法，使模型"记忆什么"与"如何学习"在图像内共同演化，并在ImageNet-1K、COCO、ADE20K上取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.motivation: 视觉骨干网络从CNN、ViT、SSM发展到TTT层，计算越来越自适应于每个输入，但自适应规则仍由训练好的骨干网络预先设定，缺乏在图像内部动态调整学习规则的能力。
AI.method: 基于Nested Learning的自指构造，VisionHOPE用五个耦合记忆体分别存储内容、生成key/value表示、控制学习率与保持率，随每次扫描的视觉上下文累积而共同演化；为克服无约束自指更新的不稳定性，推导了稳定性匹配的步长控制方案，结合自指注入的软上限与保留记忆转移的谱裁剪，并证明记忆动力学沿每次扫描是非扩张的；对二维特征图，将NL的分块公式与图像的行列对齐，跨四个方向扫描。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K、COCO和ADE20K上取得有竞争力的结果，验证了自修改学习系统作为通用视觉骨干网络基础的实用性。
AI.conclusion: VisionHOPE确立了自修改学习系统作为通用视觉骨干网络的可行基础，代码已开源。

title: Budgeted Cache Repair for Cross-Context KV-Cache Reuse
summary: Cross-context KV-cache reuse predicts a shared segment's keys and values under a new prefix instead of recomputing them, and has been reported to do so without quality loss. We find otherwise, and identify two problems. (1) A hidden cost: on MMLU and GSM8K, reuse costs substantial accuracy. (2) A decision at the wrong unit: no rule for deciding whether to reuse a cache removes that cost. What does help is choosing which parts of the cache to recompute, and the value of choosing well falls as the unit of choice grows: informed selection removes 49.5% of the cache error beyond chance at single rows (one token's keys and values), 10.6% at 64-token chunks, and nothing at the level of whole calls. Budgeted Cache Repair (BCR) acts at the unit where selection still pays. It drafts two tokens from the assembled cache, ranks cache rows by the attention those tokens pay them, and recomputes a fixed budget of rows exactly, in one of three layouts. The cost is paid rather than predicted away, and the draft that fails as a gate succeeds as a selector. BCR restores GSM8K to dense-prefill accuracy while still serving most calls from cache, and its best layout outperforms every reuse baseline's mean in the reference grid. The draft also beats a coin-flip selector at the same budget - a control prior evaluations lack.

AI.tldr: 跨上下文KV缓存复用在新前缀下预测共享段的键值而非重算，但本文发现其存在隐藏精度代价，并提出在行级粒度上进行预算化缓存修复（BCR）以恢复精度。
AI.motivation: 已有工作声称跨上下文KV缓存复用无质量损失，本文对此提出质疑，旨在揭示复用带来的隐藏精度成本，并探寻真正有效的缓解方式。
AI.method: 作者分析复用代价与选择单元的关系，发现选择粒度越小收益越高；进而提出预算化缓存修复（BCR）：从组装好的缓存中生成两个草稿token，依据这些token对缓存行的注意力进行排序，在固定预算下精确重算部分行，并提供三种布局。
AI.result: 在单行粒度上有信息的选择可消除超出随机的49.5%缓存误差，64-token块为10.6%，整次调用层面为零；BCR在保持多数调用由缓存服务的同时将GSM8K恢复到稠密预填充精度，其最佳布局优于所有复用基线的均值，且优于同预算下的随机选择控制。
AI.conclusion: 复用存在隐藏精度代价，决策单元选择是关键；在行级进行预算化重算可有效修复，验证了以选择器而非门控方式利用草稿token的有效性。

title: FeCoSplat: Feedback-Guided Compression for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables efficient novel-view synthesis from sparse multi-view images, yet its representations remain costly to store and transmit. Existing approaches compress either the input images, incurring heavy receiver-side reconstruction, or the reconstructed Gaussian primitives, which are difficult to compress due to their heterogeneous and irregular attributes. We instead compress compact intermediate features, providing a better balance between compression efficiency and receiver-side complexity. Based on this paradigm, we propose FeCoSplat, a feedback-guided compression framework for feed-forward 3DGS. FeCoSplat first compresses multi-view features to obtain an intermediate 3DGS, whose rendered views are used as feedback to guide a second-stage compression for further refinement. The resulting bitstreams are decoded into a compact implicit state, from which the final Gaussian primitives are reconstructed with a lightweight predictor. Experiments demonstrate that FeCoSplat achieves favorable rate--distortion performance, particularly at low bitrates, while requiring only 3.45M parameters for receiver-side Gaussian reconstruction. Code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 提出FeCoSplat，一种反馈引导的前馈3DGS压缩框架，通过压缩紧凑的中间特征而非输入图像或高斯原语，在压缩效率与接收端复杂度之间取得更优平衡。
AI.motivation: 前馈3DGS虽能高效地从稀疏多视图合成新视角，但其表示存储与传输成本高昂。现有方法要么压缩输入图像（导致接收端重建负担重），要么压缩重建出的高斯原语（因其异构且不规则的属性而难以压缩）。因此需要一个兼顾压缩效率与接收端复杂度的新范式。
AI.method: FeCoSplat压缩多视图特征以获得中间3DGS；将其渲染视图作为反馈，引导第二阶段压缩以进一步细化；生成的码流解码为紧凑隐式状态，再由轻量级预测器重建最终高斯原语。
AI.result: 实验表明FeCoSplat取得良好的率失真性能，尤其在低码率下表现突出，且接收端高斯重建仅需3.45M参数。
AI.conclusion: 压缩紧凑中间特征是一种兼顾压缩效率与接收端复杂度的有效范式；反馈引导的两阶段压缩机制可进一步提升性能。代码将开源。

title: CertMark: Distortion-Free Multi-Bit Watermarking with Certified Decoding
summary: Leading multi-bit watermarking methods for language models encode messages by biasing the model's next-token probabilities, creating a trade-off between message recovery and text quality. Their decoders typically return the highest-scoring candidate from accumulated token-level evidence, without a certified abstention rule that bounds the probability of outputting an incorrect message. We introduce CertMark, a distribution-preserving multi-bit watermark with certified decoding. Rather than modifying probabilities, CertMark uses the embedded message to seed an exact Gumbel-max sampler, thereby preserving the model's original sampling distribution. We propose two scalable decoders: a model-agnostic, text-only decoder and a model-aware variant that leverages the original next-token distributions for stronger recovery. Both support certified abstention with mathematical bounds on the probability of returning an incorrect message. Across text completion, summarization, and story generation, CertMark matches the perplexity of unwatermarked text while reliably recovering multi-bit messages. The model-aware decoder further achieves higher bit accuracy than probability-biasing baselines. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Batorskq/CertMark.

AI.tldr: CertMark：一种分布保持的多比特水印方法，利用消息作为 Gumbel-max 采样种子，在不改变模型采样分布的前提下嵌入信息，并提供带数学界保证的弃权解码。
AI.motivation: 现有多比特语言模型水印通过偏置下一词概率嵌入消息，导致消息恢复率与文本质量之间的权衡；其解码器仅从累积的 token 级证据中返回最高分候选，缺乏可认证的弃权规则来约束输出错误消息的概率。
AI.method: 不修改概率分布，而是用嵌入的消息作为精确 Gumbel-max 采样器的种子，从而保持模型原始采样分布。提出两种可扩展解码器：一种与模型无关、仅依赖文本；另一种是模型感知变体，利用原始下一词分布以增强恢复能力。两者均支持带数学界的可认证弃权。
AI.result: 在文本补全、摘要和故事生成任务上，CertMark 的困惑度与未加水印文本相当，同时可可靠恢复多比特消息；模型感知解码器的比特准确率优于概率偏置基线。
AI.conclusion: CertMark 在保持文本质量的同时实现了可靠的多比特水印恢复，并提供错误消息概率的理论上界，代码已公开。

title: When to Evict, Not What to Keep: Draft-Guided Eviction for Training-Free KV-Cache Compression
summary: Training-free KV-cache compression methods such as SnapKV, H2O, and PyramidKV evict tokens at the end of prefill, aiming to preserve the attention mass that future queries are expected to use -optimizing what to keep. We show that this objective fails in two distinct ways. (1) Compensation: restoring the evicted attention mass can recover the attention-level target without recovering task quality. (2) Selection: covering more of the true decode-query mass can hurt quality when the recovered mass is fragmented rather than concentrated in coherent spans. These failures share a common cause: eviction occurs before the queries that determine the answer trajectory exist. We propose Draft-Guided Eviction (DGE), which defers eviction until after drafting the first k=2 answer tokens using the full cache - just one decode step beyond prefill. Because the draft is generated from the answer's own prefix, no cache entries are discarded before this trajectory signal becomes available. The per-head cache budget remains unchanged, and DGE can be applied directly to SnapKV, PyramidKV, H2O, and StreamingLLM without modifying their eviction scores. Unlike extra-pass methods, DGE changes when eviction occurs rather than what cache entries are selected. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DGE outperforms prior methods at every evaluated budget on five of six instruct-tuned backbones, achieving 44.2 on LongBench, nearly matching FullKV at 44.3. The timing-only control DGE-W achieves the same score, demonstrating that the gain comes from when eviction occurs rather than what is selected - an effect we term trajectory anchoring.

AI.tldr: 论文指出现有免训练KV-cache压缩方法（如SnapKV、H2O、PyramidKV）在prefill阶段驱逐token存在两种失效模式：补偿失效与选择失效。作者提出Draft-Guided Eviction（DGE），将驱逐推迟到用完整cache生成前k=2个答案token之后，从而在答案轨迹信号可用后再做驱逐。DGE不改变驱逐分数与每头预算，可直接套用于现有方法，在六个指令微调骨干中的五个上于所有预算下均优于基线，LongBench得分44.2，接近FullKV的44.3。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练KV-cache压缩方法以“保留未来query期望的attention质量”为目标，在prefill结束时即驱逐token。作者论证该目标存在两个根本缺陷：(1) 补偿失效——即使恢复被驱逐的attention质量，也无法恢复任务质量；(2) 选择失效——当恢复的质量呈碎片化而非集中于连贯span时，覆盖更多真实decode-query质量反而损害质量。二者的共同根源是驱逐发生在决定答案轨迹的query出现之前，因此驱逐时机本身才是关键。
AI.method: 提出Draft-Guided Eviction（DGE）：将驱逐推迟到使用完整cache生成前k=2个答案token之后（即比prefill仅多一步decode）。由于draft由答案自身前缀生成，在轨迹信号可用前不丢弃任何cache条目。方法保持每头cache预算不变，可直接应用于SnapKV、PyramidKV、H2O与StreamingLLM，且不修改其驱逐分数。与额外前向传播（extra-pass）方法不同，DGE改变的是驱逐发生的时间，而非所选cache条目。
AI.result: 在六个指令微调骨干中的五个上，DGE在每个评估预算下均优于先前方法，LongBench得分44.2，几乎匹配FullKV的44.3。仅改变时机的对照方法DGE-W取得相同分数，说明收益来自驱逐时机而非所选条目，作者将此效应称为trajectory anchoring（轨迹锚定）。
AI.conclusion: 驱逐时机是KV-cache压缩中被忽视的关键因素。通过在答案轨迹信号出现后再驱逐，DGE在不改变驱逐分数与预算的前提下显著提升质量，且证明增益源于“何时驱逐”而非“驱逐什么”，即轨迹锚定效应。

title: Does Learning to Predict the World Help Agents Act? Auditing World-Model Post-Training
summary: Predicting how an environment will change before acting is a natural route to better decision making for agents. Recent post-training methods therefore require agents to predict the next observation and turn that prediction into a reward or a direct supervision signal, which is called world model. Existing next-observation training methods help the agent to learn the environmental content. However, they additionally involve an optimization process, which may introduce several effects other than learning to predict the world. Consequently, where the performance gain comes from during the training process remains an open question. We answer this research question through replacing true next-observation targets with in-distribution mismatched observations during the training process. Across two interactive text environments, mismatched targets lower prediction accuracy by 15.3-61.6% relative to ground-truth targets, yet retain substantial task gains over the base model. Compared with the base model, trained models consider more candidate actions and exhibit less looping. We also introduce a setting that replaces prediction-based rewards with independent random signals. This training expands task coverage (pass@64) even when the reward carries no environment information. We also generalize this finding to VisualWebArena, where random-reward training raises pass@64 by 14.3% relative to the base model, without observation-matching rewards or an external multimodal teacher for reward construction.

AI.tldr: 论文质疑世界模型训练中"预测下一观测"的收益来源：通过将真实下一观测替换为分布内错配观测，发现预测准确率大幅下降但任务收益仍保留，表明性能提升可能主要来自优化过程本身而非世界建模。
AI.motivation: 近期后训练方法要求智能体预测下一观测，并将其转化为奖励或监督信号（即世界模型）。这类方法虽帮助智能体学习环境内容，但训练中同时包含优化过程，可能引入除"预测世界"之外的其他效应。因此，训练过程中性能增益究竟来自何处仍是一个开放问题。
AI.method: 在训练过程中用分布内错配的观测替换真实的下一观测目标；并在两个交互式文本环境与VisualWebArena上进行实验。此外，引入一种用独立随机信号替换基于预测奖励的设置，以检验奖励是否携带环境信息。
AI.result: 错配目标使预测准确率相对真实目标下降15.3%–61.6%，但仍保留相对基座模型的显著任务增益；训练后模型考虑更多候选动作且更少陷入循环。随机奖励训练即使不含环境信息也能扩大任务覆盖（pass@64）；在VisualWebArena上，随机奖励训练使pass@64相对基座模型提升14.3%，无需观测匹配奖励或外部多模态教师构建奖励。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型训练带来的性能增益并非主要源于准确的下一观测预测，优化过程本身即可产生显著收益；且不携带环境信息的随机奖励亦能提升任务覆盖，说明此类训练的有效性来源需要重新审视。

title: OPERA: A Unified Omnimodal Progressive Spatio-Temporal Reasoning Agent for Referring Video Segmentation
summary: Referring video segmentation with heterogeneous multimodal queries---spanning text, audio, and reference images---demands both robust cross-modal understanding and precise spatio-temporal reasoning. We propose OPERA (Omnimodal Progressive spatio-tEmporal Reasoning Agent), a unified reasoning agent built on a single MLLM that performs dual-axis progressive reasoning via three specialized stages. Along the temporal axis, a Temporal Reasoning Agent narrows the frame search space through coarse-to-fine filtering to identify the most informative key frame. Along the spatial axis, a Distillation Agent establishes what to locate via cross-modal semantic distillation, and a Grounding Agent enhanced with GRPO determines where the target appears, with dense mask propagation completing the pixel-level output. OPERA sets a new state of the art on OmniAVS and Ref-AVS and transfers zero-shot to standard referring video segmentation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出OPERA统一多模态推理智能体，通过时间轴与空间轴的双轴渐进推理，实现异构多模态查询（文本、音频、参考图像）的指代视频分割，在OmniAVS与Ref-AVS上达到SOTA并零样本迁移至标准基准。
AI.motivation: 指代视频分割面对跨文本、音频、参考图像的异构多模态查询，需要同时具备鲁棒的跨模态理解与精确的时空推理能力，现有方法难以统一处理这一双重需求。
AI.method: OPERA基于单一MLLM构建统一推理智能体，采用三阶段双轴渐进推理：时间轴上由Temporal Reasoning Agent通过由粗到细的过滤缩小帧搜索空间以定位关键帧；空间轴上先由Distillation Agent进行跨模态语义蒸馏确定"定位什么"，再由引入GRPO增强的Grounding Agent确定"目标出现在哪"，最后通过密集掩码传播完成像素级输出。
AI.result: 在OmniAVS和Ref-AVS上取得新的state of the art，并可零样本迁移到标准指代视频分割基准。
AI.conclusion: 基于单一MLLM的双轴渐进时空推理智能体为异构多模态指代视频分割提供了统一有效方案，兼具多模态理解与精细时空定位能力，并展现出良好的零样本泛化性。

title: CalibHyper: Chance-Corrected Relational Hypergraphs for Few-Shot Molecular Property Prediction
summary: Molecular property prediction is central to drug development and materials discovery, but experiments are costly and labeled data are scarce. Context-aware methods use auxiliary assay labels to support few-shot prediction, and recent work supervises property relations with label agreement. However, label agreement is sensitive to class marginals and does not directly capture dependence between properties. We propose CalibHyper, a chance-corrected relational hypergraph method based on the joint label distribution. CalibHyper subtracts an independence baseline from the ordered four-state label distribution and shrinks the residual according to the number of joint observations. A swap-equivariant relation head estimates these residuals, which choose the auxiliary properties for each molecule and set the sign and weight of their hyperedge messages. On thirteen datasets from five benchmarks, in both 1-shot and 10-shot settings, CalibHyper and its ablation settings achieve ROC-AUC competitive with the strongest reported results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CalibHyper，一种基于联合标签分布的机会校正关系超图方法，用于分子性质的小样本预测，在多个基准上取得有竞争力的ROC-AUC。
AI.motivation: 分子性质预测对药物开发和材料发现至关重要，但实验成本高、标注数据稀缺。现有上下文感知方法利用辅助测定标签支持小样本预测，并用标签一致性监督性质关系；然而标签一致性对类别边际敏感，且不能直接刻画性质间的依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出CalibHyper，基于联合标签分布进行机会校正的关系超图方法。该方法从有序四状态标签分布中减去独立性基线，并根据联合观测数量对残差进行收缩；采用交换等变的关系头估计这些残差，进而为每个分子选择辅助性质，并设定其超边消息的符号与权重。
AI.result: 在来自五个基准的十三个数据集上，于1-shot和10-shot设置下，CalibHyper及其消融设置取得的ROC-AUC与已报告的最强结果具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 基于联合标签分布的机会校正关系建模能有效捕捉性质间依赖，缓解标签一致性对类别边际的敏感性，为分子性质的小样本预测提供了有效方案。

title: CHI: A Composite Hallucination Index Unifying Entity, Relation, and Quantity Dimensions for Summarization Evaluation
summary: Faithfulness evaluation of abstractive summaries remains an open challenge, with existing metrics addressing only isolated hallucination types: factual entity errors, relational inconsistencies, or numerical fabrications, without capturing their co-occurrence or interaction. We introduce CHI (Composite Hallucination Index), the first unified hallucination metric that decomposes faithfulness errors into three orthogonal dimensions: entity hallucination (EHI), relation hallucination (RHI*), and quantity hallucination (QHI). Each dimension employs a shared softmax-normalized architecture over Venn diagram-derived factors representing extractiveness, positive hallucination, over-focus, negative hallucination, and lost focus. The novel QHI component introduces tolerance-aware numerical matching with exact, epsilon, derived, and temporal comparison modes. We fuse the three dimensions via harmonic mean to produce a single composite score that penalizes weakness in any dimension. We validate CHI on 800 source articles spanning four domains (news, medical, legal, financial) with summaries from five generation systems. Empirical results demonstrate that: (i) the three dimensions are statistically orthogonal (mean rho = 0.148), confirming they capture distinct error types; (ii) CHI achieves the highest system-level correlation with human judgments (rho = 0.66, p = 0.006) on SummEval, outperforming ROUGE (rho = 0.53), EHI (rho = 0.58), and all individual components; and (iii) ablation studies confirm that all three dimensions contribute unique variance, with the full composite outperforming any individual component while providing decomposable error diagnostics unavailable from single-score baselines. CHI provides practitioners with a decomposable, interpretable, and efficient faithfulness metric suitable for both offline evaluation and online monitoring of summarization systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CHI（Composite Hallucination Index），首个将摘要忠实性错误统一分解为实体、关系和数量三个正交维度的幻觉度量，经多领域验证其在系统级人类判断相关性上优于 ROUGE 及单维度基线。
AI.motivation: 生成式摘要的忠实性评估仍是开放难题：现有度量仅针对孤立的幻觉类型（事实实体错误、关系不一致或数值捏造），无法捕捉它们的共现与相互作用，缺乏统一、可分解的评估手段。
AI.method: CHI 将忠实性错误分解为三个正交维度：实体幻觉（EHI）、关系幻觉（RHI*）和数量幻觉（QHI）。每个维度在基于维恩图推导的因子（抽取性、正向幻觉、过度聚焦、负向幻觉、失焦）上采用共享的 softmax 归一化架构；新增的 QHI 引入容忍度感知的数值匹配，支持精确、epsilon、派生与时间四种比较模式；最后通过调和平均融合三维度，生成对任一维度短板均施加惩罚的单一复合分数。
AI.result: 在覆盖新闻、医学、法律、金融四个领域的 800 篇源文章及五个生成系统的摘要上进行验证：(i) 三个维度统计上正交（平均 rho = 0.148），确认其捕捉不同错误类型；(ii) 在 SummEval 上 CHI 的系统级人类判断相关性最高（rho = 0.66, p = 0.006），优于 ROUGE（rho = 0.53）、EHI（rho = 0.58）及所有单维度组件；(iii) 消融研究确认三个维度均贡献独特方差，完整复合指标优于任一单组件。
AI.conclusion: CHI 为从业者提供了一个可分解、可解释且高效的忠实性度量，适用于摘要系统的离线评估与在线监控，并能提供单分数基线无法给出的错误诊断信息。

title: ReLoc: Rethinking Scene Coordinate Regression Architecture for Robust Outdoor LiDAR-based Localization
summary: Scene Coordinate Regression (SCR) has recently emerged as a promising approach for LiDAR-based localization, achieving accurate localization without requiring an explicit 3D map. Despite their effectiveness, existing SCR methods rely on scene classification-based global embedding that struggles to provide fine-grained discrimination among nearby locations. Moreover, their reliance on uniform sampling of local features during training assigns equal importance to all points, thereby inadvertently propagating features from dynamic objects or unstable regions and potentially degrading training stability. In this paper, we present ReLoc, a revamped SCR architecture that can effectively address these limitations. First, we redesign the global embedding module by combining learnable context tokens with a feature aggregator to capture richer and more discriminative scene context. Second, we introduce an attention-based local feature enhancement module to mitigate the impact of noisy local features while encouraging context-consistent structures, yielding more robust local feature representations. Experimental results on two large-scale outdoor datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art accuracy over previous SCR-based methods while maintaining real-time inference performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReLoc，一种改进的场景坐标回归（SCR）架构，用于 LiDAR 定位。通过可学习上下文 token 与特征聚合器重构全局嵌入模块，并引入注意力机制的局部特征增强模块，在保持实时推理的同时于两个大规模户外数据集上取得优于现有 SCR 方法的定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 SCR 的 LiDAR 定位方法存在两个局限：一是依赖基于场景分类的全局嵌入，难以对邻近位置进行细粒度区分；二是训练时对局部特征进行均匀采样，对所有点赋予相同权重，从而无意间传播动态物体或不稳定区域的特征，降低训练稳定性。
AI.method: ReLoc 采取两项设计：(1) 重新设计全局嵌入模块，将可学习上下文 token 与特征聚合器结合，以捕获更丰富、更具判别力的场景上下文；(2) 引入基于注意力的局部特征增强模块，抑制噪声局部特征的影响，同时促进上下文一致的结构，获得更鲁棒的局部特征表示。
AI.result: 在两个大规模户外数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法在定位精度上优于以往基于 SCR 的方法，同时保持实时推理性能。
AI.conclusion: ReLoc 有效缓解了现有 SCR 方法在细粒度场景区分与噪声局部特征方面的不足，实现了准确且实时的 LiDAR 定位，达到当前最优精度。

title: Language Discrimination Improves Linguistic Learning in Multilingual Speech Models
summary: Multilingual self-supervised speech models can benefit from sharing information across languages, but under a matched total pretraining data budget they still fall short of monolingual models. We show that strengthening the model's ability to discriminate languages during pretraining reduces and, on some measures, closes this multilingual gap on continuous phonetic and higher-level linguistic measures, while preserving substantial cross-language sharing. Using a controlled English/French HuBERT setting, we test two interventions which strengthen language discrimination: an auxiliary language classifier and per-language k-means targets. Across interventions, continuous-feature phone discrimination error (phone-ABX, lower is better) decreases from 11.6% in the bilingual baseline to 10.4% (monolingual: 10.8%), while lexical performance (sWUGGY, higher is better) increases from 52.1% to 56.7% (monolingual: 58.5%) and prosodic performance (ProsAudit, lexical subtask, higher is better) from 68.9% to 72.9% (monolingual: 72.6%). Across HuBERT training stages, the strongest gains on most linguistic measures occur when language discrimination is introduced in the first iteration, whereas later or repeated interventions yield smaller improvements and are accompanied by increased language-wise segregation. These results support a causal role for language discrimination in reducing the additional cost of multilingual learning.

AI.tldr: 在匹配预训练数据预算下，强化预训练中的语言判别能力可缩小多语言与单语言语音模型差距，同时保留跨语言共享。
AI.motivation: 多语言自监督语音模型可通过跨语言信息共享获益，但在相同总预训练数据预算下仍不如单语言模型，作者希望探究语言判别能力是否是造成该差距的关键因素。
AI.method: 在受控的英语/法语HuBERT设置下，采用两种强化语言判别的干预：辅助语言分类器与分语言k-means目标；并在HuBERT各训练阶段考察干预时机（首次迭代、后期或重复）对效果的影响。
AI.result: 连续特征音素判别（phone-ABX，越低越好）由双语基线11.6%降至10.4%（单语言10.8%）；词汇任务sWUGGY由52.1%升至56.7%（单语言58.5%）；韵律任务ProsAudit词汇子任务由68.9%升至72.9%（单语言72.6%）。多数指标上，在首次迭代引入语言判别增益最大，后期或重复干预增益较小并伴随语言间隔离增强。
AI.conclusion: 语言判别在多语言学习额外代价的降低中具有因果作用；早期引入语言判别可在保持跨语言共享的同时显著缩小多语言与单语言模型的差距。

title: Focus and Supplement: Dual-Enhanced Vision Transformer for Multi-Class Anomaly Classification
summary: Multi-class anomaly classification in industrial vision remains challenging due to noisy/incomplete anomaly representations and the unknown number of anomaly classes. To overcome this, we propose MACO, a novel multi-class anomaly classification framework that learns comprehensive representations and dynamically estimates class number without prior knowledge. First, a soft-focus attention uses anomaly maps to concentrate on relevant abnormal regions, while suppressing background noise. Second, auxiliary classification ([A-CLS]) tokens complement the [CLS] token. They collectively attend to diverse anomaly sub-regions, yielding more holistic and discriminative features. These [A-CLS] tokens are also effective across more tasks and domains. To infer the class number, we propose Correlation-based Number Estimation strategy. It computes the average correlation among labeled classes and transfers its separability cue to the unlabeled set. Experiments on MVTec AD and MTD datasets demonstrate our superiority. Under known class number, MACO improves ARI by 6.5% and $\textbf{16.3%}$ on both datasets, respectively. In the more challenging unknown number scenario, it achieves an $\textbf{11.2%}$ NMI gain on MTD and outperforms existing number estimation strategies by $\textbf{24.1%}$ UPS on MVTec AD. Code will be released at https://github.com/HUST-SLOW/MACO.

AI.tldr: 提出MACO多类异常分类框架，通过软聚焦注意力、辅助分类token和相关性数量估计，在无先验知识下实现工业图像多类异常分类，效果优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 工业视觉中多类异常分类面临异常表征噪声/不完整以及异常类别数量未知的挑战，现有方法难以获得全面且具判别性的特征，也无法在无先验条件下动态确定类别数。
AI.method: MACO包含三个核心组件：1）软聚焦注意力，利用异常图聚焦相关异常区域并抑制背景噪声；2）辅助分类[A-CLS] token，与[CLS] token协同关注多样化异常子区域，形成更全面、具判别性的特征；3）基于相关性的数量估计策略，计算有标注类间的平均相关性，并将其可分性线索迁移至无标注集以推断类别数。
AI.result: 在MVTec AD和MTD数据集上，已知类别数时MACO的ARI分别提升6.5%和16.3%；在未知类别数场景下，MTD上NMI提升11.2%，MVTec AD上UPS比现有数量估计策略高24.1%。
AI.conclusion: MACO无需类别数先验即可实现多类工业异常分类，兼顾特征表征的全面性与类别数的动态估计，实验证明其在已知和未知类别数两种场景下均具优越性。

title: When Does Geometric View Synthesis Help Wine Label Retrieval? A Public One-Shot Benchmark Across Self-Supervised and Vision-Language Backbones
summary: Geometric view synthesis can expand a single wine-label photograph into a training set, but its value with pretrained image encoders is unclear. We study this on a public WineSensed-derived benchmark of 1,000 classes, one enrollment photograph per class, and 4,295 real queries. With the earlier DINO vision transformer (ViT-S/16) recipe, geometric views raise top-1 accuracy from 34.1% to 62.6-63.7%, about three times the gain from two-dimensional (2D) augmentation. Frozen SigLIP 2-B already reaches 94.7%. A linear head over its frozen features gains 1.2-1.3 percentage points with the two geometric pipelines localized by the Segment Anything Model (SAM), while the other pipelines gain an inconclusive 0.3-0.6 points. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and validation-selected full fine-tuning show no clear gain within the reported confidence intervals; fixed-budget full fine-tuning loses 9-24 points. SAM localization supplies all six views for 99% of sources, compared with 43% for the edge-based front end. Recognition differences between the two cylinder constructions depend on the training recipe and are confounded by their crop and canvas conventions. Rendered-cylinder tests show different responses to source tilt, but an uncalibrated rim-ratio proxy establishes no corresponding trend in recognition on real photographs. An author-confirmed audit of 50 residual errors identifies 21 query-enrollment appearance mismatches, without establishing an irreducible error rate. These results support geometric synthesis for the tested self-supervised recipe and a smaller benefit through frozen-feature adaptation of the text-supervised encoder.

AI.tldr: 几何视图合成可将单张酒标照片扩展为训练集，在DINO ViT-S/16配方下将top-1准确率从34.1%提升至62.6–63.7%，约为2D增强增益的三倍；但冻融SigLIP 2-B已达94.7%，几何增强对其增益有限。
AI.motivation: 几何视图合成虽能扩大单张图像训练集，但其对预训练图像编码器的价值尚不明确，需要在真实识别基准上系统评估。
AI.method: 在源自WineSensed的公开基准上开展实验：1,000类、每类一张注册照片、4,295条真实查询；比较DINO ViT-S/16自监督配方与冻结SigLIP 2-B文本监督编码器；采用两条几何管线并用SAM进行定位；对比2D增强、线性头、LoRA、验证集选择的完整微调与固定预算完整微调；通过渲染圆柱测试与边缘前端对比分析。
AI.result: DINO配方下几何视图将top-1从34.1%提升至62.6–63.7%，约为2D增强增益的三倍。冻结SigLIP 2-B基线为94.7%；SAM定位的两条几何管线在线性头下增益1.2–1.3个百分点，其余管线仅0.3–0.6且不显著。LoRA与验证集选择的完整微调未显示明确增益，固定预算完整微调损失9–24个百分点。SAM为99%的源提供全部六个视图，边缘前端仅43%。两圆柱构造的识别差异受训练配方影响且混杂裁剪与画布约定；渲染圆柱测试对源倾斜响应不同，但未校准的轮缘比代理在真实照片上无对应趋势。50例残差误差审计发现21例查询-注册外观不匹配。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在所测自监督配方中使用几何合成，并通过冻结特征适配对文本监督编码器带来较小收益；几何增强的价值依赖于编码器类型与训练配方。

title: MoR-MLLM: Mixture of Recursions for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities across vision and language tasks. However, their massive computational and memory demands hinder real-world deployment. While recent efforts reduce costs by employing lightweight language backbones, existing paradigms remain computation-dense due to their static sparsity and depth allocation, which cannot adapt to the semantic complexity of each token. To this end, we propose MoR-MLLM, a computation-sparse MLLM based on the recent Mixture-of-Recursions (MoR) framework. MoR-MLLM introduces adaptive per-token recursion, allowing the model to dynamically adjust its recursive depth and allocate more computation to visually or linguistically challenging tokens while skipping redundant operations for simpler ones. To stabilize the training of recursive sparsity in multimodal settings, we further design a three-stage MoR-Tuning strategy and an entropy-regularized loss to encourage diverse routing distributions. Extensive experiments show that compared with recent advanced tiny MLLMs, our proposed MoR-MLLM can greatly reduce the training memory and computation complexity while retaining high performance on various vision-language tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MoR-MLLM，一种基于 Mixture-of-Recursions 框架的计算稀疏多模态大模型，通过自适应逐 token 递归深度分配实现动态计算调度，并配合三阶段 MoR-Tuning 与熵正则化损失稳定训练，在显著降低训练显存与计算复杂度的同时保持多任务性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型（MLLMs）虽在视觉-语言任务上推理能力突出，但其巨大的计算与内存开销阻碍了实际部署。现有轻量化方案多采用轻量语言骨干，但仍依赖静态稀疏性与固定深度分配，无法根据每个 token 的语义复杂度自适应调整计算量，因此整体仍是"计算密集型"。
AI.method: 提出 MoR-MLLM，基于 Mixture-of-Recursions（MoR）框架构建计算稀疏 MLLM。核心是逐 token 自适应递归：为视觉或语言上更难的 token 分配更深递归与更多计算，对简单 token 跳过冗余操作。为稳定多模态场景下递归稀疏训练，设计三阶段 MoR-Tuning 策略，并引入熵正则化损失以促使路由分布多样化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，与近期先进的 tiny MLLMs 相比，MoR-MLLM 在多种视觉-语言任务上保持高性能的同时，大幅降低了训练显存与计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 逐 token 自适应递归为多模态大模型的高效化提供了有效路径，能够在性能与计算开销之间取得更优权衡。

title: From Script to Drama: An Agentic Framework for Controllable Multi-Speaker Dialogue TTS
summary: Multi-speaker dialogue TTS requires natural speech generation, consistent speaker identity, coherent cross-turn transitions, and fine-grained control of expressive attributes such as emotion, speaking rate, and loudness. These requirements are difficult to satisfy reliably with one-shot generation, especially in long-form dialogue. We propose a controllable multi-speaker dialogue TTS framework that formulates synthesis as critique-driven iterative refinement. Its speech backbone, ControlEdit-TTS, unifies instruction-following synthesis and natural-language-guided attribute editing, enabling correction of expressive errors without full regeneration. The framework further performs hierarchical utterance-level and scene-level critique, routing detected issues to editing, resynthesis, or timing adjustment. Experiments on a bilingual Chinese--English dialogue benchmark show improved utterance-level instruction following, better dialogue-level preference than direct dialogue models and agentic baselines, and more effective refinement than regeneration-only alternatives while preserving speaker identity. Ablations further confirm the benefits of scene-level critique and edit-based correction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可控多说话人对话TTS框架，将合成建模为"批判驱动的迭代精修"：以ControlEdit-TTS为语音骨干统一指令跟随合成与自然语言属性编辑，并引入语句级与场景级的分层批判，将问题路由至编辑、重合成或时序调整。在汉英双语对话基准上，语句级指令跟随、对话级偏好均优于直接对话模型与智能体基线，且精修优于纯重生成并保持说话人一致性。
AI.motivation: 多说话人对话TTS需同时满足自然语音生成、说话人身份一致、跨轮次连贯，以及对情感、语速、响度等表达属性的细粒度控制。一次性生成（one-shot generation）难以在长对话中稳定满足这些要求，易出现表达错误且无法局部修正。
AI.method: 1) 将对话TTS形式化为批判驱动的迭代精修流程；2) 语音骨干ControlEdit-TTS统一指令跟随合成与自然语言引导的属性编辑，支持在不整体重生成的前提下纠正表达错误；3) 分层批判机制：语句级与场景级批判，将检测到的问题路由到编辑、重合成或时序调整三种处理方式。
AI.result: 在汉英双语对话基准上：语句级指令跟随能力提升；对话级偏好优于直接对话模型与智能体（agentic）基线；相比仅重生成的方案，精修更有效，同时保持说话人身份。消融实验证实场景级批判与基于编辑的修正均带来增益。
AI.conclusion: 批判驱动的迭代精修框架能有效提升长对话多说话人TTS的可控性与整体质量，编辑式修正与分层（语句/场景）批判是关键有效因素。

title: TNF based Spectral Embedding for Effective Application of Supervised Machine Learning Techniques in Automobile Insurance Fraud Detection
summary: Fraud detection is an important area of research in the insurance business due to its financial implications. The primary aim of a fraud detection model is to identify fraud and non-fraud cases with high accuracy along with other important metrics such as Sensitivity, Specificity, Precision, F1-score, False Positive Rate, False Discovery Rate, AUC etc. To achieve this, we need to explore a suitable classification model to identify fraud and non-fraud cases. In this work, we have used auto insurance data set and explored classification models such as Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), XGBoost, LightGBM and Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM). To overcome the problem of data imbalance, we have employed MWMOTE and TGAN techniques. We have used Topological Node Feature(TNF) based spectral embedding for low dimensional data representation along with some popular embedding methods like MDS, Isomaps and t-SNE. After studying all the 65 possible combinations of these models, we have proposed an innovative method for effective automobile insurance fraud detection. For the given dataset, our results show that using a combination of MWMOTE as a data imbalance handling technique (Phase I), TNFSE2 as data embedding (Phase II) and Random Forest as classification (Phase III) provides the best result in comparison to all other combinations. This work also highlights the efficacy of TNF based spectral embedding in automobile insurance dataset

AI.tldr: 本文针对汽车保险欺诈检测，系统组合评估了5种分类模型、2种不平衡处理技术和4种降维嵌入方法，共65种组合，最终提出以MWMOTE+TNF-SE2+随机森林为最优方案。
AI.motivation: 保险欺诈带来重大财务损失，欺诈检测模型需在准确率、灵敏度、特异度、F1、FPR、FDR、AUC等多指标上表现良好；同时数据存在类别不平衡问题，且需合适的低维表示，因此有必要系统探索分类模型、不平衡处理与嵌入方法的最优组合。
AI.method: 使用汽车保险数据集。分类模型：决策树、随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM、GBM。不平衡处理：MWMOTE与TGAN。低维表示：基于拓扑节点特征(TNF)的谱嵌入(TNFSE2)及MDS、Isomaps、t-SNE。对上述方法的三阶段组合进行穷举评估，共65种组合。
AI.result: 在该数据集上，MWMOTE（阶段一，不平衡处理）+ TNFSE2（阶段二，数据嵌入）+ 随机森林（阶段三，分类）的组合在所有65种组合中效果最佳。TNF 谱嵌入在汽车保险数据集上表现出良好有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种创新的汽车保险欺诈检测方法，通过系统性组合搜索验证了最优三阶段方案，并凸显了基于拓扑节点特征的谱嵌入在该场景下的实用性。

title: Recursive Harness Distillation across Agents for Robot Manipulation
summary: A central goal in robotics is to enable manipulation across changing tasks and environments. Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide broad manipulation capabilities but can struggle when execution requires diagnosing failures and adapting behavior. Strong agents can discover effective interventions through interaction with these policies. We propose Recursive Harness Distillation to accumulate this experience as reusable guidance across agents. A strong agent distills its experience into a playbook for a light agent, then recursively refines the playbook using the light agent's execution feedback. The resulting playbook enables agents to reuse accumulated intervention knowledge in new task instances without updating model parameters. In real-world manipulation, the harness improves success from 37.3% to 64.0%. On SimplerEnv Bridge, the light agent with the playbook achieves 66.7% success, compared with 41.7% for the GR00T-only baseline, and outperforms the strong agent without a playbook. The same playbook also benefits the strong agent, which reaches 79.2% success. These results demonstrate the feasibility of harness distillation for robotics: intervention experience can be accumulated, refined through execution, and reused across agents to improve manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出递归引导蒸馏（Recursive Harness Distillation），将强智能体的干预经验蒸馏为可复用的"playbook"指导轻量智能体，并通过执行反馈递归精炼，无需更新模型参数即可提升操作任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作需要在不断变化的任务与环境间泛化。VLA模型虽具备广泛操作能力，但在需要诊断失败并调整行为时表现不佳。强智能体可通过与策略交互发现有效干预，但这类经验难以被复用。因此需要一种机制来积累并重用干预知识。
AI.method: 递归引导蒸馏：强智能体将其交互经验蒸馏成一个playbook（操作手册/干预指南）交给轻量智能体；再利用轻量智能体的执行反馈递归地精炼该playbook。整个过程不更新模型参数，playbook在新任务实例中作为可复用指导。
AI.result: 真实世界操作中将成功率从37.3%提升至64.0%；在SimplerEnv Bridge上，带playbook的轻量智能体成功率达66.7%，而仅用GR00T的基线为41.7%，并超过无playbook的强智能体；同一playbook对强智能体也有增益，使其达到79.2%。
AI.conclusion: 验证了机器人领域引导蒸馏的可行性：干预经验可被积累、通过执行过程精炼，并跨智能体复用，从而提升操作性能。

title: NLPG: Natural-Language Policy Gradients for Self-Evolving Language Agents
comment: 30 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Work in progress
summary: Large language model agents increasingly rely on compound programs for retrieval, tool use, reasoning, and verification, yet their failures often arise from local procedural decisions. Existing reinforcement-learning and prompt-optimization approaches typically rely on scalar rewards or repeatedly modify entire prompts, making it difficult to capture and reuse procedural improvements while preserving a frozen agent. To address this problem, We propose Natural-Language Policy Gradients (NLPG), an external policy-memory method for improving a fixed agent without changing its model parameters or program structure. NLPG diagnoses execution traces, propagates downstream feedback backward through the module graph, and converts recurring failures into route-local natural-language corrections that are aggregated into bounded policy updates for subsequent executions. Across six benchmarks covering memory, reasoning, instruction following, and evidence verification, NLPG also outperforms the strongest listed baseline for each benchmark by 8.71 percentage points on average. These results provide evidence that evaluated procedural experience can be transformed into local and interpretable policy updates, enabling continual improvement of frozen agents.

AI.tldr: 提出自然语言策略梯度（NLPG），一种外部策略记忆方法，通过将执行轨迹中的失败诊断转化为路由局部的自然语言修正，实现对冻结智能体的持续改进，无需修改模型参数或程序结构。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体日益依赖复合程序完成检索、工具调用、推理与验证，但失败往往源于局部过程性决策。现有强化学习与提示优化方法依赖标量奖励或反复修改整个提示，难以捕捉和复用过程性改进，且难以在保持智能体冻结的前提下进行优化。
AI.method: NLPG 不改变模型参数与程序结构，属于外部策略记忆方法：诊断执行轨迹，将下游反馈沿模块图反向传播，把反复出现的失败转化为路由局部的自然语言修正，并将其聚合为有界的策略更新供后续执行使用。
AI.result: 在覆盖记忆、推理、指令遵循与证据验证的六个基准上，NLPG 平均超过各基准最强基线 8.71 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 经评估的过程性经验可被转化为局部且可解释的策略更新，从而实现冻结智能体的持续改进。

title: PulseQuant: Propagation-Guided Subspace Correction for 4-Bit Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Quantization errors in video diffusion transformers can be amplified or attenuated by subsequent denoising updates, making local reconstruction error an incomplete predictor of final impact. We introduce PulseQuant, a 4-bit post-training quantization method that combines trajectory sensitivity with activation geometry to guide offline calibration. Isolated block--step interventions estimate propagation risk, which prioritizes sensitive trajectory states during row-radius selection. With these radii fixed, response-subspace correction uses neighboring-code edits to reduce residual components along dominant activation directions. Both stages preserve the original 4-bit weight representation. Controlled interventions show that short-horizon propagated error predicts final latent error more reliably than immediate block-output error, supporting calibration beyond local reconstruction objectives. Evaluations on Wan models, Self Forcing, and MiniMax-H3 demonstrate improvements in key consistency and dense-reference metrics while remaining competitive on other attributes across model scales and generation paradigms.

AI.tldr: 提出PulseQuant，一种4比特视频扩散Transformer训练后量化方法，利用轨迹敏感性与激活几何指导离线校准，在多个模型上提升关键一致性与密集参考指标。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer中，量化误差会被后续去噪更新放大或衰减，导致局部重构误差无法可靠预测最终影响，因此需要超越局部重构目标的校准方法。
AI.method: PulseQuant采用两阶段校准：首先通过孤立块-步（block-step）干预估计传播风险，在行半径选择时优先考虑敏感轨迹状态；然后在半径固定的前提下，使用响应子空间校正，通过邻近码编辑减少沿主导激活方向的残差分量。两阶段均保持原始4比特权表示。
AI.result: 受控干预实验表明，短时传播误差比即时块输出误差更能可靠预测最终潜变量误差；在Wan模型、Self Forcing和MiniMax-H3上评估，关键一致性与密集参考指标均有提升，其他属性保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 将轨迹敏感性与激活几何纳入离线校准可有效改善视频扩散Transformer的4比特量化，支持校准目标超越局部重构，并在不同模型规模与生成范式下具有泛化性。

title: OLED-MoE: Accelerating MoE-Based dLLM Inference via Inter-Iteration Locality-Aware Expert Offloading
comment: Accepted by EuroSys '27 spring. Code available at https://github.com/flashserve/OLED-MoE
summary: Semi-autoregressive diffusion large language models (dLLMs) improve decoding parallelism through iterative block-wise denoising, but scaling them with mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers introduces a large expert parameter footprint that exceeds memory-constrained GPU capacity. Expert offloading is a natural remedy, yet existing MoE serving systems target autoregressive decoding and rely on intra-iteration layer-wise prefetching: while computing one layer, they predict and load experts for subsequent layers. Under dLLM inference, block-wise routing expands the active expert working set within each iteration, making such prefetches difficult to complete in time and costly when mispredicted. Consequently, existing prefetch-based solutions often degenerate into on-demand expert loading with high decoding latency. We propose OLED-MoE, an expert offloading system that shifts the optimization target from intra-iteration prefetching to inter-iteration expert retention. Its key insight is that adjacent denoising iterations exhibit strong expert routing overlap, and token confidence indicates which experts are likely to be reused. OLED-MoE uses confidence-guided inter-iteration prediction to retain high-value experts in GPU memory without introducing extra prefetch traffic. It further compensates unavoidable cache misses through CPU-GPU cooperative execution, jointly considering dynamic expert computation load and predicted future reuse. Across diverse dLLM workloads, OLED-MoE reduces time per output token (TPOT) by 1.23x-7.93x and improves expert cache utilization by 1.44x-4.23x over state-of-the-art offloading systems. Notably, OLED-MoE approaches full-residency performance while using only 40% of the expert GPU memory, incurring merely 23% higher TPOT despite a 60% reduction in expert memory footprint. OLED-MoE's source code is publicly available at https://github.com/flashserve/OLED-MoE.

AI.tldr: OLED-MoE 是一种面向半自回归扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的专家卸载系统，将优化目标从迭代内预取转向迭代间专家保留，通过置信度引导的预测和 CPU-GPU 协同执行，在显著降低专家显存占用的同时保持高性能。
AI.motivation: 在 dLLM 中使用 MoE 层会带来庞大的专家参数，超出显存受限 GPU 的容量。现有 MoE 服务系统针对自回归解码设计，依赖迭代内逐层预取（计算一层时预测并加载后续层专家）。但在 dLLM 的块级去噪下，每次迭代内活跃专家工作集被扩展，导致预取难以及时完成、误预测代价高，现有预取方案往往退化为按需加载，解码延迟高。
AI.method: 核心洞察是相邻去噪迭代间存在强烈的专家路由重叠，且 token 置信度可指示哪些专家可能被复用。基于此，OLED-MoE 采用置信度引导的迭代间预测，将高价值专家保留在 GPU 显存中且不引入额外预取流量；并通过 CPU-GPU 协同执行补偿不可避免的缓存未命中，联合考虑动态专家计算负载与预测的未来复用。
AI.result: 在多种 dLLM 工作负载上，相比最先进的卸载系统，OLED-MoE 将每输出 token 时间（TPOT）降低 1.23x-7.93x，专家缓存利用率提升 1.44x-4.23x。仅使用 40% 的专家 GPU 显存即可接近全驻留性能，在专家显存减少 60% 的情况下 TPOT 仅高出 23%。
AI.conclusion: OLED-MoE 通过将优化目标从迭代内预取转变为迭代间专家保留，有效解决了 dLLM+MoE 场景下专家卸载的延迟问题，在显著降低显存占用的同时逼近全驻留性能，源码已开源。

title: From Position Risks to Block Survival: Faster Generation for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) can accelerate generation by predicting multiple tokens in parallel, but there is a mismatch between how these tokens are predicted and how they ultimately contribute to generation. Parallel predictions can hardly condition on the tokens selected earlier within the same block, even though their validity depends on this realized prefix. Under the popular proposal-verification decoding, this mismatch makes errors highly asymmetric: an early rejection prevents all subsequent proposals from contributing decoding progress. We introduce BRISK-DLM, a framework that addresses both mismatches by optimizing proposal learning and selection for verified progress. BRISK-DLM trains on self-generated sequences, using risk-reward weighting to dynamically prioritize positions by their impact on verified progress and decoding cost. During inference, a lightweight prefix-conditioned corrector reranks existing candidates using previously selected tokens and preferences distilled from the model's own verifier. The corrector reuses the backbone's parallel representations and requires no additional backbone evaluation, while fused execution keeps its overhead small. BRISK-DLM improves end-to-end throughput by up to 37.4% while preserving task quality, establishing a new quality-throughput frontier for DLM generation.

AI.tldr: BRISK-DLM 通过优化提案学习与选择来对齐扩散语言模型的并行预测与生成贡献，端到端吞吐量最高提升 37.4%，同时保持任务质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）虽可通过并行预测多个 token 加速生成，但存在两个错配：1）并行预测难以对同一块内先前选择的 token 进行条件建模，而 token 的有效性却依赖已实现的前缀；2）在提案-验证解码下，早期拒绝会阻止后续所有提案贡献解码进展，导致错误高度不对称。
AI.method: 提出 BRISK-DLM 框架：训练阶段基于自生成序列，采用风险-奖励加权，按各位置对已验证进展和解码成本的影响动态分配优先级；推理阶段引入轻量级前缀条件校正器，利用已选 token 及从模型自身验证器蒸馏的偏好，对现有候选重新排序。校正器复用主干网络的并行表示，无需额外主干评估，并通过融合执行降低开销。
AI.result: 端到端吞吐量最高提升 37.4%，同时保持任务质量，确立了 DLM 生成在质量-吞吐量上的新前沿。
AI.conclusion: BRISK-DLM 通过联合优化提案学习与选择，缓解了并行预测与生成贡献之间的错配，实现了质量与吞吐量的更优权衡。

title: Preserving Morphemes: Morphology-Guided Pre-Tokenization for Nepali
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Code, data and tokenizers: https://github.com/kalexrt/nepali-morphology-tokenizer
summary: A byte-level BPE vocabulary learns each inflected form of a Nepali word as a separate string, so a noun stem is spelled differently in each of its case-marked forms. We test whether splitting words into stem and affixes before BPE helps, with the corpus, vocabulary size, model and number of training steps held fixed. Our pre-tokenizer, Papaya, uses a finite-state transducer built from a published grammar of Nepali, falls back to regular expressions, and leaves the BPE trainer unchanged. On 607 words annotated by seven native speakers its segmenter reaches 0.96 boundary F1, and the resulting tokens keep stems intact far more often than plain BPE does. In a 17M-parameter language model it lowers bits per byte by about 1% at equal training steps; most of the larger gain seen at equal epochs comes from the extra steps that longer token sequences buy, and an unsupervised Morfessor segmentation gives the same improvement. Downstream the effect is small: NER improves only on entities that contain words unseen in training, POS tagging and news classification do not change, and published Nepali tokenizers perform about as well. We release the annotated boundary set, a 556-affix dataset and the code.

AI.tldr: 将尼泊尔语词形先切分为词干与词缀再进行BPE，在中立对照下仅带来约1%的bits-per-byte下降，下游任务收益有限，且无监督Morfessor切分效果相当。
AI.motivation: 字节级BPE会把尼泊尔语每个屈折形式学成独立字符串，同一词干在不同格标记形式下拼写不同，导致词干被切碎、词表冗余。作者欲在语料、词表大小、模型与训练步数全部固定的条件下，验证"先做形态切分再做BPE"是否真正有益。
AI.method: 提出预分词器Papaya：基于已发表尼泊尔语语法构建有限状态转换器（FST）进行切分，失败时回退到正则表达式，BPE训练器保持不变。用七位母语者标注的607个词评估切分边界，并在17M参数语言模型上做等步数与等轮数对照，另与无监督Morfessor切分及已发布尼泊尔语分词器比较。
AI.result: 切分器边界F1达0.96；所得token比普通BPE更常保持词干完整。等训练步数下bits per byte降低约1%；等轮数下更大的增益主要来自更长token序列带来的额外步数，而非切分本身，无监督Morfessor切分取得同样提升。下游效果微弱：NER仅在测试集含训练未见词的实体上改善，POS标注与新闻分类无变化，已发布尼泊尔语分词器表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 形态感知预分词对尼泊尔语BPE有可测但微弱的收益，且该收益并非源自形态信息本身——等步数对照与Morfessor基线表明，token序列变长带来的训练步数增加是主要来源。作者发布标注边界集、556词缀数据集与代码，提示此类改进需在等步数条件下审慎评估。

title: SciGen-Verifier: A Multimodal Reasoner for Explainable Verification in Scientific Image Generation
summary: In realistic education, a solution is often expressed not only in words but in a drawing--a circuit, a geometric construction, a function plot--and a teacher must grade the drawing as carefully as the text. Recent advances in unified multimodal models have enabled scientific image generation, yet verifying the correctness of these specialized visual outputs remains a critical bottleneck: errors often arise from intricate domain knowledge, structural reasoning, and multi-step instruction rather than surface-level artifacts. Existing verifiers mainly target natural images and compress judgement into scalar scores, leaving scientific coverage and explainable feedback for error correction underexplored. To bridge this gap, we make three main contributions. (1) We construct SciGen-Verify, a benchmark dedicated to explainable verification of scientific image generation, spanning instruction following, multidisciplinary reasoning, and world knowledge domains. It contains a three-tier hierarchical protocol over the binary judgement, supporting explanation, and corrective editing instruction. (2) We develop SciGen-Verifier, a reasoning-driven multimodal verifier trained via cold-start supervised fine-tuning followed by a curriculum-based two-stage reinforcement learning pipeline. The rubric-guided process rewards first strengthen scientific reasoning exploration and outcome rewards subsequently align output with ground-truth annotation. (3) On SciGen-Verify, SciGen-Verifier achieves competitive performance against much larger proprietary models. It further serves as a practical online critic for iterative image rectification.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对科学图像生成难以验证的问题，构建了可解释验证基准 SciGen-Verify，并提出推理驱动的多模态验证器 SciGen-Verifier，在基准上媲美更大规模专有模型，并可作为在线评论者指导图像迭代修正。
AI.motivation: 现实教育中解决方案常以图形（电路、几何作图、函数图像）表达，需像文本一样严格批改。统一多模态模型虽已能生成科学图像，但其正确性验证仍是瓶颈：错误多源于复杂领域知识、结构推理与多步指令，而非表面伪影。现有验证器主要面向自然图像且仅输出标量分数，科学覆盖范围与可解释纠错反馈尚不充分。
AI.method: (1) 构建 SciGen-Verify 基准，面向科学图像生成的可解释验证，覆盖指令遵循、多学科推理与世界知识，并设三级层次化协议：二元判断、支撑解释、纠错编辑指令。(2) 提出 SciGen-Verifier，一种推理驱动的多模态验证器，先经冷启动监督微调，再采用课程式两阶段强化学习流程；评分标准引导的过程奖励先强化科学推理探索，结果奖励随后对齐真实标注。
AI.result: 在 SciGen-Verify 上，SciGen-Verifier 以较小规模取得与更大专有模型相当的性能；并可作为实用的在线评论者，用于迭代图像修正。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过基准与推理驱动验证器，填补了科学图像生成可解释验证的空白，提供从判断到解释再到纠错的完整反馈，并验证了其作为在线纠错评论者的实用价值。

title: Groupwise Selective State-Space Filtering for Accurate and Streaming Action Boundary Detection
summary: Action boundary detection partitions untrimmed video into intervals without assigning action classes. We present a boundary-detection adapter operating on pre-extracted video features, learning temporal representations via groupwise selective scans. Learned group fusion and temporal modeling convert these into transition scores, which are decoded into boundary timestamps. Trained with boundary-time supervision, the class-agnostic model is evaluated on Breakfast, GTEA, and 50Salads using temporal tolerances and bipartite matching, achieving boundary $F_1$ scores of 0.457, 0.622, and 0.611. A stateful variant enables feature-streaming inference with zero neural look-ahead, one-sample peak confirmation, and bounded memory. Downstream systems can subsequently assign s

AI.tldr: 提出一种作用于预提取视频特征的动作边界检测适配器，利用分组选择性扫描学习时序表示，经组融合与时序建模生成转移分数并解码为边界时间戳，在三个数据集上取得边界F1。
AI.motivation: 视频动作边界检测需将未裁剪视频划分为区间而不分配动作类别，现有方法多在端到端视频模型上处理，计算与部署代价高，且难以支持流式推理。本文希望在预提取特征上实现轻量、类无关且可流式的边界检测。
AI.method: 在预提取视频特征上构建边界检测适配器；通过分组选择性扫描（groupwise selective scans）学习时序表示；经可学习的分组融合（learned group fusion）与时序建模将表示映射为转移分数；将转移分数解码为边界时间戳；以边界时间监督训练，模型为类无关（class-agnostic）。此外提供有状态变体，实现特征流式推理。
AI.result: 在Breakfast、GTEA和50Salads数据集上，采用时间容差与二分匹配评估，边界F1分别为0.457、0.622和0.611。有状态变体支持特征流式推理，零神经前瞻（zero neural look-ahead）、单样本峰值确认（one-sample peak confirmation）以及有界内存。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以轻量适配器形式在预提取特征上完成类无关动作边界检测，并在多数据集上得到可比的边界F1；其有状态变体具备流式、低延迟与有界内存特性，便于为下游系统（如动作分类/识别）提供边界后进行类别分配。

title: VaME: Exploring Variational Latent Reasoning for Multimodal Embeddings
summary: Universal multimodal retrieval requires compact embeddings that preserve task-relevant semantic information across diverse modalities. Prior works have incorporated latent reasoning into multimodal embedding learning to refine this information before embedding extraction. However, most existing approaches remain confined to deterministic latent paths, without exploring alternative trajectories to discover better embeddings. Thus, we propose VaME (Variational Multimodal Embeddings), a framework that models latent reasoning as a learnable distribution over trajectories. Specifically, we first introduce Variational Latent Reasoning (VLR) to enable autoregressive exploration in latent space, guided by answer reconstruction through a lightweight decoder. Meanwhile, we augment the original embedding-token readout with a latent-fused embedding to facilitate exploration during subsequent reinforcement learning. Finally, we optimize latent reasoning over stochastic variational trajectories through reinforcement learning, using Semantic Decoding Reward (SDR) to favor semantically meaningful trajectories with interpretable decoded outcomes. On the 78-task MMEB-V2 benchmark, spanning image, video, and visual-document retrieval, VaME outperforms most explicit CoT-based models and all latent-reasoning baselines. VaME also demonstrates robust performance on reasoning-intensive benchmarks such as MRMR, with substantial gains after reinforcement learning. Importantly, VaME achieves these gains with at least a 4.25x inference speedup over the deterministic latent autoregressive baselines. The code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出VaME框架，将多模态嵌入的潜在推理建模为可学习的轨迹分布，通过变分潜在推理与强化学习优化，在MMEB-V2等基准上超越多数显式CoT方法，并实现至少4.25倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态检索需要跨模态保留任务相关语义的紧凑嵌入。已有工作将潜在推理引入多模态嵌入学习以精炼信息，但大多局限于确定性潜在路径，未探索替代轨迹以发现更优嵌入。
AI.method: 提出VaME，将潜在推理建模为轨迹上的可学习分布。具体包括：1）变分潜在推理（VLR），在潜在空间进行自回归探索，并由轻量解码器通过答案重建引导；2）在原始嵌入token读出基础上引入潜在融合嵌入，便于后续强化学习中的探索；3）通过强化学习在随机变分轨迹上优化潜在推理，使用语义解码奖励（SDR）偏好具有可解释解码结果的语义有效轨迹。
AI.result: 在涵盖图像、视频和视觉文档检索的78任务MMEB-V2基准上，VaME超越多数显式CoT模型及所有潜在推理基线；在MRMR等推理密集型基准上表现稳健，强化学习后增益显著；相比确定性潜在自回归基线实现至少4.25倍推理加速。
AI.conclusion: VaME通过变分潜在推理与强化学习实现了高效且语义有效的多模态嵌入学习，兼顾检索性能与推理效率，代码将公开。

title: Decoupling Token Roles in Autoregressive Pretraining
summary: Autoregressive pretraining increasingly draws on heterogeneous data, making it important to understand how a model learns from an individual token. The next-token prediction objective naturally identifies a token's contribution with its own loss. However, each token is not only a prediction target but also context for what follows. Using controlled corruption, we decouple these two roles and find a reversal: making a noisy token easier to predict reduces its damage as a target but increases it as context. The same decoupling helps explain text generated by language models: generation selects each token by its fit to the prefix, while its role as context is never tested against an independently determined continuation, because that continuation is generated to fit it. At known corrupted positions, acting through the context can reduce damage that removing the token's own loss does not. Understanding and controlling what a model learns from a token therefore requires decoupling its roles.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控破坏实验，解耦自回归模型中单个token的"预测目标"与"上下文"双重角色，发现二者存在反转效应：降低token的可预测难度会减少其作为目标的损害，却增加其作为上下文的损害。这一解耦也解释了语言模型生成文本的特性。
AI.motivation: 自回归预训练越来越多地使用异构数据，因此需要理解模型如何从单个token中学习。传统认知将token的贡献等同于其自身的损失（next-token prediction目标），但作者指出token不仅是预测目标，也是后续内容的上下文，两种角色未被区分。
AI.method: 采用受控破坏（controlled corruption）方法，将token的双重角色解耦：分别考察噪声token作为预测目标的影响和作为上下文的影响。同时通过分析语言模型生成文本，探讨生成时token的选择机制（基于对前缀的契合度），而其上下文角色从未被独立验证。
AI.result: 发现反转效应：让噪声token更易预测会降低其作为目标的损害，但会增加其作为上下文的损害。在已知破坏位置，通过上下文起作用能够减少损害，而仅移除token自身损失无法做到这一点。生成文本的token因其契合前缀而被选中，其上下文角色因后续内容被生成为拟合它而从未受独立检验。
AI.conclusion: 理解并控制模型从token中学习的内容，必须解耦其作为预测目标和上下文的双重角色。仅关注token自身损失不足以保证模型学习质量。

title: Dense Is Not Enough: Hierarchical Supervision Allocation for Long-Horizon On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers the capabilities of a large language model to a smaller student by providing teacher supervision on the student's own rollouts. In long-horizon agentic tasks, however, uniform token-level matching can allocate supervision poorly: a large local discrepancy need not improve future behavior, while consequential guidance may be beyond the current student's reach or fail to persist without privileged input. We formulate long-horizon OPD as hierarchical supervision allocation and argue that productive guidance lies at the intersection of future utility and current learnability. Crucially, this intersection evolves as the student learns. Based on this principle, we propose LENS-OPD, a coarse-to-fine framework that organizes supervision through Locate, Validate, and Refine. Locate adapts trajectory exposure to the student's evolving competence and proposes a candidate decision for intervention. Validate tests whether teacher guidance at that decision improves the same student's subsequent behavior. Refine internalizes the beneficial guided behavior into the deployable policy and concentrates token-level supervision on decisive teacher-student conflicts within the validated turn. These stages are nested: each finer allocation is conditioned on the coarser decision, rather than being optimized as an independent importance score. Experiments across multiple long-horizon agent benchmarks and student-teacher configurations show that LENS-OPD consistently improves task performance over vanilla OPD and strong curriculum- and selection-based baselines. Our results suggest that effective long-horizon distillation requires teaching at the right depth, the right decision, and the right token.

AI.tldr: 该论文将长时程在线策略蒸馏（OPD）重构为"分层监督分配"问题，提出LENS-OPD框架，通过定位、验证、精炼三个嵌套阶段，在"未来效用"与"当前可学性"的交集中分配监督，在多个长时程智能体基准上优于原始OPD及课程/选择类基线。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过在学生自身轨迹上提供教师监督，将大模型能力迁移到小模型。但在长时程智能体任务中，逐token均匀匹配监督存在分配失当问题：局部差异大并不意味着能改善未来行为；而有价值的指导可能超出学生当前能力范围，或在缺乏特权输入时无法持续。因此需要重新思考长时程OPD中的监督分配原则。
AI.method: 作者将长时程OPD形式化为分层监督分配问题，提出有效指导位于"未来效用"与"当前可学性"的交叉点，且该交叉点随学生学习而动态演化。据此提出LENS-OPD的粗到细框架，包含三个阶段：Locate（定位）根据学生不断变化的能力调整轨迹暴露，并给出候选干预决策点；Validate（验证）检验在该决策点教师指导能否改善同一学生的后续行为；Refine（精炼）将有益的指导行为内化到可部署策略中，并将token级监督集中在已验证轮次内决定性的师生冲突上。三阶段呈嵌套关系，更细粒度的分配以更粗粒度的决策为条件，而非作为独立的重要性分数优化。
AI.result: 在多个长时程智能体基准和多种师生配置上的实验表明，LENS-OPD一致地提升了任务性能，优于原始OPD以及强课程学习和选择类基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，有效的长时程蒸馏需要在"正确的深度、正确的决策和正确的token"上进行教学，即监督分配需在正确的粒度层次上动态对齐学生的能力演进。

title: MetaBench-Harness: Unlocking End-to-End Optimization of Benchmark Harnesses
summary: Rapid progress in Large Language Models (LLMs) is saturating static benchmarks faster than they can be designed. While existing automated evolution frameworks attempt to generate harder questions by perturbing individual tasks, they remain constrained by rigid, hard-coded generation rules. Moving beyond the evolution of isolated tasks, we propose to optimize the benchmark generation workflow itself end to end with MetaBench-Harness, a dual-loop search framework. Specifically, the inner loop utilizes a benchmark harness to generate a new benchmark in each round, while the outer meta-harness orchestration layer iteratively refines and searches over harness implementations based on historical evolution trajectories. By applying MetaBench-Harness to the competitive programming CodeContests and Olympiad mathematics AIME-2024 datasets, we demonstrate that the evolved benchmarks are challenging and discriminative for frontier models. Trajectory and quality analyses verify that MetaBench-Harness enables multi-dimensional evolution, steadily improving evolution reasonableness, benchmark competency, and evaluator robustness across successive rounds. Furthermore, case studies reveal its effective utilization of diverse difficulty levers to reframe problems and elevate required capabilities. Ultimately, this work provides a solution to the pressing challenge of benchmark saturation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MetaBench-Harness，一个双层搜索框架，通过优化基准生成工作流本身（而非仅扰动单个任务）来端到端自动演化更难的评估基准，以应对LLM快速饱和静态基准的问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型进展迅速，静态基准被饱和的速度快于新基准的设计速度。现有自动化演化框架试图通过对单个任务进行扰动来生成更难的问题，但受限于僵化、硬编码的生成规则，只能演化孤立任务，难以持续产出具有挑战性的评估基准。
AI.method: 提出MetaBench-Harness双层循环搜索框架：内层循环使用基准harness（benchmark harness）在每一轮生成一个新基准；外层元harness编排层（meta-harness orchestration layer）基于历史演化轨迹，对harness实现进行迭代精炼与搜索，从而端到端优化整个基准生成工作流。并在竞赛编程数据集CodeContests和奥数数据集AIME-2024上进行应用验证。
AI.result: 演化得到的基准对前沿模型具有挑战性和区分度。轨迹与质量分析验证了MetaBench-Harness可实现多维度演化，在连续多轮中稳步提升演化合理性、基准竞争力和评估器鲁棒性。案例研究揭示其能有效利用多样化难度杠杆（difficulty levers）重构问题并提升所需能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为基准饱和这一紧迫挑战提供了一种解决方案：通过双层搜索优化基准生成流程本身，实现基准的多维度、持续演化，从而生成对前沿模型更具挑战性与区分度的评估基准。

title: Resolving State-Representation Mismatch: State-Space Visual Reasoning for Open-Loop VLA Planning
summary: Despite rapid progress in vision-language-action (VLA) models, existing reasoning paradigms still face a fundamental \emph{state-representation mismatch} in open-loop planning. Given only an initial observation, models must internally simulate action-conditioned state transitions, whereas text-, pixel-, and latent-space reasoning can suffer from lossy spatial compression, error-accumulating visual generation, and bypass of intermediate latent tokens, respectively, undermining reliable long-horizon planning. We propose \textbf{State-Space Visual Reasoning} (SSVR), which decouples static visual context, language constraints, and a recurrent latent state. SSVR encodes the initial image and instruction once, then conditions each action prediction on the latent state and updates it with an action-conditioned GRU. Using Qwen2.5-VL as the backbone, SSVR achieves 99.5/99.6, 96.3/98.0, and 83.9/90.6 EM/PR on FrozenLake, Maze, and MiniBehavior, substantially outperforming prior methods. Extensive experiments support the effectiveness of recurrent state modeling for VLA open-loop planning across input transformations and transfer settings. By reusing static visual-textual context and updating a compact recurrent state, SSVR supports efficient multi-step inference, achieving up to $98.58\times$ faster Maze decoding rollouts than the evaluated baselines with the prefix cache prebuilt.

AI.tldr: 提出状态空间视觉推理（SSVR），通过解耦静态视觉上下文、语言约束与循环隐状态，缓解VLA开环规划中的状态表征错配，并大幅提升长时程规划性能与推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型的推理范式在开环规划中存在根本性的"状态表征错配"：仅给定初始观测，模型需在内部模拟动作条件的状态转移。而文本空间、像素空间和潜空间推理分别面临空间压缩有损、视觉生成误差累积、以及中间潜token被绕过的缺陷，削弱了长时程规划的可靠性。
AI.method: SSVR将静态视觉上下文、语言约束与循环潜状态解耦。模型对初始图像和指令仅编码一次，随后每个动作预测都以潜状态为条件，并用动作条件GRU更新该状态。方法以Qwen2.5-VL为主干，并利用前缀缓存支持高效多步推理。
AI.result: 在FrozenLake上达到99.5/99.6，Maze上96.3/98.0，MiniBehavior上83.9/90.6（EM/PR），显著优于先前方法。跨输入变换与迁移设置的实验验证了循环状态建模的有效性；在预构建前缀缓存下，Maze解码rollout相比所评估基线最高加速98.58倍。
AI.conclusion: 循环状态建模对VLA开环规划有效，能够跨输入变换与迁移场景稳定发挥作用。通过复用静态视觉-文本上下文并仅更新紧凑的循环状态，SSVR在保证规划精度的同时实现了高效多步推理。

title: TTRSD: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning with Self-Distillation for Vision-Language Models
summary: Test-time reinforcement learning enables vision-language models (VLMs) to adapt using unlabeled inputs. However, repeated sampling under fixed visual conditions can reinforce shared perceptual errors, while sequence-level rewards fail to isolate visual perception the foundational bottleneck that anchors multimodal reasoning risking the degradation of pre-trained reasoning capabilities. We propose TTRSD, a test-time reinforcement learning framework combining multi-view answer-level self-distillation with visual contrastive token selection. A shared policy aggregates teacher predictions across original, cropped, and downsampled views into an answer distribution. Student trajectories generated from the original image receive rewards based on the support for their final answers in this distribution. To allocate this feedback precisely toward perceptual bottlenecks, we compare the log-probabilities of the same sampled tokens under original and visually ablated inputs while holding their textual prefixes fixed, selecting visually sensitive positions for policy-gradient updates. TTRSD separates update direction, determined by group-relative advantages, from update position, determined by visual sensitivity, without requiring ground-truth labels, external verifiers, or a separate teacher. With only 20 unlabeled adaptation samples, TTRSD improves performance across seven benchmarks and three VLMs, raising InternVL3-2B's MMMU accuracy from 35.79% to 49.32%(+13.53%), demonstrating cross-dataset generalization while preserving inherent reasoning integrity.

AI.tldr: 提出 TTRSD 测试时强化学习框架，结合多视角答案级自蒸馏与视觉对比 token 选择，在无标注条件下提升 VLM 表现并保持原有推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时强化学习在固定视觉条件下重复采样会强化共享感知错误，且序列级奖励无法定位视觉感知这一多模态推理的基础瓶颈，可能导致预训练推理能力退化。
AI.method: TTRSD 采用共享策略聚合原始、裁剪、下采样三种视角的教师预测为答案分布；学生轨迹基于原始图像生成，其最终答案在该分布中的支持度决定奖励。通过固定文本前缀，比较同一采样 token 在原始与视觉消融输入下的对数概率，识别视觉敏感位置用于策略梯度更新；从而将更新方向（组相对优势）与更新位置（视觉敏感性）解耦，无需真值标签、外部验证器或独立教师模型。
AI.result: 仅用 20 个无标注适配样本，在 7 个基准和 3 个 VLM 上均获提升；InternVL3-2B 的 MMMU 准确率从 35.79% 提升至 49.32%（+13.53%），展现跨数据集泛化能力，并保持固有推理完整性。
AI.conclusion: TTRSD 通过答案级自蒸馏与视觉敏感 token 选择的解耦设计，实现了高效、无监督的测试时适配，兼顾性能提升与推理能力保持。

title: Grounding Memory Summarization in Utility Intent
summary: Existing summarizers for memory systems are typically optimized for human-facing criteria such as faithfulness, which misaligns with their true objective: preserving the evidence needed to support future queries. We show that conditioning summarization on query-answer pairs substantially improves answer quality, and that this utility-aware behavior is transferable across queries. Motivated by these findings, we propose MemSuit, a self-distillation framework in which a teacher summarizer, conditioned on observed query-answer pairs, produces utility-aware memory entries that a student learns to reproduce from the raw conversation alone. To prevent collateral erasure where conditioning on a single query-answer pair discards evidence relevant to other plausible queries, the teacher decomposes each block into multiple self-contained entries that preserve distinct query-relevant facets as independently retrievable units. To align the retriever with the compact, fact-dense style of teacher entries, we further fine-tune the embedding model with a contrastive objective supervised by teacher entries. Across a diverse suite of conversational query types, MemSuit consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, confirming the value of grounding memory in downstream utility.

AI.tldr: 提出 MemSuit 自蒸馏框架，将记忆摘要目标从"忠实原文"转向"保留下游查询所需证据"，通过按查询-答案对条件化的教师摘要器并分解为多个独立条目、再用对比学习对齐检索器，在多种对话查询类型上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统的摘要器多用忠实性等面向人类的指标优化，与真正目标（保留支撑未来查询所需证据）不一致。作者发现以查询-答案对为条件能显著提升答案质量，且这种"效用感知"行为可跨查询迁移。
AI.method: MemSuit 采用自蒸馏：教师摘要器以已观察的查询-答案对为条件，生成效用感知的记忆条目；学生模型仅从原始对话学习复现这些条目。为防止"附带擦除"（单一查询-答案对的条件下丢弃其他可能查询相关证据），教师将每个对话块分解为多个自包含条目，作为可独立检索的单元保留不同查询相关侧面。此外用教师条目监督的对比目标微调嵌入模型，使检索器对齐紧凑、事实密集的教师条目风格。
AI.result: 在多样化的对话查询类型上，MemSuit 一致优于当前最优基线。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆建立在面向下游效用之上具有明确价值，效用感知的摘要行为可迁移，且通过条目分解缓解附带擦除、通过对比微调对齐检索器是有效手段。

title: TT-VidT: Decoupling the Temporal Axis for Efficient Motion-Centric Video Pretraining
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 main track, Project page: https://kohakublueleaf.github.io/TTVidT/
summary: Comparisons in video self-supervised learning often evaluate complete training recipes rather than isolating the method itself: architecture, objective, data exposure, schedule, scale, and decoder capacity can all vary at once. This makes it hard to identify which choices yield motion-prioritized representations, whose gains concentrate on frame-to-frame change while retaining useful appearance. We address this with a matched $4 \times 6 = 24$ architecture-objective study at roughly 170M ~ 190M encoder scale on $\sim$1.7M OpenVid and Moments-in-Time v2 clips for 8 epochs, and propose TT-VidT. TT-VidT combines a DINOv3-initialized ViT-B/16 per-frame spatial path with a compact Temporal Transfer Layer, trained by Diff Compression to reconstruct target frames from a first-frame appearance anchor and frame-specific motion tokens. The sweep shows that TT3D with Diff Compression, not either component alone, enters the strongest motion-sensitive regime, and decoder ablations favor a compact video-pretrained decoder. In final comparison, TT-VidT leads Jester, Something-Something V2, ARID, and Diving48 fine-tuning simultaneously, improving over the strongest non-TT row by 54% ~ 121%, while using 48% fewer encoder FLOPs than DisMo and 55% fewer than VideoMAE or V-JEPA2. HMDB51, IARD, and EPIC-Kitchens bound the claim.

AI.tldr: 本文在统一架构-目标匹配条件下系统比较视频自监督学习方法，提出 TT-VidT：DINOv3初始化的ViT-B/16空间路径加紧凑时序迁移层Temporal Transfer Layer，以Diff Compression训练，在多个运动敏感数据集上大幅领先。
AI.motivation: 现有视频自监督学习的对比往往评估完整训练配方，架构、目标、数据量、调度、规模与解码器容量同时变化，难以判断哪些设计真正产生"运动优先"的表征，也难以确认增益是否集中于逐帧变化而同时保留外观信息。
AI.method: 构建匹配的4×6=24架构-目标扫描实验，编码器规模约170M~190M，数据为约1.7M OpenVid与Moments-in-Time v2片段，训练8个epoch。所提 TT-VidT 由DINOv3初始化的ViT-B/16逐帧空间路径与紧凑的Temporal Transfer Layer组成，采用Diff Compression目标，从首帧外观锚点与帧特定运动token重建目标帧，并做解码器消融。
AI.result: 扫描表明 TT3D 结合 Diff Compression（而非任一单独组件）才进入最强运动敏感区间；解码器消融支持使用紧凑的视频预训练解码器。最终比较中，TT-VidT 在 Jester、Something-Something V2、ARID、Diving48 微调上同时领先，较最强非TT基线提升54%~121%，编码器FLOPs比DisMo少48%，比VideoMAE或V-JEPA2少55%。
AI.conclusion: 在受控的架构-目标匹配实验下，TT3D与Diff Compression的组合是获得运动优先表征的关键，TT-VidT在多个运动敏感基准上取得显著优势且计算更省；HMDB51、IARD与EPIC-Kitchens的结果界定了该结论的适用范围。

title: A Light Bilevel Refinement Aligns Self-Supervised Representations for Stronger Task-Specific Learning
summary: Self-supervised pretraining learns representations that are broadly transferable across downstream tasks, yet direct fine-tuning can be suboptimal due to misalignment between self-supervised and downstream task objectives, potentially degrading pretrained features beneficial to the downstream task. The BiSSL framework addressed this by introducing a transitional training stage formulated as a bilevel optimization problem, in which the downstream task objective guides the self-supervised learning process in refining pretrained representations to better facilitate subsequent fine-tuning. However, BiSSL relies on conventional bilevel optimization solving techniques whose costly implicit hypergradient approximations render the method increasingly impractical for contemporary model architectures. To make it efficient and scalable, we introduce BiSSLight, which combines M-FAC-based implicit gradient approximation with parameter-efficient fine-tuning via LoRA, enabling efficient application at larger scales that were previously impractical. Evaluation across multiple downstream tasks and contemporary model architectures shows that BiSSLight consistently improves downstream performance, with gains becoming more pronounced as model size increases despite stronger baselines. The method is highly computationally efficient, reducing computation time by more than a factor of ten compared to its predecessor on a ViT-H backbone.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出BiSSLight，通过M-FAC隐式梯度近似与LoRA参数高效微调相结合，克服了BiSSL双层优化计算代价高的问题，在多种下游任务和现代模型架构上以十倍以上计算效率提升实现一致的性能增益。
AI.motivation: 自监督预训练学到的表示虽具广泛可迁移性，但直接微调时，自监督目标与下游任务目标之间的错位会损害对下游有益的预训练特征，导致微调效果次优。BiSSL通过引入以双层优化形式建模的过渡训练阶段，用下游目标引导自监督学习来精炼表示。然而BiSSL依赖传统双层优化求解技术，其隐式超梯度近似代价高昂，使其在现代模型架构上越来越不实用，亟需一种高效且可扩展的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出BiSSLight，将M-FAC（基于矩阵自由近似曲率的）隐式梯度近似与基于LoRA的参数高效微调相结合，替代BiSSL中昂贵的隐式超梯度近似，从而在更大规模模型上高效应用双层优化式的过渡训练阶段。
AI.result: 在多个下游任务和现代模型架构上的评估表明，BiSSLight持续提升下游性能；随着模型规模增大，尽管基线更强，性能增益反而更显著。在ViT-H骨干上，相比前作将计算时间减少超过一个数量级（十倍以上）。
AI.conclusion: BiSSLight使双层优化式的自监督-下游任务对齐训练变得高效且可扩展，在更大模型上带来更明显收益，具有良好的实用性与计算效率。

title: TeacherGRPO: Closing the Capacity Gap in Reasoning Distillation via Teacher Alignment
summary: Reasoning distillation from powerful teacher models to smaller students faces the Gap Curse: as teachers grow more sophisticated, their complex distributions increasingly diverge from what students can approximate, causing performance degradation. Existing mitigation strategies either filter out challenging examples through data selection or introduce weaker intermediate assistant models, inherently compromising supervision coverage or quality. We propose Teacher Alignment, which directly adapts the teacher toward the student's distribution without discarding data or degrading reasoning quality. However, naive alignment through standard knowledge distillation triggers catastrophic collapse of the teacher's reasoning capabilities. To address this, we reformulate teacher alignment as reinforcement learning and introduce TeacherGRPO, built on Group Relative Policy Optimization with two key innovations: (i) Curriculum Selective Alignment applies dual token- and distribution-level curricula to focus rewards on high-signal reasoning gaps while filtering noise from trivial tokens and uncertain tail distributions, and (ii) Importance-Adaptive Length Regularization selectively penalizes verbose redundancy while preserving pedagogically critical reasoning steps. The aligned teacher then distills knowledge to students via standard pipelines. Extensive experiments show TeacherGRPO significantly outperforms baselines across diverse reasoning benchmarks and distillation methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/LzyFischer/TeacherGRPO.

AI.tldr: 从强教师到小学生的推理蒸馏存在"Gap Curse"：教师越强，其分布越偏离学生可逼近范围，导致性能退化。本文提出Teacher Alignment，将教师直接对齐到学生分布，并用强化学习框架TeacherGRPO实现，避免数据过滤或降质。实验表明其在多种推理基准和蒸馏方法上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 推理蒸馏中，教师模型越强大，其复杂分布与学生可逼近的分布差距越大，出现"Gap Curse"，引发性能退化。现有缓解策略存在根本缺陷：一是通过数据选择过滤困难样本，牺牲监督覆盖；二是引入较弱的中间助手模型，损害监督质量。作者希望在不丢弃数据、不降低推理质量的前提下，让教师直接适应学生分布。
AI.method: 作者将教师对齐重新表述为强化学习问题，提出TeacherGRPO，基于Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）并引入两项创新：(i) Course Selective Alignment（课程选择性对齐），在token级和分布级施加双重课程，将奖励聚焦于高信号推理差距，过滤琐碎token和不确定尾部分布的噪声；(ii) Importance-Adaptive Length Regularization（重要性自适应长度正则），选择性惩罚冗余啰嗦，同时保留对教学关键的推理步骤。对齐后的教师再通过标准蒸馏流程向学生传递知识。
AI.result: 大量实验显示，TeacherGRPO在多种推理基准和多种蒸馏方法上均显著优于现有基线方法，验证了其在克服Gap Curse方面的有效性。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 教师对齐可作为缓解推理蒸馏中Gap Curse的有效途径；将教师对齐建模为强化学习并用课程选择性对齐与重要性自适应长度正则实现，能在保持监督覆盖与质量的同时提升学生性能，为蒸馏范式提供新方向。

title: TC-ADA: One-Shot Active Domain Adaptation for Semantic Segmentation
summary: Manual dense annotation remains a major obstacle to deploying semantic segmentation models in new driving environments. Active domain adaptation (ADA) seeks label-efficient transfer by annotating only a selected portion of the target domain. Existing ADA methods commonly implement this process through multiple rounds of acquisition, annotation, and retraining. We study a practical one-shot image-level setting that selects and densely annotates a fixed target subset in a single round, followed by uninterrupted adaptation. Within this setting, we develop Target-Calibrated Active Domain Adaptation (TC-ADA) as a joint design of complete-image acquisition and target-calibrated adaptation. Stage~1 uses visual representations from a vision foundation model (VFM) together with semantic predictions from a fixed unsupervised domain adaptation model to select representative and informative target images without target annotations. Stage~2 jointly uses labeled source data, labeled target data, and the remaining unlabeled target data, while calibrating source and target supervision under limited target labels. Extensive experiments across five synthetic-to-real and real-to-real driving transfers show consistent improvements over representative ADA baselines. With only 23 to 46 labeled target images on four transfers and 140 on Mapillary, TC-ADA stays within 1.9 mean intersection over union (mIoU) points of target-only full supervision. Code will be available at https://github.com/ywher/TC-ADA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TC-ADA，一种面向语义分割的一次性图像级主动域适应框架，通过VFM表征与UDA预测协同选图，并在有限目标标注下校准源/目标监督，实现高效迁移。
AI.motivation: 密集标注成本高，阻碍语义分割模型在新驾驶环境部署；现有ADA方法需多轮"采集-标注-重训"，流程繁琐且不实用，因此研究更贴近实际的一次性图像级设定。
AI.method: 采用两阶段联合设计：Stage 1 结合视觉基础模型(VFM)的视觉表征与固定无监督域适应(UDA)模型的语义预测，在无目标标注下挑选具代表性且信息量高的目标图像；Stage 2 联合利用有标注源域、有标注目标域及剩余无标注目标域数据，在目标标签有限条件下校准源域与目标域监督。
AI.result: 在五个合成到真实及真实到真实的驾驶迁移任务上，TC-ADA持续优于代表性ADA基线；在四个迁移任务中仅用23–46张标注目标图像、Mapillary上140张，即与目标域全监督相差不超过1.9 mIoU。
AI.conclusion: TC-ADA验证了一次性图像级ADA设定的可行性，通过选图与域适应校准的联合设计显著降低标注需求并保持接近全监督的性能，代码将开源。

title: CORA: A Protocol for Diagnosing Boundary Robustness in Text-to-Audio Retrieval under Query Reformulations
comment: Accepted to Findings of IJCNLP-AACL. Code and data: https://github.com/sogang-isds/CORA
summary: Text-to-Audio (T2A) retrievers are typically evaluated with caption style queries, but the same user intent can be expressed in many forms. We introduce CORA (Caption-Offset Retrieval for Audio), a caption anchored diagnostic protocol that rewrites each source caption into five intent preserving forms (Command, Question, Indirect, Key phrase, and Statement) while fixing the target audio. By tracking the same target across query forms, CORA defines RankDrop, a metric revealing failures hidden by Recall@k. Using Pearson's correlation coefficient r, we find that RankDrop is weakly associated with raw text space movement (r=0.084), but strongly associated with Target Alignment Loss and Target Boundary Margin Degradation (r=0.508 and r=0.615). The same pattern appears in OEA retrievers, where RankDrop is better explained by boundary degradation (r=0.472/0.478) than by query movement (r=0.084/0.046). Overall, these results suggest that robust T2A retrieval requires preserving the target's boundary advantage over competing audio under reformulation.

AI.tldr: 提出CORA诊断协议，将同一目标音频的标题改写为五种意图一致的查询形式，定义RankDrop指标揭示Recall@k掩盖的检索失败，并发现RankDrop与目标边界优势退化强相关，而与查询文本空间位移弱相关。
AI.motivation: T2A检索通常仅用标题风格的查询进行评估，但同一用户意图可有多种表达形式；这种单一评估方式会掩盖模型在查询改写下的脆弱性，因此需要一个保持目标音频固定、系统改变查询形式的诊断协议来暴露被Recall@k隐藏的失败。
AI.method: 提出CORA（Caption-Offset Retrieval for Audio）协议：将每条源标题改写为五种意图保持的形式（Command、Question、Indirect、Key phrase、Statement），同时固定目标音频。通过跨查询形式追踪同一目标，定义RankDrop指标，用以量化Recall@k无法反映的排序退化。使用Pearson相关系数r分析RankDrop与文本空间移动、Target Alignment Loss、Target Boundary Margin Degradation等量的关联，并在OEA检索器上验证相同模式。
AI.result: RankDrop与原始文本空间移动仅弱相关（r=0.084），但与Target Alignment Loss（r=0.508）和Target Boundary Margin Degradation（r=0.615）强相关。在OEA检索器中同样成立：RankDrop与边界退化相关性更高（r=0.472/0.478），而与查询移动相关性很低（r=0.084/0.046）。
AI.conclusion: 稳健的T2A检索要求模型在查询改写下仍能保持目标相对于竞争音频的边界优势；仅关注查询文本的语义位移不足以解释检索退化，应该以目标边界优势的保持作为评估与优化的关键。

title: SMAT: Simple and Efficient Merge-Aware Training
summary: Model merging integrates the capabilities of multiple experts without joint retraining, but standard expert training optimizes task loss alone and does not guarantee good performance after merging. Merge-aware training (MAT) aims to improve merged performance, but existing methods do not fully account for common merging operations and add training cost. We observe that, from an expert's perspective, common merging methods can be described by three operations: Scale reweights its own update, Mask removes selected coordinates, and Perturb adds updates from other experts. Based on this view, we introduce SMAT (Simple MAT), which jointly optimizes expert loss and expected loss at simulated merged parameters generated by sampling scaling coefficients, masks, and additive noise. We further introduce periodic scheduling, kernel fusion, and parameter storage switching to make SMAT efficient, with one forward and one backward pass per step. Across four language and vision-language backbones, SMAT improves the mean score across five merging methods by 1.07-2.16 points over the strongest baseline for each backbone, with less than 2% training-time overhead over standard fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出SMAT，一种将常见模型合并操作抽象为Scale、Mask、Perturb三种操作并联合优化专家损失与模拟合并参数期望损失的合并感知训练方法，几乎不增加训练开销。
AI.motivation: 标准专家训练仅优化任务损失，无法保证模型合并后的性能；现有合并感知训练方法未充分覆盖常见合并操作，且会显著增加训练成本。因此需要一种既通用又高效的MAT方法。
AI.method: 从专家视角将常见合并方法归纳为三种操作：Scale（重加权自身更新）、Mask（移除选定坐标）、Perturb（加入其他专家的更新）。据此提出SMAT，在采样缩放系数、掩码和加性噪声生成的模拟合并参数上，联合优化专家损失与期望损失。并引入周期调度、算子融合与参数存储切换，使每步仅需一次前向和一次反向传播。
AI.result: 在四种语言与视觉-语言骨干模型上，SMAT在五种合并方法上的平均得分较各骨干的最强基线提升1.07–2.16分，训练时间相对标准微调的开销低于2%。
AI.conclusion: SMAT以统一操作视角覆盖常见合并方法，在几乎不增加训练成本的前提下显著提升合并后模型的性能，验证了合并感知训练的高效性与通用性。

title: Raven: The Harness of Harnesses for Composable Agentic Intelligence
summary: As large language models advance, AI agents are moving beyond isolated, domain-specific tasks toward long-horizon, cross-domain workflows. This transition exposes two challenges: increasing harness complexity makes manual design difficult to scale, while tighter coupling to specific domains limits the generality of a single harness. The central question thus shifts from how to engineer a stronger harness for one domain to how to autonomously construct specialized harnesses, improve them through experience, and orchestrate them across domains. We introduce Raven, \emph{The Harness of Harnesses}, an open-source multi-agent ecosystem that automatically constructs and evolves modular harnesses for specific models and domains, treating each executable model--harness pair as a composable unit of intelligence. To support an \emph{All-Domain Collaboration Network}, its Host Agent decomposes goals, matches subtasks to specialized agents, coordinates execution dependencies, and integrates results, while a host archive and EverOS preserve experience across tasks and Skill Forge makes that experience available as reusable procedures.
