Our theory establishes sufficient conditions for such composition to expand reliable task coverage beyond that of the available individual agents under a shared resource budget. On complex and long-horizon tasks, Raven significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art agent systems, pushing the frontier of composable agentic intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出开源多智能体生态Raven，自动为特定模型与领域构建、演化模块化harness，并将"模型-harness"对视为可组合智能单元，通过Host Agent分解目标、匹配专家agent、协调依赖并整合结果，在复杂长周期任务上显著超越现有系统。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型发展，AI agent正从孤立、单领域任务转向长周期、跨领域工作流。这一转变暴露两个挑战：一是harness复杂度上升导致人工设计难以规模化；二是与特定领域的紧耦合限制了单一harness的通用性。核心问题因此从"如何为某个领域设计更强的harness"转向"如何自主构建专用harness、通过经验加以改进并跨领域编排"。
AI.method: Raven（The Harness of Harnesses）是一个开源多智能体生态，自动构建并演化面向特定模型与领域的模块化harness，把每个可执行的"模型-harness"对当作可组合的智能单元。为支撑All-Domain Collaboration Network，其Host Agent负责目标分解、子任务与专用agent匹配、执行依赖协调及结果整合；host archive与EverOS跨任务保存经验，Skill Forge将经验转化为可复用流程。理论上给出充分条件，说明在共享资源预算下此类组合能扩展可靠任务覆盖范围，超越单个可用agent。
AI.result: 在复杂、长周期任务上，Raven显著优于当前最先进的agent系统，推进了可组合智能体智能的前沿。
AI.conclusion: Raven通过自动构建与演化harness、跨域编排与经验复用，实现了可组合的智能体智能，验证了在共享资源预算下组合式系统能扩展可靠任务覆盖并取得领先性能。

title: MIC: Explaining Image-Claim Inconsistencies in AI-Generated Multimodal Misinformation
summary: Claims paired with AI-generated images are a rapidly growing form of misinformation. Existing automated fact-checking (AFC) methods mainly treat this as a provenance problem, detecting low-level synthesis artifacts to decide whether an image is AI-generated. However, such methods do not verify what human fact-checkers often check: whether an image's content is consistent with the context implied by its accompanying claim. To address this gap, we introduce MIC (Multimodal Inconsistency Checking), an AFC framework that assists human fact-checkers by detecting AI-generated multimodal misinformation and explaining inconsistencies using world knowledge. MIC first uses supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for task adaptation and then applies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to directly optimize component-level verifiable rewards for verdict prediction, inconsistency type classification, visual evidence description, and world-knowledge explanation. We further introduce MIC-Bench, a benchmark comprising 8,812 image-claim instances derived from 4,406 claims, where each claim is paired with an authentic image and an AI-generated counterpart that introduces a controlled contextual inconsistency. Compared with SFT alone, GRPO further improves Macro-F1 by 4.67 and 4.11 points in the in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, respectively, while also improving the semantic similarity of visual evidence descriptions and world-knowledge explanations to reference annotations. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/UKPLab/arxiv2026-mic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MIC框架，将AI生成多模态虚假信息的自动事实核查从"来源检测"转向"内容一致性核查"，通过SFT+GRPO优化多组件可验证奖励，并发布MIC-Bench基准，GRPO使Macro-F1提升约4分。
AI.motivation: 现有自动事实核查方法主要将AI生成图像虚假信息视为来源溯源问题，仅通过检测低级合成伪影判断图像是否由AI生成。但这类方法无法验证人类事实核查员通常关注的要点：图像内容是否与所配文本声明所隐含的语境一致。此空白促使作者提出内容一致性核查框架。
AI.method: 提出MIC（Multimodal Inconsistency Checking）框架，辅助人工核查员检测AI生成多模态虚假信息并利用世界知识解释不一致。方法分两阶段：先以监督微调（SFT）进行任务适配，再采用组相对策略优化（GRPO）直接优化组件级可验证奖励，涵盖四项任务：判决预测、不一致类型分类、视觉证据描述、世界知识解释。同时构建MIC-Bench基准，含8,812个图像-声明实例（源自4,406条声明），每条声明配对一张真实图像与一张引入受控语境不一致的AI生成图像。
AI.result: 相比仅用SFT，GRPO在分布内与分布外设置下分别将Macro-F1提升4.67和4.11个百分点，同时提升了视觉证据描述与世界知识解释相对于参考标注的语义相似度。
AI.conclusion: MIC框架将多模态虚假信息核查从合成伪影溯源扩展到内容一致性核查，并通过GRPO对多组件可验证奖励的优化显著提升判决性能与解释质量。MIC-Bench为带受控语境不一致的图像-声明核查提供了系统基准，代码与数据已开源。

title: Context Spanning: A Communication Framework for Full-Duplex Speech Models and External LLM Backends
summary: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models can listen and speak simultaneously like the real-time dynamics of human conversation. For natural dialogue, the ability to search for external information in real-time is also an important capability. Many models remain trapped in parametric knowledge, leaving them unable to access real-time information and tool execution. Furthermore, even when Large Language Models (LLM) retrieve information, many duplex speech models process it within a compressed latent space rather than in its raw text form, which can lead to information loss from compression. To address this issue, we propose Context Spanning, a framework for information injection between a full-duplex speech model and an external LLM backend via real-time chunked prefill. The injected frame is encoded in a single forward pass inside the real-time frame budget. It feeds the retrieved information to the speech model as-is, enabling it to reason over the information independently and generate responses. With this approach, our model achieves high performance on Full-Duplex benchmarks and strong results on Question Answering tasks, demonstrating its conversation potential. Context Spanning shows that external information can be injected directly into a duplex speech model, introducing a new simple and powerful mechanism for duplex systems.

AI.tldr: 提出Context Spanning框架，通过实时分块prefill将外部LLM后端检索到的原始文本信息直接注入全双工语音对话模型，避免潜空间压缩导致的信息损失，在Full-Duplex基准与问答任务上取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音对话模型需像人类实时对话一样边听边说，但现有模型多受限于参数化知识，无法实时检索外部信息或调用工具；即便借助LLM检索，也多将信息压缩进潜空间处理，易造成信息损失。
AI.method: 提出Context Spanning框架：在全双工语音模型与外部LLM后端之间进行信息注入，采用实时分块prefill（real-time chunked prefill）方式；注入帧在单次前向传播中于实时帧预算内完成编码，并以原始文本形式（as-is）喂给语音模型，使其能独立推理并生成回应。
AI.result: 在Full-Duplex基准上取得高性能，在问答（Question Answering）任务上也表现强劲，展现出良好的对话潜力。
AI.conclusion: 证明外部信息可直接注入全双工语音模型，为双工系统提供了一种简单而强大的新机制。

title: Elucidating the Design Space of Regression-based Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
summary: A nascent family of methods that forgoes the policy gradient and reweights a supervised regression instead has garnered momentum in reinforcement learning for diffusion and flow models. DiffusionNFT, FlowAWR, and RAM are representative regimes with contrasting motivations. It is yet opaque what, if anything, they share. We substantiate that each is the solution of one divergence-constrained reward-maximization problem, and they are differentiated only by the convex generator that defines the constraint. Under the unified modeling framework, we unravel the relaxations that prior art made during building the advantage-embedded regression target: approximating the KKT condition and posterior normalizer for the linear and exponential tilt shapes DiffusionNFT and FlowAWR respectively, while preserving the exact sparsemax projection onto the probability simplex for linear tilt leads to another superior model type in this work. Beyond the theoretical underpinnings, we further empirically investigate the design space and shed light on the training recipe for regression-style diffusion RL. Retaining the merits discovered during our exploration gives rise to DiffusionRFT, our paradigm that converges faster, trains more stably, and attains the top performance.

AI.tldr: 该文提出统一框架：DiffusionNFT、FlowAWR、RAM 均是同一"散度约束奖励最大化"问题的解，差异仅在约束的凸生成函数。作者指出前两者分别对线性与指数倾斜做了KKT条件与后验归一化的近似，而保留线性倾斜在概率单纯形上的精确 sparsemax 投影可得更优模型，并经设计空间实证研究提出 DiffusionRFT。
AI.motivation: 回归式（无策略梯度）扩散/流模型强化学习新方法不断涌现，但 DiffusionNFT、FlowAWR、RAM 动机各异，其内在联系不明确，缺乏统一理解，也缺乏对训练配方的系统认识。
AI.method: 将上述方法统一建模为一个散度约束的奖励最大化问题，用定义约束的凸生成函数区分不同算法；分析各方法在构造优势嵌入回归目标时的松弛（对线性/指数倾斜形的 KKT 条件与后验归一化近似）；对线性倾斜保留精确的 sparsemax 投影到概率单纯形，得到新模型；并开展设计空间与训练配方的实证研究。
AI.result: 理论上证明了三种方法的同源性与仅由凸生成函数决定的差异；指出现有方法的近似之处；精确 sparsemax 投影版本成为更优模型；实证明确了回归式扩散 RL 的设计空间与训练配方。
AI.conclusion: 回归式扩散 RL 可被统一为散度约束奖励最大化，方法差异源于约束生成函数；在探索中保留有效设计后提出 DiffusionRFT，具有收敛更快、训练更稳定、性能最优的特点。

title: Concept Score Relearning: A Unified Cross-Architecture Attack on Concept Erasure
summary: Concept erasure aims to suppress undesirable knowledge in text-to-image generative models. However, existing robustness evaluations typically rely on relearning attacks tailored to specific model architectures. We study concept reactivation across two substantially different generative paradigms: noise-prediction U-Nets and flow-matching Transformers. We introduce \textbf{Concept Score Relearning (CSR)}, a unified parameter-level framework that reactivates erased concepts by optimizing each model within its native prediction space. CSR requires no external target-concept image dataset and applies the same concept-directed objective to both U-Net-based Stable Diffusion and Transformer-based FLUX. Experiments across diverse concepts and multiple erasure methods demonstrate consistent concept reactivation across both architectures, highlighting the cross-architecture applicability of CSR and the persistent recoverability of apparently erased concepts. For strict nudity, CSR reaches average ASRs of 50.47\% on FLUX and 40.29\% on Stable Diffusion, consistently ranking first across all evaluated safety settings.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的参数级概念重激活框架CSR，无需目标图像数据集，可在U-Net与Transformer两类生成范式上复现已擦除概念，揭示擦除的持久可恢复性。
AI.motivation: 现有概念擦除的鲁棒性评估多依赖针对特定模型架构定制的重学习攻击，缺乏跨架构的通用评估手段，难以判断擦除效果是否真正持久。
AI.method: 提出概念分数重学习（CSR）：在模型原生预测空间内进行参数级优化以重激活被擦除概念；无需外部目标概念图像数据集；对U-Net型Stable Diffusion与Transformer型FLUX施加同一概念导向目标。
AI.result: 在多种概念与多种擦除方法上，两类架构均出现一致的概念重激活；针对nudity，CSR在FLUX上平均ASR达50.47%，在Stable Diffusion上达40.29%，在所有评估的安全设置中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: CSR具备跨架构适用性，表明表面被擦除的概念仍可被持续恢复，提示现有概念擦除方法的鲁棒性评估需纳入统一、架构无关的参数级重学习基准。

title: From PDF to Evidence: Structure-Aware Retrieval for Clinical Practice Guidelines
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: Guideline documents are published as unstructured PDFs whose evidence is locked in visual structures---tables, flowcharts, and graded recommendations---that standard retrieval pipelines flatten into fixed-size text chunks. We cast evidence access as a document image analysis problem: parse each page image into typed structural elements, then retrieve structure-aware evidence units that follow the document's own layout (sections, table rows, flowchart paths, graded recommendations), each keeping its structural context so a result points to a specific element rather than a page. On 26 clinical practice guidelines from 9 sources (3,619 pages, Chinese and English) with 199 evidence queries, structure-aware units rank the gold element first under BM25, dense, and hybrid retrieval (hybrid Element Hit@1 of 0.382), with a significant element-level ranking gain over per-element OCR text (MRR_e +0.107, p=0.002; the Hit@5 gain is directional, p=0.17), while matching page-level recall (Page Hit@5 0.879 vs. 0.889, p=0.75) at 3.8x less context and clearly outperforming a ColPali visual-RAG baseline (PH@5 0.497).

AI.tldr: 该文将指南类PDF的证据获取重构为文档图像分析问题，先按版面解析为带类型的结构元素，再检索保留结构上下文的"结构感知证据单元"，在26部临床实践指南（3,619页、199条查询）上实现了元素级排序显著提升，同时以更少上下文匹配页面级召回。
AI.motivation: 指南文档以非结构化PDF发布，证据被"锁定"在表格、流程图、分级推荐等视觉结构中；而标准检索管线将其压平成固定长度文本块，破坏了版面与结构信息，导致检索结果只能指向整页而非具体证据元素，且上下文冗余。
AI.method: 将证据获取建模为文档图像分析任务：1）对每页页面图像进行解析，识别并分类为类型化结构元素（章节、表格行、流程图路径、分级推荐等）；2）以文档自身版面为单元边界，构建保留结构上下文的结构感知证据单元；3）在BM25、稠密检索与混合检索三种排序器下评估，并与逐元素OCR文本及ColPali视觉RAG基线对比。
AI.result: 在来自9个来源、26部中英文临床实践指南（3,619页、199条证据查询）上，结构感知单元在BM25、稠密与混合检索下均将金标准元素排在第1位，混合检索Element Hit@1为0.382；相较逐元素OCR文本，元素级排序显著提升（MRR_e +0.107，p=0.002；Hit@5增益为方向性，p=0.17）；页面级召回与基线相当（Page Hit@5 0.879 vs. 0.889，p=0.75），但上下文用量减少3.8倍；明显优于ColPali视觉RAG基线（PH@5 0.497）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的文档图像解析与结构感知检索可在不损失页面级召回的前提下，显著改善指南证据的元素级可定位性，并以更少上下文完成检索；该范式优于将版面压平为定长文本块的常规做法及视觉RAG基线，为指南类PDF的证据检索提供了有效路径。

title: A Visual Classification Dataset and Model Evaluation for Historical Manuscript Illustrations
summary: Historical manuscript illustrations preserve rich visual evidence of past cultures. They depict people, animals, plants, diagrams, music notations, and decorative forms. Although large digitization projects have made many manuscripts available online, the material itself remains difficult to explore at scale. Extraction systems can find illustrations on manuscript pages, but without meaningful categories, large collections remain hard to search and explore. We address this gap by introducing a manually labeled dataset of 15,000 illustrations from manuscripts dating back hundreds of years across 22 categories, and evaluating modern vision models for image classification on this task. The problem is challenging due to stylistic diversity, degradation, and semantic ambiguity, with many images that fit more than one category. We compare fine-tuned CNN and Transformer-based classifiers, zero-shot CLIP, embedding-based classifiers, and direct vision-language models. Results show that fine-tuned image classifiers perform best overall, with ConvNeXt reaching 88.9% accuracy and 81.3% macro-F1. Using CLIP embeddings with XGBoost provides a strong alternative. In contrast, zero-shot CLIP and direct vision-language classification perform substantially worse, highlighting the limits of general-purpose models in this domain. Beyond overall performance, the analysis reveals which categories are visually separable and where errors reflect genuine semantic overlap, suggesting that some limitations arise from the taxonomy itself.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了包含22类、1.5万幅历史手稿插图的人工标注数据集，并系统评测了CNN、Transformer、零样本CLIP、嵌入分类器及视觉语言模型等现代分类方法；结果显示微调图像分类器整体最优，ConvNeXt达88.9%准确率与81.3%宏F1，而零样本CLIP与直接使用视觉语言模型效果明显较差。
AI.motivation: 历史手稿插图蕴含丰富的文化视觉资料，大规模数字化虽已提供在线访问，但因缺乏有意义的类别标注，海量馆藏在检索与探索层面仍难以规模化利用；现有提取系统仅能定位插图，无法支撑有效分类，因而需要人工标注数据集并评估现代视觉模型在此任务上的表现。
AI.method: 构建了涵盖数百年历史手稿、22个类别、15,000幅插图的人工标注数据集；在该任务上比较微调CNN与Transformer分类器、零样本CLIP、基于嵌入的分类器以及直接视觉语言模型，并分析类别可分性与误差来源。
AI.result: 微调图像分类器整体表现最佳，ConvNeXt取得88.9%准确率、81.3%宏F1；使用CLIP嵌入配合XGBoost是强有力的替代方案；零样本CLIP与直接视觉语言模型分类表现显著较差。任务难点包括风格多样、图像退化与语义歧义，许多图像可归入多个类别。
AI.conclusion: 微调专用分类器在历史手稿插图分类中显著优于通用模型，体现出通用视觉语言模型在该领域的局限；分析还揭示了哪些类别在视觉上可分离、哪些错误源于真实语义重叠，说明部分性能上限来自分类体系本身。

title: Native Association: Confidence-Aware Human Perception in the Wild with a Foundation VLM
comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Human-Centered Multimodal Intelligence in the Wild (HCMIW). 16 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables; supplementary material included as ancillary file
summary: Extracting who is where, on which team, wearing which number from a broadcast frame is typically done by stitching a detector, an OCR engine, and classifiers together -- and the stitching step swaps identities under occlusion. We make association native instead: a 0.77B vision-language model (Florence-2) is fine-tuned to emit all per-person attributes as one grammar-constrained sequence, with each attribute generated inside its owner's block. Output is therefore schema-valid on every frame by construction, and no post-hoc binding step exists to attach a correctly read number to the wrong player: residual misassociation is pure perception error, $\approx4\times$ rarer than zero-shot-prompted frontier APIs' (0.057 vs. 0.21-0.24). On a frozen multi-sport test set, this single pass reaches 0.95 detection F1 (APIs: 0.65-0.75). A single extra forward pass yields a per-field confidence that supports a reject option (jersey precision $0.71\rightarrow0.96$ at half coverage) and routes a training-free zoom-and-re-read for small players. Surprisingly, once the grammar is learned, further parameter-efficient tuning yields no measurable gain under the adaptation configurations we test; the identical recipe on WIDER-Attribute reaches 93.1 mAP given-box, yields the first detection-coupled end-to-end results under its standard test protocol (84.5 mAP), and reproduces the same tuning result. In this regime, the gains live in the structure, not in added weights.

AI.tldr: 将检测、OCR与分类融合为单一视觉语言模型（Florence-2）的语法约束序列生成，实现身份-号码-队伍的原生关联，避免后处理错绑。
AI.motivation: 传统广播画面人物属性抽取依赖检测器、OCR与分类器拼接，拼接步骤在遮挡下会错误交换身份，导致号码与球员错配。
AI.method: 微调0.77B的Florence-2模型，将每个人的所有属性以单条语法约束序列输出，各属性生成于其所有者区块内；外加上一次前向传播得到逐字段置信度，支持拒识选项与免训练"缩放重读"小目标处理。
AI.result: 误关联率0.057，约为零样本提示前沿API（0.21–0.24）的1/4；冻结多运动测试集上单次推理检测F1达0.95（API为0.65–0.75）；拒识机制使球衣精确率由0.71提升至0.96（覆盖率减半）；WIDER-Attribute上给定框93.1 mAP，标准协议下84.5 mAP（首个检测耦合端到端结果）。
AI.conclusion: 语法结构学到后，进一步参数高效微调无可测收益；增益源于输出结构而非增加权重。

title: SphMind: Towards Robust, Training-Free VLM-based Spatial Reasoning with a 360 Camera
summary: Omnidirectional or 360 cameras provide embodied AI agents with a holistic, wide field-of-view (FoV) view of their surroundings, motivating the use of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for omnidirectional spatial reasoning. However, most MLLMs are trained on conventional 2D perspective images and struggle with the severe distortions and wrap-around discontinuities induced by spherical geometry. Enabling them to generalize to non-Euclidean 3D spaces without retraining therefore remains challenging. We propose SphMind, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that decouples semantic perception from geometric reasoning. Rather than requiring MLLMs to learn spherical geometry internally, SphMind preserves their semantic capabilities while handling geometry externally. We introduce a Spherical Harmonics-based Spatial Graph (SHSG) that models spatial relationships through equivariant transformations on the sphere, together with Inference-Time Geometric Grounding (IGG), a model-agnostic closed-loop optimization process that aligns MLLM representations with spherical geometric constraints during inference. Experiments on three benchmarks show that SphMind achieves over 21.4% average improvement in directional reasoning on MP3D and Stanford2D-3D, outperforms prompt-engineering baselines by 8.7% on the real-world ODI-Bench, and improves rotational invariance by 5.9% under panorama rotations, without additional training or dataset-specific tuning. In-the-wild evaluations further show that SphMind resolves directional reasoning queries that baseline vision-language models fail to answer correctly.

AI.tldr: SphMind：免训练即插即用框架，将语义感知与几何推理解耦，借助球谐空间图与推理时几何接地，使MLLM无需重训即可完成全向空间推理。
AI.motivation: 全向/360相机为具身智能体提供整体宽视场观测，催生用多模态大模型做全向空间推理的需求。但主流MLLM在常规2D透视图像上训练，难以应对球面几何造成的严重畸变与环绕不连续，在不重训的前提下泛化到非欧3D空间仍具挑战。
AI.method: 提出SphMind，训练免费、即插即用，将语义感知与几何推理解耦：保留MLLM语义能力，在外部处理几何。核心包括基于球谐的空间图SHSG（通过球面等变变换建模空间关系）与推理时几何接地IGG（模型无关的闭环优化，在推理阶段将MLLM表征与球面几何约束对齐）。
AI.result: 在三个基准上验证：MP3D与Stanford2D-3D方向推理平均提升超21.4%；在真实世界ODI-Bench上优于提示工程基线8.7%；全景旋转下旋转不变性提升5.9%；无需额外训练或数据集特定调优。真实场景评估中，SphMind能正确解答基线视觉语言模型失败的方向推理问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式外部几何建模与推理时对齐，SphMind在免训练条件下显著提升MLLM的全向空间与方向推理能力及旋转不变性，为全向具身空间推理提供即插即用方案。

title: Rethinking Token Reweighting for SFT: Suppress, Reverse, and Extrapolate Learned Features
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) learns most aggressively from tokens that the model deems least likely. This helps acquire new behaviors, but also amplifies noisy or conflicting supervision and can overwrite useful pretrained knowledge. Through a unified policy-loss view, we revisit existing token-reweighting methods and show that they assign nonnegative coefficients to demonstrated tokens. Consequently, they can suppress or amplify supervised updates, but cannot reverse harmful features once learned. Moreover, larger training weights do not amount to feature extrapolation, since they change the optimization trajectory rather than scale a fixed SFT direction. We argue that reversal and extrapolation require a stable reference frame defined by a fixed SFT delta. Motivated by this, we propose SCALE (Selective Control of Adaptation via Local Entropy), an entropy-guided adaptation-strength-control method that freezes the pretrained model and the SFT delta and learns bounded token- and module-specific gates by minimizing predictive entropy alone. These gates suppress, reverse, or extrapolate frozen SFT features according to their alignment with entropy reduction. Across Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Qwen2.5-Math-7B, and Qwen3-4B-Base, SCALE achieves mathematical-reasoning averages of 37.84, 43.60, and 36.57, exceeding the strongest corresponding baselines while remaining competitive on general-retention benchmarks. It also attains the best average code-generation performance across HumanEval, HumanEval+, and MBPP for all three models. These results suggest that effective SFT correction can benefit from controlling how already learned residuals are used, rather than only modifying how they are learned.

AI.tldr: 本文将现有token重加权方法统一为对示范token赋予非负系数的策略损失视角，指出其无法反转已学有害特征且大幅加权不等于特征外推；据此提出SCALE方法，冻结预训练模型与SFT增量，学习有界的token与模块级门控，仅通过最小化预测熵实现抑制、反转或外推冻结的SFT特征，在数学推理与代码生成任务上超越基线并保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: 监督微调（SFT）对模型最不确信的token学习最激进，这虽有助于获取新行为，但会放大噪声或冲突监督，并可能覆盖有用的预训练知识。现有token重加权方法均给示范token分配非负系数，只能抑制或放大监督更新，无法在学习后反转有害特征；且更大权重改变的是优化轨迹而非缩放固定SFT方向，因此无法实现特征外推。作者认为反转与外推需要一个由固定SFT增量定义的稳定参考系。
AI.method: 提出SCALE（Selective Control of Adaptation via Local Entropy），一种熵引导的自适应强度控制方法：冻结预训练模型和SFT增量，学习有界的token级与模块级门控参数，仅以最小化预测熵为目标进行优化。这些门控根据与熵降低的对齐程度，对冻结的SFT特征进行抑制、反转或外推。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B、Qwen2.5-Math-7B和Qwen3-4B-Base上，SCALE的数学推理平均分分别为37.84、43.60和36.57，超过对应的最强基线，同时在通用能力保持基准上保持竞争力。三个模型在HumanEval、HumanEval+和MBPP上的平均代码生成性能均达到最佳。
AI.conclusion: 有效的SFT修正可以从控制已学习残差的使用方式中获益，而不仅仅局限于修改其学习方式。

title: GSM: Efficient Language Modeling with Shared Global State
summary: Efficient language models must reduce not only the cost of individual accesses to past context but also the overhead of repeatedly selecting and processing historical information across layers. We introduce the Global State Model (GSM), a causal encoder--decoder architecture that concentrates the selection and aggregation of long-range information in the encoding stage. Through multiple stages of history retrieval, the encoder progressively incorporates long-range information into representations at recent positions, forming a shared state with a fixed window size. Each decoder layer accesses this same state using queries updated from the preceding layer, preserving computational depth while avoiding repeated construction of historical key--value (KV) representations and long-range indexing. As a result, neither the decoder's per-step attention cost nor its KV cache size grows with the history length. Experiments show that GSM improves computational efficiency and reduces cache overhead while maintaining model performance and the ability to use long-range information, offering a shared-state architecture for efficient language modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出全局状态模型（GSM），一种因果编码器—解码器架构，将长程信息的选择与聚合集中在编码阶段，形成固定窗口大小的共享状态，从而避免重复构建历史KV表示与长程索引，使解码器每步注意力开销和KV缓存不随历史长度增长。
AI.motivation: 高效语言模型不仅要降低单次访问历史上下文的成本，还要减少跨层反复选择与处理历史信息的开销。现有方法往往在每层重复构建历史KV表示与长程索引，导致计算与缓存随历史长度增长。
AI.method: GSM采用因果编码器—解码器架构：编码器通过多阶段历史检索，逐步将长程信息并入最近位置的表示，形成固定窗口大小的共享状态；每个解码器层使用由上一层更新的查询访问同一状态，从而保留计算深度，同时避免重复构建历史KV表示与长程索引。
AI.result: 实验表明，GSM在保持模型性能与长程信息利用能力的同时，提升了计算效率并降低了缓存开销；解码器每步注意力成本与KV缓存大小均不随历史长度增长。
AI.conclusion: GSM提供了一种共享状态架构，通过集中式历史选择与聚合实现高效语言建模，为长上下文场景下的效率与性能平衡提供了可行方案。

title: A Cheap Verifier is Good Enough: LLM Post-training is Robust to Erroneous Rewards
summary: When post-training large language models on tasks with semi-verifiable rewards, there are many factors (training steps, base model size, training order, data quality, verifier accuracy, etc.) that practitioners must contend with to maximize model performance. Yet, it remains unclear how well verifier agreement predicts post-training performance on such tasks. In this paper, we explore this question with over 11k H100 GPU-hours, across HealthBench and PRBench tasks in medical, legal, and finance domains. Across the tested domains, Qwen3 trainees (1.7B-8B on HealthBench; 8B on PRBench), evaluation splits, and frontier LLM reference judges (which we call golden verifiers), higher verifier agreement does not consistently identify the best training verifier. Expensive verifiers need not outperform inexpensive ones, and open-weight Gemma verifiers produce strong training outcomes. We compare two low-cost choices retrospectively -- a cost-reducing choice and a balanced choice -- with estimated grading cost reductions of 98.8%-99.7% relative to the golden grading protocols and average post-training score gaps of 1-3 points from the best evaluated training verifier. These averages include larger losses in individual settings; they do not establish that verifier choices are interchangeable.

AI.tldr: 本文通过超过1.1万H100 GPU小时的实验，在HealthBench和PRBench（医疗、法律、金融）任务上探究验证器一致性能否预测半可验证奖励任务的后训练性能，发现更高的一致性并不能稳定选出最优训练验证器，且低成本验证器可显著降低评分成本而性能损失有限。
AI.motivation: 在半可验证奖励的任务中，后训练性能受训练步数、基座模型规模、训练顺序、数据质量、验证器准确率等多因素影响。实践中常以验证器一致性作为选择依据，但其对后训练最终性能的预测能力尚不明确，作者希望厘清这一问题。
AI.method: 在医疗、法律、金融领域的HealthBench与PRBench任务上开展实验，累计超过1.1万H100 GPU小时；受训模型为Qwen3（HealthBench上1.7B-8B，PRBench上8B）；以评测划分与前沿LLM参考评判器（称为golden verifier）为基准，比较不同训练验证器的一致性与其带来后训练性能的关系，并回溯评估两种低成本验证器方案（降本方案与均衡方案）。
AI.result: 在所测领域、模型规模、评测划分与golden verifier下，更高的验证器一致性并不能一致地识别出最佳训练验证器；昂贵的验证器未必优于廉价验证器；开权重的Gemma验证器能取得良好的训练效果。两种低成本方案相比golden评分协议降低约98.8%-99.7%的评分成本，与最佳评测训练验证器的平均后训练分数差距为1-3分，但均值掩盖了个别设置下更大的损失。
AI.conclusion: 验证器一致性并非可靠的训练验证器选择指标；低成本验证器在显著降低成本的同时可保持有限的性能损失，但结果并不表明不同验证器选择可以互换。作者提醒从业者不能仅凭一致性或成本来选择验证器，需结合具体设置进行评估。

title: Physics-Guided Flow-Map Matching for Precipitation Nowcasting
summary: Precipitation nowcasting, generating future radar fields from past observations, is critical for flood warning and disaster response. It is also a demanding benchmark for spatiotemporal generative modeling, with chaotic dynamics, heavy-tailed intensities, and rare high-intensity structures that matter most. Deterministic models minimize a pixel loss and are driven toward the conditional mean, which blurs exactly those structures, while generative models that add a stochastic residual on top of a deterministic backbone inherit the same blur. We propose Physics-Guided Flow-Map Matching (PG-FMM), a conditional flow-map model that decouples predictable advection from uncertain small-scale detail. A frozen Lagrangian advection prior transports the radar field and supplies an explicit motion forecast, and a flow-map generative head, conditioned on the past frames and the prior rollout rather than summed onto it, produces sharp stochastic detail in four sampling steps. The prior serves only as guidance, so the head replaces blurred structure instead of inheriting it. Extensive experiments on four radar benchmarks show that PG-FMM outperforms state-of-the-art methods on 18 of 24 metrics, with the largest gains at heavy-rain thresholds, where the critical success index improves by up to 58.9%. The project page can be found at https://neurogica.github.io/PG-FMM.

AI.tldr: 提出物理引导的流映射匹配模型PG-FMM，将可预测平流与不确定小尺度细节解耦，用于降水临近预报。
AI.motivation: 降水临近预报对防洪和灾害响应至关重要，同时也是时空生成建模的严苛基准，具有混沌动力学、重尾强度和罕见高强度结构等特征。确定性模型最小化像素损失会被推向条件均值，从而模糊这些最关键的结构；而在确定性主干上叠加随机残差的生成模型也继承了同样的模糊问题。
AI.method: PG-FMM采用条件流映射模型，将可预测的平流与不确定的小尺度细节解耦。使用冻结的拉格朗日平流先验对雷达场进行传输并提供显式的运动预报；流映射生成头以过去帧和先验展开为条件（而非简单相加），在四步采样内生成清晰的随机细节。先验仅作为引导，使生成头替换模糊结构而非继承它。
AI.result: 在四个雷达基准上，PG-FMM在24项指标中的18项上优于现有最先进方法，在大雨阈值处提升最大，关键成功指数（CSI）最高提升58.9%。
AI.conclusion: PG-FMM通过解耦可预测平流与不确定细节，利用先验引导而非叠加的方式，有效解决了生成模型继承模糊结构的问题，在降水临近预报中显著提升了尤其是高强度降水结构的预报性能。

title: FORUM: Frozen Outputs Reconciled Using Model Agreement for Visual Grounding
summary: Frozen multimodal large language models (MLLMs) now solve standard referring expression comprehension with a single prompted call, yet on adversarial benchmarks with same-category distractors and negation, even the largest models are confidently wrong, and resampling repeats the error. Models built from different data and architectures rarely fall for the same confounder, so their agreement is a strong label-free signal of the correct target. We present FORUM, a training-free test-time fusion of frozen MLLMs guided by two fixed geometric rules: agreement-based selection keeps the region supported by the most distinct models, and medoid localization returns an actual member box instead of a coordinate average, so one loose prediction cannot shift the answer. Fusing three open MLLMs, FORUM surpasses the 397B-parameter published reference by a relative 5% in mean accuracy on the adversarial Ref-Adv-s benchmark, and a plain averaging ensemble by 15%. The gains transfer to standard RefCOCO+, and a balanced lineup with no dominant member still surpasses the 397B model by 5%.

AI.tldr: FORUM：一种免训练的测试时融合方法，用几何规则聚合多个冻结MLLM的预测，提升对抗性指称表达理解。
AI.motivation: 冻结MLLM在标准指称表达理解上已可通过单次提示调用解决，但在含同类干扰项与否定的对抗基准上，即便最大模型也会自信出错，且重采样仍重复错误。不同数据与架构训练的模型很少被同一混淆因素骗到，因此它们的共识可作为无标签的强正确性信号。
AI.method: 提出FORUM，一种免训练的测试时融合方法，融合多个冻结MLLM；采用两条固定几何规则：基于一致性的选择（保留被最多不同模型支持的区域）与medoid定位（返回真实的成员框而非坐标平均，避免单个松散预测偏移答案）。
AI.result: 融合三个开放MLLM后，在对抗基准Ref-Adv-s上平均准确率相对397B参数已发表参考模型提升5%，比简单平均集成高15%；增益可迁移到标准RefCOCO+；在无主导成员的均衡阵容下仍比397B模型高5%。
AI.conclusion: 免训练的多模型测试时融合可有效缓解对抗性指称表达理解中的干扰与否定问题，且无需主导模型即可取得稳定增益。

title: Is Word Error Rate Enough? Rethinking Privacy Evaluation in Speech with Entity-Aware Metrics
summary: As the use of smart devices continues to increase, their potential to capture sensitive speech content raises growing privacy concerns. It is therefore critical to develop techniques that prevent information leakage while preserving the utility of the audio, and evaluation metrics that accurately quantify the level of privacy without overestimating it. In this work, we evaluate the effectiveness of two obfuscation techniques in protecting speech content, with particular emphasis on named entities, by adapting entity-aware privacy metrics from the Natural Language Processing field to the speech privacy domain. Further, we investigate several attack scenarios and show that fine-tuning on entity-rich data improves attack performance for some entity categories but not others. Finally, we provide guidance on metric selection based on whether the obfuscation method preserves temporal alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文评估两种语音混淆技术对命名实体的保护效果，将NLP中的实体感知隐私指标迁移到语音隐私领域，并研究多种攻击场景与指标选择准则。
AI.motivation: 智能设备普及带来敏感语音内容泄露风险，亟需在保留音频可用性的前提下防止信息泄露，并需要能准确量化隐私水平、避免高估的评估指标。
AI.method: 将自然语言处理领域的实体感知隐私指标适配到语音隐私域，用以评估两种混淆技术对语音内容（尤以命名实体为重点）的保护效果；同时设计并考察多种攻击场景，并测试基于实体丰富数据微调对攻击性能的影响。
AI.result: 基于实体丰富数据的微调能提升部分命名实体类别的攻击性能，但对其他类别无效；混淆方法是否保持时间对齐，会影响指标选择的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 语音隐私评估应采用实体感知指标以更准确刻画隐私水平；指标选择需依据混淆方法是否保留时间对齐特性，并为攻击者能力差异提供针对性评估与防护依据。

title: DISCO: Distributed Long Context Scaling with Grounding-Reasoning Disaggregation
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) advertise million-token context windows, reasoning quality often collapses as inputs grow -- a phenomenon termed context rot. This failure stems from a structural entanglement in monolithic architectures, where the massive search burden of contextual grounding exhausts the representational capacity needed for complex reasoning. To resolve this, we propose Grounding-Reasoning Disaggregation via DIStributed long COntext scaling (DISCO). Inspired by distributed computing frameworks like Apache Spark, DISCO partitions long context across a fleet of Worker LLMs dedicated exclusively to parallel, localized grounding. A central Driver LLM, trained via Reinforcement Learning (GRPO) to optimize planning, orchestrates execution by dynamically mapping queries into atomic extraction tasks and reducing the gathered evidence to synthesize a final answer. By isolating reasoning from raw context noise, DISCO effectively eliminates context rot. On RULER-QA (1M tokens), it maintains 78.4% accuracy where standard baselines collapse. Furthermore, it outperforms full-context models by up to 9.8 points on LongBench v2 and matches frontier models like Gemini-3-Pro-Preview while reducing inference costs by over 80%, establishing a highly efficient paradigm for robust long-context inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DISCO，将长上下文推理拆分为并行的 Worker 接地与集中式 Driver 规划/归约，从而消除 context rot，在 1M token 任务上保持高准确率并大幅降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 尽管 LLM 宣称支持百万级 token 上下文窗口，但随着输入增长，推理质量往往急剧下降，即 context rot。作者认为其根源在于单体架构中的结构性纠缠：上下文接地所需的庞大搜索负担耗尽了复杂推理所需的表征容量。
AI.method: 提出 Grounding-Reasoning Disaggregation via DIStributed long COntext scaling (DISCO)。借鉴 Apache Spark 等分布式计算框架，将长上下文切分到一组 Worker LLM 上，专门并行执行局部化接地。中心 Driver LLM 通过强化学习（GRPO）训练以优化规划，将查询动态映射为原子抽取任务，并对汇集证据进行归约以合成最终答案。
AI.result: 在 RULER-QA（1M token）上保持 78.4% 准确率，而标准基线出现性能崩溃；在 LongBench v2 上比全上下文模型高至多 9.8 分；性能可比 Gemini-3-Pro-Preview 等前沿模型，同时推理成本降低超过 80%。
AI.conclusion: 通过推理与原始上下文噪声的解耦，DISCO 有效消除了 context rot，为鲁棒的长上下文推理建立了一种高效范式。

title: LLMs Trust Their Own: Identity-Dependent Conformity in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent settings, where agents observe and influence one another, making social influence a key dimension of AI behavior and safety. We investigate whether LLMs' responses depend on the social identity of other agents, beyond the effect of their consensus. We construct judgment tasks with a single correct answer, and place models in a multi-agent setting where they receive incorrect answers from other agents whose social identities (AI or human, model family, or an arbitrary minimal group) are either shared with or distinct from their own. Across 12 open-weights models and nine tasks, we find a bidirectional effect of group identity on conformity to incorrect answers: in-group consensus increases conformity (in-group favoritism), whereas out-group consensus decreases it (out-group divergence). Unlike humans, for whom one ally breaking the consensus sharply reduces conformity, models are unmoved by an ally from the majority's group. Worse, a correct ally from the opposing group intensifies this bidirectional effect. Chain-of-Thought reasoning suppresses most of these effects, yet an in-group ally still reduces conformity to an incorrect out-group majority. Labeling peers as safety-aligned shifts overall conformity but leaves in-group favoritism and out-group divergence intact. These results show that group identity shapes how LLMs aggregate information across agents, independently of its correctness, and identify a manipulation surface for multi-agent AI systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过多智能体判断任务（12个开源模型、9类任务）发现：LLM对错误答案的从众行为受其他智能体社会身份的双向影响——内群体共识提高从众（内群体偏私），外群体共识降低从众（外群体分化）；且与人类不同，模型不受"多数派阵营中的盟友"影响，而来自对立群体的正确盟友反而强化这种双向效应。
AI.motivation: LLM日益部署于多智能体环境，智能体之间相互观察与影响，社会影响成为AI行为与安全的关键维度。作者希望探究：在共识强度相同的情况下，LLM的反应是否仍取决于其他智能体的社会身份（AI/人类、模型家族、最小群体），即社会身份是否会独立于答案正确性而塑造模型的从众行为，并识别潜在的多智能体操纵面。
AI.method: 构建具有唯一正确答案的判断任务，将模型置于多智能体情境中，使其接收到来自其他智能体的错误答案，而这些智能体的社会身份（AI或人类、模型家族、任意最小群体）与模型自身或相同或相异。覆盖12个开源权重模型和9类任务，比较内群体与在外群体共识下的从众程度，并考察盟友（正确盟友/少数派盟友）位置、思维链（CoT）推理、以及将同伴标注为"安全对齐"等因素对效应的影响。
AI.result: 发现群体身份对错误答案从众具有双向效应：内群体共识增加从众（内群体偏私），外群体共识减少从众（外群体分化）。与人类不同（人类中一个盟友打破共识即可显著降低从众），模型对来自多数派阵营的盟友无动于衷；更甚者，来自对立群体的正确盟友会强化这种双向效应。思维链推理可抑制上述大部分效应，但内群体盟友仍会降低模型对错误外群体多数派的从众。将同伴标注为"安全对齐"会改变整体从众水平，但内群体偏私与外群体分化依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，群体身份独立于答案正确性，塑造了LLM在多智能体间聚合信息的方式，揭示了多智能体AI系统的一个操纵面（manipulation surface）：通过操纵智能体的社会身份标签即可影响其判断与从众行为，这对多智能体AI安全具有重要启示。

title: Chameleon: Dynamic Format Adapter for Efficient Diffusion
comment: Under Review at International Conference on Learning Representations 2027
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is the standard way to run modern diffusion models on memory-constrained accelerators, yet every existing diffusion PTQ scheme fixes the $\mathit{number\ format}$ in advance and only tunes the scale, zero point, or per-layer bit-width. At a fixed bit-width the best format depends on the distribution being encoded, and that distribution differs across weight channels, across layers, and along the diffusion timestep, where activation distributions slide from heavy-tailed and noise-dominated to tightly clustered and structured. We propose Chameleon, a PTQ framework that holds the bit-width fixed and treats the format itself as a discrete variable, chosen per weight channel and per (layer, timestep bucket) activation tensor. Activation formats come from {INT8, FP8 E4M3, FP8 E5M2, MXFP8, MXINT8}, selected ahead of time from two cheap statistics (empirical kurtosis and the closed-form diffusion SNR) and stored in a lookup table; weight formats come from {INT8, MXINT8} at 8 bits or {INT4, NF4, FP4 E2M1, MXINT4, MXFP4} at 4 bits, selected offline by reconstruction error. An architectural fork adapts the same selection layer to multi-step UNets, single-step distilled models, and Diffusion Transformers. Across SDXL, SDXL-Turbo, and PixArt-$α$ on COCO-2014, Chameleon achieves the best FID in all six backbone $\times$ bit-width settings, with CLIP within 0.24 of the FP16 reference and the best of all quantized methods at $W_{4}A_{8}$.

AI.tldr: Chameleon 提出一种保持比特宽度固定、将数值格式本身作为离散变量进行搜索的后训练量化框架，针对扩散模型的权重通道和（层, 时间步桶）激活张量分别选择最优格式，在 SDXL、SDXL-Turbo、PixArt-α 上取得最优 FID。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型 PTQ 方案预先固定数值格式，仅调整 scale、零点或逐层比特宽度。但在固定比特宽度下，最优格式取决于被编码的分布，而该分布在权重通道间、层间以及扩散时间步上均不同：激活分布会从重尾、噪声主导逐渐滑向紧密聚集且结构化的形态。
AI.method: 将比特宽度固定，把格式本身视为离散变量，逐权重通道和逐（层, 时间步桶）激活张量进行选择。激活格式集合为 {INT8, FP8 E4M3, FP8 E5M2, MXFP8, MXINT8}，通过两个廉价统计量（经验峰度与扩散 SNR 闭式解）预先选取并存入查找表；权重格式在 8 比特下取自 {INT8, MXINT8}，在 4 比特下取自 {INT4, NF4, FP4 E2M1, MXINT4, MXFP4}，离线按重建误差选择。另设架构分叉，使同一格式选择层适配多步 UNet、单步蒸馏模型与 Diffusion Transformer。
AI.result: 在 COCO-2014 上的 SDXL、SDXL-Turbo 与 PixArt-α 实验中，Chameleon 在全部六种 backbone × 比特宽度组合下取得最优 FID；CLIP 分数与 FP16 参考差距在 0.24 以内；在 W4A8 设置下为所有量化方法中最优。
AI.conclusion: 格式选择可作为与比特宽度解耦的独立量化维度，基于分布统计的自适应格式分配能显著提升扩散模型 PTQ 性能，并具备跨架构的通用性。

title: Printability-Constrained Adversarial Decals for Near-Nadir Aerial Perception: Measured Ink Gamuts, Nested Realism Constraints, and a Physical-World Bound
summary: Adversarial patches for aerial perception are typically evaluated as digital composites, with printing left as an implementation detail. This study imposes three physical constraints during optimization rather than after it: the color range a particular printer can reproduce, the size of the flat panel a vehicle offers, and the loss of fine detail incurred when the patch is imaged from altitude. The principal comparison isolates the ink set. Two patches share all seventeen recorded optimization settings and differ only in the colors available to them. One is constrained to a uniform color cube; the other to a gamut measured by printing and scanning a 216-patch chart. Each was optimized at three seeds and evaluated against thirteen victim conditions, with every rate reported against a size-matched optimized control. The effect of the measured gamut is victim-dependent rather than uniform. Net attack success rises on three of six closed-set segmentation victims, and for these the seed ranges of the two ink sets are disjoint: $+0.120$ on DeepLabv3-R101 and $+0.041$ on SegFormer-B0. The color-cube patch is consistently stronger on the open-vocabulary segmenter and on two of four detectors, though no detector exceeds a net of $+0.026$ under either ink set. The natural explanation is that a printable palette is simply less chromatic and lower in frequency than a digital one. Eleven further patches test this account and it does not hold. Once cardinality is matched, a palette as chromatic as the cube attacks equally well. Cardinality itself shows no trend from three inks to thirty-two. Palettes matched on cardinality, lightness and chroma, and differing only in hue placement, span $0.035$ to $0.136$. A physical evaluation with printed decals did not detect transfer; it bounds the transferred rate at $0.133$, which does not exclude the simulated value of $0.121$.

AI.tldr: 该研究在优化阶段（而非事后）引入三种物理约束——打印机色彩再现范围、车辆可用平板尺寸与高空成像的细节损失，通过控制唯一变量（墨色集合）比较均匀色立方与实测打印扫描216色图表色域两种对抗补丁，发现实测色域的效果依受害者模型而定，且常见的"可打印调色板色度/频率更低故更弱"解释不成立。
AI.motivation: 航空感知对抗补丁通常以数字合成方式评估，打印仅被视为实现细节，导致评估脱离真实物理部署条件。作者希望在优化过程中直接施加物理约束，并厘清究竟是哪种物理因素（色域、色度、频率、调色板基数、色相分布）真正决定攻击效果。
AI.method: 在优化阶段施加三个物理约束：特定打印机可再现的色彩范围、车辆可提供的平板尺寸、以及从高空成像时的细节损失。核心对比隔离墨色集合：两个补丁共享全部十七项记录在案的优化设置，仅可用颜色不同——一个受限于均匀色立方，另一个受限于通过打印并扫描216色图表实测得到的色域。各在三个随机种子下优化，针对十三种受害者条件评估，所有成功率均以尺寸匹配的优化对照为基准上报。另用十一个补充补丁检验关于色度、频率、基数与色相的解释。
AI.result: 实测色域的效果依受害者而异，并非一致。在六个闭集分割受害者中，有三个攻击成功率净增，且对这三人两套墨色的种子范围互不重叠：DeepLabv3-R101上+0.120，SegFormer-B0上+0.041。色立方补丁在开放词汇分割器及四个检测器中的两个上始终更强，但任何检测器在两种墨色下净增益均不超过+0.026。"可打印调色板色度与频率更低"的直觉解释经十一个补充补丁检验不成立：基数匹配后，与色立方同等色度的调色板攻击效果相当；基数从三色到三十二色无趋势；在基数、明度、色度匹配而仅色相位置不同的调色板间，成功率跨度达0.035至0.136。使用实体贴花的物理评估未检测到迁移，但将迁移率上界限定为0.133，无法排除模拟值0.121。
AI.conclusion: 物理约束下对抗补丁的效果高度依赖受害者模型，且不能用简单的色度或频率差异来解释；墨色基数与色相分布等因素均无单调趋势。物理贴花实验因样本量有限未能证伪模拟结果（上界0.133未排除0.121），说明模拟评估仍有一定可信度，但需更大规模的物理验证。

title: SceneScaffold: Active Scene-State Construction for Unified 3D Scene Understanding
summary: Recent 3D large multimodal models (3D-LMMs) rely on a visual bottleneck to compress complex 3D scene evidence into a limited number of visual tokens compatible with large language models (LLMs). Current visual bottlenecks, however, often passively compress heterogeneous 3D evidence into a homogeneous object-centric token sequence, leaving the spatial organization of the scene under-represented. This under-representation forces the LLM to recover spatial relations from a flattened token sequence, leading to unstable reasoning in relation-intensive and spatially ambiguous scenes. To address this issue, we propose SceneScaffold, an active scene-state construction framework for unified 3D scene understanding. SceneScaffold reformulates the visual bottleneck from a passive feature compressor into an active scene organizer, constructing a role-aware spatial scaffold before language reasoning. Specifically, SceneScaffold organizes superpoint-level visual evidence into scene-state components with distinct structural roles: entity states preserve core object semantics, scene-frame states maintain spatial references via boundary and region anchors, relation states encode object-environment interaction cues, and a global summary provides compact context. Through this role-aware construction, SceneScaffold provides the LLM with a spatially organized scene representation before language reasoning. Experiments on unified 3D scene understanding tasks, including 3D visual grounding, question answering, and dense captioning, demonstrate the effectiveness of SceneScaffold, while diagnostic results further show its applicability to relation-intensive and spatially ambiguous cases. Code is available at https://github.com/lixiangqi707/SceneScaffold.

AI.tldr: 提出 SceneScaffold，将 3D-LMM 的视觉瓶颈由被动特征压缩器改造为主动场景组织器，在语言推理前构建角色感知的空间脚手架，提升统一 3D 场景理解性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 大型多模态模型依赖视觉瓶颈将复杂 3D 场景证据压缩为有限视觉 token。但当前瓶颈多为被动压缩，把异构 3D 证据压成同质的物体中心 token 序列，导致场景空间组织表达不足；LLM 需从扁平化序列中恢复空间关系，在关系密集和空间歧义场景中推理不稳定。
AI.method: SceneScaffold 是一个主动场景状态构建框架，将视觉瓶颈重构为主动场景组织器，在语言推理前构建角色感知的空间脚手架。它把超点级视觉证据组织为具有不同结构角色的场景状态组件：实体状态保留核心物体语义，场景框架状态通过边界和区域锚点维持空间参照，关系状态编码物体—环境交互线索，全局摘要提供紧凑上下文，从而向 LLM 提供空间组织化的场景表示。
AI.result: 在 3D 视觉定位、问答和密集描述等统一 3D 场景理解任务上的实验验证了 SceneScaffold 的有效性；诊断结果进一步表明其在关系密集和空间歧义情形下具有适用性。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: SceneScaffold 通过将视觉瓶颈从被动压缩转变为主动的场景状态组织，弥补了空间组织表达不足的问题，为统一 3D 场景理解提供了更稳定、更有效的场景表示，尤其在关系密集与空间歧义场景中表现良好。

title: Anatomy-Structured Hierarchical MIL for Weakly-Supervised Thoracic Disease Detection in Chest X-rays
summary: Weakly-supervised thoracic disease detection in chest X-rays (CXR) is challenging due to subtle appearances and complex anatomical overlap, motivating anatomy-aware modeling for improved localization. However, prior anatomy-aware methods typically rely on coarse region proxies or static spatial priors, which may restrict dynamic instance discovery and limit precise localization of small abnormalities. We propose Anatomy-Structured Hierarchical Multiple Instance Learning (ASH-MIL), a framework that introduces parallel anatomy-structured observation branches (cardiac, pulmonary, and agnostic) combined with hierarchical MIL aggregation. Anatomical priors are injected as soft spatial biases into decoder cross-attention, enabling anatomically grounded evidence maps without disease bounding-box supervision. Instance localization is derived directly from MIL-weighted cross-attention maps without bounding box supervision. Experiments on CXR8 and cross-domain MIMIC-CXR held-out sets demonstrate consistent improvements over prior weakly-supervised and anatomy-aware approaches, particularly under stricter localization criteria. Our code is available at https://github.com/jn-kim/ash-mil.

AI.tldr: 提出 ASH-MIL 框架，通过解剖结构化的并行观测分支与分层 MIL 聚合，并结合软空间先验注入解码器交叉注意力，在无框监督下实现胸部 X 光的多疾病弱监督检测与精确定位，在 CXR8 与 MIMIC-CXR 上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 胸部 X 光中弱监督胸部疾病检测因病变表现细微且解剖结构重叠而困难，需要解剖感知建模以改善定位。但既有解剖感知方法多依赖粗粒度的区域代理或静态空间先验，可能限制动态实例发现，并削弱对小结节的精确定位能力。
AI.method: 提出 Anatomy-Structured Hierarchical Multiple Instance Learning（ASH-MIL）：引入解剖结构化的并行观测分支（心脏、肺、解剖无关），结合分层 MIL 聚合；将解剖先验以软空间偏置形式注入解码器交叉注意力，从而在无需疾病边界框监督下获得解剖接地的证据图；实例定位直接由 MIL 加权的交叉注意力图导出，无需边界框监督。
AI.result: 在 CXR8 与跨域 MIMIC-CXR 留出集上的实验显示，相较此前的弱监督与解剖感知方法取得一致提升，在更严格的定位评价标准下提升尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: ASH-MIL 以软空间先验与分层 MIL 结合的方式实现解剖感知的弱监督检测与无框定位，验证了解剖结构化分支对动态实例发现与精细定位的有效性；代码已开源于 https://github.com/jn-kim/ash-mil。

title: AI-Driven Collaborative Assembly Line Inspection: System Integration and Deployment Challenges
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 22nd International Conference on Mobile Web and Intelligent Information Systems (MobiWIS 2026)
summary: Manual visual inspection on assembly lines is a persistent manufacturing bottleneck: operator fatigue over extended shifts lowers defect-detection rates. This paper presents the design, integration, and field deployment of an AI-assisted collaborative inspection cell at the Silverline kitchen-appliance factory, developed within the AI-PRISM project. The cell couples a Universal Robots UR 10e cobot carrying a machine-vision defect-detection pipeline with a Comau Racer-5 cobot for functional tests, coordinated through ROS 2 Humble on an Ubuntu 22.04 LTS server. Multi-modal data (Basler camera imagery, TIA microphone acoustics, and SPS electrical-safety measurements) are logged locally and visualised in real time with Grafana. We report the practical deployment challenges (close-proximity safety, AI robustness under glare and reflections, ROS 2 namespace collisions across two cobots, and operating-system and dependency issues) together with the engineering solutions adopted, and structure the integration through a four-level Human-Robot Interaction analysis. The deployed cell cuts per-unit quality-check time from 82 s to 61 s (about 25%), raises final-control resource efficiency from 0.75 to 0.88, reduces operator visual-inspection viewing time by 82%, and significantly lowers operator mental demand (p = 0.005, NASA-TLX).

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了在AI-PRISM项目框架下，于Silverline厨房电器工厂设计、集成并实地部署的一个AI辅助协作检测单元。该单元由搭载机器视觉缺陷检测流水线的UR 10e协作机器人与负责功能测试的Comau Racer-5协作机器人组成，通过ROS 2 Humble协调控制。部署后单件质检时间由82秒降至61秒（约25%），最终检测资源效率由0.75提升至0.88，操作员目视检测时长减少82%，NASA-TLX心理负荷显著下降（p = 0.005）。
AI.motivation: 装配线上的人工目视检测是长期存在的制造瓶颈：操作员在长时间轮班中疲劳累积，导致缺陷检出率下降。
AI.method: 构建AI辅助协作检测单元：UR 10e协作机器人搭载机器视觉缺陷检测流水线，Comau Racer-5协作机器人执行功能测试，二者通过运行于Ubuntu 22.04 LTS服务器的ROS 2 Humble进行协调；多模态数据（Basler相机图像、TIA麦克风声学、SPS电气安全测量）本地记录并经Grafana实时可视化；采用四级人机交互分析框架组织系统集成。
AI.result: 报告了实际部署中的挑战（近距离安全、眩光与反射下AI鲁棒性、双协作机器人ROS 2命名空间冲突、操作系统与依赖问题）及相应工程解决方案；单件质检时间由82秒降至61秒（约25%），最终检测资源效率由0.75升至0.88，操作员目视检测时长减少82%，NASA-TLX心理负荷显著降低（p = 0.005）。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助协作检测单元在真实工厂环境中可行且有效，能显著缩短质检时间、提升资源效率并降低操作员视觉负荷与心理负荷，为装配线质检瓶颈提供了可落地的工程方案。

title: In-Token Learning for High-Fidelity Image Restoration via Diffusion Transformers
comment: Technical report, 25 pages, 12 figures. Preserves the earlier broader study underlying Fill2SR (ECCV 2026), including automatic colorization; Fill2SR subsequently developed the real-world super-resolution direction
summary: We present In-Token Learning, an image restoration framework that adapts a pretrained diffusion transformer using conditional rectified flow matching. Clean targets paired with degraded inputs supervise transport from Gaussian noise to restored images. Spatially aligned degraded-image tokens are fused with evolving latent tokens along the channel dimension, preserving the image-token count at a given resolution. Direct Low-Quality Guidance (DLG) combines frozen degraded-image embeddings with a fixed task prompt through the native conditioning pathway, without a trainable ControlNet-style branch or image captioning. We evaluate super-resolution and denoising on DIV2K, LSDIR, FFHQ, RealLQ250, and RealPhoto60, and automatic colorization on DIV2K and LSDIR. The tasks use separately trained checkpoints under the same framework. Results show competitive fidelity and perceptual quality under the evaluated protocols, with weaker generalization on RealLQ250. We report full-image QHD ($2560{\times}1440$) inference and a tiled $12$K restoration demonstration of Along the River During the Qingming Festival. Attention cost still increases with resolution. This technical report preserves the early broader study underlying Fill2SR, which subsequently developed the real-world super-resolution direction.

AI.tldr: 提出 In-Token Learning 图像修复框架，基于条件整流流匹配适配预训练扩散 Transformer，通过空间对齐退化 token 融合与 Direct Low-Quality Guidance 实现超分、去噪与上色，结果具竞争力但泛化性在真实场景偏弱。
AI.motivation: 避免引入可训练的 ControlNet 式分支或图像描述生成流程，直接在预训练扩散 Transformer 的通道维度上融合退化图像 token，并复用原生条件通路注入低质引导，从而以更简洁的方式适配预训练模型完成多种图像修复任务。
AI.method: 采用条件整流流匹配，以干净目标与退化输入配对监督从高斯噪声到修复图像的传输；将空间对齐的退化图像 token 与演化中的隐变量 token 沿通道维度融合，保持给定分辨率下的图像 token 数量不变；Direct Low-Quality Guidance 通过原生条件通路将冻结的退化图像嵌入与固定任务提示结合，无需可训练的 ControlNet 式分支或图像描述。
AI.result: 在 DIV2K、LSDIR、FFHQ、RealLQ250、RealPhoto60 上评估超分与去噪，在 DIV2K、LSDIR 上评估自动上色，各任务在统一框架下使用分别训练的检查点；在评估协议下保真度与感知质量具竞争力，但在 RealLQ250 上泛化较弱；报告了全图 QHD（2560×1440）推理及《清明上河图》的分块 12K 修复演示；注意力开销仍随分辨率增长。
AI.conclusion: 该技术报告保留了 Fill2SR 背后早期的更广泛研究，后者随后发展出真实世界超分方向；In-Token Learning 在统一框架下以精简的条件注入方式取得有竞争力的修复效果，但真实场景泛化与高分辨率下的注意力开销仍是待改进之处。

title: E-CONAN (Entailment, CONtradition And Neutral) Diagnostics Dataset Investigating Linguistic Phenomena in Arabic Natural Language Understanding
summary: Natural Language Understanding (NLU) plays a crucial role in various applications, yet its performance suffers from weaknesses in handling the complexities of human languages, ranging from lexical ambiguity to high-level reasoning difficulties. Analyzing errors across diverse linguistic phenomena is crucial for NLU improvement, as it will help humans get insights to comprehensively assess models' limitations and capabilities, so optimizing models' generalization. Notably, several benchmarks contain diagnostics datasets designed for investigation and fine-grained error analysis. When highlighting the gaps in the state-of-the-art, we noted that there is no naming convention for macro and micro categories or even a standard set of linguistic phenomena that should be covered. To overcome this gap, we propose an initial hierarchy for Cross-Lingual NLU error analysis. Moreover, we propose a methodology to create an NLI hierarchical framework and applied a case study on Arabic NLU. Moreover, this paper introduces E-CONAN diagnostics dataset, a freely available dataset manually-annotated with coarse-grained and fine-grained categories based on our proposed Arabic hierarchy. E-CONAN dataset helps NLU designers better understand their models by doing error analysis and in-depth investigation. We used E-CONAN to investigate the performance of 9 pretrained language models and 5 LLMs. Results indicate that LLMs outperform pretrained models in world knowledge and commonsense reasoning macro-category, and underperform pretrained models in syntactic macro-category. Moreover, the hardest phenomena for all models is Reasoning, and the easiest phenomena for all pretrained models is Syntactic, and the easiest for LLMs is Lexico-Syntactic.

AI.tldr: 本文针对跨语言自然语言理解（NLU）错误分析缺乏统一分类体系的问题，提出跨语言NLU错误分析的初始层级结构及构建NLI分层框架的方法，并以阿拉伯语为案例构建了人工标注的E-CONAN诊断数据集，用于评估9个预训练模型与5个LLM的性能。
AI.motivation: NLU在多项应用中至关重要，但因词汇歧义、高层推理困难等语言复杂性而表现受限。跨语言现象的错误分析有助于理解模型局限、优化泛化能力。然而现有诊断基准缺乏宏/微观类别的命名规范，也没有标准化的语言现象覆盖集合，存在明显空白。
AI.method: 提出跨语言NLU错误分析的初始层级结构；提出构建NLI分层框架的方法论，并在阿拉伯语NLU上开展案例研究；构建E-CONAN诊断数据集，基于所提阿拉伯语层级进行粗粒度与细粒度人工标注。
AI.result: 利用E-CONAN评估9个预训练语言模型与5个LLM。结果显示：LLM在世界知识与常识推理宏类别上优于预训练模型，在句法宏类别上弱于预训练模型；对所有模型最难的现象是推理（Reasoning），对预训练模型最简单的是句法（Syntactic），对LLM最简单的是词汇-句法（Lexico-Syntactic）。
AI.conclusion: E-CONAN作为一个免费可用的诊断数据集，可帮助NLU设计者通过错误分析与深入调查更好地理解模型；所提层级结构与方法论填补了跨语言NLU错误分析在类别命名与现象覆盖标准上的空白。

title: ManiEdit: Sequential Unstructured Knowledge Editing for Language Models from a Manifold Perspective
summary: Large language models (LLMs) inevitably generate some incorrect or outdated content, necessitating efficient and precise mechanisms for continual knowledge updates. However, existing model editing methods struggle to sequentially edit unstructured long-form knowledge, suffering from severe edit forgetting and degradation of general capabilities. To address these challenges, we reframe knowledge editing from a manifold perspective, viewing it as a localized displacement of an edit sub-manifold within the global knowledge manifold. Under this formulation, the problem can be decomposed into two key questions: (i) how to identify representative edit points that effectively anchor the edit sub-manifold, and (ii) how to preserve the remaining manifold structure during the sub-manifold displacement process. Based on this perspective, we propose ManiEdit, a novel manifold-aware autoregressive editing framework consisting of two core components. Pivot Localization addresses the mediocre-point dilemma by identifying high-leverage pivots to anchor the edit sub-manifold. Manifold-Aware Preservation preserves different knowledge types through an energy-weighted penalty combined with recursive null-space alignment. Experiments on two base LLMs and four unstructured editing benchmarks demonstrate that ManiEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to +27.81 BERTScore and +8.50 ROUGE-L, while maintaining near-original general capabilities across six representative downstream tasks. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Areyliu/ManiEdit

AI.tldr: 本文将知识编辑重构为全局知识流形中编辑子流形的局部位移问题，提出流形感知自回归编辑框架ManiEdit，在多个基座模型与基准上取得SOTA，并保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型不可避免地产生错误或过时内容，需要高效精确的持续知识更新机制。然而现有模型编辑方法难以对非结构化长文本知识进行序贯编辑，存在严重的编辑遗忘与通用能力退化问题。
AI.method: 从流形视角重构知识编辑，将其视为全局知识流形内编辑子流形的局部位移，并分解为两个问题：(i) 如何识别能有效锚定编辑子流形的代表性编辑点；(ii) 如何在子流形位移过程中保持其余流形结构。据此提出ManiEdit框架，含两个核心组件：Pivot Localization通过识别高杠杆枢轴点锚定编辑子流形，缓解平庸点困境；Manifold-Aware Preservation通过能量加权惩罚结合递归零空间对齐，针对不同知识类型进行保护。
AI.result: 在两个基座LLM和四个非结构化编辑基准上，ManiEdit达到SOTA，相比最强基线最高提升+27.81 BERTScore与+8.50 ROUGE-L，同时在六个代表性下游任务上保持接近原始的通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，流形视角下的局部位移建模能有效缓解长文本序贯编辑中的遗忘与能力退化问题，兼顾编辑效果与通用能力保持；代码已开源。

title: Jev Matches 7B Language Models for Speech-Neuroprosthesis Rescoring
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/gabrycina/how-much-language-model
summary: A speech neuroprosthesis decodes attempted speech from brain activity and ends by rescoring the decoder's candidate sentences with a language model of several billion parameters, the only component that needs a GPU. Replacing that model with a cheaper one is hard: general language models asked to pick one sentence from a list answer from where a label sits in the list rather than from the sentence itself. We pose rescoring as a single typed decision, one call that returns a probability for every candidate, served by Jev, a hosted model trained for calibrated decisions, and combine it with the decoder's own score. On 978 held-out sentences from a participant with ALS, where the published decoder alone reaches 8.1% word error, Jev reaches 7.5% against 7.8% for both OPT-6.7b and Qwen2.5-7B; with the decoder's weight re-tuned, 6.9% against 7.2% and 7.4%. Jev is ahead in all four comparisons and at most 0.2 points behind at the 95% bound. It costs 0.07 USD per thousand sentences and needs no GPU; a dedicated GPU running a 7B model is cheaper per sentence only above 43% utilisation, far beyond what one user generates. End-to-end latency over the internet is 262 ms, of which 62 ms is spent at the provider, the same order as a 7B model on a local GPU (27 ms) but not faster.

AI.tldr: 将语音神经假体的句子重打分建模为单次类型化决策调用，用一个托管模型 Jev 替代数十亿参数语言模型，在 ALS 被试的 978 句留出集上取得更低词错误率，且无需 GPU、成本更低。
AI.motivation: 语音神经假体解码尝试性语音时，需用数十亿参数语言模型对候选句重打分，这是唯一需要 GPU 的组件，成本高。直接换用更便宜的小模型很困难：通用语言模型被要求从列表中选句时，倾向于依据标签在列表中的位置作答，而非依据句子本身内容，导致评分不可靠。
AI.method: 将重打分形式化为单次类型化决策：一次调用为每个候选句返回概率，由托管模型 Jev 提供服务，该模型经训练可给出校准的决策概率，再与解码器自身得分结合。在 ALS 被试的 978 句留出集上，与 OPT-6.7b、Qwen2.5-7B 在原始及重调解码器权重两种设置下进行对比。
AI.result: 原始解码器权重下，已发表解码器单独为 8.1% 词错误率，Jev 达 7.5%，而 OPT-6.7b 与 Qwen2.5-7B 均为 7.8%；重调解码器权重后，Jev 为 6.9%，对比 7.2% 与 7.4%。Jev 在全部四项对比中领先，95% 置信界下最多落后 0.2 个百分点。成本为每千句 0.07 美元且无需 GPU；专用 GPU 运行 7B 模型仅在利用率高于 43% 时每句更便宜，远超单用户生成量。端到端互联网延迟 262 ms，其中服务商处 62 ms，与本地 GPU 上 7B 模型的 27 ms 同量级但并非更快。
AI.conclusion: 以单次类型化决策调用实现校准重打分的托管模型 Jev，可在无需 GPU 的条件下以更低成本达到甚至优于 7B 级语言模型的重打分效果，适合单用户低吞吐的语音神经假体场景。

title: PGL-3D: Towards Progressive Geometric Learning for 3D Visual Query Localization
comment: Code and models will be released
summary: 3D Visual Query Localization (3DVQL) retrieves the latest contiguous occurrence of a queried object in an RGB--point-cloud sequence and predicts a 9-DoF cuboid for every response frame. The query is captured independently of the search sequence, so its annotated pose may differ from how the object appears in the search frames. The benchmark baseline predicts cuboids after feature modeling, leaving their geometry unused for subsequent feature refinement. We investigate whether complete intermediate cuboids can improve query and proposal representations before final decoding. We introduce Progressive Geometric Learning for 3DVQL (PGL-3D), a predict--select--refine--re-predict framework that uses intermediate cuboids to guide the aggregation of search evidence and update query and proposal representations. A shared head first predicts a complete cuboid for every proposal. Query--Tube--Memory (QTM) then selects reference observations by combining proposal association, cuboid quality, frame response, and target absence, since association confidence alone establishes neither target presence nor geometric accuracy. The center, size, and orientation of each selected cuboid define soft pooling weights over query-conditioned proposal features. The pooled memory updates the query and proposal representations, and the head re-predicts from the updated features. A training-only objective, ST-D9O, supervises cuboid geometry at every stage by adding boundary, signed-distance, and soft-overlap terms to parameter regression. PGL-3D achieves a mean stAP of $0.270 \pm 0.004$ on 3DVQL, compared with $0.044$ reported for LaF. Ablations support the benefits of geometry-guided feature updates, while stage-wise analyses show improved cuboid accuracy. Replacing the geometry objective in our PROT3D reproduction with ST-D9O improves mAO on GSOT3D from $21.63\%$ to $25.78\%$. Our code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出PGL-3D框架，利用中间3D立方体几何信息引导查询与候选表示更新，在3DVQL上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有3DVQL基线在特征建模后才预测立方体，中间立方体几何未参与后续特征精炼；且查询与搜索序列独立采集，标注姿态与搜索帧中物体外观可能不一致，关联置信度本身无法同时确立目标存在性与几何精度。
AI.method: 提出PGL-3D，即预测—选择—精炼—重预测框架：共享头为每个候选预测完整立方体；Query–Tube–Memory (QTM) 结合候选关联、立方体质量、帧响应与目标缺失选择参考观测；用选中立方体的中心、尺寸与朝向定义对查询条件候选特征的软池化权重，池化记忆更新查询与候选表示后重预测；训练期目标ST-D9O在参数回归上加入边界、符号距离与软重叠项，对各阶段立方体几何进行监督。
AI.result: 在3DVQL上平均stAP达0.270±0.004，基线LaF为0.044；消融验证几何引导特征更新有益，阶段分析显示立方体精度提升；将PROT3D复现中的几何目标替换为ST-D9O后，GSOT3D的mAO由21.63%提升至25.78%。
AI.conclusion: 完整中间立方体可有效提升查询与候选表示，几何引导的特征更新与阶段化几何监督显著改善3DVQL定位性能，方法具可迁移性。

title: ForeFly: A Dual-Horizon World Action Model for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Aerial Vision-Language Navigation (AVLN) requires UAVs to maintain reliable instruction following over long trajectories in complex 3D environments. However, existing AVLN approaches are predominantly reactive or limited to single-horizon prediction, overlooking complementary future cues across different temporal horizons. To address this limitation, we propose ForeFly, a dual-horizon latent world action model that predicts both a proximal future for local continuity and an adaptive route-critical future for long-range guidance. Horizon-specific foresight queries are primed with recent and route-critical visual memories, providing history-aware context for future prediction. To exploit their distinct roles in action generation, we introduce Foresight-Guided Action Refinement (FGAR), which asymmetrically exploits proximal foresight for local action enhancement and route-critical foresight for feature-wise correction and route-level guidance. Experiments on the TravelUAV and UAV-ON benchmarks show that ForeFly consistently outperforms strong baselines across seen and unseen settings, validating the effectiveness of dual-horizon foresight and FGAR learning. The code is available at: https://github.com/kunhuiW/ForeFly

AI.tldr: 本文提出ForeFly，一种双时间域潜在世界动作模型，通过预测近端未来与自适应路线关键未来，并配合前瞻引导动作精炼（FGAR），提升空中视觉语言导航的长程指令跟随能力。
AI.motivation: 现有空中视觉语言导航（AVLN）方法多为反应式或仅限单一时间域预测，忽略了不同时间尺度上互补的未来线索，难以在复杂3D环境中维持长轨迹的可靠指令跟随。
AI.method: 提出ForeFly双时间域潜在世界动作模型：同时预测用于局部连续性的近端未来和用于长程引导的自适应路线关键未来；使用近期与路线关键的视觉记忆初始化时间域特定的前瞻查询，提供历史感知上下文；引入前瞻引导动作精炼（FGAR），非对称地利用近端前瞻增强局部动作、利用路线关键前瞻进行特征级修正与路线级引导。
AI.result: 在TravelUAV与UAV-ON基准上，ForeFly在已见与未见场景中均持续优于强基线，验证了双时间域前瞻与FGAR学习的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 双时间域未来预测与定向动作精炼能有效提升空中视觉语言导航的鲁棒性与长程导航性能，代码已开源。

title: Fill2SR: Repurposing Inpainting Diffusion Transformers for Real-World Super-Resolution
comment: ECCV 2026. 26 pages, 12 figures, including an 8-page appendix with additional visual results
summary: Recent real-world image super-resolution (SR) methods often adapt text-to-image (T2I) backbones with ControlNet-style branches or spatial conditioning tokens, which increases memory and computes with resolution and often constrains training to a fixed scale. We propose Fill2SR, which repurposes a masked-inpainting Diffusion Transformer for SR without extra spatial branches. Our Inpainting-Interface Evidence Adapter (IIEA) writes the low-quality (LQ) observation into the native masked-image slot under a full-image mask, turning inpainting into a reverse-degradation conditional rectified flow trained with LoRA-only tuning. We further introduce RCDT, an offline pipeline that distills degradation descriptors from unpaired real images and transfers them onto clean targets using frozen open-source models. Fill2SR supports mixed-resolution training up to QHD and yields stable performance across $512/1024/2048$ outputs. On synthetic benchmarks, our base model with IIEA achieves the best LPIPS on DIV2K and LSDIR; adding RCDT trades a small LPIPS drop for consistently stronger no-reference quality on RealLQ250 and RealPhoto60. Fill2SR remains memory-predictable, running $1536^2$ inference on a single 32GB GPU and extending to multi-megapixel outputs via tiled restoration.

AI.tldr: Fill2SR 将掩码修复扩散 Transformer 复用于真实图像超分，无需额外空间分支，支持混合分辨率训练与单卡大分辨率推理。
AI.motivation: 现有真实图像超分方法多采用 ControlNet 分支或空间条件 token 适配 T2I 主干，显存与算力随分辨率增长，且训练常被限制在固定尺度。
AI.method: 提出 Fill2SR：用 Inpainting-Interface Evidence Adapter（IIEA）将低质观测写入全图掩码下的原生掩码图像槽，把修复转为反向退化的条件整流流，仅用 LoRA 微调；并引入 RCDT 离线流程，从无配对真实图像蒸馏退化描述子并迁移到干净目标上。
AI.result: 支持最高 QHD 的混合分辨率训练，在 512/1024/2048 输出上表现稳定；合成基准上，带 IIEA 的基模在 DIV2K 和 LSDIR 取得最佳 LPIPS；加入 RCDT 后 LPIPS 略降，但在 RealLQ250 和 RealPhoto60 上无参考质量持续更强。显存可预测，单张 32GB GPU 可跑 1536² 推理，并通过分块恢复扩展至多百万像素输出。
AI.conclusion: Fill2SR 通过修复接口复用扩散 Transformer，避免额外空间分支，实现了分辨率可扩展、显存可预测的真实图像超分方案。

title: IVT-Guard: All-in-One Reasoning Model for AI-Generated Content Detection
summary: The rapid proliferation of highly realistic AI-Generated Content (AIGC) necessitates robust and interpretable detection mechanisms. However, existing detectors are predominantly confined to single modalities and provide binary outputs without reasoning. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) present a promising solution, their development is constrained by the scarcity of multimodal reasoning data and the reasoning-detection optimization dilemma, where explicit reasoning supervision can compromise detection accuracy. To this end, we introduce IVT-Set, a comprehensive dataset comprising over 152K diverse image, video, and text samples equipped with multi-granularity Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning trajectories. Based on it, we propose IVT-Guard, a pioneering framework for unified and interpretable AIGC detection across image, video, and text modalities. Furthermore, to overcome the aforementioned optimization dilemma, we design a novel three-stage training paradigm: Artifact-Aware Pre-training, Artifact-to-Evidence Supervised Fine-Tuning via artifact-aware injection, and Evidence-Verdict Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IVT-Guard achieves state-of-the-art detection performance across in-domain, out-of-domain, and cross-dataset settings while delivering faithful reasoning. Code and data will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出IVT-Set数据集与IVT-Guard框架，实现图像、视频、文本三模态统一且可解释的AIGC检测，并通过三阶段训练缓解推理-检测优化矛盾，取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGC检测器多局限于单一模态，仅输出二分类结果而缺乏推理过程。多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）虽是有前景的方案，但受限于多模态推理数据稀缺，以及存在推理-检测优化矛盾——即显式推理监督可能损害检测准确率。
AI.method: 1）构建IVT-Set数据集，包含超过152K图像、视频、文本样本及多粒度思维链（CoT）推理轨迹；2）提出IVT-Guard统一可解释检测框架，覆盖图像、视频、文本三模态；3）设计三阶段训练范式：伪影感知预训练、基于伪影感知注入的伪影到证据监督微调、以及证据-裁决一致性组相对策略优化（GRPO）。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，IVT-Guard在域内、域外及跨数据集设置下均达到最先进的检测性能，同时能提供忠实的推理过程。
AI.conclusion: IVT-Guard通过数据集构建与三阶段训练范式，有效缓解了推理与检测的优化矛盾，实现了多模态统一、可解释且性能领先的AIGC检测，代码与数据将开源。

title: TGRL: Temperature-Grouped Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Exploration in LLMs
summary: Efficient exploration often remains a central bottleneck in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Although temperature control and test-time scaling strategies can increase rollout diversity of large language models (LLMs), they either expand the sample budget at rollout time or leave the benefit of exploration unquantified. To this end, we propose Temperature-Grouped Reinforcement Learning (TGRL), which turns temperature-induced diversity into an explicit training signal. For each prompt, TGRL partitions its rollout group into low- and high-temperature subsets, estimates exploration gain through their reward contrast, and allocates this group-level signal as token-level credit using Jensen--Shannon (JS) divergence between the corresponding temperature-scaled next-token distributions induced by the same logits. Notably, TGRL reaches equivalent accuracy up to 36% faster than strong RLVR baselines without expanding the rollout budget. Across 11 benchmarks from diverse domains, TGRL broadly improves over strong RLVR baselines: it improves the six-benchmark math average by 1.6% at 32B, raises CodeForces rating by 196.7 points and LiveCodeBench Pass@16 by 4.4%, and improves ALFWorld/WebShop success rates by 6.3%/4.9%. Comprehensive ablations and wall-clock analysis confirm the efficacy of all proposed components. Code is available at https://github.com/1229095296/TGRL/tree/main.

AI.tldr: 提出TGRL（温度分组强化学习），将温度引发的多样性转化为显式训练信号，通过低/高温子组奖励对比估计探索增益，并用JS散度将该组级信号分配为token级信用，在不扩大采样预算前提下提升RLVR效率与性能。
AI.motivation: 在可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中，高效探索仍是核心瓶颈。温度控制与测试时扩展虽能提升LLM rollout多样性，但要么增加采样预算，要么未量化探索收益。
AI.method: 对每个prompt，将其rollout组划分为低温与高温子集；通过两子集奖励对比估计探索增益；利用同一logits对应温度缩放下一token分布间的Jensen-Shannon（JS）散度，将该组级信号分解为token级信用进行训练。
AI.result: 在11个跨领域基准上普遍优于强RLVR基线：32B下六个数学基准平均提升1.6%，CodeForces评分提升196.7分，LiveCodeBench Pass@16提升4.4%，ALFWorld/WebShop成功率提升6.3%/4.9%；达到同等精度最多快36%，且不扩大rollout预算。消融与墙钟时间分析验证各组件有效性。
AI.conclusion: TGRL把温度诱导的多样性与探索收益显式量化为可训练信号，在不增加采样成本的情况下加速并提升RLVR性能，组件有效且通用。

title: LoopLUT: 3D Lookup Tables with Progressive Region Refinement for Real-Time 4K Image Enhancement
summary: Color enhancement of 4K images must meet a quality target under a tight compute budget. Three-dimensional lookup tables (3D LUTs) dominate real-time enhancement because they decide at low resolution and apply a per-pixel lookup at full resolution. A single global LUT, however, is spatially invariant, so an underexposed shadow and a well-exposed region that share a pixel value receive identical corrections. Spatially heterogeneous demands cannot be expressed by such a mapping. We propose LoopLUT, a region-cascaded 3D LUT with progressive refinement. A global LUT performs the overall correction, followed by K-1 loop iterations. In each iteration a gating head predicts at low resolution the region that still needs correction, then builds a residual LUT from the color statistics of that region alone. The cascaded gates form a partition of unity, so the output is a per-pixel convex combination of the K lookup results. Fusion is therefore performed by the gates themselves, with no separate fusion module and no interpolation error accumulating across rounds. The decision stage runs at a fixed 256x256 resolution, independent of output resolution, so a 4K image costs only K pure lookups. Extensive experiments across four benchmarks show that LoopLUT improves PSNR by up to 2.81 dB over the strongest prior method, while keeping real-time throughput at 4K. The same decomposition also generalizes well to underwater enhancement datasets.

AI.tldr: LoopLUT 提出区域级联 3D LUT 与渐进细化机制：全局 LUT 做整体校正，随后 K-1 次循环中由门控头在低分辨率预测仍需校正的区域并构建残差 LUT，门控构成单位分解，使输出为 K 个查找结果的逐像素凸组合，从而免去独立融合模块并避免插值误差累积。决策阶段固定 256×256，与输出分辨率无关，4K 仅需 K 次纯查找。
AI.motivation: 4K 图像色彩增强需在严格计算预算下达到质量目标。3D LUT 因低分辨率决策加全分辨率逐像素查找而主导实时增强，但单一全局 LUT 具有空间不变性：具有相同像素值的欠曝阴影区与正常曝光区会得到相同校正，无法表达空间异质性需求。
AI.method: 采用区域级联 3D LUT 与渐进细化框架：先由全局 LUT 完成整体校正，再进行 K-1 次循环迭代；每次迭代中门控头在低分辨率预测仍需校正的区域，并仅依据该区域的颜色统计构建残差 LUT。级联门控形成单位分解，输出为 K 个查找结果的逐像素凸组合，融合由门控隐式完成，无需单独融合模块，且不产生跨轮累积的插值误差。决策阶段固定于 256×256 分辨率。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，LoopLUT 相比最强先前方法将 PSNR 最高提升 2.81 dB，同时在 4K 下保持实时吞吐。该分解在水下增强数据集上同样具有良好泛化性。
AI.conclusion: LoopLUT 通过区域级联与渐进细化的 3D LUT 设计，在固定低分辨率决策与仅 K 次纯查找的 4K 代价下实现空间自适应色彩增强，兼顾质量与实时性，并具备跨域泛化能力。

title: PoE-Fuse: Precision-Weighted Expert Fusion for Bi-Temporal Change Understanding
summary: Bi-temporal change understanding, which localizes and characterizes what changed between two satellite images, is central to disaster response and environmental monitoring, spanning change detection, building localization, and damage assessment. Strong vision-language models address these tasks, but adapting them typically requires full fine-tuning or reinforcement learning, which is costly and unstable. We propose PoE-Fuse, a parameter-efficient framework that instead composes frozen foundation experts for geometry, grounding, and language, resampling their features onto a shared spatial grid and training only a lightweight fusion trunk. PoE-Fuse treats the aligned features as Gaussian observations of a latent scene state and fuses them by learned per-cell precision. This product-of-experts estimator strictly generalizes uniform summation and scalar gating, and extends to change fields by composing the precisions of the two timestamps. A single shared trunk solves the three tasks at once, reaching a mean F1 of 59.2%, compared with 40.7% for an instruction-tuned temporal vision-language assistant, and surpassing dedicated change-detection models retrained under the same protocol and training budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PoE-Fuse，一种参数高效的双时相变化理解框架，通过冻结几何、定位与语言基础专家并仅训练轻量融合主干，实现变化检测、建筑定位与损伤评估三任务统一。
AI.motivation: 双时相变化理解在灾害响应与环境监测中至关重要，但现有强视觉语言模型适配成本高且不稳定（全量微调或强化学习）。
AI.method: 将冻结基础专家特征重采样至统一空间网格，视为潜在场景状态的高斯观测，按学习到的逐单元精度进行融合（product-of-experts 估计），并通过对两个时间戳精度组合扩展到变化场；单一共享融合主干同时求解三任务。
AI.result: 平均 F1 达 59.2%，显著高于指令微调时序视觉语言助手的 40.7%，并超过在相同协议与训练预算下重训练的专用变化检测模型。
AI.conclusion: PoE-Fuse 以参数高效方式统一多任务双时相变化理解，理论上严格泛化均匀求和与标量门控，实践中优于专用模型与大型助手。

title: ViCoR: Reliable Molecular Structure Extraction via Spatially Aligned Verification and Executable Revision
summary: Reliable optical chemical structure recognition (OCSR) is essential for building high-quality chemical data from scientific literature, yet even small recognition errors can propagate into chemical databases and downstream models. In practice, recognized structures often require manual inspection and correction before use, making large-scale data curation costly and difficult to scale. We therefore study Selective Structure Recognition (SSR), a post-recognition setting that automatically produces reliable structured outputs while rejecting unresolved cases. Selection-only approaches can improve reliability by rejection, but cannot create additional correct outputs beyond those produced by the base recognizer. We propose ViCoR, a repair-before-rejection framework for iterative VerIfiCatiOn and Revision. Its key idea is to make observation-prediction correspondence explicit: coordinate-preserving rendering establishes spatial correspondence between the source image and predicted structure, while index anchoring maps localized visual discrepancies to executable graph edits without full-structure regeneration. A shared VLM is progressively trained from verification to revision. On two real-world OCSR benchmarks, ViCoR improves overall accuracy from 73.53\% to 88.26\% and from 61.83\% to 84.32\%, while achieving over 97\% accepted accuracy at 85--89\% coverage. The resulting molecular data further improve reaction-extraction F1 by 15.5 points and literature-sourced reaction prediction accuracy by 7.7 and 5.8 points, demonstrating the value of automated reliability control for scientific data curation and downstream chemical learning.

AI.tldr: 提出ViCoR——一种“先修复后拒绝”的迭代验证与修订框架，实现选择性结构识别（SSR），在保证高接受精度的同时提升OCSR整体准确率。
AI.motivation: OCSR是构建高质量化学数据的关键，但识别错误会传播至数据库和下游模型，导致人工校对成本高、难以规模化。仅靠“选择/拒绝”策略虽能提升可靠性，却无法创造新的正确输出，因此需要一种能在拒绝前主动修复错误的方法。
AI.method: 提出ViCoR框架，核心是显式建立观测-预测对应关系：1）保坐标渲染（coordinate-preserving rendering）在源图像与预测结构间建立空间对应；2）索引锚定（index anchoring）将局部视觉差异映射为可执行的图编辑，避免整结构重生成；3）共享VLM从验证任务渐进式训练至修订任务，形成迭代验证与修订流程。
AI.result: 在两个真实OCSR基准上，整体准确率分别从73.53%提升至88.26%、从61.83%提升至84.32%；在85–89%覆盖率下接受精度超过97%。生成的分子数据进一步使反应抽取F1提升15.5点，文献来源反应预测准确率分别提升7.7和5.8点。
AI.conclusion: ViCoR通过“修复优先于拒绝”的机制，突破了仅选择策略的上限，验证了自动化可靠性控制在科学数据策管与下游化学学习中的价值。

title: Anguinus Sculpturae: Compositional Synthesis of Peak-Enhancement Breast DCE-MRI Scans
comment: Accepted as an oral at the MAMA-SYNTH 2026 challenge / Deep-BreAth 2026 Workshop, MICCAI 2026. 12 pages, 3 figures, 1 table
summary: Dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI (DCE-MRI) is rich in anatomical and perfusion information, but its reliance on gadolinium-based contrast agents raises safety concerns and adds cost. Virtual contrast enhancement, synthesizing post-contrast from pre-contrast images, is a promising alternative. We address the MAMA-SYNTH challenge task of predicting peak-enhancement breast MRI. Rather than adopting the full machinery of diffusion or flow matching, we observe that under a rectified, straight-line path the generative process collapses to a single difference prediction: the synthetic peak image is the pre-contrast image plus a predicted enhancement map, recovered in one forward pass. Around this we build Anguinus Sculpturae, a compositional pipeline in which nnU-Net segmentations of lesion, foreground and breast region guide two generators - one optimized for global fidelity, one for lesion structure through an asymmetric Tversky term routed via a frozen segmenter - composited region-wise with Gaussian-weighted blending. On the held-out Duke subset of MAMA-MIA our model achieves the best FRD and Dice among all evaluated variants, showing that single-step difference prediction with segmentation guidance suffices to recover both global fidelity and lesion structure. Code is available at https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/AnguinusSculpturae.

AI.tldr: 本文针对MAMA-SYNTH挑战中的乳腺MRI峰值增强预测任务，提出"虚拟对比增强"的单步差异预测方法，构建了名为Anguinus Sculpturae的组合式流水线，在Duke子集上取得最优FRD与Dice。
AI.motivation: 动态对比增强乳腺MRI（DCE-MRI）蕴含丰富的解剖与灌注信息，但依赖钆基造影剂，带来安全隐患并增加成本。虚拟对比增强（由平扫图像合成增强图像）是一种有前景的替代方案，本文即针对该挑战任务展开研究。
AI.method: 作者并未采用完整的扩散或流匹配框架，而是发现：在矫正后的直线路径下，生成过程可简化为单次差异预测——合成峰值图像等于平扫图像加上一个预测的增强图，且仅需一次前向传播即可获得。据此构建Anguinus Sculpturae组合式流水线：利用nnU-Net分割病灶、前景与乳腺区域来引导两个生成器，其一优化全局保真度，其二通过冻结分割器引入非对称Tversky项以优化病灶结构，并通过高斯加权融合进行区域级合成。
AI.result: 在MAMA-MIA的留出Duke子集上，该模型在所有评估变体中取得了最佳的FRD和Dice指标。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，带有分割引导的单步差异预测足以同时恢复全局保真度与病灶结构。代码已开源。

title: Quizzing the Translation: A Prover-Grounded Evaluation Metric for NL$\rightarrow$FOL
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 18 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/pu-suo/siv-metric
summary: A standard pipeline for symbolic reasoning over natural-language problems translates them into first-order logic and invokes a theorem prover. The translation step is the bottleneck: swap "every" for "some" and every inference that follows is corrupted. Yet today's metrics often score more broken translations higher than less broken ones, because BLEU, BERTScore, and Smatch++ reward surface overlap that the worst errors happen to preserve. We introduce SIV, which derives two kinds of probes from the target formula and uses a theorem prover to verify the candidate translation against each. Positive probes are statements the candidate must entail, which detect translations that drop content; contrastive probes are statements the candidate must not entail, which detect translations that assert more than the original. On a controlled pool of perturbed FOLIO translations, the severity of the error accounts for 80% of SIV's score variance, compared with at most 17% for any prior metric. Across six error classes on a disjoint pool, SIV scores the reference above the perturbed candidate in over 99% of pairs. Because each probe is labeled with what it tests, the failure pattern also supplies a labeled error trace, recovering the perturbation class at macro-F1 0.638, nearly double the score-only baseline. On 434 expert-audited real LLM translations, SIV attains the top AUC, uniquely detects and grades expert-labeled major errors, and abstains, rather than mis-scoring, on out-of-vocabulary translations.

AI.tldr: 提出SIV，一种基于定理证明器的探测式翻译评估指标：由目标公式派生正向（必须蕴含）与对比（必须不蕴含）探针，验证候选翻译。在受控扰动FOLIO数据上，错误严重性解释SIV分数方差的80%（此前指标≤17%），跨六类错误99%以上配对中参考译文得分高于扰动候选，并提供可标注的错误轨迹（宏F1 0.638，约为仅分数基线的两倍）；在434条专家审计的真实LLM翻译上取得最高AUC，能识别并分级重大错误，并对词汇外翻译选择弃权而非误评。
AI.motivation: 自然语言符号推理的标准流程是先翻译为一阶逻辑再调用定理证明器，翻译是瓶颈：把"every"换成"some"会破坏后续全部推理。但现有指标（BLEU、BERTScore、Smatch++）奖励表层重叠，而最严重的错误恰好能保持表层相似，导致更糟的翻译反而得分更高，故需要一种能感知语义错误严重性并给出可解释诊断的评估方法。
AI.method: 从目标公式派生两类探针：正向探针为候选翻译必须蕴含的陈述，用于检测内容缺失；对比探针为候选翻译必须不蕴含的陈述，用于检测过度断言。使用定理证明器逐一验证候选翻译与各探针的一致性，据此聚合为SIV分数。每个探针带有其测试内容的标签，因此失败模式本身构成带标注的错误轨迹，可反推扰动类别；对词汇外翻译设计弃权机制。
AI.result: 在受控扰动FOLIO翻译池上，错误严重性解释SIV分数方差的80%，而所有先前指标最多仅17%；在不重叠池的六类错误上，SIV在超过99%的配对中给参考译文打分高于扰动候选。错误轨迹恢复扰动类别的宏F1为0.638，接近仅用分数基线的两倍。在434条专家审计的真实LLM翻译上，SIV取得最高AUC，唯一能够检测并分级专家标注的重大错误，并在词汇外翻译上选择弃权而非误评。
AI.conclusion: SIV将翻译评估从表层相似度转向语义蕴含/排除验证，使评分与错误严重性高度对齐，并提供可解释、可标注的失败诊断；在受控与真实数据上均优于现有指标，且具备处理词汇外输入的弃权能力，为符号推理管线中的翻译质量评估提供了更可靠的方案。

title: SpatialSpeak: QA-Native Reconstruction with Local and Global Context for Spatial Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can benefit from geometric priors for multi-view spatial reasoning, yet answer-only training does not directly supervise the intermediate geometric estimates and their use in deriving quantitative spatial answers. We hypothesize that spatial chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision becomes more effective when the VLM first jointly learns complementary local geometry and global scene context through multi-view reconstruction. We introduce SpatialSpeak, a two-stage framework that connects QA-native reconstruction pretraining with spatial CoT learning. In Stage I, QA-Native Reconstruction Pretraining (QA-RP) combines marked-point 3D queries for fine-grained local geometry with object-center queries for global scene context across views. Both tasks are formulated as text-based question answering, allowing geometric estimation and subsequent reasoning to share the same autoregressive output interface. In Stage II, spatial CoT with Visual Compensation (CoT-VC) trains the model to express question-relevant geometric estimates and use them to derive answers, with reliability assessment and visual compensation supporting answer refinement when needed. On ReVSI, QA-RP increases the gain from CoT-VC from 2.6 to 6.9 points, and ablations show that both local and global reconstruction supervision are beneficial. SpatialSpeak achieves state-of-the-art results on ReVSI, VSI-Bench, and SPAR-Bench, with a ReVSI score of 62.8 that exceeds the strongest compared baseline by 8.7 points.

AI.tldr: SpatialSpeak：两阶段框架，先用QA-native多视图重建预训练，再进行空间CoT学习，在多视图空间推理基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: VLM可从几何先验中受益于多视图空间推理，但answer-only训练无法直接监督中间几何估计及其用于推导定量空间答案的过程。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：Stage I的QA-RP结合标记点3D查询（局部几何）与物体中心查询（全局场景上下文），均以文本问答形式实现，共享自回归输出接口；Stage II的CoT-VC训练模型表达与问题相关的几何估计并据此推导答案，辅以可靠性评估与视觉补偿进行答案精炼。
