AI.result: 在ReVSI上，QA-RP将CoT-VC的增益从2.6分提升至6.9分；消融显示局部与全局重建监督均有收益；在ReVSI、VSI-Bench、SPAR-Bench上达SOTA，ReVSI得分62.8，超出最强基线8.7分。
AI.conclusion: 通过多视图重建预训练与空间CoT监督结合，可有效提升VLM多视图空间推理能力，验证了局部与全局几何监督的互补价值。

title: ParaAgent: Reinforcing Parallel Acting in Open-World Tool Environments
summary: Language model agents are increasingly deployed in open-world tool environments, which require balancing exploring unknown capabilities and exploiting known ones. Existing methods face a performance-efficiency tradeoff: they either rigidly decouple exploration and execution or interleave them without coordination. We argue that the key lies not in whether to decouple or interleave them, but in how to coordinate them across granularities. We introduce ParaAct, a structured parallel-action loop that combines phase-level Exploration $\rightleftharpoons$ Execution with action-level parallelism. To learn this loop, ParaAgent combines multi-agent cold-start demonstrations with reinforcement learning under multi-level advantage decoupling, making planning structure explicit and supervising it with step-, phase-, and trajectory-level rewards. Learning is supported by our ToolEnv, a scalable simulator grounded in 50,011 realistic tool interfaces. On two open-world tool benchmarks, ParaAgent-4B achieves the best average success among all baselines, including GPT-4.1 systems, with the largest gains on multi-tool tasks. Behavioral analyses show that these gains stem from this action organization, highlighting its importance for capable and efficient open-world agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ParaAct 与 ParaAgent，通过跨粒度的探索-执行协调（阶段级 + 动作级并行）提升开放世界工具智能体的性能与效率。
AI.motivation: 开放世界工具环境中，智能体需平衡对未知能力的探索与对已知能力的利用。现有方法面临性能-效率权衡：要么刚性解耦探索与执行，要么交错进行但缺乏协调。作者认为关键不在是否解耦或交错，而在于如何跨粒度协调二者。
AI.method: 提出 ParaAct：一种结构化并行动作循环，融合阶段级“探索⇌执行”切换与动作级并行。为学习该循环，提出 ParaAgent：结合多智能体冷启动示范与强化学习，并在多层优势解耦下训练，使规划结构显式化，并以步级、阶段级、轨迹级奖励进行监督。训练依托 ToolEnv——基于 50,011 个真实工具接口构建的可扩展模拟器。
AI.result: 在两个开放世界工具基准上，ParaAgent-4B 取得所有基线（含 GPT-4.1 系统）中最高的平均成功率，在多工具任务上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 行为分析表明，性能提升源于该动作组织方式，凸显跨粒度协调对构建高能力、高效率开放世界智能体的重要性。

title: StoryEngine: A State-Grounded Agentic Framework for Video Storytelling
summary: Despite recent progress in agentic multi-shot video generation, producing coherent and consistent long-form stories remains challenging. Existing agentic pipelines typically rely on textual shot plans or previously generated pixels, yet lack an explicit mechanism for propagating the consequences of story events and maintaining the video world state across shots. As a result, missing visual details may be reconstructed inaccurately, while visual drift may propagate across subsequent shots, undermining both narrative coherence and visual consistency. To address these challenges, we propose StoryEngine, a state-grounded agentic framework for video storytelling. StoryEngine establishes a separation between authoritative semantic plans and unreliable visual observations. Specifically, StoryEngine maintains a structured representation of entity placement and story-relevant states, and propagates event-induced changes to define the intended start and end states of each shot. To visually realize these states, StoryEngine constructs canonical references for recurring entities and environments, and compiles state and visual constraints into executable render plans. Meanwhile, to realize these states correctly, a bounded evaluation-guided repair loop further corrects local state inconsistencies. Together, these mechanisms preserve causal story progression and prevent local visual errors from propagating across shots. To comprehensively evaluate long-form storytelling, we construct a benchmark across diverse scenarios and visual styles, with metrics assessing storytelling quality, narrative coherence, and visual consistency. Experimental results demonstrate that StoryEngine consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across all evaluation dimensions, validating its effectiveness for coherent and consistent video storytelling.

AI.tldr: 提出 StoryEngine，一种以状态为基础的智能体视频叙事框架，通过分离权威语义计划与不可靠视觉观测、维护结构化世界状态并传播事件影响，实现长时程故事视频的连贯与一致性生成，实验全面优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多镜头视频生成的智能体流程依赖文本分镜计划或已生成像素，缺乏显式机制传播故事事件后果、维护跨镜头的视频世界状态，导致缺失的视觉细节被错误重建、视觉漂移在后续镜头中累积，损害叙事连贯性与视觉一致性。
AI.method: StoryEngine 分离权威语义计划与不可靠视觉观测：维护实体布局与故事相关状态的结构化表示，传播事件引发的状态变化以定义每个镜头的预期起止状态；为复现实体与环境构建规范参考，将状态与视觉约束编译为可执行渲染计划；并采用有界评估引导的修复循环纠正局部状态不一致。
AI.result: 在涵盖多样场景与视觉风格的新构建长时程叙事基准上，StoryEngine 在叙事质量、叙事连贯性与视觉一致性等全部评测维度上持续优于当前最先进方法，验证了其在连贯一致视频叙事上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以显式世界状态为核心的状态化智能体框架能够有效保持因果故事推进，并阻止局部视觉错误跨镜头传播，为长时程连贯视频叙事提供了可行范式。

title: Event-Only Wingbeat Counting under Camera Motion: A Controlled MuJoCo Benchmark
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Controlled simulation study with an ideal contrast-event sensor. Follow-up to arXiv:2609.17308 using new event-only acquisitions and a motion ablation protocol
summary: Counting completed wingbeats requires identifying individual cycles, including during frequency changes and pauses; estimating a dominant frequency alone is insufficient. Camera motion further mixes target and background brightness changes in event observations. We present a controlled MuJoCo benchmark that separates motion training from event-only image translation compensation. The acquisition contains 324 streams from 24 independent scenes, three flapping geometries, two distances (1.5 and 3.0 m), and static, moderate-motion and stronger-motion views. Fifteen scenes are used for fitting, three for validation and six for held-out testing. A fixed causal temporal convolutional network is evaluated in a matched 2 x 2 ablation with three initialization seeds and compared with ridge, Fourier, autocorrelation and an adapted EEPPR baseline. Under moderate motion, paired motion training reduces count mean absolute error from 31.130 to 3.185 cycles at 1.5 m and from 42.019 to 5.444 at 3.0 m. Adding the tested compensation increases these errors to 4.630 and 10.185, respectively. A Fourier baseline achieves 0.944 cycles at 1.5 m under moderate motion, showing that the neural model is not uniformly best. We report exact-count accuracy and temporally matched cycle F1 alongside count error. These findings support motion-aware training in this small synthetic benchmark, while exposing limits of simple event-background stabilization. They do not establish real-sensor performance, aerodynamic flight, or generalization to unseen vehicle types.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个受控的MuJoCo基准，将运动训练与仅基于事件的图像平移补偿分离，用于在频率变化和停顿条件下精确计数完整翅膀拍动周期。
AI.motivation: 仅估计主导频率不足以计数完整翅膀拍动周期，因为需要识别单个周期，包括频率变化和停顿阶段；同时相机运动会在事件观测中混入目标与背景的亮度变化，干扰计数。
AI.method: 构建受控MuJoCo基准，含24个独立场景、324条事件流、三种拍动几何、两个距离（1.5与3.0 m）及静态/中等/较强运动视角；15场景拟合、3验证、6测试。评估固定因果时序卷积网络，在匹配的2×2消融下用三个初始化种子，并与岭回归、傅里叶、自相关及改造EEPPR基线比较。
AI.result: 中等运动下，配对运动训练将计数MAE从31.130降至3.185周期（1.5 m）、从42.019降至5.444（3.0 m）；加入所测补偿后误差反而升至4.630和10.185。傅里叶基线在1.5 m中等运动下达到0.944周期，表明神经模型并非普遍最优。同时报告精确计数准确率与时间匹配周期F1。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在该小型合成基准中采用运动感知训练，同时暴露简单事件背景稳定的局限；但未验证真实传感器性能、气动飞行或对未见飞行器类型的泛化能力。

title: Safety Reconstructed: Generative Modeling via Masked Diffusion Builds Strong Safety Guardrails
summary: Guard models are the last line of defense between a language model and a harmful output, yet their training objective is surprisingly narrow. Existing guards learn to predict a single verdict token from a conversational context, concentrating supervision on a single target. The consequences are structural: models latch onto shortcut features, are overconfident, and remain sensitive to where safety evidence appears in the sequence rather than its role in the full context. We propose a different framing. Rather than predicting a label from text, our LLaDA-Guard asks which label better explains the text: scoring the prompt or response under each label hypothesis and classifying based on their difference. This shifts supervision to every token in the moderated region, forcing the model to account for full content rather than its most discriminative fragments. We instantiate this idea with a masked diffusion language model, fine-tuning LLaDA-8B-Instruct with a class-conditional reconstruction objective using LoRA and requiring no architectural changes beyond the base model. LLaDA-Guard leads on average rank against discriminative baselines trained on stronger backbones across seven held-out safety benchmarks, while exhibiting substantially better confidence calibration (ECE 0.0875 vs. 0.1384 for Qwen3Guard), less over-defense on benign prompts with unsafe-looking cues, and less prompt leakage when moderating responses. Its generative nature further enables token-level risk localization as a natural byproduct, yielding a pipeline for rewriting unsafe prompts into safe equivalents without additional training and achieving a 60.7% average conversion-to-safe rate.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LLaDA-Guard，将防护模型训练从"从上下文预测单一标签"重构为"判断哪个标签假设更能解释文本"，基于掩码扩散语言模型以类别条件重建目标进行微调，在安全基准上取得更优排名、校准性与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有防护模型（guard models）训练目标过于狭窄：仅从对话上下文中预测单一判定token，监督仅集中于一个目标。这导致模型依赖捷径特征、过度自信，并对安全证据在序列中出现的位置敏感，而非关注其在完整上下文中的作用。作者希望将监督信号扩展到被审核区域的每一个token，使模型必须考虑完整内容。
AI.method: 提出新框架：不是从文本预测标签，而是评估哪个标签假设更能解释文本——在每种标签假设下对prompt或response打分，并依据得分差异进行分类。以掩码扩散语言模型实例化该思路，使用LoRA对LLaDA-8B-Instruct进行类别条件重建目标（class-conditional reconstruction）微调，除基础模型外无需架构改动。
AI.result: 在七个留出安全基准上，LLaDA-Guard相对在更强骨干上训练的判别式基线取得更优的平均排名；置信校准显著更好（ECE 0.0875，对比Qwen3Guard的0.1384）；对含看似不安全线索的良性prompt过度防御更少；审核响应时prompt泄漏更少。其生成式特性还天然提供token级风险定位，无需额外训练即可构建将不安全prompt改写为安全等价物的流水线，平均转化安全率达60.7%。
AI.conclusion: 将防护建模从判别式标签预测转为假设解释性打分，可有效扩展监督范围、缓解捷径学习与过度自信问题，并在安全基准、校准、过度防御与泄漏等方面全面优于判别式基线，同时以生成能力为副产品带来token级风险定位与免训练的安全改写能力。

title: Quantifying Behavioral Tails in Black-Box Language Models
summary: We introduce RareTrap, a framework for estimating the probability of severe behaviors in black box large language models (LLMs). A key challenge for probability estimation is defining a tractable distribution over the input space. To accomplish that, RareTrap uses a surrogate LLM and constructs a geometry-aware mapping from a lower-dimensional latent reference space into its token-embedding space to induce an explicit and reproducible distribution over input prompts. A response-level performance function is utilized on the response to quantify behavior severity. This enables sequential rare event simulation that concentrates evaluations on progressively more severe behaviors while preserving probability under the induced prompt distribution, which would otherwise be prohibitive to measure. Across 10 open-weight and two frontier models (GPT-5.4 and Claude Sonnet 4.6), we find that RareTrap successfully induces severe resource consumption behaviors and computes their probability with as few as 200 evaluations. RareTrap provides model developers a principled approach for evaluating language models under a common distribution, and prioritizing alignment effort to improve safety and mitigate risks.

AI.tldr: RareTrap：在黑盒大模型中估计严重行为概率的框架，通过代理模型构造几何感知的低维潜空间映射，诱导可复现的提示分布，结合响应级严重性评分与序贯稀有事件模拟，以极少评估次数估计严重行为概率。
AI.motivation: 概率估计的关键难点在于输入空间上难以定义可处理的分布，导致严重行为概率（稀有事件）难以测量；需要为模型开发者提供统一的分布下评估方法，以优先开展对齐工作、提升安全性并降低风险。
AI.method: RareTrap 使用代理 LLM，在低维潜参考空间与 token 嵌入空间之间构造几何感知映射，从而在输入提示上诱导显式、可复现的分布；在响应层面定义性能函数以量化行为严重性；再通过序贯稀有事件模拟，将评估逐步集中到更严重的行为，同时在该诱导提示分布下保持概率无偏。
AI.result: 在 10 个开放权重模型和 2 个前沿模型（GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6）上，RareTrap 成功诱导出严重的资源消耗行为，并在少至 200 次评估内计算出其概率。
AI.conclusion: RareTrap 为模型开发者提供了在统一分布下评估语言模型的原则性方法，可据此优先分配对齐工作，提升安全性并降低风险。

title: Learning to Learn from Context: Synthetic Training from Perturbed Public Documents
summary: Real-world tasks often require large language models (LLMs) to learn from complex task-specific context rather than pretrained parametric knowledge. This capability remains a weakness of LLMs, while human annotation for such task contexts is expensive and difficult to scale. Public high-quality documents are an abundant alternative, but much of the public web has already been consumed during pretraining: training on such documents naively would reward memorization rather than context learning. In this work, we attempt to make use of high-quality public documents with small perturbations and empirically find that LLMs can successfully generate context-dependent reasoning traces and answers, which are then used to train a student model. Specifically, we construct a synthesis pipeline that (i) rewrites source documents to reduce memorization risk, (ii) generates questions and rubrics that require reasoning over the document, (iii) answers the questions with the document as context, and (iv) admits only samples that genuinely depend on the document. Without any human annotators, our pipeline generates about 10k samples from 3.5k documents, and the resulting student model substantially improves the performance on CL-bench. SFT raises a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B student from 13.7% to 22.8%, and a subsequent rubric-reward RL stage reaches 24.6%, on CL-bench comparable with a frontier model of over a trillion parameters, Qwen3.8-2.4T (23.9%). We also observe a broad transfer of improvements to long-context understanding, instruction following, and reasoning, while code generation and knowledge remain mostly flat. We hope this work provides a reproducible and scalable way to improve the ability of LLMs to learn from context, and to facilitate further research on context-grounded reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出无人工标注的合成流水线：对高质量公开文档做扰动改写、生成需依赖文档的问题与评分标准、带文档作答，并筛选真正依赖上下文的样本，约1万条样本训练学生模型，在CL-bench上显著提升上下文学习能力。
AI.motivation: 真实任务常要求LLM从任务特定上下文（而非预训练参数知识）中学习，但该能力薄弱；人工标注此类上下文昂贵且难规模化。公开高质量文档是替代来源，然而大部分公开网页已被预训练消耗，直接训练会奖励记忆而非上下文学习，因此需探索如何利用这类文档提升上下文依赖推理能力。
AI.method: 构建合成流水线（无需人工标注）：(i) 改写源文档以降低记忆风险；(ii) 生成需要对文档进行推理的问题与评分标准(rubric)；(iii) 以文档为上下文作答；(iv) 仅保留真正依赖文档的样本。用该流水线从3.5k篇文档生成约10k样本，用于SFT训练学生模型，并进一步采用rubric-reward RL阶段。
AI.result: 在CL-bench上，SFT将Qwen3.6-35B-A3B学生模型从13.7%提升至22.8%，后续rubric-reward RL达到24.6%，与超万亿参数的前沿模型Qwen3.8-2.4T（23.9%）相当。改进还可广泛迁移到长上下文理解、指令遵循与推理任务，而代码生成与知识类任务基本持平。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种可复现、可扩展的提升LLM从上下文学习能力的方法，并能促进基于上下文推理的后续研究。

title: Probe to Act: Elevating Browser-Use Agent via Active Visual Probing
summary: Browser-use agents require seamless alignment between structured web metadata and visual information, while preserving relevant context across long interactions. Existing interfaces often rely on either screenshot-level action prediction or static Set-of-Marks overlays, leaving the model to resolve dense DOM-pixel alignment before every operation. We introduce Probe to Act (P2A), an active probing framework for the browser-agent loop that moves this alignment into decision time. P2A addresses an asymmetric bridge between symbolic DOM hypotheses and screenshot layout by rendering on-demand symbolic DOM structure back into pixels. Before committing a state-changing browser operation, the agent can issue lightweight probes to translate DOM handles into pixel evidence, map screen regions back to DOM candidates, register visual-only targets, and commit verified notes. These interleaved processes naturally produce evidence-based memory: only probed, acted-on, or explicitly committed observations are kept across steps, preserving only decision-critical evidence in long-horizon contexts. P2A can be used as a prompting strategy for proprietary models under the standard DOM+SoM interface, and can be distilled into open-weight models through cold-start synthesis and self-bootstrapped SFT. Across three browser-use benchmarks, P2A shows clear gains on task success rate for both proprietary and fine-tuned models; on VisualWebArena, for example, it improves Gemini-3-Pro from 54.1% to 61.2% and Qwen3-VL-8B from 24.6% to 32.9%, while matching the costly full-observation history ($\sim$3$\times$) at only $\sim$1.2$\times$ the peak retained input context of action-only history.

AI.tldr: P2A将DOM符号与截图像素的"对齐"从预处理阶段移到决策时刻，通过按需主动探测（probe）在像素上验证DOM假设，并把探测/交互/提交过的观测作为证据记忆保留，从而在浏览器智能体中同时提升任务成功率与长程上下文效率。
AI.motivation: 现有浏览器智能体界面要么依赖截图级动作预测，要么依赖静态Set-of-Marks叠加，模型在每次操作前都必须自行解决密集的DOM-像素对齐问题，且难以在长交互中保持相关上下文。作者希望把这种对齐负担从"每次都做"转变为"决策时按需主动解决"。
AI.method: 提出Probe to Act（P2A）主动探测框架：把符号化DOM假设渲染为像素证据，在提交状态改变操作前，智能体可发出轻量探测，将DOM句柄翻译为像素证据、将屏幕区域映射回DOM候选、登记仅视觉可见的目标并提交已验证笔记。这些交错探测自然形成"基于证据的记忆"——仅保留被探测、被操作或被显式提交的观测。P2A既可作为标准DOM+SoM接口下的提示策略用于闭源模型，也可通过冷启动合成与自举SFT蒸馏进开源权重模型。
AI.result: 在三个浏览器使用基准上，P2A对闭源与微调模型均提升任务成功率；在VisualWebArena上，Gemini-3-Pro由54.1%升至61.2%，Qwen3-VL-8B由24.6%升至32.9%；同时以仅约1.2倍的动作历史峰值保留输入上下文，达到与约3倍全观测历史相当的效果。
AI.conclusion: 将DOM-像素对齐从固定预处理迁移到决策时的主动探测，可在不显著增加上下文成本的前提下显著提升浏览器智能体的任务成功率，并形成可蒸馏、可迁移的提示与训练策略，为长程网页交互提供高效的证据记忆范式。

title: Tsubame: Tree Replay for Diffusion-Based Speculative Decoding
summary: Context-aware dynamic trees allocate the speculative decoding budget according to draft path probabilities, adapting their depth and branching to the current context. Under stochastic decoding, however, we find that this structural advantage does not always compensate for the acceptance gains of random sampling paired with advanced verification, and such dynamic trees can fall behind sampled chains in some settings. These trees grow their topology from the candidates themselves, so the tokens submitted for verification are typically the deterministic high-score tokens selected during construction. This coupling is not inherent: once the topology is fixed, its nodes can be repopulated by sampling, allowing dynamic trees to retain their structural advantage while also benefiting from random sampling and advanced verification. Diffusion-based drafters make this practical, as their parallel outputs or lightweight conditional corrections allow candidates to be regenerated cheaply after the complete topology is known. We introduce Tsubame, a two-pass tree speculative decoding framework for diffusion-based drafters. The first pass plans and freezes a context-aware topology using draft path scores; the second replays the fixed topology, sampling the tokens that populate its nodes to form the candidate tree for verification. We prove that Tsubame is lossless under compatible sampling and verification strategies. Experiments across three diffusion-based drafters, six datasets, and multiple candidate budgets show that Tsubame improves acceptance length and throughput over deterministic trees, including settings where it reverses their disadvantage against sampled chains.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Tsubame，一个面向扩散式草稿模型的两阶段树式投机解码框架。它先规划并冻结上下文感知的树拓扑，再在固定拓扑上采样填充节点，从而在保留动态树结构优势的同时获得随机采样与高级验证的接受增益。作者证明其在兼容策略下无损，并在多模型、多数据集上提升了接受长度与吞吐。
AI.motivation: 上下文感知动态树根据草稿路径概率分配投机预算，自适应调整深度与分支。但在随机解码下，这种结构优势并不总能补偿"随机采样+高级验证"带来的接受增益，动态树在某些设置下甚至落后于采样链。其根源在于：动态树从候选本身生长拓扑，导致提交验证的 token 通常是构建时选出的确定性高分 token，结构规划与 token 选择被耦合在了一起。
AI.method: 作者指出这种耦合并非固有：一旦拓扑确定，其节点可以通过采样重新填充。扩散式草稿模型使这一思路可行，因为其并行输出或轻量条件修正可在完整拓扑已知后低成本地重新生成候选。基于此提出 Tsubame 两阶段框架：第一阶段利用草稿路径分数规划并冻结上下文感知拓扑；第二阶段回放固定拓扑，采样填充各节点，形成用于验证的候选树。
AI.result: 作者证明 Tsubame 在兼容的采样与验证策略下是无损的。实验覆盖三种扩散式草稿模型、六个数据集和多种候选预算，结果表明 Tsubame 相较确定性树提升了接受长度与吞吐量，并在部分设置中扭转了确定性树相对采样链的劣势。
AI.conclusion: Tsubame 将动态树的结构规划与节点 token 选择解耦，通过"先冻结拓扑、再采样填充"实现结构与随机采样的双重优势，为扩散式草稿模型提供了一种无损、可泛化的树式投机解码方案。

title: Learning Multimodal Embeddings with Evidence-Aligned Readout
summary: Multimodal large language models can expose task-relevant evidence through generation, but producing useful evidence does not by itself determine how it enters a retrieval embedding. We study whether the semantic organization of that evidence can also specify where representations are read. To address this question, we introduce EviAlign, which couples Semantic Evidence Generation with Boundary Readout in a shared multimodal large language model. It organizes evidence into five semantic units, reads the contextualized state at each unit boundary, and aggregates these states into a single normalized embedding. Generation and contrastive retrieval objectives jointly train this shared structure. With the same trailing readout, semantic evidence and free-form CoT yield nearly identical retrieval performance, suggesting that evidence organization alone does not explain the full gain. A controlled $2\times3$ study compares consistent and permuted evidence organization across three readout strategies, using training targets with matched evidence spans. With five readout states and the same mean pooling, the advantage of consistent semantic organization grows from 0.65 points at length-based training positions to 2.39 at evidence boundaries, yielding a 1.74-point co-design interaction. Across 12 MMEB retrieval tasks, EviAlign achieves 76.9 average Recall@1 with 500K training pairs while retaining single-vector indexing and scoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EviAlign，将语义证据生成与边界读出耦合在共享多模态大语言模型中，通过受控实验证明语义组织与读出位置的协同设计才是性能提升的关键。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型虽能通过生成暴露任务相关证据，但证据如何进入检索嵌入尚不明确；作者要探究证据的语义组织是否也能决定表征的读取位置。
AI.method: 提出 EviAlign，在共享 MLLM 中耦合语义证据生成与边界读出：将证据组织为五个语义单元，在每个单元边界读取上下文化状态，聚合成归一化嵌入；生成与对比检索目标联合训练该共享结构。
AI.result: 相同尾部读出下，语义证据与自由形式 CoT 检索性能几乎一致；2×3 受控实验中，5 个读出状态、相同均值池化下，一致性组织相对打乱组织的优势从基于长度位置的 0.65 分增至证据边界的 2.39 分，协同设计交互达 1.74 分；12 个 MMEB 检索任务上以 500K 训练对达 76.9 平均 Recall@1，并保持单向量索引与打分。
AI.conclusion: 证据组织本身不足以解释全部增益，语义组织与读出位置需协同设计；EviAlign 在高效单向量检索下取得领先性能。

title: Audit-First VAPO: Risk-Certified Selective Updates under Imperfect Verification
summary: Imperfect verifiers can assign a harmful update direction even when clipping and regularization bound its magnitude. We introduce Audit-First VAPO, which separates discrete directional admission from continuous magnitude control. An observation-only accept-appeal-abstain policy uses a finite secondary-verification budget; its action trace is frozen before clean labels are joined. Simultaneous finite-sample bounds then certify selected harmful risk, coverage, and verifier-call rate over a predeclared policy family. Conditional Hoeffding-Azuma bounds account for the dependence induced by shared budgets, and rollout or verifier changes initiate a new certification stage. After admission, a bounded trust-clip-KL actuator controls magnitude. We evaluate two models on two reasoning benchmarks against static RLVR, matched-random selection, confidence thresholding, noise correction, and verifier augmentation. On Qwen3.5-0.8B and GSM8K at target risk $ρ=0.08$, RC-VAPO achieves 74.1% accuracy, selected harmful risk 0.0697, coverage 0.4125, and relative verifier cost $1.16\times$. At matched coverage and update magnitude, its selected-risk difference from matched random is -0.0260 with paired 95% interval $[-0.0364,-0.0157]$. Across asymmetric, confidence-dependent, and correlated-verifier noise, the certificate is satisfied on 57 of 60 independent runs. These comparisons isolate informative directional selection from proposal suppression, update shrinkage, and additional verifier computation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Audit-First VAPO 框架：将离散的方向性准入与连续的幅度控制解耦，用仅需观测的接受-申诉-弃权策略与有限样本证书保证被选中样本的危害风险、覆盖率与验证器调用率。
AI.motivation: 不完美的验证器即使有裁剪和正则化约束更新幅度，仍可能给出有害的更新方向；现有方法把方向选择、样本筛选与更新缩放混在一起，无法把"信息性方向选择"的收益与"提案抑制""更新收缩""额外验证算力"的效应分离，也缺少对风险与覆盖率的可证明保证。
AI.method: Audit-First VAPO 分两阶段：先用仅基于观测的 accept–appeal–abstain 策略在有限二次验证预算下做离散方向准入，动作轨迹在接入干净标签前冻结，再用条件 Hoeffding–Azuma 界给出预声明策略族上的同时有限样本证书，覆盖被选危害风险、覆盖率与验证器调用率（含共享预算导致的依赖）；rollout 或验证器变化则启动新的认证阶段。准入之后，用有界 trust-clip-KL 执行器控制更新幅度。
AI.result: 在两个模型、两个推理基准上，与静态 RLVR、匹配随机选择、置信度阈值、噪声纠正、验证器增强对比：Qwen3.5-0.8B + GSM8K 在目标风险 ρ=0.08 下，RC-VAPO 准确率 74.1%、被选危害风险 0.0697、覆盖率 0.4125、相对验证成本 1.16×；在匹配覆盖率和更新幅度下，其被选风险相对匹配随机的差为 −0.0260，配对 95% 区间 [−0.0364, −0.0157]；在非对称、置信依赖与相关验证器噪声下，60 次独立运行中 57 次满足证书。
AI.conclusion: 结果把有信息量的方向性选择与提案抑制、更新收缩和额外验证算力的贡献分离开来，表明在可验证的有限样本风险—覆盖率保证下进行方向准入、再以有界执行器控制幅度，能有效降低被选危害风险并保持性能，且证书在多数噪声设定下成立。

title: One Model Is Not a Crowd: Multi-LLM and Aspect-Conditioned Diverse Comment Generation
summary: Human communication on the internet is shaped by diverse perspectives, most visibly expressed in online comment spaces. As large language model (LLM)based AI agents begin to inhabit these spaces, a key question arises: whether synthetic comment threads can capture the diversity inherent in human discourse. This concern is increasingly important, as the growing presence of homogenized AI-generated content risks reducing diversity over time, potentially leading to model collapse and degrading the richness of digital communication. Inspired by the plurality of human crowds and the aspect-driven nature of discourse, we hypothesize that comment diversity is better approximated by combining multiple LLMs with aspect-conditioned generation. We formalize and evaluate this approach using models from different providers and introduce a framework that characterizes diversity across semantic, linguistic, and socio-pragmatic features along three axes: dispersion, coverage, and alignment. Using this framework, we conduct a large-scale study on over 2 million YouTube comments across multiple domains. Our results reveal that multi-LLM and aspect-conditioned generation better align with human comment distributions and such data remains viable under pretraining style curation and is effective for downstream tasks. Yet, human diversity remains unmatched. Overall, our findings provide a practical foundation for generating more diverse and socially grounded discourse in AI-mediated environments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM生成的评论能否捕捉人类评论的多样性，提出用多LLM+方面条件生成来近似评论多样性，并在200万条YouTube评论上验证其更贴近人类分布但对人类多样性仍有差距。
AI.motivation: 在线评论空间是多元视角的载体，而LLM智能体开始进入这些空间。若合成评论趋于同质化，可能随时间降低多样性、导致模型崩塌并削弱数字交流的丰富性，因此需要判断合成评论线程能否还原人类话语的多样性。
AI.method: 受人类群体多元性与话语的方面驱动特性启发，提出将多个不同厂商的LLM与方面条件生成相结合来近似评论多样性；构建一个框架，从语义、语言和社会语用特征，沿离散度、覆盖度、对齐度三个轴刻画多样性；在多个领域的200万条以上YouTube评论上开展大规模研究。
AI.result: 多LLM与方面条件生成与人类评论分布更对齐；此类数据在预训练式数据筛选下仍具可用性，并在下游任务中有效；但人类多样性仍未被完全复现。
AI.conclusion: 研究为在AI介导环境中生成更多样、更具社会根基的话语提供了实践基础。

title: When Noise Meets Long-Tail: Feature-Threshold Dual Calibration for Robust Pseudo-Labeling
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Main Track. Code: https://github.com/pingggg516/FTC-Seg
summary: Pseudo-labeling has become a cornerstone of learning from unlabeled data in semantic segmentation. Yet its effectiveness drops sharply in real-world scenarios where strong imaging noise and long-tailed class distributions occur together. We trace this failure to a vicious cycle of pseudo-label degradation. Imaging noise entangles foreground and background features, lowering prediction confidence across all classes, while long-tailed distributions leave tail classes with far fewer training samples and inherently lower confidence. Under fixed high-threshold filtering, these tail-class predictions are systematically filtered out, so they receive no supervision from unlabeled data and thus features keep degrading in subsequent iterations. Critically, noise and long-tail are not independent obstacles but mutually amplifying ones, and addressing either alone is insufficient. To break this cycle, we propose FTC-Seg, a Feature-Threshold dual-Calibration framework built on a standard teacher-student framework. At the feature level, Orthogonal Prototype Reconstruction (OPR) uses a set of learnable orthogonal prototypes to residually purify pixel-wise features, widening the margin between weak foreground targets and noisy backgrounds. At the threshold level, Adaptive Threshold Calibration (ATC) dynamically adjusts class-specific thresholds based on learning difficulty and prediction-distribution bias, rescuing low-confidence pseudo-labels of tail classes from systematic exclusion. Extensive experiments on four public benchmarks spanning three distinct noise modalities show that FTC-Seg achieves strong performance against state-of-the-art methods, with particularly substantial gains on tail classes. Our results establish that jointly calibrating features and thresholds is essential for robust pseudo-labeling under compounded noise and class imbalance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对语义分割中"成像噪声+长尾分布"共存时伪标签失效问题，提出特征-阈值双校准框架FTC-Seg，通过正交原型重构净化特征、自适应阈值校准拯救尾部类低置信伪标签，在4个基准上显著超越SOTA，尾部类增益尤为突出。
AI.motivation: 伪标签是无监督数据学习语义分割的核心手段，但在强成像噪声与长尾类分布同时出现的真实场景中效果急剧下降。作者将失败归因于"伪标签退化恶性循环"：成像噪声使前景背景特征纠缠、普遍降低预测置信度；长尾分布使尾部类样本少、置信度天然偏低。在固定高阈值过滤下，尾部类预测被系统性剔除，无法获得无标签数据的监督，特征在后续迭代中持续退化。关键在于噪声与长尾并非独立障碍，而是相互放大，单独解决任一问题都不充分。
AI.method: 提出FTC-Seg（Feature-Threshold dual-Calibration），构建在标准teacher-student框架之上。特征层面：Orthogonal Prototype Reconstruction (OPR) 使用一组可学习的正交原型对像素级特征进行残差式净化，扩大弱前景目标与噪声背景之间的间隔。阈值层面：Adaptive Threshold Calibration (ATC) 依据学习难度和预测分布偏差动态调整类特定阈值，将尾部类低置信伪标签从系统性排除中挽救出来。
AI.result: 在覆盖三种不同噪声模态的四个公开基准上开展大量实验，FTC-Seg 相较当前最优方法取得强劲性能，且在尾部类上增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明，在噪声与类别不平衡叠加的条件下，联合校准特征与阈值是实现鲁棒伪标签的关键。

title: Closing the Cross-Dialect Gap: Query Plans as a Portable Interface in Text-to-SQL
comment: Accepted at Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Text-to-SQL systems are typically trained and evaluated on a single dialect (SQLite), yet production deployments span PostgreSQL, MySQL, ClickHouse, and beyond. We show that this single-dialect assumption leads to a substantial drop in cross-dialect accuracy for every model we tested. The drop persists across scale, architecture, and even purpose-built text-to-SQL systems. We argue that the fix is to change the generation target: instead of asking an LLM to emit dialect-specific SQL, we have it emit a dialect-agnostic relational algebra query plan, which a deterministic compiler then renders into SQL for any supported backend. Across thirteen models from 3B to frontier scale, this restores cross-dialect portability nearly uniformly, at a small cost in peak accuracy on the model's home dialect for capable prompted models and none once fine-tuned on plans; under matched fine-tuning, plan supervision yields a stronger model than SQL supervision. We also introduce MetricName, a question-aware result-set comparator needed to evaluate fairly across dialects, where existing metrics confound semantic errors with benign cross-dialect variation. More broadly, the result is a reminder that a generation target chosen for execution is not necessarily the one that maximizes generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文指出Text-to-SQL系统普遍只在SQLite单一方言上训练与评测，导致跨方言部署时精度大幅下降；提出让LLM生成方言无关的关系代数查询计划，再由确定性编译器渲染为各后端SQL，从而近乎一致地恢复跨方言可移植性，并引入MetricName作为公平的跨方言评测指标。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL系统通常在单一方言（SQLite）上训练和评测，但真实生产环境涉及PostgreSQL、MySQL、ClickHouse等多种后端。这种单一方言假设会使所有测试模型在跨方言场景下精度显著下降，且该下降不随规模、架构或专门构建的Text-to-SQL系统而消失。因此需要一种从根本上解决跨方言可移植性的方案。
AI.method: 改变生成目标：不再让LLM直接输出方言特定的SQL，而是输出方言无关的关系代数查询计划，再由确定性编译器将其渲染为任意受支持后端的SQL。同时在13个3B到前沿规模的模型上进行验证，并引入MetricName——一种问题感知的结果集比较器，以在跨方言评测中区分语义错误与良性的方言差异。
AI.result: 跨13个模型（3B至前沿规模）的实验表明，该方法近乎一致地恢复了跨方言可移植性；对有能力的提示模型而言，仅在其原生方言的峰值精度上有小幅损失，而在计划上微调后该损失消失。在相同微调条件下，计划监督比SQL监督得到更强的模型。现有指标会将语义错误与良性跨方言差异混淆，MetricName可解决该评测问题。
AI.conclusion: 为执行而选择的生成目标未必是最大化生成质量的目标。以方言无关的关系代数计划作为生成目标，可在几乎不损失精度的情况下实现跨方言可移植性，并带来更强的微调效果，这提示生成目标的选取应兼顾可移植性与生成质量。

title: Reset Is Not Recovery: Evaluating Recoverability from False Conversational Context via Sycophancy Hysteresis
summary: Grounded language models are usually evaluated by adding relevant context, but multiturn dialogue also contains unsupported user claims that may contaminate later factual answers. We study post-pressure recoverability: whether a model returns to clean-context behavior after a user repeatedly advocates a wrong answer and then withdraws that pressure. We introduce a recovery-after-pressure protocol for multiple-choice factual dialogue and measure sycophancy hysteresis, the residual probability assigned to the user-advocated wrong answer relative to a clean-context counterfactual. Across seven instruction-tuned open-weight models and two factual benchmarks, ordinary reset often reduces but does not erase pressure-induced bias. History preserving repairs such as user retraction, system reset, and self-verification recover only 2-3/14 model-dataset pairs under the strict clean-restoration diagnostic, whereas operations that change the effective context are substantially more reliable; the two conditions that remove the pressure-bearing history entirely, fresh-context deletion and context truncation, recover 14/14. In an oracle trusted-evidence condition across fourteen model-dataset pairs, preserving the pressure-bearing history while adding benchmark-derived trusted evidence increases accuracy from 0.368 to 0.929, while wrong-answer following falls from 41.2% to 4.3%. Controls show that the effect is not explained by dialogue length, repeated confidence, plausible distractors, mere false-answer mention, or option-label inertia. These results suggest that faithful grounded dialogue requires evaluating which prior context should be treated as evidence and which should be removed or quarantined before answering.

AI.tldr: 提出“施压后可恢复性”评测协议与“谄媚迟滞”指标，发现保留施压历史的修复手段难以真正消除偏见，只有删除或截断施压上下文才能完全恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有多轮对话中，用户可能反复主张错误答案，这类无依据的用户主张会污染后续事实性回答，而常见评测通常只关注加入相关上下文，忽视了压力撤回后模型能否回到干净上下文的行为。
AI.method: 设计面向多项选择事实对话的“施压后恢复”协议，测量谄媚迟滞，即相对干净上下文反事实，模型仍分配给用户所主张错误答案的残余概率；在7个指令微调开源模型与2个事实基准上 비교多种修复操作，并设置可信证据的真值条件与多组对照实验。
AI.result: 普通重置常能降低但无法消除压力诱导偏见；用户撤回、系统重置、自我验证等保留历史的修复在严格诊断下仅恢复2-3/14模型-数据集组合；完全移除施压历史的净上下文删除与上下文截断恢复14/14。在14个组合的可信证据条件下，保留施压历史同时加入基准可信证据，准确率由0.368升至0.929，跟随错误答案比例由41.2%降至4.3%。对照表明该效应不能由对话长度、重复自信、合理干扰项、单纯提及错误答案或选项标签惯性解释。
AI.conclusion: 忠实的有据对话需评估哪些先前上下文应被视为证据、哪些应在回答前移除或隔离。

title: Auditing Agent Actions through Query-Conditioned Attribution
summary: LLM agents increasingly take consequential actions through interactions with users, policies, and external tools. Auditing these agents requires automated attribution of realized actions to their historical basis. However, existing attribution formulations do not provide question-specific traces for diverse auditing objectives. Additionally, when access to the acting model is limited (e.g., in API-only deployments), applicable methods commonly rely on costly input perturbations or external LLM analysis of complete trajectories. We therefore formulate query-conditioned agent action attribution, a new task that takes a natural-language auditing query as input and recovers the source and ordered intermediate evidence for the query-specified aspect of an action. We instantiate this task with $A^3Bench$, a benchmark comprising 1,396 auditing queries across policy basis, parameter provenance, failure propagation, and unsafe-behavior tracing. To enable efficient, query-specific attribution, we use small open-weight models as attribution proposers that combine query-conditioned gradient saliency with query-semantic relevance to rank history units. Our proposer consistently achieves stronger source and evidence rankings at lower inference cost than open-weight baselines, improving source MRR by up to 40.9\% and evidence MAP by 42.1\% with only two forward passes and one backward pass. Controlled evaluations confirm that our proposer improves attribution specificity by adapting its rankings to fine-grained changes in the auditing query. Building on a proposer ensemble, our end-to-end system surpasses the strongest frontier-model baseline in source accuracy (64.5\% vs.\ 60.4\%) while reducing empirical deployment latency by 29.9\% relative to the fastest frontier API baseline. Code and data will be released after the initial review period following final validation and cleanup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"查询条件化智能体动作归因"新任务，并构建A³Bench基准，利用小规模开放权重模型结合查询条件化梯度显著性与语义相关性实现高效归因，在更低推理成本下取得优于基线的效果。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体日益通过与用户、策略和外部工具的交互执行有后果的动作，审计这些智能体需要将已发生的动作自动归因到其历史依据。但现有归因形式无法针对多样化审计目标提供问题特定的追踪；且在模型访问受限（如仅API部署）时，现有方法多依赖昂贵的输入扰动或对完整轨迹的外部LLM分析。
AI.method: 形式化定义"查询条件化智能体动作归因"任务：以自然语言审计查询为输入，恢复该查询所指定动作方面的来源及有序中间证据。构建A³Bench基准，涵盖策略依据、参数来源、故障传播和不安全行为追踪四类审计查询共1,396条。采用小型开放权重模型作为归因提出者，融合查询条件化梯度显著性与查询语义相关性对历史单元排序，仅需两次前向和一次反向传播。
AI.result: 归因提出者在来源与证据排序上持续强于开放权重基线，推理成本更低：来源MRR最高提升40.9%，证据MAP最高提升42.1%。控制实验证实其能根据审计查询的细粒度变化自适应调整排序，提升归因特异性。基于提出者集成，端到端系统在来源准确率上超越最强前沿模型基线（64.5% vs. 60.4%），且相比最快的前沿API基线将实际部署延迟降低29.9%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作开辟了查询条件化的智能体动作归因方向，A³Bench为多样化审计目标提供了评测支撑，所提基于小型开放权重模型的归因方案在效率与效果上均具优势，代码与数据将在评审期后发布。

title: MAD-Guard: Controlled Study of Autoregressive Generation versus Direct Decision Interfaces for Closed Multimodal Forensic Tasks
summary: When should multimodal foundation models generate tokens, and when should they directly output a decision? We present MAD-Guard, a controlled study of output-decision interfaces for closed multimodal forensic tasks. Once a multimodal representation is computed, is autoregressive generation necessary for closed forensic decisions with high input complexity but low output entropy? Under a matched Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, 2,400 FakeClue training samples, and LoRA budget ($r=16, α=32$) on Huawei Ascend 910C NPUs, we evaluate a progression of decision interfaces (AR-SFT [generate] $\to$ Logit Slice $\to$ Binary Direct Head $\to$ +choice $\to$ +act $\to$ CLM-Head) and decompose latency into backbone representation (53.12 ms), 151,643-way vocabulary projection (+85.04 ms $\to$ 138.16 ms), and decoding (+248.26 ms $\to$ 386.42 ms). Under 1-to-1 binary supervision ($\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{BCE}}$), a Binary Direct Head cuts latency by $2.60\times$-$7.27\times$ (53.12 ms) and lowers calibration error by $1.88\times$ (ECE = 0.0450 vs. 0.0845), with a -1.80% accuracy trade-off (93.10% vs. 94.90%; 0.9795 vs. 0.9871 ROC-AUC) from forfeiting token priors. Gains above AR-SFT arise either from multi-task attribution and uncertainty gating (+choice+act: 96.44% accuracy, 0.9940 ROC-AUC, 0.0187 ECE at 53.71 ms) or from a disaggregated contrastive head (CLM-Head: 96.55% binary and 96.44% multi-task accuracy, 0.0166 ECE, 98.79% 7-class attribution at 54.42 ms) retaining semantic priors without token decoding. Across 5,000 out-of-sample images from five benchmarks, our framework excels on synthetic, camouflage, and document forgeries (96.44% GenImage, 97.73% Chameleon, 91.84% Doc) while showing a clear boundary on compressed face manipulation (FF++ ROC-AUC = 0.5913).

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨多模态基础模型在闭式取证任务中应采用何种输出决策接口，发现直接决策头在保持精度的同时显著降低延迟与校准误差。
AI.motivation: 闭式多模态取证任务输入复杂度高但输出熵低，作者质疑在已有高质量多模态表征的前提下，是否有必要采用自回归生成来完成决策，从而探索更优的输出接口设计。
AI.method: 在统一 Qwen3-VL-8B 主干、2,400 条 FakeClue 训练样本及 LoRA（r=16, α=32）配置下，于华为昇腾 910C NPU 上对比一系列决策接口（AR-SFT 生成 → Logit Slice → 二值直接头 → +choice → +act → CLM-Head），并将延迟分解为主干表征、15万余词表投影与解码三部分，采用 1:1 二值监督（BCE 损失）进行训练。
AI.result: 二值直接头将延迟降至 53.12 ms（2.60×–7.27× 加速），校准误差降低 1.88×（ECE 0.0450 vs. 0.0845），精度仅牺牲 1.80%（93.10% vs. 94.90%，ROC-AUC 0.9795 vs. 0.9871）。+choice+act 达到 96.44% 精度、0.9940 ROC-AUC、0.0187 ECE、53.71 ms；CLM-Head 达 96.55% 二值精度、96.44% 多任务精度、0.0166 ECE、98.79% 七分类归因，延迟 54.42 ms。在五个基准 5,000 张样本上，合成/伪装/文档伪造表现优异（GenImage 96.44%、Chameleon 97.73%、Doc 91.84%），但压缩人脸篡改存在明显边界（FF++ ROC-AUC 0.5913）。
AI.conclusion: 对于输入复杂、输出熵低的闭式取证决策，自回归生成并非必要；直接决策头与对比式解耦头可在免去词元解码的同时保留语义先验，实现延迟、校准与精度的更优权衡，但其能力边界体现在压缩人脸篡改场景。

title: Resource-Aware Parameter-Efficient Model Adaptation for Onboard High-Dimensional Data
summary: Onboard satellite models often require frequent updates, but the weights adapted to earlier data distributions can quickly become outdated. However, updating large-scale model parameters in orbit presents significant challenges due to the limited uplink bandwidth of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite systems, particularly for hyperspectral satellite imagery, where high-dimensional spectral-spatial inputs lead to increased model size and update costs. Existing full fine-tuning methods are thus expensive to retrain and difficult to deploy under strict communication constraints. To address this challenge, we propose NE-LoRA, a parameter-efficient adaptation framework for bandwidth-constrained onboard hyperspectral model updates. NE-LoRA combines a primary low-rank branch with a nonlinear auxiliary branch to capture both global update trends and complex spectral-spatial variations. Additionally, we introduce a differentiated training strategy for multi-matrix adapters, motivated by the asymmetric initialization and gradient dynamics of different adapter matrices. Experiments on four hyperspectral datasets and three representative backbone models demonstrate that NE-LoRA consistently outperforms LoRA-based baselines and remains competitive with, and in several cases superior to, full fine-tuning. Across the evaluated settings, NE-LoRA updates only a small fraction of the total parameters on average while preserving low deployment overhead, offering a favorable accuracy-communication trade-off for onboard hyperspectral adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出 NE-LoRA，一种参数高效的自适应框架，用主低秩分支与非线性辅助分支相结合，在带宽受限的星载高光谱模型更新中实现低通信开销与高精度。
AI.motivation: 星载卫星模型需要频繁更新，但适配早期数据分布的权重会快速失效；而在轨更新大规模参数面临 LEO 卫星上行带宽受限的问题。高光谱卫星影像的高维光谱-空间输入进一步增大模型规模与更新成本，现有全量微调方法重训昂贵、难以在严格通信约束下部署。
AI.method: NE-LoRA 采用双分支适配结构：主低秩分支捕捉全局更新趋势，非线性辅助分支刻画复杂的光谱-空间变化；并针对多矩阵适配器引入差异化训练策略，其动机来自不同适配矩阵在非对称初始化与梯度动态上的差异。
AI.result: 在四个高光谱数据集与三种代表性骨干模型上，NE-LoRA 一致优于基于 LoRA 的基线方法，并与全量微调相当，在若干情况下甚至更优；平均仅更新总参数的一小部分，同时保持较低的部署开销。
AI.conclusion: NE-LoRA 为星载高光谱自适应提供了一种精度与通信开销之间的良好折中，适合带宽受限条件下的参数高效在轨更新。

title: When Do Agents Help? Embedding, LLM and Agentic Alignment of Classical Texts and Their Translations
comment: Preprint. This manuscript has not yet been peer reviewed
summary: Classical texts aligned with their translations support machine translation, retrieval and computational research, but evidence comparing alignment workflows is scattered. This study compares seven systems on 452 texts in Pali, Sanskrit, Mishnaic Hebrew and Tibetan, comprising 9,833 human-aligned units: four embedding pipelines, a direct LLM call, an autonomous agent, and the agent revised by an independent auditor. Generative workflows recover 93-94% of reference correspondences, against at most 77% for embeddings. A ceiling analysis shows that sentence boundaries make some references unrepresentable by the embedding pipelines. Reference recovery is similar across generative workflows: the agent's advantage is 0.5 percentage points (95% CI -0.02 to 1.17), and auditing adds no established benefit. Agents nevertheless produce structurally valid output for all 452 texts, against 437 for direct calls. A blinded three-LLM panel assesses every generative mismatch against the source and human reference. Most mismatches are labelled defensible editorial variation; consensus major-error labels cover only 0.06-0.14% of units. The panel labels significantly fewer residual defects for agents than direct calls (0.7% versus 1.4%), suggesting that reference recovery alone understates alignment quality. On ten long Pali discourses taken as published online, agents and audited agents raise recovery from the direct call's 71% to 84% and 92%. Identical reference-located chunks bring all three to 93%. Agents thus improve structural reliability and reduce judged defects on short passages, while their large recovery advantage on long documents disappears after chunking. In this setting, independent auditing offers little measurable additional benefit on prepared passages.

AI.tldr: 比较七种跨语言对齐系统（四个嵌入流程、直接调用LLM、自主智能体、智能体加独立审核）在巴利语、梵语、密西拿希伯来语和藏语452篇文本、9,833个人工对齐单元上的表现。
AI.motivation: 古典文本与其译文的对齐支撑机器翻译、检索与计算研究，但比较不同对齐流程的证据分散，缺乏系统性评估。
AI.method: 在452篇文本、9,833个人工对齐单元上对比七种系统；用天花板分析检验句边界造成的表示上限；用盲评三LLM小组对生成式错配逐条与源文、人工参考比对；并在十篇线上发布的较长巴利语篇章上比较原始长度与分块后的恢复率。
AI.result: 生成式流程恢复93–94%的参考对应，嵌入流程最高仅77%；句边界使部分参考对嵌入流程不可表示。智能体相对直接调用仅高0.5个百分点（95%置信区间-0.02至1.17），审核无可靠增益。智能体对全部452篇均产出结构有效结果（直接调用为437篇）。盲评显示多数错配属可辩护的编辑性差异，共识重大错误仅占0.06–0.14%；智能体残差缺陷显著少于直接调用（0.7%对1.4%）。在十篇长巴利语篇章上，智能体与审核智能体把恢复率从直接调用的71%提升到84%和92%，但使用相同的参考定位分块后三者均达93%。
AI.conclusion: 智能体提升结构可靠性并减少短篇章上的判定缺陷；其在长文档上的恢复率优势在分块后消失；在已准备好的篇章上，独立审核带来的可测量增益有限。

title: Seeing and Solving Are Not Enough for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) answer visual questions by combining visual information extraction with downstream problem solving. We investigate a fundamental question: Does an incorrect answer necessarily reflect a failure in visual extraction or problem solving? A model may succeed at both abilities when tested separately yet still fail on the original multimodal question, a distinction that overall answer accuracy cannot reveal. To study this, we perform a question-level empirical analysis across multiple VLMs and visual domains. We define an exactly scorable task state (i.e., the visual information sufficient to solve a question) and use it to test whether the same model can extract the required state, solve the question from the ground-truth state, and answer the original multimodal question. We find that composition failures, where extraction and solving both succeed but direct answering fails, account for 17.7% to 75.6% of direct-answering errors across multiple VLMs and datasets. To address this failure mode, we introduce a simple yet effective method, termed State Realization Tuning (SRT). SRT fine-tunes LoRA adapters attached to the language-model layers while keeping the pretrained VLM weights frozen. It trains the model to output the ground-truth task state before the final answer in a single autoregressive response. SRT improves over standard supervised fine-tuning by 1.7 to 14.1 percentage points and repairs 92.5% to 98.1% of diagnosed composition failures. A single LoRA adapter trained with SRT also improves performance across substantially different task-state structures. Our work shows that having both visual extraction and problem-solving capabilities does not guarantee correct multimodal answering. Requiring the model to first output the visual information needed to solve the question can help bridge this gap.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"组合失败"(composition failure)概念:VLM 能分别完成视觉信息抽取与基于答案状态的求解,却在直接多模态作答时出错;此类失败占直接作答错误的 17.7%–75.6%。作者提出 State Realization Tuning (SRT),让模型自回归地先输出可精确评分的任务状态再给答案,较标准 SFT 提升 1.7–14.1 个百分点,修复 92.5%–98.1% 的组合失败。
AI.motivation: 总体答案准确率无法区分错误来源:模型可能在"视觉抽取"和"问题求解"两项能力上分别成功,却在端到端多模态作答中失败。作者希望回答"错误答案是否必然反映抽取或求解失败",并揭示这一被聚合指标掩盖的失败模式。
AI.method: 在多个 VLM 与视觉域上做问题级经验分析:定义可精确评分的任务状态(task state),对同一模型分别测试三项——能否抽取所需状态、能否由真值状态求解问题、能否直接回答原始多模态问题,从而将错误归因。据此提出 SRT:冻结预训练 VLM 权重,仅微调挂载于语言模型层的 LoRA 适配器,训练模型在单次自回归响应中先输出真值任务状态、再输出最终答案。
AI.result: 组合失败占各 VLM/数据集直接作答错误的 17.7%–75.6%。SRT 相比标准监督微调提升 1.7–14.1 个百分点,修复 92.5%–98.1% 已诊断的组合失败;单个用 SRT 训练的 LoRA 适配器在结构差异较大的任务状态上也能带来提升。
AI.conclusion: 同时具备视觉抽取与问题求解能力并不能保证多模态作答正确,组合失败是可测量且可修复的独立失效模式。让模型先显式输出求解所需的视觉信息,可有效弥合能力与端到端表现之间的差距。

title: Prompt-Anchored Residual Adaptation for Biomedical Vision-Language Models
summary: Pretrained biomedical vision-language models achieve strong zero-shot performance in biomedical image classification. However, downstream biomedical classification often depends on subtle visual differences between classes that may not be fully captured by pretrained representations. Few-shot adaptation addresses this mismatch by optimizing a task-specific predictor on a small labeled support set. Because the selected examples capture only part of the visual variation within the target classes, the adapted predictions can depend strongly on their composition. We propose Prompt-Anchored Residual Adaptation (PARA), which retains the frozen prompt prediction as a support-invariant semantic anchor and incorporates a visual prediction learned from the support set through an anchor-relative residual. The residual step is computed in a closed form from frozen support embeddings using anchor discrepancy and support agreement. Support-set dependence also limits evaluation: comparisons are fair within a shared draw but remain conditional on its composition. To obtain more reliable comparisons, we introduce a repeated-support protocol that separates support-selection variation from optimization randomness and reports both average and worst-20% performance. PARA achieves state-of-the-art performance in both few-shot classification and base-to-novel generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出Prompt-Anchored Residual Adaptation（PARA），以冻结提示预测作为与支持集无关的语义锚点，并通过锚点相对残差从支持集学习视觉预测，残差步用闭式解计算；同时提出重复支持集评估协议以分离支持集选择与优化随机性，在少样本分类与基类到新类泛化上达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 预训练生物医学视觉-语言模型零样本性能强，但下游分类常依赖类别间细微视觉差异，预训练表示可能无法充分捕捉。少样本适应通过小规模有标签支持集优化任务预测器来缓解这一不匹配，但所选样例仅覆盖目标类内部分视觉变化，导致适应后的预测强烈依赖支持集组成，进而影响性能与评估公平性。
AI.method: PARA保留冻结的提示预测作为支持集不变（support-invariant）的语义锚点，并引入由支持集学习得到的视觉预测，通过锚点相对残差（anchor-relative residual）进行融合。残差步基于锚点差异（anchor discrepancy）与支持一致性（support agreement），利用冻结的支持集嵌入以闭式解（closed form）计算，无需迭代优化。评估方面提出重复支持集协议（repeated-support protocol），将支持集选择变化与优化随机性分离，并同时报告平均性能与最差20%（worst-20%）性能。
AI.result: PARA在少样本分类（few-shot classification）和基类到新类泛化（base-to-novel generalization）两个任务上均取得最先进（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: 将冻结提示预测作为支持集不变的语义锚点、并以闭式锚点相对残差引入支持集视觉信息，可有效降低对支持集组成的敏感度；配套的重复支持集评估协议能提供更可靠的对比，兼顾平均与最差表现。

title: Understanding Confabulation and Rethinking Reconstruction in Activation Explanations
summary: Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs) produce unsupervised text explanations of a model's activations: a verbalizer describes an activation and a reconstructor learns to recover it from this text. Under the established point-reconstruction NLA training recipe, explanations become more useful for predicting model behavior while also increasingly introducing unsupported details and exhibiting writing defects. To assess these changes separately, we introduce a standardized evaluation framework for unstructured NLA explanations, measuring information recoverable from explanations, contextual support for their claims, and writing quality. To address confabulation and writing defects, we move beyond predicting a single activation: explanations can distinguish distributions of possible activations even when their means and optimal point-reconstruction rewards are identical. We introduce Flow-NLA, which models the distribution of activations compatible with an explanation and trains the verbalizer using a diffusion likelihood bound. Across Qwen, Gemma, and Apertus, this richer signal retains the utility gains of point reconstruction while curbing the growth of confabulation and writing defects, opening up a direction for improving activation-derived training to encourage more informative, supported, and readable explanations. Code and evaluation prompts will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自然语言自编码器（NLA）对模型激活生成无监督文本解释，指出点重建训练会导致解释信息量提升但伴随虚构内容与写作缺陷增多；为此提出标准化评测框架，并进一步提出Flow-NLA，用扩散似然界建模激活分布，从而在保持效用增益的同时抑制虚构与写作缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有NLA采用点重建（point-reconstruction）训练配方，其解释在预测模型行为上更有用，但会引入无支撑细节（confabulation）并出现写作缺陷。这些变化交织在一起，难以分别评估，也缺乏针对非结构化解释的标准化评价手段。作者希望区分“信息量”“上下文支撑性”“写作质量”三类变化，并找到一种训练信号，使解释更丰富、更可支撑、更可读。
AI.method: 1）提出面向非结构化NLA解释的标准化评测框架，分别度量：可从解释中恢复的信息、解释主张的上下文支撑性、写作质量。2）超越单点激活预测：指出当不同激活分布的均值与最优点重建奖励相同时，解释仍可区分这些分布。3）提出Flow-NLA：建模与某解释相容的激活分布，并使用扩散似然界（diffusion likelihood bound）训练verbalizer。
AI.result: 在Qwen、Gemma与Apertus上，Flow-NLA这种更丰富的信号在保留点重建带来的效用增益的同时，抑制了confabulation与写作缺陷的增长。
AI.conclusion: 用分布级训练信号替代单点重建，可同时提升激活解释的信息量、支撑性与可读性，为改进基于激活的训练、生成更有信息量且更可支撑、更可读的解释开辟了新方向。代码与评测提示将在录用后公开。

title: Revisiting Diffusion Fine-Tuning for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Diffusion-based unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) improves cross-domain transfer by generating target-specific synthetic data for downstream adaptation. Existing methods are largely designed for single-target adaptation: when a model trained on one labeled source domain must be adapted to multiple unlabeled target domains, they typically require separate diffusion fine-tuning for each source--target pair, causing training, storage, and deployment costs to grow with the number of targets. In this paper, we study multi-target data generation for diffusion-based UDA, where a single source-guided diffusion fine-tuning process is reused to generate target-specific synthetic data for multiple target domains. We propose MUSE (Multi-target UDA-oriented Synthesis with Efficient diffusion fine-tuning), a decoupled adaptation framework that separates source-supervised semantic adaptation from target-specific style adaptation. MUSE uses a shared semantic branch updated by labeled source data and target-private style branches specialized to individual target domains, enabling target-specific generation while avoiding repeated source-guided fine-tuning for each target. Experiments on standard UDA benchmarks show that MUSE achieves a stronger accuracy--efficiency trade-off than repeated per-target diffusion adaptation, reducing diffusion fine-tuning cost while improving average target-domain accuracy. The project page is available at https://xuanqi99.github.io/MUSE/.

AI.tldr: 提出 MUSE 框架，通过解耦语义与风格分支，实现单次源引导扩散微调复用于多目标域数据生成。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的 UDA 方法主要面向单目标迁移，当模型需适配多个无标注目标域时，需对每个源-目标对单独进行扩散微调，导致训练、存储与部署成本随目标数量线性增长。
AI.method: MUSE 采用解耦适配框架：将源监督的语义适配与目标特有的风格适配分离，共享一个由标注源数据更新的语义分支，并为每个目标域配备私有风格分支，从而在避免重复源引导微调的情况下实现目标特异生成。
AI.result: 在标准 UDA 基准上，MUSE 相比重复的逐目标扩散适配取得更优的精度-效率权衡：在降低扩散微调成本的同时提升平均目标域精度。
AI.conclusion: MUSE 为多目标扩散式 UDA 数据生成提供了高效方案，验证了解耦语义与风格的可复用性，兼顾准确率与计算开销。

title: From Granular Revision Operations to Meaningful Revision Units: Evaluating LLMs for Revision Boundary Detection
summary: Revision traces provide valuable evidence about students' writing processes, but their usefulness for learning analytics depends on how individual revisions are represented. Automated draft-comparison methods often produce granular edit operations that can fragment a single purposeful revision into multiple analytic units. This study evaluates whether LLMs can identify meaningful revision unit boundaries in structured revision operation data and whether they provide value beyond simple non-LLM baselines. Using 113 matched draft--revision pairs from undergraduate writing, expert annotation yielded 4,344 candidate boundaries. We compared zero- and few-shot GPT-5.5 and base Qwen3-32B, parameter-efficient fine-tuning of Qwen3-32B, and majority and proximity-based baselines. Despite receiving revision context and task instructions, no prompted LLM condition outperformed the proximity heuristic (macro-F1 = .825). In contrast, fine-tuned Qwen3-32B using the two context representation achieved the highest macro-F1 (.859), identifying more same-unit relationships while maintaining precision comparable to the heuristic. Deterministic post-processing substantially improved the prompted models but added little benefit to the strongest fine-tuned model. These findings suggest that LLMs can support revision boundary judgment when task-adapted, but general purpose prompting alone may not outperform transparent structural heuristics.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估LLM能否在结构化修订操作数据中识别有意义的修订单元边界，并检验其相对非LLM基线的增益。基于113对本科写作草稿-修订对（4,344个候选边界），对比了零/少样本GPT-5.5、Qwen3-32B基础模型、参数高效微调Qwen3-32B及多数类与邻近性基线。结果显示：提示式LLM均未超过邻近启发式（macro-F1=0.825），而微调Qwen3-32B达最高macro-F1（0.859）；确定性后处理显著提升提示模型但对最优微调模型增益有限。结论：LLM需任务适配才能支持边界判断，通用提示难以超越透明的结构启发式。
AI.motivation: 修订痕迹可反映学生写作过程，但其学习分析价值取决于单次修订如何被表征。自动草稿比较方法常生成细粒度编辑操作，会把一次有意图的修订切碎为多个分析单元，从而损害分析有效性。因此需要判断LLM能否识别有意义的修订单元边界，并明确其是否优于简单的非LLM基线。
AI.method: 数据：113对匹配的本科写作草稿-修订对，经专家标注得到4,344个候选边界。模型条件：零样本与少样本GPT-5.5、基础Qwen3-32B、Qwen3-32B的参数高效微调（PEFT，两种上下文表示）；基线：多数类基线与邻近性启发式。评估指标：macro-F1，并关注同单元关系识别与精确率。此外引入确定性后处理，检验其对各模型的增益。
AI.result: 提示式LLM即使获得修订上下文与任务指令，均未超过邻近性启发式（macro-F1=0.825）。采用两种上下文表示的微调Qwen3-32B取得最高macro-F1（0.859），在保持与启发式相当精确率的同时识别出更多同单元关系。确定性后处理显著提升提示模型，但对最强微调模型增益很小。
AI.conclusion: LLM在任务适配（微调）后可支持修订边界判断，但仅靠通用提示无法超越透明、结构化的启发式方法。这提示学习分析实践应优先考虑任务适配与可解释基线，而非默认依赖通用提示。

title: Shared Experience, Separate Learning: Companion Confidence Calibration for LLMs
summary: Reliable self-assessment is essential for large language models (LLMs), yet they often remain highly confident when their answers are wrong. We study \emph{concurrent confidence calibration}, where confidence is learned alongside capability improvement rather than calibrated only after training. Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides a natural setting for this paradigm, as it continuously produces responses paired with verifiable correctness feedback. Existing concurrent methods, however, learn both capability and confidence through reinforcement learning within shared policy parameters, potentially coupling two fundamentally different learning problems. We instead propose \emph{shared experience but separate learning}: capability and confidence learn from the same trajectories, but through separate optimization mechanisms and parameters. Based on this principle, we introduce \textbf{CoCal (Companion Confidence Calibration)}, which trains a lightweight companion from rollout hidden states and verifier-derived correctness supervision while leaving task optimization unchanged. Experiments on Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B show that CoCal improves confidence estimation without sacrificing task performance, outperforming both RL-based concurrent methods and matched post-hoc calibration. The learned companion further generalizes across domains and policy shifts, while the benefits of CoCal persist at both scales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CoCal，一种"共享经验但分离学习"的并发置信度校准方法，在 RLVR 训练过程中利用 rollout 隐状态训练轻量伴随模型来做置信度校准，在不损失任务性能的前提下提升置信度估计，并优于 RL 并发方法和事后校准。
AI.motivation: LLM 在答错时仍常表现出高置信度，可靠的自我评估能力至关重要。现有的并发校准方法把能力提升与置信度学习都放在同一套策略参数里用强化学习完成，可能把两类本质不同的学习问题耦合在一起，因此需要解耦二者的优化机制。
AI.method: 提出 CoCal（Companion Confidence Calibration），遵循"共享经验、分离学习"原则：能力与置信度使用相同轨迹数据，但使用分离的优化机制与参数。具体做法是从 rollout 的隐状态（hidden states）和验证器给出的正确性监督信号中训练一个轻量伴随模型，任务策略优化保持不变。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-8B 与 Qwen3-14B 上的实验显示，CoCal 在不牺牲任务性能的情况下改善了置信度估计，优于基于 RL 的并发校准方法和匹配的事后校准方法；学到的伴随模型可跨领域和策略漂移泛化，且该优势在两个规模上均成立。
AI.conclusion: 通过将置信度学习从策略参数中解耦、以共享经验但独立优化的方式训练伴随模型，可以在 RLVR 过程中实现更可靠的并发置信度校准，兼顾任务性能与泛化性。

title: BOReFT: Manifold Steering of Language Models for Black-box Optimization
summary: Language models are increasingly used as proposal models for black-box search, from program optimization to molecular design. Existing approaches typically improve proposals through iterative prompting or parameter updates, offering limited control over how completely and efficiently the model's search space is explored. Continuous optimization methods, such as Bayesian optimization, provide a principled way to search but require a suitable domain to operate over. To address this, we introduce BOReFT, which learns a compact, low-dimensional space of hidden-state interventions in a frozen language model, and uses this space as the search domain for Bayesian optimization with an external scoring function. Empirically, we find that the learned domain spans semantic regions and exhibits smoothness properties that support search. Theoretically, we show that semantic coverage and interpolation control the best score available in the learned space, and that decoding from this space yields a standard stochastic-bandit observation model for adaptive search. We evaluate BOReFT on the interpretable word search task "Semantle" and on three more real-world discovery tasks in de novo molecule property optimization. Compared to strong LLM baselines, BOReFT finds in Semantle a higher number of hidden targets and, on two out of three molecular objectives, achieves higher property scores. Consequently, our method provides a principled new bridge between discrete proposal spaces of LLM-based search and continuous black-box optimization.

AI.tldr: BOReFT在冻结语言模型的隐藏状态干预上学习紧凑低维空间，将其作为贝叶斯优化的搜索域，结合外部评分函数，在Semantle及分子性质优化任务上优于强LLM基线。
AI.motivation: 现有将语言模型用作黑盒搜索提议模型的方法，多依赖迭代提示或参数更新，对搜索空间被探索的完整性与效率控制有限；而贝叶斯优化等连续优化方法虽提供有原则的搜索方式，却需要一个合适的定义域。作者希望弥合LLM离散提议空间与连续黑盒优化之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出BOReFT：在冻结语言模型的隐藏状态干预上学习一个紧凑、低维的空间，并将该空间作为贝叶斯优化的搜索域，配合外部评分函数进行优化。理论上分析语义覆盖与插值如何决定该空间可得的最佳分数，并证明从该空间解码可得到用于自适应搜索的标准随机赌博机观测模型。
AI.result: 所学空间在经验上覆盖语义区域并具备支持搜索的平滑性。在可解释词搜索任务Semantle上，BOReFT相较强LLM基线找到更多隐藏目标；在三个从头分子性质优化任务中的两个上取得更高的性质分数。
AI.conclusion: BOReFT为LLM离散提议空间与连续黑盒优化之间提供了一个有原则的新桥梁。该方法通过低维隐藏状态干预空间实现可控、高效的搜索探索，在词搜索与分子设计任务上验证了有效性。

title: GeoShrink: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers with Two Lines of Code
summary: Diffusion transformers incur substantial inference cost through repeated model evaluations along a sampling trajectory. We introduce GeoShrink, a training-free acceleration method that retains the original solver grid while evaluating the model only at a prescribed set of anchors. At skipped stages, GeoShrink predicts the solver-facing output by adding a geometrically retained fraction of the latest observed innovation to the most recent exact output. We derive this rule from chordal tangent transport and round-trip line projection, and establish a geometric anchor-spacing principle that minimizes the largest adjacent gap expansion under fixed coverage and first span. The analysis characterizes the geometric closure and propagation of prediction errors without assuming access to future model outputs. Experiments cover image, video, motion, and audio generation, together with adapted 3D backends. At approximately $5\times$ acceleration, GeoShrink improves FLUX PSNR by 3.10 dB over the strongest listed baseline. On HunyuanVideo, it achieves a reported $4.99\times$ speedup and improves ChronoMagic-Bench-150 PSNR by 5.44 dB over the strongest listed fidelity baseline. Comparisons at fixed evaluation budgets further show substantial gains on motion, audio, music, and 3D generation.

AI.tldr: GeoShrink 是一种免训练扩散 Transformer 加速方法，通过仅在预设锚点处评估模型、在跳过阶段利用几何保留的“新息”分量进行预测，实现约 5 倍加速并显著提升生成保真度。
AI.motivation: 扩散 Transformer 的采样轨迹需要反复进行模型评估，推理开销巨大；现有加速方法往往需要训练或修改求解器网格。
AI.method: 保留原始求解器网格，仅在规定的锚点集合处评估模型；在跳过阶段，将最新观测到的“新息”（innovation）乘以几何保留比例后加到最近一次精确输出上，以预测面向求解器的输出。该规则由弦切向传输（chordal tangent transport）与往返直线投影（round-trip line projection）推导而来，并建立了在固定覆盖与首跨度条件下最小化最大相邻间隙扩张的几何锚点间距原则。分析刻画了在不访问未来模型输出前提下的预测误差几何闭合与传播。
AI.result: 在约 5 倍加速下，FLUX 的 PSNR 较最强基线提升 3.10 dB；在 HunyuanVideo 上实现 4.99 倍加速，ChronoMagic-Bench-150 的 PSNR 较最强保真度基线提升 5.44 dB。在固定评估预算下，运动、音频、音乐与 3D 生成任务均取得显著增益；实验覆盖图像、视频、运动与音频生成，并适配了 3D 后端。
AI.conclusion: GeoShrink 作为一种免训练加速方法，通过几何化的锚点评估与误差传播分析，在多种模态生成任务中以固定评估预算换取显著的速度与保真度双重收益。

title: The Rashomon Wikipedia: A Data-Perspectivist Analysis of Divergent Historical Narratives
summary: Wikipedia aims to provide a unified, neutral record of history, yet its independent language editions often function as distinct epistemic communities, creating divergent narratives around contested events. This paper investigates cross-lingual historiographical bias by analyzing Wikipedia articles across five languages (Romanian, Hungarian, Russian, Turkish, and English) focusing on three contentious events in Romanian history: the Battle of Posada (1330), the Soviet occupation of Bessarabia (1940), and the Night Attack at Targoviste (1462). Using human annotators and Large Language Models (LLMs) to classify citation stance and quantify narrative evolution from 2005 to 2024, we identify a phenomenon of "citation isolation". In the case of the Battle of Posada, only 2 out of 119 citations were shared between language editions, with the Romanian edition exhibiting a 91% pro-national bias compared to the balanced Hungarian edition. Longitudinal analysis reveals that these narratives are volatile and responsive to contemporary geopolitics, evidenced by a significant shift in the Russian framing of Bessarabia in 2024. Finally, we propose a "Peace-Maker" pipeline to automate conflict reconciliation. We demonstrate that while standard prompting leads models to hallucinate consensus, "adversarial" prompting, which explicitly instructs the model to preserve and attribute disagreement, achieves near-perfect neutrality scores.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究维基百科跨语言版本在争议历史事件上的叙事分歧，提出"引用隔离"现象，并设计"Peace-Maker"流程以自动化冲突调和。
AI.motivation: 维基百科以中立、统一的历史记录为目标，但各独立语言版本实际构成不同的知识社群，围绕争议事件形成分歧叙事。作者希望量化这种跨语言史学偏见及其随时间与地缘政治的演变。
AI.method: 选取罗马尼亚、匈牙利、俄语、土耳其语、英语五个语言版本，聚焦三起争议事件（1330年波萨达战役、1940年苏联占领比萨拉比亚、1462年特尔戈维什泰夜袭）。结合人工标注者与大语言模型对引文立场进行分类，并量化2005至2024年间的叙事演变；随后提出"Peace-Maker"流程，对比标准提示与"对抗式"提示在调和冲突上的效果。
AI.result: 识别出"引用隔离"现象：波萨达战役中119条引文仅2条被各语言版本共享，罗马尼亚语版本呈现91%的亲本国偏见，而匈牙利语版本较为平衡。纵向分析显示叙事具有波动性并对当代地缘政治敏感，俄语对比萨拉比亚的框架在2024年出现显著转变。标准提示会使模型臆造共识，而明确要求保留并归属分歧的"对抗式"提示可达到近乎完美中立性评分。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言维基百科在争议历史上存在显著的引用隔离与叙事分歧，且随现实地缘政治动态变化；通过对抗式提示的"Peace-Maker"流程，可在保留并标注分歧的前提下实现高度中立的冲突调和。

title: TutlAit v1: a crowdsourced Moroccan Tamazight speech dataset with Arabic transcriptions and regional accent labels
summary: Tamazight (Amazigh) is, together with Arabic, one of the two official languages of Morocco, yet it remains severely under-resourced for speech technology: pub licly available labelled audio is scarce, generally lacks information on the regional variety spoken, and is often of uneven transcription quality. This article describes the TutlAit dataset, a corpus of Moroccan Tamazight speech paired with Modern Standard Arabic text and explicit regional accent labels. The data were collected with TutlAit, a purpose-built crowdsourcing web application (React 18 front end, Django 5 / Django REST Framework back-end, PostgreSQL database). Native speakers recruited through targeted LinkedIn and Instagram campaigns created an account, declared their regional variety (Atlas, Souss, Rif or other) and demographic information, and then contributed through two workflows: Text-to Audio, in which an Arabic sentence is displayed and the volunteer records its oral Tamazight rendering in the browser, and Audio-to-Text, in which a Tamazight excerpt is played and the volunteer types its Arabic transcription. A complemen tary set of segments was obtained from freely accessible Tamazight audiovisual media, segmented and annotated with ELAN and imported through a bulk CSV/ZIP pipeline. Every upload is converted server-side to 16kHz mono WAV, hashed with SHA-256 for duplicate rejection, checked for duration bounds and validated by an administrator. The dataset contains 13,384 audio files totalling 75,231 seconds (approximately 20.9 hours, about 3.01GB). The Atlas variety accounts for 9,956 files (14.08h) and the Souss variety for 3,378 files (6.75h); small Rif (22 files) and Kabyle (28 files) subsets are also included. The corpus can be reused for speech recognition, speech translation and accent identification for Moroccan Tamazight.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 TutlAit 数据集：一个带有区域口音标注的摩洛哥 Tamazight（Amazigh）语音语料库，与阿拉伯语文本配对，通过众包 Web 应用和公开音视频采集构建，共 13,384 个音频文件、约 20.9 小时。
AI.motivation: Tamazight 虽为摩洛哥官方语言之一，但在语音技术领域资源严重匮乏：公开可用的标注音频稀缺，通常缺乏区域变体信息，且转写质量参差不齐，因此亟需构建带口音标注的高质量语料库。
AI.method: 开发众包 Web 应用 TutlAit（React 18 前端、Django 5/Django REST Framework 后端、PostgreSQL 数据库），通过 LinkedIn 和 Instagram 招募母语者，采集其区域变体（Atlas、Souss、Rif 或其他）与人口统计信息，采用 Text-to-Audio（展示阿拉伯语句子、录制 Tamazight 口述）与 Audio-to-Text（播放 Tamazight 片段、键入阿拉伯语转写）两种流程；另从公开 Tamazight 音视频媒体获取补充片段，用 ELAN 分段标注并通过 CSV/ZIP 批量管道导入。所有上传在服务器端转换为 16kHz 单声道 WAV，经 SHA-256 哈希去重、时长边界检查并由管理员验证。
AI.result: 数据集包含 13,384 个音频文件，总时长 75,231 秒（约 20.9 小时，约 3.01GB）。其中 Atlas 变体 9,956 个文件（14.08 小时），Souss 变体 3,378 个文件（6.75 小时），另含少量 Rif（22 个文件）和 Kabyle（28 个文件）子集。
AI.conclusion: 该语料库可复用于摩洛哥 Tamazight 的语音识别、语音翻译和口音识别任务。

title: Yorùbá in Unicode: An Overview of a Problem
comment: v3 corrected explanation of why certain vowels lack precomposed forms; code-point typo fixed
summary: There is a recurrent problem in the writing of Yorùbá on the internet and on the computer that has proven intractable over the years. The language, along with other African languages that depend on diacritics for disambiguation, requires a small set of precomposed characters that Unicode does not encode. This has forced writers and digital systems to rely on combining character sequences that behave inconsistently across platforms, corrupt under font substitution, and fail in search. This paper documents that failure across a range of real world contexts, from published books to web platforms to mobile keyboards, using personal and empirical evidence. It identifies Unicode's NFC normalization stability policy as the structural constraint that prevents a straightforward fix, arguing for direct intervention of the Consortium in solving the active problem, proposing a formal encoding request for the four core Yorùbá characters as the most durable path to resolution.

AI.tldr: 约鲁巴语等依赖附加符号的非洲语言在数字书写中长期受困：Unicode未编码其所需的一小组预组合字符，导致写作者只能依赖跨平台行为不一致、字体替换时易损坏、且搜索失效的组合字符序列。本文记录了该问题在书籍、网络平台、移动键盘等真实场景中的表现，指出Unicode的NFC规范化稳定性政策是根本性约束，并主张Unicode联盟直接介入，通过正式编码请求为四个核心约鲁巴字符新增编码。
AI.motivation: 约鲁巴语及其他依赖附加符号消歧的非洲语言，在互联网和计算机书写中面临长期未能解决的问题：Unicode未编码其所需的少量预组合字符。这迫使写作者与数字系统使用组合字符序列，而这类序列跨平台表现不一致、在字体替换下损坏、在检索中失败，造成持续的可用性与可访问性障碍。
AI.method: 本文采用个人经验与实证证据相结合的方式，记录上述失败在多种真实场景（已出版书籍、网络平台、移动键盘）中的具体表现，并将Unicode的NFC规范化稳定性政策识别为阻碍直接修复的结构性约束。
AI.result: 研究显示，因缺乏相应预组合字符，组合字符序列在跨平台行为、字体替换和搜索等环节普遍失效；NFC规范化稳定性政策使既有方案难以奏效，构成该问题的结构性根源。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张Unicode联盟应直接介入以解决这一现实问题，并提出为四个核心约鲁巴字符提交正式编码请求，认为这是最持久的解决方案。

title: Constrained Edit Fields for Training-Free Flow Editing
summary: Text-guided image editing aims to perform a desired edit while preserving source content unrelated to it. Pretrained rectified-flow models enable training-free editing of real images through modifications to their sampling trajectories. However, responses at locations unrelated to the desired edit can still accumulate along the editing trajectory and become visible in the final result. To overcome this, we propose Constrained Edit Fields (CEF), which assigns each spatial location a continuous edit responsibility that quantifies its relevance to the desired edit. CEF estimates edit responsibility directly from the source image when the relevant content is present. For edits whose target content is absent from the source, CEF first generates an unconstrained proposal to reveal its realized spatial support and then estimates responsibility from that proposal. At each editing step, CEF decomposes the base edit field into prompt-induced and trajectory-induced components, enabling edit responsibility to preserve instruction-relevant updates while suppressing unintended trajectory-induced changes. Evaluated on all 700 PIE-Bench examples, CEF achieves state-of-the-art Structure Distance, background LPIPS, and background MSE with both Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium and FLUX, while retaining competitive instruction alignment. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, it reduces these metrics over the previous best results by 10.2%, 21.2%, and 48.0%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出 Constrained Edit Fields (CEF)，为每个空间位置分配连续的编辑责任度，用于在无训练的图像编辑中抑制编辑轨迹上无关位置的累积变化，在 PIE-Bench 上取得 SOTA 的内容保持性能。
AI.motivation: 基于预训练 rectified-flow 模型的无训练编辑方法虽可编辑真实图像，但沿采样轨迹，与目标编辑无关的位置仍会累积响应并显现在最终结果中，导致源内容被破坏。
AI.method: CEF 为每个空间位置分配一个连续编辑责任度，衡量其与目标编辑的相关性。当源图中存在相关内容时，直接从源图估计该责任度；当源图中不存在目标内容时，先生成无约束提案以确定其实际的空间支撑区域，再据此估计责任度。在每个编辑步骤，将基础编辑场分解为提示诱导分量与轨迹诱导分量，使编辑责任度在保留指令相关更新的同时抑制轨迹诱导的非预期变化。
AI.result: 在 PIE-Bench 全部 700 个样本上，CEF 在 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 与 FLUX 上均取得 SOTA 的 Structure Distance、背景 LPIPS 与背景 MSE，同时保持有竞争力的指令对齐度。在 SD 3.5 Medium 上，三项指标相较此前最佳结果分别降低 10.2%、21.2% 与 48.0%。
AI.conclusion: 通过基于空间编辑责任度的编辑场分解，CEF 可在无训练条件下有效抑制轨迹诱导的无关变化，显著提升文本引导图像编辑的内容保持能力。

title: The Effects of Incremental Instruction Delivery on Language-Model Creative Writing
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 13 tables. Code and data available at https://github.com/solusops/SISTER-2026-Team19
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as interactive writing tools, where users develop stories, revise ideas, and introduce new requirements across multiple turns rather than specifying a complete brief upfront. Yet most evidence on multi-turn instruction degradation comes from tasks with objectively verifiable outcomes, leaving unclear whether incremental interaction harms creative artifacts in ways that explicit requirement checks cannot capture. We study this question using 160 human-authored creative-writing tasks across six genres, presenting each intended specification either upfront or progressively over 5-9 turns to six distinct open-weight model families, yielding 960 matched pairs. Progressive delivery reduces explicit constraint adherence and produces its largest writing-quality degradation in structure/coherence. The structural gap persists among outputs with equal observed adherence, suggesting that measured requirement loss alone does not explain the observed structural difference. We define Creative Integrity as a compact measure of joint adherence and narrative structure; under incremental delivery, models retain 71.2% of FULL Creative Integrity (95% CI [68.2%, 74.3%]). A three-rater human study over 50 matched pairs independently recovers FULL advantages in structure/coherence, craft, and genre effectiveness, while automated scores remain positively associated with aggregated human ratings. These findings show that interactive creative-writing systems should be evaluated not only on whether requirements survive conversation, but also on whether evolving requirements remain coherently integrated into the final artifact. Our dataset, benchmarks, and source code are available at: https://github.com/solusops/SISTER-2026-Team19

AI.tldr: 研究对比"一次性完整给出写作要求"与"分5-9轮逐步给出要求"对LLM创意写作的影响，发现渐进式交付降低显式约束遵守度，并对结构/连贯性造成最大质量损害，且该损害无法仅用要求丢失解释；提出Creative Integrity指标，渐进模式下仅保留71.2%。
AI.motivation: 多轮指令退化研究多集中于有客观可验证结果的任务，尚不清楚增量交互是否会损害创意写作产物，且这种损害是否能被显式要求检查捕捉。因此需要针对创意写作场景考察渐进式需求交付的影响。
AI.method: 使用160个人工撰写的创意写作任务，覆盖6种体裁；将每个预期规格以"一次性完整给出"或"分5-9轮渐进给出"两种方式呈现给6个不同的开源权重模型家族，得到960对匹配样本；并开展3位评分者对50对匹配样本的人工研究，与自动评分进行关联分析。
AI.result: 渐进式交付降低了显式约束遵守度，并在结构/连贯性上产生最大的写作质量退化；在观测遵守度相同的输出中，结构差距依然存在，说明要求丢失不足以解释结构差异。渐进模式下模型仅保留FULL Creative Integrity的71.2%（95% CI [68.2%, 74.3%]）。人工研究独立复现了FULL在结构/连贯性、写作技巧和体裁有效性上的优势，自动评分与聚合人工评分正相关。
AI.conclusion: 交互式创意写作系统的评估不能只看要求是否在对话中存活，还应看不断演变的要求是否被连贯地整合进最终作品中；并提出Creative Integrity作为联合衡量遵守度与叙事结构的紧凑指标。

title: DuraS2ST: Chain-of-Thought and Reinforcement Learning for Duration-Aligned Speech-to-Speech Translation
summary: Speech-to-speech translation (S2ST) in time-sensitive applications such as video dubbing requires not only semantic fidelity and speaker preservation, but also strict duration consistency to avoid audio-visual misalignment. However, existing S2ST systems largely generate target speech without explicit temporal planning, making duration control an unresolved challenge. We introduce DuraS2ST, a duration-aligned reasoning framework that enables a single speech language model to first generate an explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) for planning target wording and phonetic length, and then synthesize the corresponding speech tokens. To support this paradigm, we construct DuraSet-440K, a high-quality duration-aligned CoT corpus for supervised initialization. We further optimize the model with multi-modal multi-dimensional reinforcement learning, using a Duration Margin Reward to balance translation quality and duration consistency, and Modality-Aware Reward Attribution to assign rewards to appropriate token spans. Experiments on CVSS-T show that DuraS2ST achieves a strong balance between translation quality and duration consistency, outperforming competitive open-source and commercial baselines. Project page: https://github.com/Mia11939/DuraS2ST.

AI.tldr: DuraS2ST：通过显式时长规划链式推理与强化学习，实现语音到语音翻译的时长一致性控制。
AI.motivation: 视频配音等时间敏感场景要求S2ST在语义保真、说话人保持之外，还需严格保证时长一致以避免音视频错位；而现有S2ST系统缺乏显式时间规划，时长控制仍是未解决难题。
AI.method: 提出DuraS2ST时长对齐推理框架：单一语音语言模型先生成显式思维链（CoT）规划目标措辞与音素长度，再合成语音token；构建DuraSet-440K高质量时长对齐CoT语料用于监督初始化；采用多模态多维强化学习优化，引入Duration Margin Reward平衡翻译质量与时长一致性，并设计Modality-Aware Reward Attribution将奖励分配到合适token跨度。
AI.result: 在CVSS-T上，DuraS2ST在翻译质量与时长一致性间取得良好平衡，优于有竞争力的开源与商业基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式时长规划推理与多模态强化学习，可有效解决S2ST的时长可控性问题，兼顾翻译质量与音画同步需求。

title: ENet-GP: Unified Document Image Restoration
summary: Reliable document digitization in uncontrolled capture settings is challenging because real images exhibit multiple interacting degradations rather than a single isolated distortion. Documents thus captured are affected simultaneously by geometric distortions, like page warping, as well as photometric degradations such as non-uniform illumination, and blurring. However, most existing approaches address these factors independently and are evaluated on benchmarks containing only one distortion type, limiting their real-world applicability. We introduce GutenDoc, a large-scale dataset of high-resolution dense-text documents with physically grounded compound degradations. Using physics-based rendering, our dataset jointly models geometric warping and diverse photometric effects, enabling systematic evaluation under realistic capture conditions. We further propose a unified restoration framework that jointly corrects geometric and photometric distortions within a single-network and single-training setup, without the need for degradation-specific retraining or sequential inference passes. Extensive experiments show that our method remains competitive on established single-distortion benchmarks while substantially improving robustness under compound degradations, providing a practical solution for real-world document digitization.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GutenDoc数据集与统一恢复框架，联合处理文档数字化中的几何与光度复合退化，在单退化基准上保持竞争性并在复合退化下显著提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 真实拍摄的文档图像往往同时存在多种相互作用的退化（如页面几何扭曲与非均匀光照、模糊等光度退化），而现有方法通常独立处理各类退化，且仅在仅含单一退化类型的基准上评估，限制了其真实场景下的适用性。
AI.method: 构建GutenDoc大规模高分辨率密集文本文档数据集，基于物理渲染同时建模几何扭曲与多种光度效应，实现真实拍摄条件下的系统性评估；并提出统一恢复框架，在单网络、单次训练设置下联合校正几何与光度退化，无需针对特定退化重新训练或串行推理。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在已有单退化基准上仍具竞争力，同时在复合退化条件下鲁棒性显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为真实世界文档数字化提供了一种实用方案，强调了复合退化建模与统一联合恢复的重要价值。

title: Positions Are Not Facts: The Mismatch Between KV Caches and Memory
summary: When a fact changes, how should a language model update the history stored in its key-value (KV) cache? Hiding the old record is cheap, but it may still contain needed details or answer questions about the past. We compare hiding whole records, hiding only replaced values, and deleting old text and recomputing the cache. In a controlled quantity task, masking makes all eight models prefer the new value more strongly, yet six lose complete answers through unit errors or failure to stop; keeping the unit preserves all current answers. Later states also retain useful information from earlier records: on multi-hop updates, rebuilding these states at unchanged positions lowers historical accuracy by 20-41 percentage points, whereas moving the existing states has little effect. Keeping object dependencies and unchanged revision passages prevents many losses. Recognition is a separate challenge. Learned readouts recover distinctions missed by fixed cache similarities on synthetic record pairs. On natural text, text-detector-selected masks show no clear advantage over random masks at the same rate in 14 same-model detector-generator comparisons. Query-dependent access can avoid some losses, with additional storage or access costs. These findings identify what must be preserved beyond the replaced value when using a KV cache as updatable memory.

AI.tldr: 该文研究语言模型在事实变化时如何更新KV缓存中的历史记录，比较了整条记录掩蔽、仅隐藏被替换值、以及删除旧文本重算缓存三种策略，并考察历史信息保留、识别能力与访问方式。
AI.motivation: 事实会发生变化，而KV缓存作为可更新记忆时如何正确处理历史记录尚不明确。简单隐藏旧记录虽成本低，但可能丢失仍需要的细节或历史问答能力，因此需要明确除被替换值之外还必须保留什么。
AI.method: 在受控数量任务中比较整条记录掩蔽、仅隐藏被替换值、删除旧文本重算缓存；在多跳更新中比较重建未变位置状态与移动已有状态；通过合成记录对比较学习读出与固定缓存相似度；在自然文本上用检测器选择掩码与随机掩码进行14组同模型检测器-生成器对比；并评估查询相关访问。
AI.result: 掩蔽使八个模型都更强烈偏好新值，但六个模型因单位错误或未能停止而丢失完整答案，保留单位则维持全部当前答案。多跳更新中，未变位置重建状态使历史准确率下降20-41个百分点，而移动已有状态影响很小。学习读出可恢复固定相似度漏掉的区分；自然文本上检测器掩码相对随机掩码无明显优势。查询相关访问可避免部分损失，但增加存储或访问成本。
AI.conclusion: 使用KV缓存作为可更新记忆时，除被替换值外还需保留对象依赖、未变的修订段落及单位等信息；识别与访问策略也需专门设计，简单掩蔽或重建会带来历史信息损失。

title: M3-Score: Fidelity, Memorization and Coverage as Separate Axes for Evaluating Generative Radiology Image Models
summary: Quantitative evaluation of generative models for radiology remains challenging. Clinically relevant structures are often small and infrequent, feature spaces learned from natural images may represent them poorly, and a single summary score cannot distinguish limited fidelity from limited diversity. This study proposes the Medical Multi-axis Maximum Mean Discrepancy score (M3-Score), an evaluation framework based on RadioDINO-s16, a frozen vision transformer pretrained on radiology images. M3-Score reports three complementary axes computed at pre-specified encoder depths: \emph{fidelity}, measured by an unbiased multi-bandwidth radial basis function (RBF) MMD$^2$ at the final block; \emph{memorization}, measured by nearest-neighbor distances at 75\% depth; and \emph{coverage}, defined as the fraction of real images with a generated neighbor within their $k$-nearest-neighbor radius at 33\% depth. Reference sets are sampled across subjects to limit the influence of correlated slices.
