On BraTS brain MRI, the fidelity axis ordered five comparison sets of increasing severity (Spearman $ρ= 1.00$), and a subject-disjoint real set yielded $\mathrm{MMD}^2 = 0$ (permutation $p = 1$). An unconditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model achieved $\mathrm{MMD}^2 = 0.073$ (95\% confidence interval $[0.071, 0.080]$) but covered only 38\% of the real distribution. Under progressive mode dropping, $k$-NN manifold recall increased at all twelve encoder blocks, whereas the proposed coverage estimator decreased monotonically ($ρ= -1.00$). RadioDINO-s16 features separated real brain MRI from generated samples with a ROC-AUC of 0.819, compared with 0.555 for InceptionV3 and 0.582 for CLIP. Across a twentyfold range of sample sizes, the mean M3 value varied by a factor of 1.05, compared with 2.52 for the Fréchet Inception Distance.

AI.tldr: 提出基于放射学预训练ViT（RadioDINO-s16）的医学多轴最大均值差异评分M3-Score，在编码器不同深度分别度量保真度、记忆化与覆盖度，在BraTS上优于InceptionV3/CLIP特征及FID。
AI.motivation: 生成式模型在放射学中的定量评估仍具挑战：临床相关结构通常小而罕见，从自然图像学得的特征空间难以良好表征这些结构；且单一汇总分数无法区分“保真度受限”与“多样性受限”两类失效模式。因此需要面向医学图像、可分解为多个互补维度的评估框架。
AI.method: M3-Score以在放射学图像上预训练的冻结视觉Transformer（RadioDINO-s16）为特征骨干，在预先指定的编码器深度上计算三个互补轴：（1）保真度——在最后一个block用无偏多带宽RBF核的MMD²；（2）记忆化——在75%深度用最近邻距离；（3）覆盖度——在33%深度定义为真实图像中在k近邻半径内存在生成近邻的比例。参考集按受试者跨被试采样，以限制相关切片的影响。
AI.result: 在BraTS脑MRI上：保真度轴将五个严重度递增的对比集合正确排序（Spearman ρ=1.00），受试者不重叠的真实集给出MMD²=0（置换检验 p=1）。无条件DDPM的MMD²=0.073（95%CI [0.071, 0.080]），但仅覆盖真实分布的38%。在渐进式模式丢弃下，k-NN流形召回在全部12个编码器block均上升，而所提覆盖度估计单调下降（ρ=-1.00）。RadioDINO-s16特征区分真实与生成脑MRI的ROC-AUC为0.819，InceptionV3为0.555，CLIP为0.582。在20倍样本量范围内，M3均值仅变化1.05倍，而FID变化2.52倍。
AI.conclusion: M3-Score通过医学专用冻结编码器的多深度、多轴设计，同时刻画保真度、记忆化与覆盖度，能区分单分数指标无法区分的失效模式；其对样本量稳健、对分布退化敏感，为放射学生成模型的定量评估提供了更可靠、可解释的框架。

title: Tokens Change, Structure Endures: Spectral Watermarking for Generated Speech
summary: Watermarking is a promising tool for establishing the provenance of AI-generated speech. While many neural audio watermarking methods rely on a separately trained watermark generator, token-level watermarking is a training-free alternative that operates directly during generation. Its main weakness is retokenization: decoding generated speech to a waveform and encoding it again can change token identities and erode the watermark. To make the watermark robust to these changes, we propose Redwing, REtokenization-Durable Watermarking IN Generation. It builds a graph from the token substitutions observed under retokenization, whose Laplacian yields a basis that assigns similar values to tokens likely to substitute for one another. Over this basis, embedding and detection functions are jointly optimized to preserve watermark signal through retokenization while limiting embedding distortion and detector variability on unwatermarked speech. On the Moshi full-duplex system, after eight consecutive passes of Mimi resynthesis, Redwing achieves 80.7% TPR at a calibrated 1% FPR, compared with 8.3% for KGW and at most 7.3% for WMAR. It also has the highest TPR after eight passes through three other neural codecs (77.5-93.0%), and the gains generalize to TTS models at a speech-quality cost close to that of KGW. These results show that retokenization is not merely a source of noise: its transition structure can be exploited as a design principle for robust token-level watermarking.

AI.tldr: 提出 Redwing，一种训练无关的 token 级语音水印方法，利用重分词引起的 token 替换图结构增强水印鲁棒性，在多次重合成后显著优于 KGW 与 WMAR。
AI.motivation: token 级水印无需单独训练水印生成器，直接在生成过程中嵌入，但主要缺陷是重分词（retokenization）：将生成语音解码为波形再编码会改变 token 身份，从而侵蚀水印。本文旨在让水印对这类 token 变化保持鲁棒。
AI.method: 从重分词下观察到的 token 替换关系构建图，利用其拉普拉斯矩阵得到一组基，使易于相互替换的 token 获得相近取值；在该基上联合优化嵌入函数与检测函数，在保持水印信号穿越重分词的同时，限制嵌入失真与未加水印语音上的检测器波动。
AI.result: 在 Moshi 全双工系统上，经过八次连续 Mimi 重合成后，Redwing 在标定 1% FPR 下达到 80.7% TPR，而 KGW 为 8.3%，WMAR 至多 7.3%；在另外三种神经编解码器八次传递后 TPR 最高（77.5%–93.0%），且增益可泛化到 TTS 模型，语音质量代价与 KGW 接近。
AI.conclusion: 重分词不只是噪声来源：其转移结构可被作为设计原则，用于构建鲁棒的 token 级水印。

title: Who Warmed the Archives? LLMs Overestimate Historical Warmth
summary: Historical archives are an under-used source for extending the instrumental climate record backward in time, and LLMs offer a way to extract the indices climatologists derive by hand. Beyond measuring how well systems extract this signal, we check whether their errors are safe to use for cross-century comparison, since a good correlation score does not rule out systematic, era-linked bias. Comparing lexical baselines, fine-tuned historical transformers, and LLM prompting on the Pfister temperature index across five centuries of German text, lexical methods beat every fine-tuned transformer we test, including one pretrained from scratch on historical German (r=-0.016). All six LLMs we test (Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek v4 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Qwen3.7-Plus, Kimi-K2.6-Fast) show a warm bias that grows with calendar year, with the same sign in every model (slopes +0.13 to +0.34/century, p<0.01). The effect is modest in size (r-squared approx equal to 0.01 to 0.05) but consistent across six independently developed models. The best-correlated of the six, Gemini 2.5 Flash, matches the best lexical correlation (r=0.32) at double the error. An ablation stripping explicit dates and calendar-era markers from the quotes leaves this trend essentially unchanged, favoring an anachronistic present-day prior over the model correctly inferring the quote's era. Correlation alone is thus insufficient for vetting an LLM as a historical-climate-index oracle.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估LLM从德语历史文本中提取Pfister温度指数以延伸器测气候记录的能力，发现词法方法优于所有微调Transformer，且六个LLM均存在随年份增长的暖偏差，说明单靠相关系数不足以验证LLM用于跨世纪气候比较。
AI.motivation: 历史档案是延伸器测气候记录的未充分利用来源，气候学家手工从中提取气候指数。LLM为此提供了自动化途径，但仅有良好的相关系数并不能排除系统性的、与年代相关的偏差，因此需要检验LLM误差是否可用于跨世纪比较。
AI.method: 在跨越五个世纪的德语文本上，针对Pfister温度指数，比较三类方法：词法基线、在历史德语上微调的Transformer（包括一个从零预训练的模型），以及LLM提示（Gemini 2.5 Flash、GPT-5-mini、DeepSeek v4 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Qwen3.7-Plus、Kimi-K2.6-Fast共六个模型）。通过回归分析检测暖偏差随日历年的变化，并通过消融实验移除引文中的显式日期和历法时代标记。
AI.result: 词法方法击败所有微调Transformer，包括从零在历史德语上预训练的模型（r=-0.016）。六个LLM均表现出随日历年增长而增大的暖偏差，所有模型符号一致（斜率+0.13至+0.34/世纪，p<0.01）。效应规模适中（r-squared约0.01至0.05），但在六个独立开发的模型中一致。相关性最好的Gemini 2.5 Flash达到最佳词法相关性（r=0.32），但误差翻倍。消融实验移除显式日期和历法时代标记后趋势基本不变。
AI.conclusion: LLM的暖偏差倾向于来自时代错位的当代先验，而非正确推断引文所属时代。因此仅凭相关性不足以将LLM验证为历史气候指数的可靠来源，跨世纪比较需警惕此类系统性年代偏差。

title: Surprising Success, Repeated Failure: Entropy-Guided Credit Assignment for Exploration in LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) enhances reasoning in large language models (LLMs) through outcome-level feedback, yet recent approaches to finer-grained credit assignment often require auxiliary models, additional sampling, or privileged information. Although policy entropy provides a readily available signal, prioritizing uncertain positions under both reinforcement and penalization concentrates penalties where failed responses still retain alternatives for recovery, which can suppress opportunities for exploration. To address this, we introduce Entropic Advantage Policy Optimization (EAPO), an entropy-guided credit assignment method that treats success and failure asymmetrically. Specifically, motivated by the observation that success under uncertainty is less repeatable while confident failures tend to recur, EAPO couples normalized policy entropy with the sign of the response advantage to reinforce surprising success and correct repeated failure. It assigns stronger reinforcement to high-entropy decisions in successful responses and stronger penalties to low-entropy decisions in failed responses, while attenuating penalties at uncertain positions to preserve opportunities for recovery. By redistributing the response advantage across tokens, EAPO derives token-level credit directly from existing rollout signals without additional supervision. We validate EAPO on a range of reasoning tasks across both base and reasoning backbones, demonstrating that it achieves the best overall performance. We further show that EAPO promotes more effective exploration, broadening problem coverage and generating more diverse candidate answers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出熵优势策略优化（EAPO），一种熵引导的信用分配方法，通过非对称处理成功与失败来改进RLVR中的token级信用分配，无需额外模型或监督。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR的细粒度信用分配方法常需辅助模型、额外采样或特权信息；而利用策略熵时，若同等优先强化与惩罚不确定位置，会把惩罚集中在失败但仍有恢复可能的响应上，抑制探索。
AI.method: EAPO基于“不确定性下的成功不易复现、而自信的失败往往重复”这一观察，将归一化策略熵与响应优势的符号耦合：对成功响应中的高熵决策给予更强强化，对失败响应中的低熵决策给予更强惩罚，同时减弱不确定位置的惩罚以保留恢复机会；通过将响应优势重新分配到各token，直接利用现有rollout信号导出token级信用。
AI.result: 在多种推理任务及基础与推理骨干模型上进行验证，EAPO取得最佳整体性能，并促进更有效的探索，拓宽问题覆盖范围并生成更多样化的候选答案。
AI.conclusion: EAPO通过非对称的熵引导信用分配，在不增加监督成本的前提下提升推理性能与探索多样性。

title: Larry Caused the Car to Stop, But the Model Didn't Notice: Transformer Blindness to the M-Heuristic
summary: Modern transformer models excel at capturing semantic relationships through sentence embeddings, yet their ability to perform pragmatic reasoning remains understudied. This paper investigates whether encoder-based transformers such as DeBERTa employ the M-Heuristic (the neo-Gricean principle that marked linguistic forms implicate marked meanings). We test this hypothesis by contrasting lexical causatives (e.g., ``Larry stopped the car'') with periphrastic causatives (e.g., ``Larry caused the car to stop'') using a Natural Language Inference framework. Our experiments across 188 conditions with 15 ambitransitive verbs reveal that DeBERTa, RoBERTa, and BART show no evidence of capturing the pragmatic distinction between these forms, with DeBERTa predicting ``Neutral'' for 100% of cases. Probing analysis initially suggested a representation-use dissociation, but control experiments reveal the probe was tracking syntactic complexity, not causative pragmatics. Semantic similarity over 30 triplets places periphrastic causatives closer to unmediated manner descriptions in 29/30 cases, opposite to M-Heuristic predictions in the embedding space. Under explicit metalinguistic framing, Gemini Flash-Lite reaches 100% with item-specific traces, so the principle is available under instruction yet unused in default NLI.

AI.tldr: 本文检验编码器型Transformer（DeBERTa、RoBERTa、BART）是否在默认NLI任务中运用M-Heuristic（标记形式蕴含标记意义的新格赖斯原则），通过对比词汇致使句与迂说致使句发现模型普遍未捕捉该语用区分，仅在显式元语言指令下（Gemini Flash-Lite）才显现该原则。
AI.motivation: 现代Transformer在语义关系捕捉上表现优异，但其语用推理能力（尤其是新格赖斯M-Heuristic这类标记性推理）研究不足。词汇致使句与迂说致使句的对比是检验该原则的理想测试床，可判定模型是否区分"标记形式—标记意义"的语用蕴含。
AI.method: 构建188个条件、覆盖15个双向及物动词的NLI框架，对比词汇致使句（如Larry stopped the car）与迂说致使句（如Larry caused the car to stop）；对DeBERTa、RoBERTa、BART进行预测测试，辅以探针分析、控制实验及30组三元组语义相似度分析，并测试显式元语言框架下Gemini Flash-Lite的表现。
AI.result: DeBERTa、RoBERTa、BART均无证据显示捕捉该语用区分，DeBERTa在100%案例中预测为"Neutral"；探针最初提示表征—使用分离，但控制实验表明探针实际追踪的是句法复杂度而非致使语用；30组三元组中，迂说致使句在29/30案例中比词汇致使句更接近无中介方式描述，与M-Heuristic预测相反；显式元语言框架下Gemini Flash-Lite达100%且具条目级痕迹。
AI.conclusion: M-Heuristic原则在模型中被编码且可通过指令调用，但在默认NLI推理中未被使用；编码器型Transformer缺乏默认的语用推理能力，所谓表征—使用分离实为句法复杂度伪影，凸显指令情境对语用能力显现的关键作用。

title: LA-CPD: Local-Evidence-Aware Change-Point Detection for Human-LLM Authorship Segmentation
summary: As LLM-generated text becomes increasingly human-like, accurately localizing LLM-authored spans in human-LLM co-authored documents is important for attribution and accountability in cases involving copyright infringement, fraud, and other harmful uses of AI-generated content. Sentence-level detectors provide local authorship evidence, but content variation can cause score fluctuations even among sentences from the same source, creating spurious boundaries. Recovering a coherent document partition therefore remains challenging when both the number and locations of authorship transitions are unknown. We propose Local-Evidence-Aware Change-Point Detection (LA-CPD), a structured method that transforms noisy sentence-level score sequences into coherent authorship segments. Given scores from a frozen local detector, LA-CPD combines a length-weighted within-segment residual with a windowed two-mean contrast to capture segment consistency and sustained changes around candidate cut points. Dynamic programming optimizes cut locations for each candidate count, while an AIC-style criterion selects the final partition, yielding sentence labels, authorship boundaries, and maximal LLM-authored spans. On a held-out human-LLM co-authored test set, LA-CPD outperforms WCP+AIC, increasing sentence-level accuracy from 0.747 to 0.796 while improving boundary localization and LLM-span delineation.

AI.tldr: 提出 LA-CPD 方法，将噪声句子级检测分数序列转化为连贯的作者归属分段，实现人机协同文档中 LLM 生成内容的精确定位。
AI.motivation: LLM 生成文本日益逼真，在人机协同创作文档中精确定位 LLM 撰写片段对版权侵权、欺诈等归因与问责很重要。句子级检测器虽提供局部证据，但内容变化导致同源句子分数波动，产生虚假边界；当作者转换的数量与位置均未知时，恢复连贯的文档划分仍具挑战。
AI.method: 提出 Local-Evidence-Aware Change-Point Detection（LA-CPD），一种结构化方法：基于冻结的局部检测器给出的分数，结合长度加权的段内残差与窗口化双均值对比，捕捉分段一致性和候选切点附近的持续变化；用动态规划对每个候选切点数优化切点位置，再用 AIC 式准则选择最终划分，输出句子标签、作者边界和最大 LLM 撰写片段。
AI.result: 在留出的人机协同测试集上，LA-CPD 优于 WCP+AIC，将句子级准确率从 0.747 提升至 0.796，同时改善边界定位和 LLM 片段划分效果。
AI.conclusion: LA-CPD 通过变点检测将噪声局部证据整合为连贯的作者分段，在未知转换数量与位置的情况下有效提升 LLM 撰写片段的定位精度，为 AI 生成内容的归因与问责提供支持。

title: Multi-Aperture PPG with MAPIS: Spatial Optical and Temporal Coherence Fields
summary: Conventional reflectance photoplethysmography (PPG) typically reduces tissue optical responses to one or a few detector channels. Matrix Pinhole Image Sensing (MAPIS) instead simultaneously samples multiple aperture-dependent optical signals. We analyzed 44 recordings of 30 seconds each from a single MAPIS device to characterize the spatial relationships among DC intensity, pulsatile AC, perfusion index (PI), and temporal coherence across Red and infrared channels. AC increased sublinearly with DC at both wavelengths, resulting in higher PI toward lower-DC apertures, consistent with a first-order relative path-sensitivity interpretation. A second counterintuitive spatial trend was observed in temporal coherence: lower-DC and lower-AC apertures exhibited higher autocorrelation and greater cardiac-periodic spectral concentration. IR signals also showed consistently higher temporal coherence than corresponding Red signals. These observations demonstrate that multi-aperture PPG resolves reproducible spatial relationships among optical intensity, fractional pulsatile sensitivity, and waveform coherence that are largely averaged together in conventional single-channel PPG. The present study establishes within-device relationships and motivates controlled studies of the underlying photon-path mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于单一MAPIS设备44段30秒记录，表征了多孔径PPG中DC强度、脉动AC、灌注指数与时间相干性的空间关系。
AI.motivation: 传统反射式PPG通常将组织光学响应压缩到一至数个探测通道，掩盖了孔径相关的光学信息；作者希望利用多孔径同步采样揭示这些被平均掉的空间规律。
AI.method: 使用Matrix Pinhole Image Sensing（MAPIS）单设备采集44段30秒记录，在红与红外通道上分析DC强度、脉动AC、灌注指数（PI）及时间相干性（自相关与心搏周期谱集中度）的空间关系。
AI.result: AC随DC呈亚线性增长（两波长一致），低DC孔径PI更高，符合一阶相对路径灵敏度解释；反直觉的是低DC、低AC孔径自相关更强、心搏周期谱集中度更高；红外信号的时间相干性始终高于对应红光信号。
AI.conclusion: 多孔径PPG可分辨光强、脉动分数灵敏度与波形相干性之间可重复的空间关系，这些关系在传统单通道PPG中被平均掉；本研究确立器件内部关系，并为后续光子路径机制的受控研究提供依据。

title: Relevance Is Not Sufficient Evidence: Detecting Evidence Gaps Before Generation in RAG
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external sources, but retrieved passages often name the right entities without providing the facts needed to answer. Even when instructed to abstain, 12 generators answer 40.0-99.3% of insufficient-evidence questions. Training generators to abstain ties the decision to model weights, may reward answers recalled from parametric knowledge, and still requires a full generator call. Can sufficiency be judged from the question and evidence alone, before any answer exists? We identify pitfalls in constructing insufficient-evidence tests: removing relevant evidence or pairing evidence with unrelated questions can reveal labels through lexical overlap or evidence position. We build a paired benchmark using substitution, deletion, and question-swap constructions that vary answer support while controlling selected surface features, such as word use. Sufficiency can be judged without generating an answer, but no single signal works across all datasets. We introduce RINSE (Relevance Is Not Sufficient Evidence), which combines three signals: whether every part of the question is covered, whether any passage offers an answer, and whether a small language model reading the passages together judges them sufficient. Across six datasets, RINSE ranks sufficient above insufficient evidence with a score of 0.837 (chance 0.5), exceeding the best of 10 prior methods (0.746) and a frontier model queried through an API (0.784). Its weakest dataset scores higher than any other method's weakest (0.684 vs. 0.676). RINSE runs locally before generation, taking 36.5 ms per question on a single GPU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RINSE方法，在生成答案前仅凭问题与检索证据判断证据充分性，综合三项信号在六个数据集上达到0.837排序得分，优于10种先前方法与前沿API模型，单GPU耗时36.5ms。
AI.motivation: RAG中检索到的段落常提及正确实体却缺乏回答所需事实，即使指示弃答，12个生成器仍对40.0-99.3%证据不足问题作答。训练生成器弃答会绑定模型权重、可能奖励参数化记忆、且需完整生成调用，因此需要独立于答案生成的证据充分性判断。
AI.method: 识别证据不足测试构建中的陷阱（移除相关证据或与无关问题配对会因词汇重叠或证据位置泄露标签），构建采用替换、删除、问题交换的配对基准，在控制表层特征（如用词）的同时改变答案支持度。提出RINSE，融合三信号：问题各部分是否被覆盖、是否有段落提供答案、小型语言模型通读段落判断是否充分。
AI.result: 六个数据集上，RINSE将充分证据排在不足证据前得分0.837（随机0.5），超过10种先前最佳方法（0.746）及前沿API模型（0.784）；最弱数据集得分0.684高于其他方法最弱的0.676；单GPU每问题36.5ms。
AI.conclusion: 证据充分性可在答案生成前判断，但无单一信号适用于所有数据集；RINSE通过多信号组合实现稳健且高效的充分性判别，可作为生成前的本地预处理步骤。

title: MinkowskiPE: Minkowski Positional Encoding for Spatiotemporal Perception
summary: Modeling spatiotemporal coupling is a key challenge in building physical intelligence across scales, from microscopic to macroscopic. Existing models capture such structure broadly through physics-motivated dynamical formulations or learning-motivated architectures. The former provide stronger priors but may constrain flexibility, whereas the latter are more flexible but leave the spatiotemporal coupling largely implicit. We therefore seek an approach that combines flexible learning with an explicit geometric bias for jointly modeling time and space. To this end, we propose Minkowski Positional Encoding (MinkowskiPE), which uses joint temporal and spatial coordinates to parameterize Lorentz transformations applied to query and key features. With MinkowskiPE, the query-key attention score depends on position only through the relative spacetime displacement between the two tokens and is therefore invariant to global translation of the coordinates. This paradigm retains the standard dot-product attention interface and remains compatible with efficient attention implementations. We evaluate MinkowskiPE on microscopic molecular dynamics and macroscopic video prediction tasks, achieving the best results on all nine multi-trajectory molecular evaluations and reducing KTH video-prediction MSE by 9.9% relative to the best baseline while using roughly one-tenth as many parameters.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Minkowski Positional Encoding (MinkowskiPE)，通过洛伦兹变换参数化注意力中的query-key特征，使注意力分数仅依赖相对时空位移，实现灵活的时空耦合建模，在分子动力学和视频预测任务上均取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 跨尺度的时空耦合建模是构建物理智能的核心挑战。现有方法分为两类：物理驱动的动力学公式提供更强先验但灵活性受限；学习驱动的架构更灵活但时空耦合大多是隐式的。因此需要一种兼具灵活学习能力与显式几何先验的方法来联合建模时间与空间。
AI.method: 提出Minkowski Positional Encoding (MinkowskiPE)，利用联合的时空坐标参数化施加于query和key特征的洛伦兹变换。使得query-key注意力分数仅通过两个token之间的相对时空位移依赖位置，从而对坐标的全局平移保持不变。该方法保留标准点积注意力接口，兼容高效注意力实现。
AI.result: 在微观分子动力学和宏观视频预测任务上评估。在所有九个多轨迹分子评估中取得最佳结果；在KTH视频预测任务上，相对最佳基线MSE降低9.9%，同时参数量约为其十分之一。
AI.conclusion: MinkowskiPE将灵活学习与显式几何偏置相结合，为跨尺度联合建模时间与空间提供了有效方案，在兼顾参数效率的同时显著提升性能。

title: Controlling Speaking Rate in Autoregressive TTS via Activation Steering
comment: Accepted at IEEE SLT 2026. 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables
summary: Autoregressive text-to-speech (TTS) systems synthesize natural speech but, once trained, offer little control over speaking rate. We show that speaking rate can be steered at inference time, without retraining, by clamping a single decoder block's activation along a discovered speed axis. A decoder-block analysis recovers the rate axis, a neutral operating point, and a per-step intensity scale; at inference, the activation's projection onto this axis is set to a fixed scalar. Learning this direction from synthetically time-stretched and time-compressed speech yields rate control that largely preserves speaker identity, generalizes across model architectures, and maintains high naturalness in objective and human evaluations. Unlike standard additive steering, which breaks at the slow extreme, clamping remains stable on all three systems tested; at moderate targets, the better rule depends on the model. Finally, we show that rate information is decodable across layers but causally steerable only within a mid-depth window, and demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on the public Seed-TTS-Eval benchmark.

AI.tldr: 通过夹逼（clamping）解码器单个模块沿"语速轴"的激活，可在推理时无重训练地调控自回归TTS的语速，且保持音色与自然度。
AI.motivation: 自回归TTS系统虽能合成自然语音，但训练完成后对语速几乎无法控制；传统加性引导（additive steering）在极慢语速下会失效。
AI.method: 对解码器模块做分析，恢复出语速轴、中性工作点与每步强度尺度；利用合成的时间拉伸/压缩语音学习该方向；推理时将激活在该轴上的投影钳制为固定标量。
AI.result: 语速可控且基本保持说话人身份，跨模型架构泛化，客观与人工评测自然度均高；夹逼在全部三个系统上稳定，而加性引导在慢速极端处失效；中等目标下更优规则取决于模型；语速信息在多层可解码，但仅在中间深度窗口内可因果调控；在公开Seed-TTS-Eval基准上有效。
AI.conclusion: 激活夹逼是一种简单、无需重训练的语速控制手段，优于加性引导的稳定性，并揭示了语速表征的层级特性。

title: Eyes on the Road: A Naturalistic Comparison of MTW Rider Gaze in Urban Indian Traffic
summary: Motorized two-wheelers (MTW) dominate Indian roads but remain underrepresented in driver behavior research. This study presents the first large-scale analysis of MTW driver gaze behavior in naturalistic, heterogeneous urban traffic, using the \textit{myEye2Wheeler} dataset. A semantic segmentation pipeline (YOLOv11 + SAM2) was used to extract object-level gaze metrics under two attention modes: direct gaze (foveal overlap) and central vision (parafoveal monitoring). Results reveal a functional division: central vision supports broad monitoring, while direct gaze enables brief, selective sampling. Novice riders exhibit road-anchored scanning, returning to the road between object fixations, while experienced riders form longer chains of attention across multiple objects. The findings suggest that experience primarily refines temporal rhythm rather than altering allocation strategy and reduces object-class effects in gaze patterns. These findings offer new insight into MTW attention structures and inform future work on behavior modeling and safety systems.

AI.tldr: 首个基于myEye2Wheeler数据集的大规模机动两轮车(MTW)驾驶员注视行为分析：通过YOLOv11+SAM2语义分割提取对象级注视指标，揭示中央视觉与直接注视的功能分工及新手/老手在注意链结构上的差异。
AI.motivation: MTW在印度道路交通中占主导地位，但在驾驶员行为研究中长期被忽视；缺乏自然驾驶、异构城市交通条件下针对两轮车骑手注视行为的大规模研究，导致MTW注意结构不清、行为建模与安全系统缺乏依据。
AI.method: 使用自然驾驶数据集myEye2Wheeler，构建基于YOLOv11与SAM2的语义分割流水线，在两种注意模式下提取对象级注视指标：直接注视（中央凹重叠/foveal overlap）与中央视觉（旁中央凹监控/parafoveal monitoring）；并在新手与经验骑手间比较注视分配策略与时间结构。
AI.result: 发现功能分工：中央视觉支持广域监控，直接注视用于短暂、选择性的采样；新手骑手呈现"道路锚定"式扫描，在对象注视之间回归道路，而经验骑手形成跨多个对象的更长注意链。经验主要优化时间节奏而非改变注意分配策略，并削弱对象类别对注视模式的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次刻画了异构城市交通中MTW骑手的注意结构，表明骑手经验的核心作用是精细化注视的时间组织而非重构分配策略，为MTW行为建模与安全系统设计提供新见解与实证基础。

title: Augmenting Visual Anomaly Detection with Automated Interpretability
summary: Visual anomaly detectors identify deviations from known-normal data, but their anomaly signals may mix evidence of actual anomalies with benign visual variation. We investigate whether automated interpretability can augment visual anomaly detectors by identifying and intervening on different components of this signal. We decompose PatchCore nearest-normal residuals into sparse features using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), and provide high-activation and contrastive non-active examples to a Multimodal LLM, which describes each feature and labels it as anomaly, distractor, or uncertain. These labels guide interventions in the SAE hidden representation, where distractor features are suppressed and anomaly features amplified. The edited representation is then used to reconstruct patch embeddings, which are rescored with PatchCore. Across 40 categories from four benchmarks, applying both interventions jointly improves macro-average image-level AUROC from 0.8724 to 0.8857 on source data and from 0.8066 to 0.8210 under synthetic corruptions. On three additional RobustAD categories with real acquisition shifts, the same interventions improve AUROC from 0.8745 to 0.9056 on source data and from 0.6069 to 0.6599 under real acquisition shifts. Finally, individual feature interventions across all 43 categories show that the MLLM labels are aligned in aggregate with how features differently affect normal and anomalous images.

AI.tldr: 用稀疏自编码器分解PatchCore残差特征，借助多模态LLM标注特征为异常/干扰/不确定，据此在隐表示中抑制干扰、放大异常并重打分，在多个基准上提升AUROC。
AI.motivation: 视觉异常检测器的异常信号中混杂了真实异常证据与良性视觉变化（干扰），需要区分并干预这两类成分以提升检测性能。
AI.method: 将PatchCore的最近邻正常残差用稀疏自编码器（SAE）分解为稀疏特征；向多模态LLM提供高激活与非激活对比样例，令其描述并将特征标为异常、干扰或不确定；依据标签在SAE隐表示中抑制干扰特征、放大异常特征，再重建patch嵌入并用PatchCore重新打分。
AI.result: 在四个基准的40个类别上，联合干预使宏平均图像级AUROC从0.8724升至0.8857（源数据），合成损坏下从0.8066升至0.8210；在三个RobustAD类别上，源数据从0.8745升至0.9056，真实采集漂移下从0.6069升至0.6599；43个类别的逐特征干预显示MLLM标签总体上与特征对正常/异常图像的不同影响相吻合。
AI.conclusion: 自动化可解释性可有效增强视觉异常检测：通过语义标注与表示干预分离异常与干扰成分，可跨类别、跨基准及存在分布漂移时稳定提升检测性能。

title: One Attack to Fool Them All: Highly Transferable Black-Box Adversarial Attacks on Frontier MLLMs
summary: Adversarial attacks have long posed a fundamental threat to machine learning systems. As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) rapidly evolve and become widely deployed, assessing their vulnerability to such attacks is essential for their safe use. In this work, we investigate whether a single adversarial image can consistently mislead diverse frontier MLLMs in black-box settings. We propose O-Attack, a highly transferable black-box attack framework. This framework builds on our insight that surrogate models contain a broad, high-level, cross-modally aligned semantic space. This space extends beyond final-layer outputs and provides multiple semantically consistent representations that remain underexploited by existing attacks. Within this space, O-Attack anchors aligned representations, progressively broadens semantic conditions, and optimizes perturbations through semantic consensus to promote consistent target alignment. By fully exploiting this space with the same surrogate models as M-Attack, O-Attack raises attack success rates on GPT-5.4 (29.1% to 77.2%), Claude-4.6 (42.8% to 81.6%), and Gemini-3.1 (38.2% to 80.9%). Extensive experiments across 24 MLLMs show that O-Attack outperforms six state-of-the-art methods in black-box transferability, with consistent effectiveness across prompts and improved efficiency and imperceptibility. This work exposes the practical safety risks posed by black-box adversarial attacks against frontier MLLMs, underscoring the need for more rigorous robustness evaluation and more effective defenses.

AI.tldr: 提出 O-Attack 黑盒迁移攻击框架，利用代理模型跨模态对齐语义空间中的多语义一致表示优化扰动，显著提升对前沿多模态大模型的攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）快速发展并广泛部署，但其对抗攻击脆弱性评估仍不充分；作者关注单一对抗图像能否在黑盒设置下持续误导多种前沿 MLLMs，以揭示实际安全风险。
AI.method: 提出 O-Attack 高度可迁移的黑盒攻击框架。基于如下洞察：代理模型蕴含广泛、高层、跨模态对齐的语义空间，该空间超出最终层输出，提供多个语义一致表示且被现有攻击利用不足。在该空间内，O-Attack 锚定对齐表示、逐步扩展语义条件，并通过语义共识优化扰动，以促进一致的目标对齐；使用与 M-Attack 相同的代理模型。
AI.result: 在 GPT-5.4 上将攻击成功率从 29.1% 提升至 77.2%，Claude-4.6 从 42.8% 提升至 81.6%，Gemini-3.1 从 38.2% 提升至 80.9%。在 24 个 MLLMs 上的大量实验表明，O-Attack 在黑盒迁移性上优于六种最先进方法，跨提示保持一致有效性，并具更优效率与不可感知性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了黑盒对抗攻击对前沿 MLLMs 构成的实际安全风险，强调需要更严格的鲁棒性评估和更有效的防御手段。

title: CLIMB-flow: Coupled Linear Inverse posterior sampling via Multiscale-Based flow
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: Diffusion models are now widely used in Bayesian inverse problems in imaging as priors, where latent diffusion models are often used for larger scale problems to keep the computational complexity and model-size manageable. Unfortunately, the auto-encoder based compression results in loss of spatial detail. In addition, the optimization is converted to a non-linear problem. In this paper, we introduce a posterior sampling algorithm customized for the pyramidal/cascaded architecture, which relies on a coarse to fine hierarchical strategy to generate images in the pixel domain. We present CLIMB-Flow which alternates between three steps: an end-point estimation from the current coarse and noisy image, data-consistent update of the clean image, and re-noising it back to the level the network expects. Together these steps sample the posterior at that scale using an approximate Gibbs sampling from two conditional distributions. Experiments on ImageNet, CelebA, AFHQ and fastMRI span inpainting, deblurring, super-resolution and accelerated MRI, with PSNR gains of 1.37-7.66 dB over the strongest competing method on CelebA and pixel-domain reconstruction up to 512x512.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CLIMB-Flow，一种针对金字塔/级联架构定制的后验采样算法，在像素域以粗到细的层级策略求解贝叶斯逆问题，避免潜扩散模型的自编码器细节损失与非线性优化问题，在多个数据集与任务上取得显著 PSNR 提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型已广泛作为成像贝叶斯逆问题的先验，其中潜扩散模型因计算复杂度和模型规模可控而常用于大规模问题。但基于自编码器的压缩会丢失空间细节，且优化被转化为非线性问题。因此需要一种能在像素域直接生成、保持空间细节的后验采样方法。
AI.method: 提出 CLIMB-Flow 后验采样算法，针对金字塔/级联架构，采用粗到细的层级策略在像素域生成图像。算法在三个步骤间交替：(1) 从当前粗糙且含噪图像进行端点估计；(2) 对干净图像进行数据一致性更新；(3) 重新加噪回网络期望的噪声水平。这三步通过从两个条件分布的近似 Gibbs 采样，在该尺度上完成后验采样。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet、CelebA、AFHQ 与 fastMRI 上实验，涵盖图像修复、去模糊、超分辨与加速 MRI。相比最强竞争方法，在 CelebA 上 PSNR 提升 1.37–7.66 dB，并实现最高 512x512 的像素域重建。
AI.conclusion: CLIMB-Flow 通过在像素域进行粗到细层级后验采样，规避了潜扩散模型自编码器压缩导致的细节损失与非线优化问题，在多种逆问题任务中显著优于现有方法，验证了金字塔/级联架构下定制采样的有效性。

title: DeltaSeek: Toward Active Perception in Evolving Construction Environments
summary: Construction environments evolve continuously, causing large geometric changes that degrade static mapping and registration performance. This necessitates active perception, where robots deliberately select sensing configurations to resolve the environment's current state. We present DeltaSeek, an initial framework toward active perception in evolving built environments. While our broader objective is a system that reasons about where, how, and when to observe, this paper addresses a critical prerequisite: how a robot's sensing embodiment constrains the observations it can acquire. We formalize an embodiment's permissible observation set and evaluate with a Husky A300 equipped with a UR5e on an IFC-derived benchmark under chassis-mounted and wrist-mounted RGB-D configurations, scoring observations by geometric visibility and effort by drivable distance. In a room-scale scene with eight controlled changes spanning four observability conditions, exhaustive evaluation over 240 permissible base poses and five arm postures shows that two changes admit no chassis viewpoint whatsoever, while the wrist camera resolves both. For changes observed by both embodiments, the median base travel is $6.0$~m for the wrist camera and $15.2$~m for the chassis camera. These results distinguish sensing limitations from acquisition costs, clarifying whether an observation is impossible or simply requires more travel.

AI.tldr: DeltaSeek 是一个面向动态建筑环境的主动感知初步框架，本文聚焦于"机器人的感知载体如何约束其可获取的观测"这一前提性问题，并在 IFC 基准上对比底盘相机与腕部相机的可观测性与代价。
AI.motivation: 建筑环境持续演变导致显著几何变化，使静态建图与配准性能退化，因此需要主动感知，由机器人主动选择感知配置以解析环境当前状态。而在此之前，必须明确感知载体本身对可获取观测的约束。
AI.method: 形式化定义了"载体允许观测集"（permissible observation set）；在 IFC 导出的基准上，使用配备 UR5e 的 Husky A300，比较底盘安装与腕部安装两种 RGB-D 配置；以几何可见性对观测打分，以可行驶距离度量执行代价；在含四类可观测性条件、八处受控变化的房间尺度场景中，对 240 个可行基座位姿与 5 种手臂姿态进行穷举评估。
AI.result: 两处变化不存在任何底盘视角，而腕部相机均可解析；在两载体均可观测的变化中，腕部相机所需基座移动距离中位数为 6.0 m，底盘相机为 15.2 m。
AI.conclusion: 结果区分了感知能力局限与获取代价，从而明确一项观测是根本不可能，还是仅需更多移动代价。

title: ChemOPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Task Chemical Reasoning
summary: Large language models are increasingly expected to support diverse chemical reasoning capabilities within a unified model. One approach is to develop specialized capabilities separately and consolidate them through multi-teacher on-policy distillation, but this raises two questions: how should specialization be organized, and how should specialist guidance be integrated? We introduce ChemOPD, which addresses both. We estimate task affinities from supervised fine-tuning gradients and solve a constrained mixed-integer program(MIP) to construct partially overlapping specialist groups. During distillation, we retain a generalist teacher trained on all tasks so that specialist guidance supplements rather than replaces its supervision. Our anchor-residual objective gradually increases the routed specialist's contribution on student-generated responses. On ChemCoTBench, affinity-guided specialization produces task-dependent gains over the generalist teacher and improves several capabilities beyond semantic task grouping. Yet stronger teacher-side performance does not automatically yield stronger students: with the same specialists and routes, anchor-residual OPD improves most reported metrics over specialist-only distillation and realizes a larger share of the available teacher gains. These results highlight specialization and capability integration as connected but distinct design problems in chemical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChemOPD，通过亲和度引导的专家分组与锚点-残差式多教师在线策略蒸馏，在统一模型中整合化学推理能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型需在单一模型中支持多样化学推理能力。分头训练专家再用多教师在线策略蒸馏整合时，存在两个问题：如何组织专业化分工，以及如何整合专家指导。
AI.method: 从监督微调梯度中估计任务亲和度，求解带约束的混合整数规划（MIP）以构建部分重叠的专家组；蒸馏时保留一个在所有任务上训练的通用教师，使专家指导仅作补充而非替代；提出锚点-残差目标，在学生生成响应上逐步提高被路由专家的贡献权重。
AI.result: 在ChemCoTBench上，亲和度引导的专业化相较通用教师带来依赖任务的增益，并在若干能力上优于语义任务分组；在相同专家与路由下，锚点-残差OPD在多数指标上优于仅专家蒸馏，并能实现更大比例的可用教师增益。教师端更强并不自动带来更强学生。
AI.conclusion: 专业分工与能力整合是化学推理中相互关联但彼此不同的设计问题，需分别优化。

title: Laya as a Typed Probabilistic Assessor: An Independent Reproduction and a Preregistered Study of Calibration and Selective Escalation
comment: 31 pages, 8 figures. Ancillary files include the frozen preregistration, all run manifests, per-decision prediction records, and the metric code
summary: The shipped Laya Typed-Decisions checkpoint, a 421M-parameter ModernBERT-large assessor that answers typed choice/noul/score questions over workflow state, is uniformly under-confident. The signed confidence-accuracy gap is $-0.214$, every occupied reliability bin's accuracy exceeds its confidence, and that sign uniformity collapses every binned ECE variant to the same value, $0.214$. The card frames the risk as over-confidence; the measured direction is the opposite, and the direction decides which way a confidence-gated cascade fails. A single disjointly fitted temperature ($T=0.469$, sharpening) removes most of the miscalibration (held-out ECE $0.204$ to $0.037$) and outperforms the shipped per-option-count table. The frozen selection rule instead chose isotonic regression, which overfit and failed its held-out NLL contrast on both tracks, so hypothesis H2 is not supported. Re-running the released checkpoint on its full official test split reproduces the card's headline accuracy ($0.767$ vs. $0.766$). The retrospective E1 reproduction preceded the analysis freeze; E2-E8 were prospectively preregistered, and 20 of 22 executed confirmatory tests reject under Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at $q=0.05$ (two descoped). The frozen gate beats random escalation but misses its 10% accepted-set error target on both tracks, an exploratory out-of-distribution probe finds no zero-shot transfer (accuracy $0.617$), and every score measures agreement with a synthetic teacher whose self-agreement ceiling ($0.735$) the specialist exceeds. Per-decision predictions, run manifests, and the frozen preregistration are in the ancillary files. The author has no affiliation with the model's publisher, the dataset's publisher, or TypeSafe.

AI.tldr: Laya Typed-Decisions 检查点（421M ModernBERT-large）存在系统性"置信不足"：符号化置信-准确率差为 -0.214，使所有分箱 ECE 变体退化为同一值 0.214。单一温度标定（T=0.469）将留出 ECE 从 0.204 降至 0.037，优于出厂的按选项数查表法；而被冻结的选择规则选中的 isotonic 回归过拟合并未通过留出 NLL 对比，故假设 H2 不成立。
AI.motivation: 模型卡将风险表述为过度自信，但实测方向相反，而方向决定了置信门控级联的失效方式。作者旨在检验出厂检查点的标定质量、验证被冻结的标定选择规则，并对其发布的行为主张进行可复现性核算与预注册确认性检验。
AI.method: 在完整官方测试集上重跑已发布检查点以复现模型卡准确率；拟合单一不相交的温度参数进行标定，并与出厂按选项数查表法及 isotonic 回归对比；E1 为回溯性复现（先于分析冻结），E2–E8 为前瞻性预注册；执行 22 项确认性检验（2 项降范围）并按 Benjamini-Hochberg FDR（q=0.05）判定；另做置信门控级联评估与探索性分布外探针；以合成教师为基准衡量各分数的一致性。
AI.result: 置信-准确率差为 -0.214，每个非空可靠性箱内准确率均高于置信度；温度标定 T=0.469（锐化）将留出 ECE 由 0.204 降至 0.037，且优于出厂查表法；isotonic 回归过拟合并同时在两条轨道上未通过留出 NLL 对比，H2 不成立；完整测试集复现准确率 0.767（模型卡 0.766）；22 项确认性检验中 20 项在 BH FDR q=0.05 下拒绝（2 项降范围）；冻结门控优于随机升级，但在两条轨道上均未达到 10% 接受集误差目标；分布外探针无零样本迁移（准确率 0.617）；所有分数仅衡量与合成教师的一致性，而教师自一致上限 0.735 已被专用模型超越。
AI.conclusion: 出厂检查点的失准方向是置信不足而非过度自信，简单的温度标定即可大幅消除失准并胜过出厂查表法；被冻结的选择规则（isotonic）不可靠，导致 H2 未获支持。结论整体可复现且大部分预注册检验显著，但门控未达误差目标、缺乏零样本迁移能力，且基准本身受合成教师自一致上限限制。逐决策预测、运行清单与冻结的预注册文件均在附属材料中；作者与模型出版商、数据集出版商及 TypeSafe 均无隶属关系。

title: ViBR-WM: Visual Bayesian Regression for World Modeling
summary: Modeling temporal dependence and uncertainty is central to forecasting with world models. The Visual Bayesian Regression World Model combines visual features, physical histories and known covariates through interpretable regression, within a modular architecture supporting trend, seasonal and cycle dynamics. Visual compression reduces representation dimension, while Bayesian variable selection reduces active regression dimension. Posterior prediction combines forecasts across predictor subsets using their posterior probabilities as weights and accounts for parameter uncertainty and future disturbances. The model forecasts joint visual--physical states recursively and physical targets directly. Across four forecasting tasks spanning object motion, vegetation greenness and solar power, ViBR-WM achieves lower mean overall physical-target error than Temporal Straightening, ConvLSTM, PredRNN and SimVP on every task. Repeated fitting and resampling support these overall gains.

AI.tldr: ViBR-WM 是一种模块化世界模型，通过可解释的贝叶斯回归整合视觉特征、物理历史与已知协变量，在趋势、季节与周期动态下建模时间依赖与不确定性，并在四类预测任务上取得低于 Temporal Straightening、ConvLSTM、PredRNN 与 SimVP 的平均物理目标误差。
AI.motivation: 世界模型预测的核心挑战在于同时建模时间依赖与不确定性。现有方法在表示维度与回归维度上冗余较大，且对参数不确定性与未来扰动缺乏显式刻画。该研究旨在通过可解释的模块化架构，在保留趋势、季节与周期动态的同时，用贝叶斯方式量化不确定性并降低维度。
AI.method: 提出 ViBR-WM（Visual Bayesian Regression World Model）：以可解释回归为核心，融合视觉特征、物理历史与已知协变量，支持趋势、季节与周期动态的模块化架构。采用视觉压缩降低表示维度，利用贝叶斯变量选择降低活跃回归维度。后验预测按后验概率对预测子集加权组合，并纳入参数不确定性与未来扰动。模型递归预测联合视觉-物理状态，并直接预测物理目标。
AI.result: 在覆盖物体运动、植被绿度与太阳能发电的四项预测任务上，ViBR-WM 在每一项任务中的平均整体物理目标误差均低于 Temporal Straightening、ConvLSTM、PredRNN 与 SimVP。重复拟合与重采样进一步支持这些整体增益的稳健性。
AI.conclusion: ViBR-WM 通过可解释贝叶斯回归与视觉压缩、变量选择的结合，在降低表示与回归维度的同时显式处理不确定性，在多项跨领域预测任务上稳定优于主流时空预测基线，表明模块化概率回归架构在世界模型中具有实用价值。

title: Rethinking Contextualization by Reinterpreting Attention Head Channels
summary: Contextualization, the core operation of language modeling, transmits information across words to build sentence-specific word representations. Prior works mainly study contextualization, focusing on individual words and attention heads as a growing discrete dictionary, lacking a global view of their general behavior. Therefore, we propose a general principle: Globally, we find and estimate that different words carry different amounts of information, and less-informative words tend to absorb more contextual information. Specifically, these low-information words do not absorb contextual words uniformly, and finer-grained selectivity enables more precise routing to promote information transmission between matched words. Moreover, to find what mechanism causes such processing, we reinterpret attention heads as channels gated by their singular vectors and find that: (1) these singular vectors point to the hidden states of more informative words, allowing such words to write their information to others more strongly to act as information sources, and vice versa; and (2) these singular vectors can be viewed equally as hidden state features, enabling automated interpretation of attention heads beyond prior heuristic head discovery, also embedding heads into a continuous space rather than treating them as discrete, independent dictionary entries.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出关于上下文化的一般性规律：不同词携带的信息量不同，低信息词倾向于吸收更多上下文信息，且这种吸收具有细粒度选择性；作者将注意力头重解释为由奇异向量门控的通道，发现奇异向量指向高信息词的隐状态，使这些词作为信息源向外写入信息。
AI.motivation: 已有研究多从离散词典视角分析上下文化，聚焦单个词与注意力头，缺乏对其整体行为的全局视角，因此需要提出更普遍的原则来刻画词与注意力头在信息传递中的作用。
AI.method: 提出一般性原则并实证估计不同词的信息量差异；分析低信息词吸收上下文信息的非均匀性与细粒度选择性；将注意力头重解释为由其奇异向量门控的通道，考察奇异向量与隐状态的关系，并据此实现注意力头的自动解释与连续空间嵌入。
AI.result: 发现不同词携带信息量不同，低信息词吸收更多上下文信息且具细粒度选择性路由；奇异向量指向更信息性词的隐状态，使高信息词更强地向外写入信息成为信息源，反之亦然；奇异向量可等价视为隐状态特征，支持注意力头的自动化解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了上下文化的全局原则，将注意力头从离散独立词典条目转变为连续空间中的可解释通道，为信息路由与注意力头自动解释提供新视角。

title: ReDrive: Shaping Representations with World Modeling for End-to-End Driving
summary: Driving policies require capabilities of scene understanding and future evolution prediction. To achieve this goal, current end-to-end models typically construct complex perception-planning pipelines or introduce world models that explicitly predict future states, resulting in a complex system architecture. Inspired by the transferability of general-purpose visual representations, we argue that combining sufficiently strong visual representations with representation world modeling can support effective planning without relying on complex inference-time auxiliary modules. Based on this insight, we present ReDrive, an end-to-end driving framework that strengthens planning-oriented visual features via future representation prediction. To achieve this, ReDrive adopts a three-stage training pipeline consisting of driving video pretraining, joint world-modeling and planning training, and planner adaptation. This yields a strong planning-oriented representation and a high-performance planner, while requiring neither auxiliary perception modules nor future prediction at inference time. Experiments on NAVSIM demonstrate strong performance, achieving 91.0 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.8 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2. These results show that shaping representations with world modeling is sufficient to enable high-performance end-to-end planning while retaining a simple encoder-planner inference pipeline.

AI.tldr: ReDrive 通过世界建模塑造面向规划的视觉表征，无需推理期辅助模块即可实现高性能端到端驾驶规划。
AI.motivation: 驾驶策略需要场景理解与未来演化预测能力。现有端到端模型通常构建复杂的感知-规划流水线，或引入显式预测未来状态的世界模型，导致系统架构复杂、推理期开销大。受通用视觉表征可迁移性的启发，作者认为：足够强的视觉表征结合表征层面的世界建模，即可支撑有效规划，而无需依赖复杂的推理期辅助模块。
AI.method: 提出 ReDrive 端到端驾驶框架，通过未来表征预测来强化面向规划的视觉特征。采用三阶段训练流程：(1) 驾驶视频预训练；(2) 世界建模与规划联合训练；(3) 规划器适配。该流程在不引入辅助感知模块、也不在推理时进行未来预测的前提下，获得强规划导向表征与高性能规划器。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM 上取得强劲性能：NAVSIM v1 达 91.0 PDMS，NAVSIM v2 达 90.8 EPDMS。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，用世界建模来塑造表征，足以支撑高性能端到端规划，同时保持简单的“编码器-规划器”推理流水线。核心贡献在于将世界建模的作用定位为训练期的表征学习手段，而非推理期的显式预测模块，从而在性能与架构简洁性之间取得平衡。

title: Program-Verified Self-Evolution for Vision-Language Models
summary: Self-evolving vision-language models train on questions they generate from unlabeled images. Since these questions have no gold answers, prior methods label them by majority vote over sampled answers or by a model judge. In a human evaluation, we find that 24\% of majority-vote labels and 18\% of model-judge labels produced during self-evolution are wrong. To address this problem, we present Verifiable QA Generation for Self-Evolving Models (VQS), which changes how the model judges answers. Instead of voting on an answer, the model parses each image into a structured record, such as a scene graph, a chart table, or a diagram graph. Fixed programs then write a question from the record and compute its answer. The model still acts as a visual checker, but it only confirms the individual facts the program reads, one short claim at a time. These claim-level checks select the parser's training targets, so the parser also improves without labels. Human raters find 94\% of VQS answers correct, against 76\% for majority voting. Across ten benchmarks, VQS improves Qwen3-VL by up to 3.18 points at the 2B, 4B, and 8B scales and outperforms the strongest self-evolving baseline at each. Gains keep growing over three training rounds, reaching 3.84 points at 2B. Code is released at https://github.com/ahmedheakl/VQS

AI.tldr: 提出VQS框架，用结构化解析+程序化问答+短声明视觉校验替代多数投票/模型评判，生成无标签可验证QA，自演化提升VLM性能。
AI.motivation: 自演化视觉语言模型依赖无标注图像自生成问题，但无金标准答案，现有用多数投票或模型评判打标签存在大量错误（人工评估中分别有24%和18%的标签错误），噪声标签限制自训练效果。
AI.method: VQS改变答案判定方式：模型将图像解析为结构化记录（场景图、图表表格、示意图图结构等）；固定程序基于记录生成问题并计算结果答案；模型仅作为视觉校验器，逐一确认程序读取的单个事实（短声明级别的claim check）；这些声明级校验用于筛选解析器的训练目标，使解析器在无标签下也能改进。
AI.result: 人工评估中VQS答案正确率94%，多数投票为76%；在十个基准上，VQS在2B/4B/8B规模使Qwen3-VL最高提升3.18分，并优于最强自演化基线；三轮训练增益持续增长，2B规模达3.84分。
AI.conclusion: 将答案判定从整体投票转为可验证的结构化程序生成与声明级视觉校验，可显著降低自演化标签噪声，实现无标签持续自提升，且增益随训练轮次累积。

title: In-Context Adaptation of Encoder-Decoder Models in Speech Recognition
summary: In-context learning offers an appealing approach to adapt automatic speech recognition (ASR) models to new speakers, accents, and domains by providing speech-text pairs as demonstrations at inference time. Recent work shows that some LLM-based speech models are capable of ASR in-context adaptation, when providing interleaved speech-text demonstrations. In this work, we ask whether in-context adaptation is an inherent ability for all encoder-decoder models. We study two forms of demonstration, collated and interleaved demonstration, across six encoder-decoder models, spanning conventional cross-attention-based and LLM-based architectures. We find that all tested models are able to perform in-context adaptation out of the box, achieving up to 30% relative improvement in the oracle experiments and up to 23% using first-pass hypotheses. Through controlled experiments on three English datasets, we show that lexical and speaker information both contribute to successful adaptation. While interleaved demonstration is effective in certain cases, collated demonstration brings consistent adaptation across the board. Our results suggest that in-context adaptation for ASR is not unique to specific architectures, training, or demonstration approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文探究上下文自适应是否为所有编码器-解码器语音识别模型的固有能力，通过在六种模型上测试两种演示形式，发现所有模型均可在开箱情况下实现上下文自适应。
AI.motivation: 近期研究表明部分基于LLM的语音模型在提供交错语音-文本演示时具备ASR上下文自适应能力，但尚不清楚这种能力是否为所有编码器-解码器模型所固有，因此本文系统性地检验该问题。
AI.method: 研究两种演示形式（拼接式collated与交错式interleaved），覆盖六种编码器-解码器模型，包括传统交叉注意力架构与LLM类架构；并在三个英语数据集上进行受控实验，分析词汇信息与说话人信息的作用。
AI.result: 所有测试模型均能开箱即用地进行上下文自适应，oracle实验中相对提升最高达30%，使用首遍假设时最高达23%；词汇与说话人信息均对成功自适应有贡献；交错式演示在特定情形下有效，而拼接式演示在各模型中均能带来一致的适应性提升。
AI.conclusion: ASR的上下文自适应并非特定架构、训练方式或演示方法所独有，而是编码器-解码器语音模型的普遍能力。

title: Population Physics, Population Problems: Safety and Emergence in LLM Societies
summary: The collective behaviour of large language model (LLM) societies is not the sum of their individual outputs. It yields statistically distinct, sometimes-unpredictable phenomena, for which the tools we use to study single agents may not scale. Due to recent incidents involving autonomous agentic systems, however, understanding these systems is paramount. For that we introduce a framework for measuring self-organisation in LLM social systems and apply it to three such systems: a Schelling grid, a social network (Moltbook), and a Twitter-like misinformation simulation ('Rogue'). All three exhibit statistically significant self-organisation. Moreover, their relaxation dynamics vary with the environmental information available to the agents, with open-ended systems (Moltbook, Rogue) exhibiting sharp, phase-transition-like dynamics. Further results show that population-level pathologies can emerge even when the LLMs are safety-tuned or monitored, being primarily driven by the coordinated activity of a population subset. We also show when self-organisation does \textit{not} emerge under two additional scenarios (a commons dilemma, GovSim, and a LLM-as-a-judge deliberation scheme, ChatEval). We argue that measuring signatures of this kind offers a lightweight, agent-agnostic diagnostic layer for detecting coordinated collective behaviour in deployed multi-agent systems without relying on natural language or model versioning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个测量LLM社会系统自组织程度的框架，并在三个系统（Schelling网格、Moltbook社交网络、Rogue虚假信息模拟）中验证其显著自组织现象，同时指出两个不出现自组织的场景（GovSim、ChatEval）。
AI.motivation: LLM群体的集体行为并非个体输出的简单加总，会涌现出统计上独特、有时不可预测的现象，而研究单个智能体的工具难以适用。加之近期自主智能体系统相关事件，理解这些系统至关重要。
AI.method: 提出一个测量LLM社会系统自组织的框架，并将其应用于三类系统：Schelling网格、社交网络Moltbook、类Twitter虚假信息模拟Rogue；另在公地困境GovSim和LLM-as-a-judge审议方案ChatEval两个场景中检验自组织是否不出现。
AI.result: 三个系统均表现出统计显著的自组织；其弛豫动力学随智能体可获取的环境信息而变化，开放式系统（Moltbook、Rogue）呈现类似相变的急剧动力学。即使LLM经过安全微调或被监控，仍可出现群体层面病理，主要由子群体的协同活动驱动。GovSim与ChatEval两个场景未出现自组织。
AI.conclusion: 测量此类自组织特征可提供一种轻量、与智能体无关的诊断层，用于在已部署的多智能体系统中检测协同集体行为，且不依赖自然语言或模型版本信息。

title: Lost with a Map: Conversational State and Behavioral Reliability in Language Models
comment: 9 pages main text, 39 pages total, 3 main-text figures
summary: Task-oriented dialogue requires maintaining and updating information across turns, yet language models expose no explicit belief-state object. We study how conversational state is represented, updated, and used inside eight instruction-tuned language models from four families on MultiWOZ and SGD. Structure and values separate: which domains, slots, and requests are active is linearly readable just before the model acts, whereas exact values are far more readable where the user stated them. After a user changes a value, both values remain accessible at their mentions, and causal interventions show that both continue to influence the model's action. In natural closed-loop interaction, query failures separate into cases of weak structural support, incorrect value resolution, and failure to deploy otherwise-supported constraints, with targeted interventions producing systematically different repair behavior across these cases. These findings motivate a state-action controller that starts from the base model action and selectively edits it using structural readouts, without requiring a complete predicted belief state as an intermediate representation. On held-out MultiWOZ interaction across five models, it raises the base model exact-query accuracy from .318 to .621 and task success from .272 to .371 at negligible added cost. Overall, reliable interaction requires not only retaining conversational information, but resolving which available constraints currently apply and ensuring that they govern action.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究指令微调语言模型在任务型对话中如何表征、更新和使用对话状态，发现结构信息与槽值信息在表征上可分离，并提出一种无需完整信念状态作为中间表示的“状态-动作控制器”，在MultiWOZ上以极小代价显著提升精确查询准确率与任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 任务型对话需要跨轮次维护与更新信息，但语言模型并未显式暴露信念状态对象。作者希望弄清对话状态在模型内部如何被表征、更新与使用，并据此改善自然闭环交互中的可靠性，尤其是查询失败问题。
AI.method: 在MultiWOZ与SGD上研究4个家族共8个指令微调模型。通过线性可读性探测分析结构与值信息的表征位置，使用因果干预检验用户改值后旧值与新值对动作的影响，并分析自然闭环交互中的查询失败类型。在此基础上提出状态-动作控制器：以基座模型动作为起点，利用结构读出进行选择性编辑，不依赖完整预测信念状态作为中间表示。
AI.result: 结构与值分离：在模型行动前，活跃的domain、slot与request结构可线性读出；而精确值在用户陈述处更易读出。用户改值后，新值与旧值在各自提及处仍可访问，因果干预显示两者均继续影响模型动作。自然闭环交互中，查询失败分为结构支撑弱、值解析错误、未能部署已受支撑约束三类，针对性干预在各类上产生系统性不同的修复行为。在留出MultiWOZ交互、五个模型上，精确查询准确率由.318提升至.621，任务成功率由.272提升至.371，额外成本可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 可靠交互不仅需要保留对话信息，还需要解析哪些可用约束当前适用，并确保这些约束真正支配动作。基于结构读出的选择性动作编辑可在不构建完整信念状态的情况下有效提升对话可靠性。

title: LLMs learn different forms of metacognition when trained to predict their own accuracy
comment: Stefano Palminteri, Pierre-Yves Oudeyer contributed equally
summary: Large language models are trained to always produce an answer, regardless of whether they possess the relevant knowledge, which leads them to fabricate facts. Prior work has shown that LLMs' confidence estimates correspond poorly to their actual performance, and that fine-tuning can substantially improve them. However, what models actually learn during such training remains poorly understood. We investigate how LLMs acquire metacognitive monitoring, the ability to know what one knows, by training 10 open-weight LLMs to predict their own accuracy on factual multiple-choice questions before answering them. We find that trained confidence reflects two distinct signals. While on questions close to the training data, it tracks the model's true accuracy, in other domains, it instead tracks output consistency: the concentration of the model's answer distribution. Output consistency tracking emerges early in training and generalizes across datasets, whereas accuracy tracking develops later and remains local to the training distribution. These results suggest that calibration training may not teach models to generally detect errors they commit confidently, and they raise broader questions about the nature of metacognition in artificial systems.

AI.tldr: 通过训练10个开源LLM在回答前预测自身准确率，发现训练出的置信度反映两种信号：在训练分布附近追踪真实准确率，在其他领域则追踪输出一致性（答案分布集中度）。一致性追踪较早出现且可泛化，准确率追踪出现较晚且局限于训练分布。
AI.motivation: LLM总倾向于给出答案而非承认无知，导致编造事实；现有研究表明其置信度估计与真实表现对应较差，微调可改善，但模型在训练中究竟学到了什么尚不清楚。
AI.method: 训练10个开源权重LLM，在回答事实性多选题之前先预测自身的准确率，以此考察其元认知监控能力的习得过程，并分析训练所得置信度背后的信号来源。
AI.result: 训练后的置信度包含两种不同信号：在接近训练数据的题目上追踪模型真实准确率，在其他领域则追踪输出一致性，即答案分布的集中度。
AI.conclusion: 输出一致性追踪在训练早期出现并可跨数据集泛化，准确率追踪发展较晚且局限于训练分布。这表明校准训练可能并未教会模型普遍识别其自信犯下的错误，并对人工系统元认知的本质提出更广泛的疑问。

title: Faster Block-Diffusion Serving with Distribution-Free Risk Guarantees
summary: Block-diffusion language models are served at hand-picked operating points, such as acceptance thresholds, buffer depth, schedule, checkpoint and precision, and each point is chosen by its mean benchmark accuracy. However, a mean does not tell an operator how often a faster configuration fails on prompts that the slower one answers correctly. On the serving engine and its decode traces, the default commit rule already commits every fully resolved block, a static skip rule captures nearly all of the compute that allocation can save, and self-distillation on engine-decoded targets adds speed at unchanged accuracy. Larger speedups come from lower thresholds, which commit tokens that are still uncertain. We therefore present Redline, a finite-sample procedure that selects operating points, hand-picked or learned, from the correctness of their answers on calibration prompts. Redline keeps the reference-relative risk, the joint probability that the reference answers correctly and a candidate configuration does not, within a user-chosen budget with high probability, and deploys the fastest configuration that passes. It speeds up math at a smaller risk budget than code in both model families, and at a budget of ten percent it deploys a LLaDA2 math configuration that commits over a third more tokens in each forward. It also applies without modification to the acceptance rule of speculative decoding and to weight quantization. On the same calibration data, Redline stays within its stated failure probability, whereas each tolerance of a mean-accuracy rule either gains less speed for some model and task or exceeds the risk budget far more often for another. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/Redline.

AI.tldr: Redline：一种基于校准集答案正确性的有限样本操作点选择方法，将候选配置相对参考配置的“参考相对风险”控制在用户预算内并部署最快通过者；在数学任务上以更小风险预算获得更大加速，并可直接应用于投机解码接受规则与权重量化。
AI.motivation: 块扩散语言模型的部署依赖于人工挑选的操作点（接受阈值、缓冲区深度、调度、检查点与精度），且以平均基准准确率作为选择标准；但均值无法反映“较快配置在较慢配置能正确回答的提示上失败”的频率，操作者缺乏对失败风险的可靠控制。
AI.method: 先对服务引擎与解码轨迹进行分析：默认提交规则已提交完全解析的块，静态跳过规则几乎捕获分配可节省的全部算力，引擎解码目标上的自蒸馏在精度不变下提升速度，更大加速来自会提交不确定 token 的低阈值。据此提出 Redline：一种有限样本选择流程，从校准提示上的答案正确性出发，选择人工或学习的操作点，将参考相对风险（参考正确而候选错误的联合概率）以高概率约束在用户预算内，并部署通过的最快配置。
AI.result: 在两类模型族中，数学任务可在比代码更小的风险预算下实现加速；在 10% 风险预算下，部署的 LLaDA2 数学配置每次前向多提交超过三分之一的 token。同一校准数据上，Redline 保持在其声明失败概率内，而平均准确率规则的各容忍度的结果要么在某些模型与任务上加速更少，要么在另一些情况下远超风险预算。方法无需修改即可用于投机解码的接受规则与权重量化。
AI.conclusion: 以参考相对风险为控制目标的 Redline 提供了对块扩散语言模型服务操作点选择的风险可控、部署最简单且可直接迁移的加速框架，优于以平均准确率为准的规则；代码已开源。

title: Where Activation Sparsity and KV-Cache Sparsity Cross in LLM Decoding
summary: At each step, decoding one sequence with a large language model rereads the projection weights, whose traffic is fixed, and the key-value (KV) cache, whose traffic grows with context. Activation sparsity trims the first term and KV-cache sparsity the second, yet their reported speedups are hard to compare because each depends on context length and on the dense attention kernel it is measured against. We derive a byte crossover, the context length at which the two savings are equal, together with ideal speedup bounds for each branch and for their composition, from model dimensions and keep ratios alone. We then time both branches and their composition from 2K to 128K tokens on two GPUs after a dense prefill of real text, with dense and sparse modes reading the cache through the same split-K attention kernel. The projection branch leads at short context and the KV branch at long context, with speedups that follow their byte bounds up to fixed kernel costs. Adding these costs, measured in separate sweeps, lets the byte account predict the measured crossings of three keep-ratio pairs, a second model, and a second GPU to within 4.1K tokens. Timing the dense baseline with masked instead of split-K attention inflates the apparent speedup of the same KV policy about fivefold. An attention-scored KV selection answers the same passkey and multi-key placements as dense decoding up to 127K tokens, whereas a KV window misses most of them. Under matched perplexity budgets, activation sparsity composed with this selection decodes 14 to 26% faster than the best single branch on both GPUs. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ByteCross.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"字节交叉点"（byte crossover）分析框架，仅依据模型维度和保留率，推导出激活稀疏与KV缓存稀疏两种节省相等的上下文长度，以及各分支和组合的理想加速上界，并在2K–128K token上于两块GPU上验证。
AI.motivation: 激活稀疏裁剪投影权重流量、KV缓存稀疏裁剪缓存流量，但二者报告的加速难以比较，因为各自依赖于上下文长度和所对比的密集注意力内核。作者希望建立一个可预测、可比较的理论与实测框架。
AI.method: 从模型维度和保留率推导字节交叉点与理想加速上界；对真实文本做密集预填充，在2K–128K token上计时两分支及其组合，密集与稀疏模式均使用同一split-K注意力内核读取缓存；通过单独扫描测量固定内核开销；并用注意力评分的KV选择与KV窗口进行对比。
AI.result: 短上下文下投影分支领先，长上下文下KV分支领先，加速比在固定内核开销内符合字节上界；加入内核开销后，字节账目能在4.1K token内预测三组保留率、第二个模型和第二块GPU的实测交叉点；用masked替代split-K注意力计时密集基线会把同一KV策略的表观加速夸大近五倍；注意力评分KV选择在127K token内与密集解码通过相同的passkey和多键放置，而KV窗口大多失败；在匹配困惑度预算下，激活稀疏与该选择组合比最佳单分支快14–26%。
AI.conclusion: 字节交叉点结合实测固定内核开销，可跨保留率、模型与GPU准确预测激活稀疏与KV稀疏的加速交叉；注意力评分KV选择在长上下文下保持与密集解码相当的检索质量，与激活稀疏组合可获得显著加速。

title: Risk-Controlled Selective LLM Answering by Pricing Label-Free Checks
comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, 24 tables. Dongyub Jude Lee and Jungseob Lee contributed equally
summary: Serving an answer from a large language model requires deciding when to abstain, yet a verifier's ranking accuracy alone does not determine the error rate among served answers. We introduce PriceCheck, which builds a compact family of decision rules from label-free checks such as re-solving a problem. Each check has a price: its agreement rates on correct and incorrect answers and its cost per run. Prices fitted on a small, class-enriched labelled set compose into predictions of a schedule's coverage and cost, guiding which checks to run and when to stop. A calibration test then selects a schedule at a stated selective-risk target. In mathematics, the selected schedules serve 76.1% of answers on average and keep held-out selective risk below 1.5% on all 15 splits. Under the shared testing protocol, PriceCheck serves more answers at that target than reward models, a prompted judge, the generator's confidence and a trained correctness classifier. At matched coverage, it keeps the fewest wrong answers among these scorers. Across 118 diagnostic schedules, price-based coverage predictions have a rank correlation of 0.97 with observed coverage. These results show that choosing how checks are combined and stopped matters alongside how well a verifier ranks answers. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/PriceCheck.

AI.tldr: 提出 PriceCheck：用无标签检查（如重新求解）构建决策规则族，每项检查带有“价格”（在正确/错误答案上的一致率与单次成本）；用小规模类别增强标注集拟合价格，预测调度方案的覆盖率与成本，从而决定运行哪些检查、何时停止，并通过校准测试在给定选择性风险目标下选择调度方案。
AI.motivation: 大模型作答需要决定何时弃答，但仅凭验证器的排序准确率无法决定已服务答案中的错误率；因此需要一种能同时刻画覆盖率与错误率的决策机制。
AI.method: 将无标签检查（如重新求解问题）参数化为“价格”：在正确答案与错误答案上的一致率及单次运行成本；在小型类别增强标注集上拟合价格，据此组合成对调度方案覆盖率与成本的预测，指导检查的选择与停止时机；最后用校准测试在指定选择性风险目标下选定调度方案。
AI.result: 数学任务中，所选调度方案平均服务 76.1% 的答案，且在全部 15 个划分上保持留出选择性风险低于 1.5%；在共享测试协议下，该目标下比奖励模型、提示式评判器、生成器置信度和训练好的正确性分类器服务更多答案，且在覆盖率相同时错误答案最少；118 个诊断调度方案中，基于价格的覆盖率预测与观测覆盖率的秩相关为 0.97。
AI.conclusion: 如何组合与停止检查，与验证器排序答案的能力同等重要。

title: Residual-Stream Burden Shapes Representation Learning in Diffusion Transformers
summary: In diffusion-based generation, a neural network can be trained to predict the clean data, the noise, or the velocity from a noisy input. These prediction targets are interconvertible and describe the same generative process, yet plain Diffusion Transformers operating on large pixel patches succeed with clean prediction and fail with noise or velocity prediction. We argue that this asymmetry arises because noisy targets require the residual stream to preserve noise-dependent input variation through depth for the final readout, forcing subsequent layers to compute on noisy representations. A spectrally concentrated clean target imposes a lighter demand, leaving greater freedom to organize hidden representations for subsequent computation. We call this preservation requirement *residual-stream burden* and show how it shapes representation learning in Diffusion Transformers. Controlled experiments indicate that the exploitable structure is spectral concentration in patch space and that the bandwidth of the persistent residual state is a key resource for noisy prediction. We further show that this account is consistent with recent decoupled pixel-space architectures, whose diverse designs all reduce the residual-stream burden on the main pathway. To examine this understanding from a complementary direction, we expand and reorganize the residual-stream bandwidth directly, introducing Spatially Indexed Hyper-Connections (SiHC) that reach FID 1.71 on ImageNet $256^2$. Together, these results identify residual-stream burden as a mechanism through which prediction targets and architecture jointly shape representation learning in Diffusion Transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"残差流负担"（residual-stream burden）概念，解释扩散Transformer中清洁预测优于噪声/速度预测的不对称性，并据此设计SiHC架构达到ImageNet 256²上FID 1.71。
AI.motivation: 扩散生成中预测目标（清洁数据、噪声、速度）本可相互转换、描述同一生成过程，但作用于大像素块的普通Diffusion Transformer在清洁预测上成功，在噪声或速度预测上却失败。作者希望揭示这一不对称性的内在机制。
AI.method: 提出残差流负担假说：噪声目标要求残差流在深层中持续保留与噪声相关的输入变化以供最终读出，迫使后续层在带噪表征上计算；而谱集中的清洁目标要求更轻，使隐藏表征有更大自由度被组织用于计算。通过受控实验验证可利用结构是patch空间的谱集中性、持续残差状态的带宽是噪声预测的关键资源；并分析近期解耦像素空间架构；进而直接扩展并重组残差流带宽，提出空间索引超连接（SiHC）。
AI.result: 受控实验表明谱集中性与残差状态带宽是噪声预测的关键因素；该解释与近期解耦像素空间架构一致。SiHC在ImageNet 256²上达到FID 1.71。
AI.conclusion: 残差流负担是预测目标与架构共同塑造Diffusion Transformer表征学习的机制。

title: NSV-Shift: A Contrastive Benchmark for Non-Speech Vocalization Understanding and Response Adaptation in Speech-to-Speech Models
summary: We introduce NSV-Shift, a contrastive benchmark for evaluating whether speech-to-speech models can understand non-speech vocalizations (NSVs) and adapt their responses accordingly. Each pair contains two conversations with identical lexical content that differ only in the NSV embedded in the final turn. Our pilot contains 22 human-verified pairs (44 audio conditions) and evaluates five models on NSV perception, emotion understanding, and response adaptation. Results show that models generally perform better at detecting NSVs than at interpreting their fine-grained emotional meaning or producing appropriately differentiated responses. The data construction pipeline, dataset, and evaluation pipeline are publicly available at https://github.com/ChenzwNina/nsv-construction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出NSV-Shift，一个对比式基准，用于评估语音到语音模型能否理解非言语发声（NSV）并据此调整回应。
AI.motivation: 现有语音到语音模型评估多关注词面内容，缺乏对非言语发声（如叹息、笑声等）理解与响应适应能力的系统评测。
AI.method: 构建对比式基准NSV-Shift：每对样本包含两段词面内容相同、仅末轮嵌入的NSV不同的对话；先导集含22个人工验证的样本对（44个音频条件）；在NSV感知、情绪理解、回应适应性三个维度上评估五个模型；公开数据构建流程、数据集与评测流程。
AI.result: 模型在检测NSV方面普遍优于解读其细粒度情绪含义，也优于生成恰当差异化回应。
AI.conclusion: 当前语音到语音模型对NSV的细粒度情绪理解与回应适应能力仍不足，NSV-Shift为相关评测提供了可复用的基准与流程。

title: SlopBench: How Well Can We Rank Language Models by Slop? A Multi-Domain Benchmark of Repetitive AI Writing
summary: SlopBench asks which models produce the stiff, repetitive prose readers call AI slop, a question detectors leave open once they have classified a text as machine-written. We evaluated eighteen models on 112 hand-written tasks in email, social posts, essays, and workplace chat, sampling each model on each task up to ten times, for 19,928 outputs in all. SlopBench scores four surface behaviors a reader can check by hand: length against the word band each task specifies, opener repetition across a model's own samples of one task, and paragraph rhythm and fixed lexical constructions against pre-ChatGPT human corpora. Under one fixed weighting, Kimi K2.6 scores lowest at 21.1 and Mistral Large highest at 40.6. Across 500 random reweightings Kimi has the lowest score in 58 percent of draws and Mistral the highest in 97 percent. No draw preserves the full order of the eighteen, and a scenario bootstrap leaves exactly one of those ranks unambiguous. We ran three further checks on that middle order: a crowd arena, an AI detector, and lexical diversity. None of them confirmed the order. We therefore report the four behaviors separately and treat the composite as one weighting among many, and we release the prompts, outputs, reference statistics, and scoring code.

AI.tldr: 提出 SlopBench，用四项可人工核查的表面行为指标评测18个模型在112项任务上的"AI味"（AI slop）程度，但发现综合排名高度依赖权重，故主张分项报告并公开全部材料。
AI.motivation: 现有AI文本检测器只能判定"是否为机器生成"，却无法回答"哪类模型写得更呆板、重复"这一读者关心的问题，存在评测空白。
AI.method: 构建 SlopBench：112 项人工撰写任务（邮件、社交帖、文章、职场聊天），18 个模型每任务最多采样 10 次，共 19,928 条输出；从四个表面行为打分——是否落在任务规定词数区间、同一任务多次采样间开头句重复度、段落节奏、固定词汇搭配（对照 ChatGPT 之前的人类语料库）。并进行 500 次随机权重抽样、情景 bootstrap，以及人群竞技场、AI 检测器、词汇多样性三项额外验证。
AI.result: 固定权重下 Kimi K2.6 最低（21.1）、Mistral Large 最高（40.6）；500 次随机重加权中 Kimi 有 58% 的抽样最低、Mistral 有 97% 最高；没有任何一次抽样能保持 18 个模型的完整排序，bootstrap 后仅有一个名次无歧义。三项额外检查均未能确认中间名次的顺序。
AI.conclusion: 综合得分只是一种权重下的结果，不足以支撑稳定排序；应分别报告四项行为指标，并将综合分视为众多权重之一，同时公开提示词、输出、参考统计与评分代码。

title: JIVE: Jacobian-Informed Volume Expansion for Diverse Generative Sampling
summary: Generative models often suffer from mode collapse and limited sample diversity. While prior works attempt to mitigate this by jointly generating a batch of samples and repelling their trajectories, these heuristics do not explicitly maximize the diversity of the resulting endpoints. We introduce JIVE, a training-free framework that enhances generative diversity by injecting velocity perturbations aligned with the leading right singular subspace of the generator's endpoint Jacobian. By leveraging this local geometric structure, JIVE provably maximizes endpoint diversity while preserving sample quality. To maintain practical efficiency, we compute these perturbation directions via matrix-free iterations rooted in classical numerical linear algebra, requiring only a small computational overhead. Across different benchmarks, JIVE boosts both pixel and feature-level diversity in few-step and one-step generation.

AI.tldr: JIVE：一种免训练框架，通过对生成器端点雅可比的主导右奇异子空间施加速度扰动来提升生成多样性，可证明地最大化端点多样性并保持样本质量，计算开销小。
AI.motivation: 生成模型常出现模式崩溃和样本多样性受限。现有方法通过联合生成一批样本并使其轨迹相互排斥来缓解，但这些启发式方法并未显式最大化最终生成端点（endpoints）的多样性。
AI.method: 提出JIVE（training-free框架）。其核心是向生成过程注入速度扰动，扰动方向与生成器端点雅可比（endpoint Jacobian）的主导右奇异子空间对齐；利用该局部几何结构可证明地最大化端点多样性。为保持效率，采用基于经典数值线性代数的矩阵无关（matrix-free）迭代方法计算扰动方向，仅需少量额外计算。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，JIVE 在少步（few-step）和单步（one-step）生成中同时提升了像素级和特征级多样性。
AI.conclusion: JIVE 通过利用端点雅可比的局部几何结构进行速度扰动，实现了可证明的端点多样性最大化，同时保持样本质量且开销小，为提升生成多样性提供了有效的免训练解决方案。

title: Artificiality's First Exam: An LLM-Referenced C-test for Supraintelligence
comment: Preprint, under review. 63 pages. Code and data at https://github.com/jorallo/ctest-one
summary: Under the accelerated pace of AI development, any benchmark whose difficulty is calibrated with humans or current AI systems becomes circular, or saturates soon. How can we then evaluate machines that may become more capable than the current machines and the people who write the tests? One answer to the question hinges on inverse problems, inductive inference questions for which difficulty depends on the complexity of the underlying mechanism, given the observations and the previous knowledge. Levin's Kt, a computable variant of Kolmogorov complexity, puts a theoretical upper bound to that difficulty, balancing the simplest representation encoding for the mechanism and the logarithm of the time steps to run that mechanism. Previous tests derived from Levin's Kt, such as the original C-test, are based on minimalistic Universal Turing Machines (UTM), capable of very limited representations and no previous knowledge. Reasoning large language models (LLM) are UTMs that capture a compendium of human culture as knowledge, using prompts as natural language programs. This paper presents the first test based on Levin's Kt with LLMs as representational machines. Fresh test items can be produced at high difficulties, estimated in a ratio scale measured in bits, before any human or frontier model can solve them. We formalise the measure, devise a lightweight generation and certification pipeline, explore the effect of the power of the reference machine and the gap between examiner and examinee. We produce a first battery of certified items administered to twelve LLMs. The resulting agent characteristic curves decrease with difficulty, down to the uncharted high-difficulty region, the supra-intelligence window of items we can certify, yet beyond generations of frontier intelligence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出首个以大型语言模型（LLM）作为表征机器的Levin Kt测试，通过轻量级生成与认证流水线产出高难度、以比特为尺度认证的全新题目，并据此刻画十二个LLM的智能特征曲线。
AI.motivation: AI发展加速使任何依据人类或当前AI系统校准难度的基准都变得循环或迅速饱和，因此需要一种难度不依赖测试者、可评估超越当前机器与出题人能力的评测方法。
AI.method: 以逆问题与归纳推断为理论基础，采用Levin Kt（Kolmogorov复杂度的可计算变体）界定难度上界；将LLM视为具备人类文化知识、以提示为自然语言程序的通用图灵机；形式化度量，设计轻量级题目生成与认证流水线，并考察参考机器能力与考官—考生差距的影响。
AI.result: 生成首批经认证的题目集并在十二个LLM上测试，得到的智能体特征曲线随难度下降，延伸至尚未被探索的高难度区间，即“超智能窗口”——可认证但超出历代前沿智能能力范围。
AI.conclusion: 将Levin Kt与LLM结合可构建难度可扩展、以比特比率尺度度量的非循环基准，为评估潜在超越人类的机器智能提供了可行路径。

title: Quantization Error Is Spectrally Flat: A Single Random Probe Is a Calibrated, Data-Free Sensitivity Estimator, with Application to Budget-Targeted Mixed-Precision Quantization
summary: A single random Gaussian probe gives an unbiased estimate of the squared Frobenius norm of a layer's quantization error. The estimator is well-behaved because round-to-nearest error is spectrally flat. Across 1,683 tensors from a 35B MoE and a 9B dense model, effective dimensionality is 0.93 to 0.96 times the i.i.d. noise value of the same shape, and on the MoE the median is unchanged from 2-bit to 8-bit. The probe coefficient of variation is predictable from tensor shape. One probe measures per-tensor sensitivity to within 4 to 7%; twenty probes reach 1.3 to 1.4%.RAM applies the propagated form of this estimator to budget-targeted mixed-precision quantization with no calibration data. Gaussian probes carrying the network's own input statistics score every tensor at six bit-widths. A knapsack solver allocates bits under an exact byte budget, with guardrails against catastrophic 2-bit assignments. One probe pass serves any budget. Isolated and propagated scores rank tensors independently on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (Spearman -0.01), yet the propagated probe rank-correlates 0.81 to 0.83 with the GPTQ layer objective from real activations, while the isolated estimator is uncorrelated with it. That objective is the wrong allocation target: at matched bytes on Qwen3.8-27B, a block-output probe beats a vendor IQ3_M mix and an oracle that allocates from the real-activation objective. On Qwen3-8B the propagated probe ties HAWQ-V2 at matched bytes. Across seven architectures from 8B to 122B, with probe timing up to a 400B model in nine minutes on one workstation, RAM reaches 3.5 to 13.6% lower median WikiText-2 perplexity than size-comparable uniform 4-bit builds on the tested MoE models. (Black Sheep Ai baa.ai)

AI.tldr: 提出RAM：用随机高斯探针的无偏估计器（传播形式）在无校准数据下为混合精度量化分配比特预算，在MoE模型上比同尺寸均匀4-bit方案降低3.5–13.6%的WikiText-2困惑度中位数。
AI.motivation: 混合精度量化需要逐张量敏感度来分配比特，但传统方法依赖真实激活/校准数据（如GPTQ目标、HAWQ-V2），成本高且在MoE上可能不是正确的分配目标。作者希望无需校准数据、以单次探针通行即可服务任意比特预算，并获得可预测、低方差的敏感度估计。
AI.method: 单随机高斯探针给出层量化误差平方Frobenius范数的无偏估计，因round-to-nearest误差谱平坦而表现良好；RAM使用其传播形式，携带网络自身输入统计的高斯探针在六个位宽上为每个张量打分，再用背包求解器在精确字节预算下分配比特，并对灾难性2-bit分配设护栏。一次探针通行适用于任意预算。
AI.result: 1,683个张量（35B MoE与9B稠密）上有效维度为同形状i.i.d.噪声值的0.93–0.96倍，MoE上中位数从2-bit到8-bit不变；单探针CV可由张量形状预测，敏感度误差4–7%，二十探针1.3–1.4%。隔离与传播分数在Qwen3.5-35B-A3B上独立排名（Spearman -0.01），传播探针与GPTQ层目标秩相关0.81–0.83，隔离估计器不相关。在Qwen3.8-27B同字节数下block-output探针优于厂商IQ3_M与真实激活目标的oracle；Qwen3-8B上与HAWQ-V2持平；七个8B–122B架构上（400B模型单工作站9分钟探针）MoE上中位困惑度低3.5–13.6%。
AI.conclusion: 随机探针敏感度估计可无校准地驱动混合精度Bit分配，传播形式比隔离形式更贴合真实激活目标；真实激活目标本身是次优分配目标，RAM在MoE上以同字节数取得更低的WikiText-2困惑度且探针开销可控。

title: Preserving DEG Rankings for Gene Discovery in Histology-Based Spatial Gene Expression Prediction
summary: Predicting spatial gene expression from histology images could scale spatial transcriptomics (ST) to image-only cohorts, but conventional histology-based ST prediction is trained and evaluated mainly by per-gene spatial-profile reconstruction. This objective is misaligned with a key downstream use of ST: differentially expressed gene (DEG) discovery, where genes are ranked for a biological or morphology-defined contrast by evidence of between-group expression differences. We formulate image-based differential expression ranking (IDER), which asks whether predicted expression profiles preserve the contrast-specific ranked gene list obtained from measured profiles. IDER compares gene rankings induced by differential-expression statistics, rather than raw expression magnitudes or per-gene spatial correlations. We further introduce a differentiable IDER objective that aligns these statistics across genes and can be trained with morphology-derived proxy contrasts without predefined biological group labels. Experiments on public ST datasets show improved DEG-ranking agreement and pathway-enrichment overlap over conventional reconstruction objectives, including morphology-derived and pathologist-annotated tissue-region evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于图像推断差异表达排序（IDER）的新任务与可微目标，用差异表达统计量对齐基因排序，而非重建每基因空间表达谱，从而提升图像预测ST的DEG发现一致性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于组织学图像预测空间转录组（ST）的方法主要以逐基因空间表达谱重建为训练与评价目标。但该目标与ST的关键下游用途——差异表达基因（DEG）发现——不一致：DEG发现关注的是按组间表达差异证据对基因进行排序，而非表达量数值本身的拟合精度。
AI.method: 作者形式化定义图像驱动的差异表达排序（IDER）任务：检验预测表达谱能否保持由实测表达谱得到的对比特异性基因排序，通过差异表达统计量诱导的基因排序进行比较。并进一步设计可微的IDER目标，在基因维度上对齐这些统计量；该方法可利用形态学衍生的代理对比进行训练，无需预定义生物学分组标签。
AI.result: 在公开ST数据集上的实验显示，相比传统重建目标，该方法在DEG排序一致性以及通路富集重叠度上均有提升，评估涵盖形态学衍生对比与病理学家标注的组织区域对比两类场景。
AI.conclusion: 以差异表达排序而非表达谱重建来定义与优化图像预测ST，可更好地服务于DEG发现等下游分析，并为无标签条件下利用组织形态学信号训练提供可行路径。

title: ArticulateArena: A Metric for Articulated Kinematics
summary: Modern methods reconstruct or generate simulation-ready articulated objects, predicting not only their geometry but also how their parts are connected and allowed to move. Evaluating the geometry is straightforward, but evaluating the predicted articulation is not, because articulation specifies a motion rather than a shape, and there is no agreed distance between two motions. More specifically, existing protocols score joint type, axis direction, origin, and motion limits separately, although these parameters jointly describe a single physical motion, and the same motion can be written as different parameter values. As a result, a joint can score maximally wrong against an equivalent encoding of itself, and several component errors are ill-conditioned or undefined exactly where predictions become accurate. We propose ArticulateArena, a representation-invariant counterpart of Chamfer distance for articulation that compares the motions one-DOF joints induce rather than the parameters that encode them. It represents each joint by the unordered pair of its Lie-algebra endpoint twists, and we prove that the resulting quotient distance is a metric. It unifies fixed, revolute, prismatic, and helical joints, brings continuous joints into the same score through a compactification, and reads as the RMS motion of the moving part in meters when weighted by its mass distribution. A motion-aware tree edit distance lifts the metric to full kinematic trees, pricing structural errors such as spurious or missing joints in the same motion units as joint errors, and for a fixed inner product it remains a metric on trees up to relabeling. Alongside the metric we release ArticulateArena-20K, a new suite of 19,977 articulated objects with verified kinematics, and we re-evaluate published reconstruction methods on it under the new metric. Project page: https://heyumeng.com/ArticulateArena-web/

AI.tldr: 提出ArticulateArena——首个表示不变的关节运动度量，将Chamfer距离思想推广到articulation，并发布20K数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有评估协议将关节类型、轴方向、原点、运动限位分开打分，但同一运动可用不同参数编码，导致等价编码被误判为最大错误，且部分分量误差在预测精确时反而病态或未定义。
AI.method: 用单自由度关节所诱导的运动而非其编码参数进行比较；以Lie代数端点twist的无序对表示关节，构造商距离并证明其为度量；统一fixed/revolute/prismatic/helical关节，经紧化纳入连续关节，按质量分布加权后以米为单位读作运动部件RMS运动；再用运动感知树编辑距离提升至完整运动学树。
AI.result: 所提商距离为度量，树编辑距离在内积固定时保持为树上的度量（至重标号）；发布ArticulateArena-20K（19,977个经运动学验证的关节物体），并在新度量下重新评估已发表的重建方法。
AI.conclusion: 为articulation评估提供表示不变、物理可解释的统一度量与配套基准，可作为重建方法的标准评测方案。

title: Unifying Video Tasks via Spatiotemporal Analogy
summary: Adapting video models to new tasks typically requires dedicated data curation and fine-tuning. While visual analogy provides a training-free alternative by specifying tasks in-context, it remains restricted to the image domain. To explore whether analogy-based methods can unify diverse video tasks and generalize to out-of-distribution scenarios, we introduce ViGeo, a framework that extends visual in-context learning to the video domain via spatiotemporal canvas completion. Evaluated on a diverse task taxonomy with a strict train-test split, ViGeo generalizes to unseen video manipulations and zero-shot modalities (e.g., event cameras). Finally, we identify task internalization, where a query format associated with a pretrained task overrides the demonstration, and show that this shortcut can be removed with a small amount of task-unrelated data, highlighting the need to decorrelate prompt format from task identity.

AI.tldr: 提出 ViGeo 框架，通过时空画布补全把视觉类比/上下文学习从图像扩展到视频，实现免训练、可泛化的多视频任务统一建模。
AI.motivation: 将视频模型适配到新任务通常依赖专门的数据整理与微调，成本高；视觉类比虽提供免训练的上下文任务指定方式，但仅限于图像域，尚不清楚类比方法能否统合多样视频任务并泛化到分布外场景。
AI.method: ViGeo 以时空画布补全为形式，将视觉上下文学习扩展到视频域，用示范在上下文中指定任务，无需针对任务训练。评估采用多样任务分类体系并严格划分训练/测试集，检验对未见视频操作及零样本模态（如事件相机）的泛化。
AI.result: ViGeo 能泛化到未见过的视频操作与零样本模态；同时发现"任务内化"现象，即与预训练任务相关的查询格式会压过示范信息。
AI.conclusion: 类比式方法可统一多样视频任务并泛化到分布外情形；任务内化捷径可用少量任务无关数据消除，说明需将提示格式与任务身份解耦。

title: Test-Time Generalized Category Discovery
summary: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) and Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) are traditionally treated as disjoint problems: the former adapts models to domain shift assuming all test classes are known, while the latter discovers novel categories assuming labeled training data for known classes. However, real-world deployment rarely fits either setting. Motivated by this gap, we introduce Test-Time Generalized Category Discovery (TT-GCD), a unified and more realistic scenario where a vision-language model must adapt to distribution shifts, classify known categories using only textual supervision, and discover novel categories, all during test time and without access to labeled data. To address this challenging scenario, we propose PACT (Prototype Assignment for Category discovery at Test time), a fully unsupervised framework that casts known-class recognition and novel-class discovery via prototype assignment. PACT first re-aligns shifted visual features with the text-derived class representations of the VLM using confident zero-shot predictions. Known and novel categories are then both represented by prototypes in the visual embedding space, estimated from the unlabeled test stream, and each test image is assigned to the category whose prototype is most similar to its visual feature. Extensive experiments across corruption and domain-shift benchmarks demonstrate that PACT outperforms adapted state-of-the-art TTA and GCD methods, effectively bridging the gap between adaptation and discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TT-GCD 新场景及 PACT 方法，在测试时无监督条件下同时实现分布式偏移适应、已知类分类与新颖类发现。
AI.motivation: 现有 TTA 假设测试类全部已知，GCD 假设已知类有标注训练数据，二者均不符合真实部署情况，因此需要一个统一的、更现实的场景。
AI.method: PACT 为全无监督框架，通过原型分配统一处理已知类识别与新颖类发现：先用高置信度零样本预测将偏移后的视觉特征与 VLM 文本导出的类别表示重新对齐；再在视觉嵌入空间中用无标注测试流估计已知类和新颖类的原型，将每张测试图像分配到特征最相似的原型所对应类别。
AI.result: 在腐蚀和域偏移基准上的大量实验表明，PACT 优于经过适配的最先进 TTA 与 GCD 方法，有效弥合了适应与发现之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: TT-GCD 将 TTA 与 GCD 统一为更现实的测试时无监督场景，PACT 验证了原型分配框架在该场景下同时进行适应与发现的可行性和优越性。

title: EpiTransfer: Sparse, Training-Free Long-Range Depth Estimation from Temporal Monocular Aerial Frames
