summary: Reliable 3D spatial understanding is essential for autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, and scene reconstruction. While state-of-the-art learned depth estimation techniques achieve high accuracy in-distribution, they often generalize poorly to novel viewpoints and altitudes. This paper presents a geometrically derived, training-free depth estimation method using epipolar transfer with only two monocular images and camera pose estimates. By leveraging camera motion to synthesize a virtual stereo pair with a freely chosen baseline, our approach transforms temporal correspondence into a stereo triangulation task while mitigating geometric degeneracies inherent to direct two-view triangulation. Validated across outdoor drone flights (to a maximum range of approximately 90\,m) and indoor OptiTrack environments against LiDAR ground truth, the method achieves an indoor AbsRel of 0.092 and $δ< 1.25$ of 0.940, comparable to direct triangulation (AbsRel 0.073) while retaining valid depth over a larger fraction of challenging scenes, and substantially outperforms off-the-shelf learning-based baselines such as ZoeDepth (AbsRel 0.225) and Depth Anything V2 (AbsRel 0.570), which are not trained or fine-tuned for this domain, with no training data required.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练、几何推导的深度估计方法，利用两幅单目图像与相机位姿，通过极线变换合成虚拟双目对进行三角测量，在室内外场景中优于学习类基线。
AI.motivation: 可靠的三维空间理解对自主导航、避障和场景重建至关重要。现有学习式深度估计方法虽在分布内精度高，但对新视角和新高度的泛化能力差，且依赖训练数据与微调。
AI.method: 仅使用两幅单目图像和相机位姿估计，基于极线变换（epipolar transfer）进行几何推导的免训练深度估计。利用相机运动合成具有可自由选择基线的虚拟双目对，将时序对应关系转化为双目三角测量问题，从而缓解直接双视图三角测量固有的几何退化问题。
AI.result: 在室外无人机飞行（最大约90 m）和室内OptiTrack环境中以LiDAR真值验证：室内AbsRel为0.092、δ<1.25为0.940，与直接三角测量（AbsRel 0.073）相当，但在更多挑战性场景中保持有效深度的比例更高；显著优于现成的学习类基线ZoeDepth（AbsRel 0.225）和Depth Anything V2（AbsRel 0.570）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需任何训练数据，即可在跨视角与跨高度场景中实现可靠的深度估计，泛化性优于未针对该域训练或微调的学习式方法。

title: Simple Diffusion Language Models Are More Effective Few-Step Generators Than Reported
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) promise fast parallel generation, yet high-quality samples often require large number of refinement steps, which diminishes their advantage in practice. This has led to massive interest in and rapid development of new methods for effective few-step generation. We show that much of the supposed quality gap at few steps can instead arise from a suboptimally configured sampler. Modest sampler sharpening, without any model retraining, enables a couple years old masked DLM to rival supposedly far improved successors. This differently sampled DLM in fact achieves lower generative perplexity in just 16 steps than what its standard sampler obtains with 1024, while improving both judged quality and semantic diversity. We further show that conventional per-output metrics can fundamentally obscure these gains, since any optimal trade-off between two such metrics can be attained by a generator supported on at most two outputs. We subsequently introduce GroupEval, which separately evaluates quality and across-output semantic diversity, and offers fresh insights including uncovering how 1.5-4.7x perplexity gains of a distilled model yield no corresponding quality gain. Finally, we explain why sharpening helps: parallel unmasking destroys dependencies among simultaneously generated tokens, creating a gap between prediction and generation. We prove that pervasive temperature choice of one is generically suboptimal under parallel sampling even for an exact denoiser, and that worse predictions can yield better samples. Through these results, we argue for a broader evaluation principle of treating the deployed generator as the object of comparison, benchmarking it against tuned baselines, and assessing quality and diversity jointly and with more human-aligned measures.

AI.tldr: 无需重训练，仅通过采样器锐化（sharpening）即可让旧版掩码扩散语言模型在16步生成质量超越原采样器1024步的效果；现有逐输出指标会掩盖此类增益，作者提出GroupEval联合评估质量与语义多样性，并从理论上证明温度=1在并行采样下次优。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）号称可快速并行生成，但高质量样本往往需要大量细化步数，削弱了其速度优势。这催生了大量少步生成新方法。作者质疑：少步下的"质量差距"很可能并非来自模型本身，而是来自配置不当的采样器，因此需要重新审视采样策略与评价方式。
AI.method: 1) 对已有（约两年前的）掩码DLM仅做适度的采样器锐化（sampler sharpening），不进行任何模型重训练；2) 理论分析并行采样：证明同时并行解掩码会破坏同时生成token间的依赖关系，造成预测与生成之间的差距，并证明即使去噪器精确，温度=1也通常是次优的，且更差的预测可能带来更好的样本；3) 提出GroupEval评估协议，分别刻画质量与跨输出语义多样性。
AI.result: 锐化采样的DLM仅用16步即达到比其标准采样器1024步更低的生成困惑度，同时提升人工评判质量与语义多样性，性能可比肩号称大幅改进的后继模型。此外，GroupEval揭示：某个蒸馏模型虽取得1.5–4.7倍困惑度增益，却无相应的质量提升；并指出任意两个逐输出指标间的最优权衡都能被仅支持至多两个输出的生成器达到，故此类指标本质上会掩盖上述增益。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张更广泛的评估原则：以实际部署的生成器为比较对象，与调优后的基线对比，并联合评估质量与多样性，采用更贴近人类判断的度量。采样器配置而非模型能力本身，是少步扩散语言模型性能的关键变量。

title: SymNetPro: LOS-Aware Directional Multi-Transmitter Localization from Sparse Radio Observations
comment: Code, datasets, and model checkpoints are available at:https://github.com/LyuzhouYe98/SymNet--a-multi-task-network-for-joint-radio-map-reconstruction-and-transmitter-localization
summary: Directional multi-transmitter localization from sparse received-power observations is difficult because the receiver observes only the source-unresolved aggregate field: multiple directional sources superpose, building blockage fragments their visible regions, and stronger sources can mask weaker ones. We present SymNetPro, which retains the dual-task radio-map reconstruction and localization backbone of SymNet and adds two targeted components. First, a sparse line-of-sight (LOS)-aware attention bias injects obstruction-aware spatial relations into selected token interactions. Second, transmitter-drop augmentation recomposes training scenes after removing one sample-supported transmitter, exposing the model to controlled source-cardinality variation. Experiments on directional ray-traced urban environments show substantially lower OSPA than representative localization baselines under extreme sparse sampling, with consistent gains under measurement noise and increasing transmitter count. A transmitter-specific evidence analysis further shows that remaining misses concentrate in regimes where the target contributes little distinguishable power to the aggregate observation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SymNetPro，在 SymNet 的“无线电地图重建+定位”双任务骨干上引入稀疏视距感知注意力偏置与发射机丢弃增强，以解决稀疏接收功率观测下多方向性发射机的聚合场定位难题。
AI.motivation: 稀疏接收功率观测下的多方向性发射机定位困难：接收端只能观测到未分辨源的聚合场，多个方向性源相互叠加，建筑遮挡使可见区域破碎，强源还会掩盖弱源，因此在极端稀疏采样下定位精度低。
AI.method: 保留了 SymNet 的双任务（无线电地图重建与定位）骨干，并新增两个组件：（1）稀疏视距（LOS）感知注意力偏置，将遮挡感知的空间关系注入选定的 token 交互中；（2）发射机丢弃增强，在移除一个由样本支持的发射机后重组训练场景，使模型接触可控的源数量变化。
AI.result: 在方向性射线追踪城市环境中，极端稀疏采样下 OSPA 显著低于代表性定位基线；在测量噪声和发射机数量增加时仍保持一致的性能提升。发射机特定证据分析表明，剩余漏检主要集中在对聚合观测贡献的可区分功率很小的情形。
AI.conclusion: SYMNETPRO 通过遮挡感知注意力建模与源数量扰动增强，有效缓解了聚合场下多发射机定位的源不可分辨与遮挡难题，性能优于代表性基线且对噪声与发射机数量变化具有鲁棒性。

title: Gaussian Splatting-based Volumetric Video Compression with Sparse 4D Anchors
summary: Immersive video communication requires photorealistic, render-efficient, and compact dynamic scene representations. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offers a promising representation, but dynamic 3DGS remains difficult to compress due to dense primitives and spatiotemporal redundancy. Anchor-based formulations improve compactness with sparse scaffolds that share geometry and appearance across primitives. However, existing designs often rely on deforming a single canonical scaffold and condition each primitive on its associated anchor in isolation, limiting their ability to handle non-local dynamics and disocclusion while under-exploiting inter-anchor correlations, particularly in motion- or texture-dense regions. To address these limitations, we propose SAGA, a volumetric video codec built upon Sparse Anchor-assisted GAussian splatting representations. SAGA represents dynamic 3D scenes using hierarchically organized sparse 4D anchors, where coordinate-based INR decoders generate fine anchors and Gaussian primitives from inter-anchor interpolations, enabling compact parameter sharing across spatiotemporal structures. For long-range dependencies among unstructured anchors, we further introduce fixed-size memory slots with orthogonality-informed updates for accurate entropy-context modeling. Experiments show that SAGA achieves strong rate-distortion performance against GIFStream, with PSNR BD-rate reductions of 80.39% and 83.94% on Neu3D and MPEG MIV, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGA，基于分层稀疏4D锚点与INR解码的动态3DGS体视频编解码器，通过锚点间插值和正交记忆槽建模长程依赖，在Neu3D与MPEG MIV上相对GIFStream实现PSNR BD-rate降低80.39%和83.94%。
AI.motivation: 沉浸式视频通信需要照片级真实、渲染高效且紧凑的动态场景表示。动态3DGS因密集基元与时空冗余难以压缩；现有基于锚点的方法虽通过稀疏支架共享几何与外观提升紧凑性，但多依赖单一规范支架变形，且各基元仅孤立依赖所属锚点，导致难以处理非局部运动与去遮挡，并低估锚点间相关性，在运动或纹理密集区域尤为明显。
AI.method: SAGA采用分层组织的稀疏4D锚点表示动态3D场景，利用基于坐标的INR解码器从锚点间插值生成精细锚点与高斯基元，实现跨时空结构的紧凑参数共享；针对非结构化锚点间的长程依赖，引入固定大小记忆槽与正交性引导的更新机制，以实现准确的熵上下文建模。
AI.result: 实验表明SAGA相对GIFStream取得强率失真性能，在Neu3D和MPEG MIV数据集上PSNR BD-rate分别降低80.39%与83.94%。
AI.conclusion: SAGA通过分层稀疏4D锚点、INR插值生成与正交记忆槽熵上下文建模，有效缓解动态3DGS的密集与冗余问题，并弥补现有锚点方法在非局部动态、去遮挡和锚点间相关性利用上的不足，显著提升动态场景压缩的率失真表现。

title: On the Token Value Inequality in Efficient Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-Thought reasoning has enabled large language models to achieve substantial performance gains on complex tasks. However, these gains come at the cost of dramatically increased token consumption. This raises a fundamental question: is every token in the reasoning trace equally valuable? We present a diagnostic and optimization framework grounded in a key empirical finding: the value of tokens within a CoT reasoning sequence is highly non-uniform, and this non-uniformity can be effectively characterized by token-level log probability signals. We show that normalized log probability helps distinguish core tokens, which carry structural and decisive reasoning content, from redundant tokens, which are exploratory, low-confidence filler that contributes less directly to the final answer. Building on these findings, we formulate the TokenProbe framework around two empirical findings and one claim: findings identify token value inequality first and then establish TokenProbe as a core-token proxy, and the claim introduces an efficient GRPO objective positing that selectively compressing redundant tokens can yield Pareto improvements in the accuracy-token efficiency space. Empirically, our method preserves reasoning quality while reducing the token usage by 76% of the baseline. Under matched reasoning-length budgets, we show that it can even outperform strong flagship baselines like Gemini-3.1-Pro. Homepage: https://runjia.tech/tokenprobe/.

AI.tldr: 提出诊断与优化框架 TokenProbe：基于 token 级对数概率刻画 CoT 推理中 token 价值的高度非均匀性，区分核心 token 与冗余 token，并通过高效 GRPO 目标选择性压缩冗余 token，实现准确率- token 效率的帕累托改进。
AI.motivation: CoT 推理虽提升大模型复杂任务表现，但显著增加 token 消耗。核心疑问是：推理轨迹中每个 token 是否同等重要？若 token 价值高度非均匀，则可对低价值冗余部分进行压缩，从而在不损失推理质量的前提下降低开销。
AI.method: 构建诊断与优化框架 TokenProbe。首先以 token 级对数概率信号（尤其归一化对数概率）作为价值度量，区分承载结构与决定性推理内容的核心 token 与探索性、低置信度的冗余填充 token；随后将 TokenProbe 作为核心 token 代理指标，并引入高效 GRPO 目标，选择性地压缩冗余 token。
AI.result: 在保持推理质量的同时，token 使用量相比基线减少 76%；在推理长度预算匹配的条件下，甚至可超越 Gemini-3.1-Pro 等强基线模型。
AI.conclusion: CoT 推理轨迹中 token 价值高度非均匀且可由对数概率信号有效刻画，据此对冗余 token 进行选择性压缩可在准确率与 token 效率之间取得帕累托改进，为高效推理提供可行路径。

title: Do System One Decisions Add Up? A Study of Probabilistic Coherence
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures. Code and experimental results: https://github.com/samanjoy2/system-one-coherence
summary: A decision model can give probabilities that sum to one for every question yet disagree with itself when the same decision is broken into smaller steps. We study this form of probabilistic coherence in Jev and the English Laya checkpoint, using 2,500 matched examples per system across TREC, CLINC150, and MASSIVE. Across 72,000 classification questions, we compare direct fine-label predictions with broad-category probabilities and predictions reconstructed through those categories. Both systems show substantial disagreement: mean category-level total variation ranges from 0.219 to 0.349 for Jev and from 0.424 to 0.689 for Laya, on a scale where zero means exact agreement. The consequences differ sharply. On CLINC150, reconstruction reduces Jev's accuracy by 22.9 percentage points (paired 95% bootstrap interval: [-24.9, -20.9]) and improves Laya's by 21.3 points ([18.0, 24.5]). The same directions hold across all three datasets, with all six unadjusted accuracy-change intervals excluding zero. Improved accuracy can also accompany less reliable confidence: on MASSIVE, Laya gains 9.2 accuracy points while its expected calibration error rises from 0.046 to 0.124. Error analysis identifies both broad-category mistakes and within-category confusions. These findings show why decision systems need joint evaluation of accuracy, confidence calibration, and probability coherence in the workflow used by an application.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究决策模型的概率一致性（probabilistic coherence），在Jev与English Laya两个系统上，用TREC、CLINC150、MASSIVE三个数据集共2,500个匹配样本、72,000个分类问题，比较直接标签预测与经粗类别重构预测之间的分歧。两系统均表现出显著不一致，但重构对准确率的影响方向相反：Jev准确率下降，Laya上升，且准确率提升可能伴随置信度校准变差。
AI.motivation: 决策模型可能对每个问题给出和为1的概率，却在同一决策被拆分为更小步骤时自相矛盾。作者希望探究这种概率一致性（coherence）问题在实际系统中的表现及其后果，说明评估决策系统时需要同时考虑准确率、置信度校准与概率一致性。
AI.method: 在Jev与English Laya两个系统上，跨TREC、CLINC150、MASSIVE三个数据集，每个系统使用2,500个匹配样本，共72,000个分类问题。比较直接细标签预测、粗类别概率以及通过该类别重构的预测；用类别级总变差（total variation）衡量分歧，用配对bootstrap区间检验准确率变化，并计算期望校准误差（ECE）。
AI.result: 两系统均呈现显著不一致：类别级平均总变差Jev为0.219–0.349，Laya为0.424–0.689（0表示完全一致）。后果方向相反：CLINC150上重构使Jev准确率下降22.9个百分点（配对95% bootstrap区间[-24.9, -20.9]），使Laya提升21.3个百分点（[18.0, 24.5]）；三个数据集方向一致，六个未调整准确率变化区间均不含零。准确率提升可伴随可靠性下降：MASSIVE上Laya准确率增加9.2个百分点，同时ECE从0.046升至0.124。误差分析识别出粗类别错误与类别内混淆。
AI.conclusion: 概率一致性缺陷在决策系统中普遍存在，且重构对准确率的影响因系统而异，准确率提升未必意味着置信度更可靠。因此，评估决策系统应在应用实际工作流中联合考察准确率、置信度校准与概率一致性。

title: Beyond Solo and Consistency: Vindicating Multi-Agent Debate via Conditional Progressive Pruning
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) based Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) is one of the most effective test time scaling techniques. Through multi-round communication, agents complement each other in knowledge and reasoning and solve tasks that no single member can solve. However, existing MAD frameworks fail to beat strong Single Agent and Consistency-based baselines under the same strict cost limit, which shakes the foundation of the MAD field. We propose Conditional Progressive Pruning (CPP), a lightweight pruning framework that fully exploits multi-round MAD. CPP outperforms all existing MAD frameworks on multiple dominated benchmarks. It is also the first to fully outperform consistency methods. Our code, detailed agent interaction records will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出条件渐进剪枝（CPP），一种轻量级剪枝框架，旨在充分释放多轮多智能体辩论（MAD）的潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有MAD框架在同等严格成本限制下无法超越强单智能体与一致性（Consistency-based）基线，动摇了MAD领域的基础。
AI.method: 提出条件渐进剪枝（CPP），通过轻量级剪枝机制充分利用多轮辩论过程，在其中逐步筛选与压缩智能体参与。
AI.result: CPP在多个主流基准上优于所有现有MAD框架，并首次全面超越一致性方法。
AI.conclusion: CPP在成本受限条件下显著提升MAD效果，为多智能体辩论的测试时扩展提供了有效方案，代码与详细智能体交互记录将随后发布。

title: Test-Time Spatial Reasoning for Robot Manipulation Using Generative Real-to-Sim
summary: Spatial reasoning is fundamental to general robot intelligence, as it enables robots to complete long-horizon tasks involving multi-object interaction. We introduce Simify, a training-free, test-time framework that performs explicit spatial reasoning via massively parallel physics simulation. From a single RGB-D image of a scene, Simify reconstructs simulation-ready assets leveraging 3D generative models and vision-language models. Then given a task specified by a reward function (e.g., build the tallest tower), Simify launches thousands of parallel rollouts in simulation and performs an evolutionary search to optimize object arrangements, typically converging within seconds. We conduct quantitative experiments on real-robot hardware to demonstrate the ability of our framework to execute complex object rearrangement tasks end-to-end with previously unseen objects. Results show that our framework outperforms prior work on foundation models for spatial reasoning by effectively exploiting large-scale parallel simulation during inference, and also highlight the importance of complete and accurate geometry for successful sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: Simify 是一个免训练、基于测试时大规模并行物理仿真的空间推理框架：从单张 RGB-D 图像重建可仿真资产，并通过进化搜索优化物体摆放，在数秒内完成复杂物体重排任务的端到端真机执行。
AI.motivation: 空间推理是通用机器人智能的基础，支撑多物体交互的长时程任务。现有基础模型在空间推理上表现不足，本文希望借助推理阶段的大规模并行仿真来提升空间推理能力，并实现仿真到现实的有效迁移。
AI.method: 方法免训练、在测试时执行显式空间推理。输入为单张 RGB-D 场景图像，利用 3D 生成模型与视觉语言模型重建可仿真的资产；任务以奖励函数指定（如搭建最高塔）；随后在仿真中启动数千条并行 rollout，并用进化搜索优化物体排列。
AI.result: 在真实机器人硬件上开展了定量实验，能够对先前未见过的物体执行复杂的物体重排任务并端到端完成；相比面向空间推理的基础模型先前工作表现更优，同时表明完整且准确的几何信息对成功的 sim-to-real 迁移至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 在推理阶段有效利用大规模并行仿真可显著增强机器人空间推理与物体重排能力，且高质量几何重建是仿真到现实迁移成功的关键。

title: High-Level Text Preprocessing for Semantic Similarity Analysis of Discursive Texts: A Framework and Empirical Demonstration
comment: 18 pages, 8 tables, 39 references; submitted for publication
summary: Semantic Textual Similarity (STS) methods assume that a document's lexical content faithfully represents what it asserts. This assumption fails for discursive documents that discuss, compare, critique, and contextualize other positions in the process of articulating their own. The result is semantic diffusion: similarity scores between documents are inflated by vocabulary acquired through discursive engagement rather than substantive alignment. Standard Natural Language Processing (NLP) preprocessing (tokenization, stopword removal, stemming, lemmatization) cannot address this problem because it operates at the lexical level, treating all content identically regardless of its discursive function. This paper introduces high-level text preprocessing: a systematic, rule-based intervention applied before the standard preprocessing pipeline to isolate each document's actual claim from its discursive structure. We propose 12 rules, each with an explicit rationale, and demonstrate their effect on an encyclopedic philosophical corpus: three entries from the Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy (virtue ethics, deontological ethics, and consequentialism). A three-phase experiment using eight Transformer-based STS models shows that preprocessing reduces centroid cosine similarity scores across all three theory pairs, with 23 of 24 model-pair comparisons showing the expected decrease and cross-model agreement ranging from 7-1 to 8-0. We introduce the semantic diffusion index (SDI), a per-document metric for assessing the semantic reorientation between a document's raw and high-level preprocessed representations. Although the framework is demonstrated using philosophical texts, it potentially addresses a domain-agnostic problem applicable to legal texts, policy documents, academic articles, and any genre in which a discursive approach introduces vocabulary from positions the document does not endorse.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"高层文本预处理"，用12条规则在标准预处理前剥离文档的论述性结构，以缓解语义扩散问题，并在哲学语料上验证其降低相似度虚高的效果。
AI.motivation: 语义文本相似度（STS）方法假设文档的词汇内容忠实反映其主张，但论述性文档（讨论、比较、批评、语境化其他立场）会引入并非自身认同的词汇，导致"语义扩散"：相似度被论述性互动获得的词汇抬高而非实质立场一致。标准NLP预处理（分词、去停用词、词干化、词形还原）只在词汇层面操作，无法区分内容的论述功能，故无法解决该问题。
AI.method: 提出高层文本预处理：在标准预处理流程之前施加系统的、基于规则的干预，将每个文档的实际主张与其论述结构隔离。共提出12条规则，每条附明确理据。在百科全书式哲学语料上演示：斯坦福哲学百科全书的三个条目（德性伦理学、义务论伦理学、后果主义）。采用三阶段实验，使用八个基于Transformer的STS模型，并引入语义扩散指数（SDI），一个逐文档指标，用于评估文档原始表征与高层预处理表征之间的语义重定向程度。
AI.result: 预处理在全部三对理论之间均降低了质心余弦相似度；24个模型-理论对比较中有23个显示预期下降；跨模型一致性在7-1至8-0之间。
AI.conclusion: 该框架虽以哲学文本演示，但针对的是领域无关的问题，潜在适用于法律文本、政策文件、学术论文，以及任何因论述方式引入文档并不认同之立场词汇的文体。

title: Opera: A Verbal Critic Framework for Long-horizon Coding Agents
summary: Long-horizon coding agents need timely corrections, yet feedback can be ineffective or even harmful when it misjudges ongoing work or fails to address the underlying problem. Existing critics focus on evaluating trajectories and generating feedback, but rarely track what happens after feedback is delivered. We present Opera, a verbal critic framework that treats each correction as a persistent note, followed until the diagnosed problem is resolved. Opera decides when to review through periodic and event-driven triggers, diagnoses issues with typed operators, audits feedback against visible evidence before delivery, and tracks the agent's subsequent actions to distinguish mere compliance from actual resolution. As a test-time critic, Opera improves the resolve rate of non-critic agents by up to 12.4, 15.0, and 8.9 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, a SWE-Bench Pro subset, and DeepSWE v1.1, respectively, across four policy models, and achieves the highest mean resolve rate among competitive critic baselines on all three benchmarks, and also improves policy models when the policy critiques itself. Beyond inference, Opera-guided rollouts provide approximately on-policy training data: fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on them improves its resolve rate on held-out SWE-Bench Pro repositories by 10.2 percentage points without a critic at inference time, matching fine-tuning on rollouts from a stronger model, while preserving its performance when switching harness, i.e., from Openhands to Terminus-2, which the latter substantially degrades. Our code is available at: https://github.com/dongyuanjushi/Opera.

AI.tldr: Opera将每次纠正视为需持续跟踪直至问题解决的"持久笔记"，通过周期性/事件触发审查、类型化操作符诊断、证据审计与后续动作追踪来区分"表面遵从"与"真正解决"，在多个基准上显著提升resolve率并可生成类on-policy训练数据。
AI.motivation: 长时程编码智能体需要及时纠正，但反馈若误判进行中的工作或未触及根本问题，会无效甚至有害。现有critic侧重评估轨迹与生成反馈，却极少追踪反馈交付后发生了什么。
AI.method: 提出Opera——一种verbal critic框架：1）将每次纠正作为持久笔记，跟踪到所诊断问题被解决为止；2）通过周期性触发与事件驱动触发决定何时审查；3）用类型化操作符（typed operators）诊断问题；4）交付前依据可见证据审计反馈；5）追踪智能体后续动作，区分单纯遵从与真正解决。既可作为测试时critic，也可用于生成训练数据。
AI.result: 作为测试时critic，在四个策略模型上，于Terminal-Bench 2.1、SWE-Bench Pro子集、DeepSWE v1.1上分别将非critic智能体的resolve率提升最高12.4、15.0、8.9个百分点，并在三个基准上取得竞争性critic基线中最高的平均resolve率；策略模型自我批评时亦有提升。Opera引导的rollout约等于on-policy训练数据：在Qwen3.5-9B上微调，使held-out SWE-Bench Pro仓库的resolve率提升10.2个百分点（推理时无critic），与用更强模型rollout微调相当，且在从Openhands切换至Terminus-2时保持性能（后者会显著降低性能）。
AI.conclusion: 追踪反馈后续效果、以持久笔记方式管理纠正是有效提升长时程编码智能体的关键；Opera兼具推理时增益与训练数据生成价值，并具备跨harness鲁棒性。

title: RewardExplainer: Learning Reward Model Explanations from Counterfactual Preference Feedback
summary: Reward models (RMs) are a key component of large language model post-training, providing reward signals for subsequent reinforcement learning. However, conventional discriminative RMs typically output only scalar scores, making it difficult to identify the response behaviors associated with their scoring decisions. Existing interpretation methods often rely on predefined high-level attributes and require repeated counterfactual interventions for each response pair to validate candidate explanations, lacking a closed-loop mechanism that uses RMs' feedback to train a reusable explainer. To address this, we propose RewardExplainer, a framework that obtains feedback from the target reward model through counterfactual rewriting and uses this feedback to further optimize the explainer. RewardExplainer generates open-ended, atomic, and intervenable natural-language scoring mechanisms, making explanations more concrete, readable, and actionable. It further converts counterfactual feedback into preference supervision, enabling the explainer to more faithfully capture the target RM's scoring preferences and sensitive behaviors than single-pass generation. Extensive experiments across multiple target RMs and explainer backbones show consistent improvements. Beyond interpretation, we use the generated mechanisms to identify potential bias patterns and construct targeted debiasing data for fine-tuning the reward model, improving robustness on reward-hacking benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出RewardExplainer框架，通过反事实重写从目标奖励模型获取反馈并优化解释器，生成开放式、原子化、可干预的自然语言评分机制，提升解释忠实度并实现去偏。
AI.motivation: 常规判别式奖励模型仅输出标量分数，难以识别与评分决策相关的响应行为；现有解释方法依赖预定义高层属性，且需为每个响应对反复进行反事实干预来验证候选解释，缺乏利用RM反馈训练可复用解释器的闭环机制。
AI.method: RewardExplainer通过反事实重写从目标奖励模型获取反馈，并用该反馈进一步优化解释器；生成开放式、原子化、可干预的自然语言评分机制；将反事实反馈转化为偏好监督，使解释器比单次生成更忠实地捕捉目标RM的评分偏好与敏感行为。
AI.result: 在多个目标RM与解释器骨干上的大量实验显示一致性提升；利用生成的机制识别潜在偏见模式并构建针对性去偏数据以微调奖励模型，在reward-hacking基准上提升了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该闭环反馈框架使奖励模型解释更具体、可读、可操作且忠实，并可作为识别偏见与构建去偏数据的工具，提升奖励模型鲁棒性。

title: A Multi-Dataset Benchmark of YOLO-Based Weed Detection in Precision Agriculture
summary: Weed detection is an important component of precision agriculture, enabling site-specific weed management and reducing unnecessary herbicide use. Although deep learning methods have achieved strong results for crop and weed detection, many studies rely on single-dataset evaluation, making it difficult to assess robustness across different agricultural domains. This paper presents a multi-dataset benchmark of deep object detectors for weed detection in precision agriculture, with a focused evaluation of YOLO26 models. We evaluate nano, small, and medium variants on seven public weed-detection datasets covering different crops, weed species, field conditions, acquisition setups, and annotation protocols. The models are compared in terms of detection accuracy, model complexity, inference latency, FPS, and model size. In addition to in-dataset evaluation, we investigate cross-domain generalization using a unified one-class weed setup and evaluate multi-source training using the combined training subsets from all datasets. The results show that YOLO26 achieves strong in-dataset performance, with YOLO26m obtaining the highest average accuracy and YOLO26s providing the best practical accuracy-efficiency trade-off. However, cross-domain performance decreases substantially, with YOLO26s dropping from an average in-domain mAP$_{50:95}$ of 0.603 to 0.148 in the off-domain setting. Multi-source training improves performance on several datasets, but does not fully eliminate domain shift. Overall, the benchmark highlights the importance of dataset diversity, domain similarity, and target-domain adaptation for robust weed detection in real-world precision agriculture applications.

AI.tldr: 本文对YOLO26系列目标检测器在杂草检测任务上进行多数据集基准评测，并系统考察跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习杂草检测研究多依赖单一数据集评估，难以判断模型在不同农业场景下的鲁棒性，缺乏跨数据集、跨域的基准对比。
AI.method: 在七个公开杂草检测数据集（涵盖不同作物、杂草种类、田间条件、采集设备与标注协议）上评测YOLO26的nano、small、medium三种变体，比较检测精度、模型复杂度、推理延迟、FPS与模型大小；并采用统一单类杂草设置进行跨域泛化测试，以及多源联合训练评估。
AI.result: YOLO26在域内表现优异，YOLO26m平均精度最高，YOLO26s在精度-效率权衡上最佳；但跨域性能显著下降，YOLO26s平均域内mAP$_{50:95}$从0.603降至域外0.148；多源训练可提升部分数据集性能，但未能完全消除域偏移。
AI.conclusion: 该基准表明数据集多样性、域相似性与目标域自适应对实现真实农业场景下鲁棒的杂草检测至关重要。

title: UnfoldCRF: Structured Mask Refinement with Image-Conditioned Latent Regions
summary: Learned mask refiners improve segmentation accuracy, but it is hard to tell how much of the improvement comes from explicit structure rather than from extra capacity, and whether it holds up when the mask generator or its error distribution changes. UnfoldCRF treats refinement as inference in a conditional random field over pixel labels and latent region variables. Its energy has a corrected unary term, learned local pairwise interactions, and image-conditioned latent-region consistency, with a null state that lets a region with weak label agreement withdraw from the consistency term; inference unrolls damped mean-field updates on this one energy. To isolate the effect of structure, we compare against recurrent black-box refiners that read the same inputs and receive the same parameter budget, stage count, and supervision. On COD10K, UnfoldCRF beats the strongest matched control by 1.0 $F^ω_β$ point, improves all four COD metrics, and lowers the fraction of images made worse from 11.7\% to 8.5\%. Under a train-once protocol over five datasets and several mask sources, the 2.6M-parameter variant gains 4.2 mean $Δ$IoU against 2.0 for its control, and a variant built on frozen DINOv2 features matches the strongest foundation-model refiner with about a seventh of its resident parameters while staying ahead of its own control. On mask generators never seen in training, the gain is 2.0 $F^ω_β$ points against 0.6 for the control. Zeroing individual messages shows where the corrections come from: the pairwise messages mostly fix boundaries, the region messages mostly fix non-boundary errors. Code and supporting materials will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出 UnfoldCRF，将掩码精修建模为隐变量 CRF 上的展开平均场推断，通过等参数量、等监督的对照实验证明性能提升源自显式结构而非额外容量。
AI.motivation: 已学习的掩码精修器虽提升分割精度，但难以辨别提升来自显式结构还是额外容量，且不确定在掩码生成器或其误差分布变化时是否稳健。因此需要一个受控比较来隔离结构的作用。
AI.method: 将精修视为像素标签与潜在区域变量上的条件随机场推断。能量项包含校正一元项、学习的局部成对交互、图像条件化的潜在区域一致性项，并设置空状态使标签一致性弱的区域退出一致性项；推断以阻尼平均场更新在该单一能量上展开。对照实验采用循环黑箱精修器，输入、参数量、阶段数与监督均匹配。
AI.result: COD10K 上比最强匹配对照高 1.0 F^ω_β，四项 COD 指标全部提升，变差图像比例从 11.7% 降至 8.5%。一次训练跨五数据集与多种掩码源协议下，2.6M 参数变体平均 ΔIoU 增益 4.2（对照 2.0）；基于冻结 DINOv2 特征的变体以约七分之一常驻参数匹敌最强基础模型精修器且优于自身对照。未见过的掩码生成器上增益 2.0 F^ω_β（对照 0.6）。消融将各消息置零显示：成对消息主要修复边界，区域消息主要修复非边界误差。
AI.conclusion: 在严格匹配容量与监督的条件下，UnfoldCRF 的增益可归因于显式 CRF 结构，且在不同掩码源、跨数据集与未见生成器上具有稳健性与参数效率。

title: MetaSampling: Making Frame Samplers Efficient for Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Frame selection is an important component of long-video question answering (VQA) with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing frame-selection methods improve over simple top-$k$ embedding retrieval and uniform sampling, but are typically applied under a fixed global selection budget. We introduce \textbf{MetaSampling}, a training-free, plug-and-play sampling strategy that can be applied on top of existing frame selectors. MetaSampling improves downstream VQA efficiency by dynamically reducing the number of frames passed to the MLLM while preserving, and in some cases improving, answer accuracy. We evaluate MetaSampling across 36 paired frame-selector--MLLM-backbone--VQA-benchmark configurations. MetaSampling reduces the number of selected frames in all 36 configurations and improves accuracy in 25 of them, yielding an average frame reduction of $8.9\%$ while slightly improving accuracy overall.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、即插即用的MetaSampling采样策略，在36种配置中普遍减少帧数并提升VQA准确率。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答中，现有帧选择方法虽优于朴素top-k检索和均匀采样，但通常依赖固定的全局选择预算，无法动态调整帧数，导致效率与精度难以兼顾。
AI.method: MetaSampling是一种免训练、即插即用的采样策略，可叠加在现有帧选择器之上，动态减少送入MLLM的帧数量，同时保持甚至提升答案准确率。
AI.result: 在36种"帧选择器—MLLM骨干—VQA基准"组合配置上评估：全部36种配置均减少所选帧数，其中25种配置准确率提升，平均帧数减少8.9%，整体准确率略有提升。
AI.conclusion: MetaSampling能有效提升下游VQA效率，具备良好的通用性与兼容性，可在不损失甚至提升精度的前提下降低计算开销。

title: ZeroBot: Learning from Scratch in Minutes with Generative Real2Sim
summary: We present ZeroBot, a real2sim framework for learning a robot manipulation task from scratch in minutes under challenging conditions: zero human demonstrations, zero policy pre-training, and zero known object models. Given only a single view of an object and a goal pose for that object, ZeroBot uses image-to-3D generative models to obtain a complete object mesh, which is used in simulation for large-scale parallel reinforcement learning. To accelerate training, we introduce an action space which leverages the generated geometry and learned value function to sample states involving robot-object contact. When evaluated on real-world tasks including grasping, pushing, articulated object interaction, and multi-stage manipulation, ZeroBot achieves an 87% success rate with an average training time of 119 seconds. These results show the value of using image-to-3D models in a real2sim framework for rapid, autonomous robot learning.

AI.tldr: ZeroBot 提出 real2sim 框架，在零人类演示、零策略预训练、零已知物体模型条件下，仅凭单视角图像与目标位姿，用图像到3D生成模型构建物体网格并在仿真中大规模并行强化学习，真实任务平均119秒训练达87%成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作学习的传统方法依赖人类示范、策略预训练或已知物体CAD模型，获取成本高、扩展性差。作者希望验证：在"零人类演示、零策略预训练、零已知物体模型"的极端条件下，能否利用图像到3D生成模型的先验，快速、自主地学会真实世界操作任务。
AI.method: 提出 real2sim 框架 ZeroBot：输入仅为一个物体的单视角图像和目标位姿，先用图像到3D生成模型重建完整物体网格；将该网格导入仿真环境进行大规模并行强化学习。为加速训练，设计了一种新动作空间，利用生成几何与学习到的价值函数，采样包含机器人-物体接触的状态。
AI.result: 在抓取、推动、铰接物体交互及多阶段操作等真实任务上评估，ZeroBot 达到87%成功率，平均训练时间仅119秒。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了将图像到3D模型嵌入 real2sim 框架，可实现快速、自主的机器人学习，为摆脱人类示范与预训练依赖的操作策略学习提供了可行路径。

title: A Computer Vision Approach to Visual Fraud Detection in Phishing Websites Using YOLOv8
summary: Phishing remains one of the most common vectors for financial and identity fraud, and most detection systems still rely on inspecting a page's URL, HTML markup, or domain registration history. These signals are easy for an attacker to rotate or obfuscate, and they say very little about what actually convinces a victim to hand over a password or a card number: the way the page looks. This paper describes a visual, image-based approach to phishing detection that treats a rendered webpage the same way a human eye would, as a picture that either matches a trusted brand or doesn't. A YOLOv8 convolutional neural network was trained to classify full-page website screenshots as phishing or legitimate based on layout, logo placement, color scheme, and login-form structure, rather than on text extracted from the page. The system reached 92% classification accuracy on a held-out test set, processed a single screenshot in roughly 100 milliseconds, and, after a round of data augmentation aimed specifically at lighting, compression, and scaling variation, cut the false-positive rate by 11% relative to the pre-augmentation baseline. The paper walks through the dataset construction, the augmentation strategy, the model architecture and training setup, and the resulting performance, and closes with a discussion of where this kind of visual detector fits alongside, rather than instead of, existing URL- and content-based defenses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于视觉图像的网络钓鱼检测方法，使用YOLOv8对网页整页截图进行分类，判断其为钓鱼页面或合法页面，在独立测试集上达到92%准确率，单张截图处理耗时约100毫秒，并通过针对光照、压缩、缩放变化的数据增强将假阳性率较基线降低11%。
AI.motivation: 现有钓鱼检测系统主要依赖URL、HTML标记或域名注册历史等信息，这些信号易被攻击者轮换或混淆，且难以反映真正诱导受害者泄露密码或卡号的关键因素——页面的视觉外观。因此需要一种从渲染后页面图像出发、贴近人类视觉判断的检测思路。
AI.method: 将渲染后的网页视为图像，训练YOLOv8卷积神经网络，对整页网站截图进行钓鱼/合法二分类；分类依据为页面布局、logo位置、配色方案和登录表单结构等视觉特征，而非页面提取文本。同时设计了针对光照、压缩和缩放的定向数据增强策略，并详述了数据集构建、模型架构与训练设置。
AI.result: 在独立测试集上取得92%的分类准确率；单张截图处理时间约100毫秒；经过面向光照、压缩和缩放变化的数据增强后，假阳性率相较增强前基线下降11%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉型检测器可作为现有基于URL和页面内容的防御手段的补充而非替代，与二者协同使用可形成更完整的钓鱼防护体系。

title: Position Aware Layer Queries for Test Time Training in Vision Language Models
summary: Test-Time Training (TTT) adapts models to incoming test samples (e.g. out-of-distribution, (OOD)) when conventional fine-tuning is infeasible. Existing TTT methods for Vision-Language Models (VLMs) create supervision from several augmented views, each requiring forward (and often backward) passes through the entire VLM, incurring substantial computational cost. We observe that one forward pass with all the intermediate layer outputs already yields far more signal than the final embedding from all augmentations. We introduce Layer Query Network (LQN), a lightweight approach that can adapt a frozen VLM (teacher) in a single forward pass of the VLM via a small model (student). LQN uses Position-Aware Distillation (PAD) to mimic the teacher VLM's intermediate-layer spatial tokens by querying spatial coordinates of intermediate tokens. LQN additionally relies on Location Consistency Regularization (LCR), a self-supervision technique, replacing expensive O(H x W) image augmentation with O(1) coordinate sampling. Integrating these, LQN i) adapts and improves zero-shot CLIP ViT-B/16 by 9.8% Top-1 on OOD ImageNet, ii) outperforms the previous best GS-Bias on fine-grained classification by 3.9% Top-1, iii) achieves faster convergence than TPS for CLIP ResNet-50 (47 mins vs 55 mins), iv) generalizes adaptation to VLMs like SigLIP, EVA-CLIP, and CoCa, and lightweight students like MLP, ResNet, VGG, and v) extends to panoptic, instance, and semantic segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Layer Query Network（LQN），一种在单次前向传播中适配冻结VLM的轻量测试时训练方法，通过位置感知蒸馏与位置一致性正则实现高效自适应。
AI.motivation: 现有针对视觉语言模型（VLM）的测试时训练（TTT）方法依赖多视图增强，每个视图都需对整个VLM进行前向（有时含反向）传播，计算开销巨大。作者观察到，单次前向传播中所有中间层输出所包含的监督信号，已远多于多次增强后的最终嵌入。
AI.method: 提出Layer Query Network（LQN），用小型学生模型在一次VLM前向传播中适配冻结的教师VLM。核心组件包括：1）位置感知蒸馏（PAD），通过查询中间token的空间坐标来模仿教师VLM的中间层空间token；2）位置一致性正则（LCR），一种自监督技术，以O(1)的坐标采样替代昂贵的O(H×W)图像增强。
AI.result: i）将零样本CLIP ViT-B/16在OOD ImageNet上Top-1提升9.8%；ii）在细粒度分类上比此前最优的GS-Bias高出3.9% Top-1；iii）对CLIP ResNet-50收敛快于TPS（47分钟vs 55分钟）；iv）可泛化到SigLIP、EVA-CLIP、CoCa等VLM及MLP、ResNet、VGG等轻量学生模型；v）可扩展至全景、实例和语义分割任务。
AI.conclusion: LQN通过利用单次前向传播的中间层信号，以极低计算成本实现高效VLM测试时适配，在多种模型、任务和下游场景中验证了有效性与泛化性。

title: Jev in Medicine: A Benchmark Evaluation
summary: Jev is a non-generative System One model that assigns probabilities to predefined answer options and cannot answer outside them. Its accuracy and calibration on medical question-answering and case-based diagnostic-reasoning tasks are unknown. We evaluated Jev 1.13 on four medical benchmarks: MetaMedQA, PubMedQA, DiagnosisArena-MCQ and the NEJM Case Challenges. GPT-6 Sol, with (medium) and without reasoning, was the reference. The primary outcome was top-1 accuracy; key secondary outcomes were calibration, selective prediction and recognition of unanswerable questions. All 8,469 requests returned a valid answer. Jev's accuracy was similar to that of GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning on PubMedQA (78.4% vs 78.2%;), lower on MetaMedQA (74.8% vs 82.7%) and much lower on DiagnosisArena-MCQ (59.8% vs 82.4%;) and the NEJM cases (61.8% vs 82.4%). On MetaMedQA, Jev's probabilities were the best calibrated (expected calibration error 0.063 vs 0.146), and its answers with a probability of at least 0.9 (52.9% of questions) were 93.4% accurate, but GPT-6 Sol was as accurate when it accepted a similar proportion of questions. On DiagnosisArena-MCQ, Jev's probabilities discriminated poorly (AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768). Of the 162 questions whose correct answer was "I don't know or cannot answer", Jev chose that option for 10.5% (GPT-6 Sol, 8.6%). Median latency was 0.27-0.31 s; all 2,823 items cost USD 0.08. Jev was fast and inexpensive, and its accuracy was similar to that of a frontier LLM on research abstracts but lower on examination questions and much lower on complex diagnostic cases. Task-specific validation is required before clinical use.

AI.tldr: 评估非生成式System One模型Jev 1.13在四个医学基准上的准确性与校准，并与GPT-6 Sol对比。
AI.motivation: Jev为非生成式System One模型，仅在预定义选项间分配概率，无法给出选项外答案；其在医学问答与病例诊断推理上的准确性和校准性能尚不明确。
AI.method: 在MetaMedQA、PubMedQA、DiagnosisArena-MCQ与NEJM Case Challenges四个基准上评估Jev 1.13，以GPT-6 Sol（含/不含中等推理）为参照。主要终点为top-1准确率，次要终点为校准、选择性预测及对不可回答问题（"I don't know or cannot answer"）的识别。
AI.result: 8,469次请求全部返回有效答案。PubMedQA上Jev与中等推理GPT-6 Sol相当（78.4% vs 78.2%）；MetaMedQA较低（74.8% vs 82.7%）；DiagnosisArena-MCQ（59.8% vs 82.4%）与NEJM病例（61.8% vs 82.4%）显著更低。MetaMedQA上Jev校准最佳（ECE 0.063 vs 0.146），概率≥0.9的答案（占52.9%）准确率93.4%，但GPT-6 Sol在接收相近比例题目时准确率相当；DiagnosisArena-MCQ上其概率区分度差（AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768）。162道正确选项为"我不知道或无法回答"的题目中，Jev选择该选项的比例为10.5%（GPT-6 Sol为8.6%）。中位延迟0.27–0.31 s，2,823项共花费0.08美元。
AI.conclusion: Jev快速、低成本，在研究摘要类问答上准确率与前沿LLM相当，在考试题上较低，在复杂诊断病例上显著更低；临床使用前需进行任务特异性验证。

title: Structure-Adaptive Tree Field Integrators
summary: We present a new class of near-linear algorithms for efficiently integrating general tensor fields defined on trees with distance dependent kernels, the Structure-Adaptive Tree Field Integrators (STAD-TFIs). STAD-TFIs exploit the tree's underlying structure through decompositions built around path backbones and single vertex separators, and use two-dimensional fast Fourier transforms to compute interactions jointly. By exploiting this structural information, STAD-TFIs achieve more computationally efficient integration than their regular efficient tree field integrators (TFI) counterparts. We provide a detailed theoretical analysis of our proposed approach and complement it with an exhaustive empirical evaluation, ranging from speed tests on synthetic trees, through accelerated Sinkhorn-based relaxations of the Optimal Transport algorithms on real meshes, to Topological Attention Transformers for vision tasks. To the best of our knowledge, we provide some of the first results showing that efficient to compute and accurate relaxations of the geodesic Sinkhorn-based solutions of the Optimal Transport problem can be derived by applying fast TFI methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构自适应树场积分器（STAD-TFIs），利用路径骨干与单顶点分隔子的分解及二维FFT，实现树上张量场的高效近线性积分，并在合成树、网格最优传输与视觉Transformer任务上验证其性能。
AI.motivation: 现有正则高效树场积分器（TFI）在积分定义于树上、具有距离依赖核的一般张量场时计算效率仍有提升空间，且缺乏将快速TFI方法应用于测地Sinkhorn最优传输松弛的有效途径。
AI.method: STAD-TFIs通过围绕路径骨干和单顶点分隔子构建的分解来显式利用树的底层结构，并采用二维快速傅里叶变换（2D FFT）联合计算相互作用，从而在积分过程中获得比正则TFI更高的计算效率。
AI.result: 作者提供了详细的理论分析，并进行全面实证评估：合成树上的速度测试、真实网格上基于Sinkhorn的最优传输加速松弛，以及视觉任务中的拓扑注意力Transformer。结果表明，STAD-TFIs在效率上优于正则TFI，并能得到快速且准确的测地Sinkhorn最优传输解的松弛。
AI.conclusion: STAD-TFIs是一类高效、准确的树上张量场积分算法，首次展示了通过快速TFI方法可获得高效且精确的测地Sinkhorn最优传输松弛解，拓宽了树场积分在最优传输与视觉任务中的应用。

title: Re:Cognize -- Open-Set Comic Character Re-Identification
summary: A manga reader meets a character on one page and knows them on sight a hundred pages later, without ever being handed a cast list. Re-identifying comic characters demands the same, open-set and sequential: pages arrive as a stream in reading order, new faces appear before anyone names them, and the cast is assembled as the story is read. $\textbf{Re:Cognize}$ evaluates recognition as the story is read, not against a cast handed over in advance: four protocols on one query stream, from closed-set retrieval to a cast the model must build and grow itself. The surprise is where models fail. Recognising is close to solved: one reference image per character already ranks as well as a gallery built in advance. Knowing what to believe is not: a model that adds its own matches makes its cast worse, while the same growth with correct labels would gain over twenty points of top-1 accuracy. The bottleneck is acceptance, not vision, and one comparison decides it: an addition pays exactly when it is right more often than the cast already was on the queries it takes over. The comparison has nothing to fit, and measured on half of a new corpus it calls the other half correctly. $\textbf{ReCast}$ puts it to work with nothing fitted on data: a cast sheet of one running average per character, grown only where the page itself vouches for a crop. It recovers a third to two thirds of what perfect labels would, depending on whether the cast starts from random examples or from first appearances. Re:Cognize measures whether a model can read along; ReCast is a cast that does. Our claims are on identity maintenance, recognising characters already met; the emergence of new ones is measured as a diagnostic under a fixed reference rule, and we propose no method for it.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Re:Cognize评估协议与ReCast方法，研究漫画角色在阅读流中的开放集、序列化重识别与角色表自我维护。
AI.motivation: 漫画读者能在无角色表的情况下跨页识别角色，而现有识别评估通常依赖预先给定的闭合角色集，忽略了"边读边构建角色表"的开放集、序列化场景。
AI.method: Re:Cognize在单一查询流上设计四种协议，从闭合集检索到模型自行构建并增长角色表；据此诊断失败环节，提出接受判据（新增样本正确率高于被替换查询上的既有角色表表现时才接纳），并实现ReCast：每角色一个running average的cast sheet，仅在页面本身为裁剪提供佐证处增长，无需拟合。
AI.result: 识别本身接近解决：每角色一张参考图即可达到与预建gallery相当的水平；瓶颈在"相信什么"而非视觉。模型自行加入匹配会损害角色表，而同样增长若使用正确标签可提升20+点top-1。接受判据在新语料一半上测得的判断可正确预测另一半。ReCast可恢复完美标签收益的三分之一到三分之二（取决于初始化为随机样本还是首次登场）。
AI.conclusion: 识别瓶颈是样本接受而非视觉能力；仅需一次无需拟合的比较即可决定是否扩充角色表，ReCast以零数据拟合实现有效的角色表维护。主张限于已见角色的身份维持；新角色出现仅作为固定参考规则下的诊断指标，未提出相应方法。

title: Faithful Activation Verbalization: Reducing Hallucinations in LLM Representation Interpretation
summary: Activation verbalization methods such as Activation Oracle and Natural Language Autoencoders decode hidden representations of large language models into human-readable natural language. However, existing methods can produce incomplete or hallucinated descriptions, making their activation verbalizations difficult to trust and use reliably in practice. To this end, we introduce AVPO, a two-stage framework that first reconstructs source text from a hidden activation and then evaluates the resulting text with a separate frozen question-answering model, yielding an explicit and inspectable intermediate readout. We further optimize the inverter with direct preference optimization (DPO), using rewards that capture both semantic recoverability and lexical fidelity. Across six text families, AVPO improves gist- and detail-level information recovery over the strongest baseline by up to 17.1 and 9.3 percentage points, respectively. Crucially, the gains arise from preference optimization rather than fine-tuning on selected reconstructions alone, enabling compact cross-model inverters to surpass donor-matched question-conditioned verbalizers while improving both semantic recoverability and lexical fidelity. Moreover, out-of-distribution case study shows that AVPO better recovers high-level semantics while fabricating fewer details.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AVPO，一种两阶段激活言语化框架：先从隐藏激活重建源文本，再用独立冻结的问答模型评估重建结果，并通过DPO优化反演器，兼顾语义可恢复性与词汇保真度，在多个文本族上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有激活言语化方法（如Activation Oracle、自然语言自编码器）将大模型隐藏表示解码为自然语言时，会产生不完整或幻觉性描述，导致其激活言语化结果难以信任、难以可靠使用。因此需要一种具备显式、可检查中间读出结果的改进方法。
AI.method: AVPO为两阶段框架：第一阶段从隐藏激活重建源文本；第二阶段用单独冻结的问答模型评估重建文本，产生显式可检查的中间读出。进一步使用直接偏好优化（DPO）优化反演器，奖励同时捕捉语义可恢复性与词汇保真度。
AI.result: 在六类文本族上，AVPO相比最强基线在大意级和细节级信息恢复上分别提升最多17.1和9.3个百分点。增益来自偏好优化而非仅对选定重建结果的微调；使紧凑的跨模型反演器超越与供体匹配的问题条件化言语化器，并同时提升语义可恢复性与词汇保真度。分布外案例研究表明AVPO更好地恢复高层语义且编造更少细节。
AI.conclusion: AVPO通过两阶段重建-评估框架结合DPO偏好优化，有效缓解激活言语化的不完整与幻觉问题，提升语义与词汇层面的可靠性，并在跨模型和分布外场景中表现更优。

title: Conformal Factuality Control for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can ground large language models in external evidence, but retrieved context does not guarantee that generated claims are factually supported. This problem is especially relevant in multi-hop RAG, where retrieval and reasoning proceed through multiple dependent stages. We study whether claim-level conformal factuality control, previously developed for RAG, remains effective in this setting. We apply split-conformal claim filtering to multi-hop RAG and evaluate it on HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA using Llama 3.1 8B and GPT-4o-mini, together with a single-hop reference experiment. Across all six multi-hop model-dataset configurations, increasingly stringent conformal targets consistently increase the fraction of responses whose retained claims are fully supported. At the 95% target, this rate ranges from 95.80% to 97.20%, compared with 55.60%-76.03% without filtering. However, the improvement is strongly selective: only 4.41%-31.09% of generated claims are retained and 9.70%-51.40% of responses remain non-empty at the 95% target. These results show that conformal factuality extends to multi-hop RAG, while demonstrating that nominal reliability must be interpreted jointly with claim retention and abstention.

AI.tldr: 本文将面向RAG的claim-level保形事实性控制应用于多跳RAG，在HotpotQA、NQ、TriviaQA上以Llama 3.1 8B与GPT-4o-mini验证其有效性，发现高保形目标显著提升留存claim的支撑率，但代价是claim保留率与非空响应率大幅下降。
AI.motivation: RAG虽能引入外部证据，但检索到的上下文并不保证生成claim有事实支撑；在多跳RAG中检索与推理跨多个依赖阶段进行，该问题更突出。作者希望检验为RAG开发的claim-level保形事实性控制能否迁移到多跳场景。
AI.method: 对多跳RAG应用split-conformal claim filtering，在HotpotQA、Natural Questions、TriviaQA三个数据集上，使用Llama 3.1 8B和GPT-4o-mini两个模型进行评估，并设置单跳参照实验，共六个多跳模型-数据集配置。
AI.result: 在所有六个配置中，保形目标越严格，留存claim完全被支撑的响应比例越高。95%目标下该比例为95.80%-97.20%，而未经筛选时为55.60%-76.03%。但提升具有强选择性：95%目标下仅4.41%-31.09%的生成claim被保留，仅9.70%-51.40%的响应保持非空。
AI.conclusion: 保形事实性控制可扩展至多跳RAG，但名义可靠性必须结合claim保留率与弃答率共同解读，高支撑率往往以大量claim被过滤和响应被清空为代价。

title: 3D Point Tracking with State Space Models
comment: 20 pages, 11 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to Computer Vision and Image Understanding
summary: Tracking any point of a dynamic scene in metric 3D - in absolute meters, not up to an unknown scale - underpins 3D and 4D reconstruction, robot navigation, and autonomous driving, where decisions are made in meters, not pixels. Our objective is a 3D point tracker accurate in those absolute terms and operating within a single commodity GPU, pose-free, monocular budget. Our method rests on one observation: once a point's 2D image trajectory is fixed, the quantity that governs its metric accuracy is the depth along its pixel ray. Rather than learning tracking end-to-end, we therefore compose two frozen front-ends - dense optical flow for 2D correspondence and a monocular metric-depth network for the third dimension - and learn only the residual they cannot supply: that depth, refined by a compact state space model (Mamba-3) conditioned on appearance features (DINOv3). A state space model rather than the transformers the strongest 3D trackers adopt is what makes a single-GPU budget attainable: it summarises a track in a fixed-size recurrent state whose memory cost is constant in the number of frames, whereas attention requires a key-value cache that grows linearly with them. On the TAPVid-3D minival benchmark our best configuration attains the highest absolute metric accuracy among methods evaluated under identical conditions (mean metric Average Jaccard, 0.256), exceeding strong feed-forward trackers, while a companion analysis, reproduced with each competitor's own evaluator, explains why several published trackers lose most of their accuracy under this budget.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种在单块消费级GPU、无位姿、单目条件下运行的度量3D点跟踪方法：固定光流与单目度量深度前端，仅用Mamba-3状态空间模型结合DINOv3特征学习残差深度，在TAPVid-3D minival上取得最高绝对度量精度（Average Jaccard 0.256）。
AI.motivation: 机器人导航、自动驾驶与3D/4D重建需要在绝对米制下决策，而现有3D点跟踪器多依赖未知尺度的相对深度或重型Transformer，难以在单卡GPU预算内保持度量精度。作者旨在实现绝对米制、无位姿、单目、单GPU可用的高精度3D点跟踪。
AI.method: 核心观察：2D图像轨迹固定后，决定度量精度的是像素射线上的深度。方法不端到端学习跟踪，而是组合两个冻结前端——稠密光流提供2D对应、单目度量深度网络提供第三维——仅学习其无法提供的残差深度。残差由紧凑的状态空间模型Mamba-3在DINOv3外观特征条件下进行细化。采用状态空间模型而非Transformer是因为其以固定大小循环状态概括轨迹，内存开销随帧数恒定，而注意力需要随帧数线性增长的KV缓存。
AI.result: 在TAPVid-3D minival基准上，最佳配置在相同条件下取得最高绝对度量精度（mean metric Average Jaccard 0.256），超过强前馈跟踪器；配套分析用各竞争方法自身的评估器复现，解释了为何若干已发表跟踪器在该预算下损失大部分精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过冻结前端加轻量状态空间残差细化，可在单块消费级GPU、无位姿、单目预算下实现高精度绝对米制3D点跟踪，验证了以固定内存代价的SSM替代Transformer注意力在该任务上的有效性。
